store_data.about_the_game:
Gridlock is a daily block puzzle challenge where every player gets the exact same pieces. Place blocks on a 9×9 grid, complete rows, columns, or 3×3 squares to clear them, and rack up the highest score before you run out of space.

HOW IT WORKS

- Drag and drop block shapes onto the 9×9 grid

- Fill a complete row, column, or 3×3 square to clear it

- Build combos by clearing lines on consecutive placements

- Game ends when no pieces can fit — you're gridlocked!

DAILY CHALLENGE

Every day, all players receive the same sequence of pieces. You get one shot — plan carefully, compete on the global leaderboard, and see how you stack up.

FREE PLAY

Practice anytime with random pieces. Beat your personal best and sharpen your strategy for the daily challenge. Watch an ad to get a second chance with new pieces!

FEATURES

- Daily puzzle with shared global leaderboard

- Free play mode with local high score tracking

- 3 ways to clear: rows, columns, and 3×3 squares

- Google Play Games achievements and leaderboard

- Combo scoring system rewards consecutive clears

- Clean, minimal design with satisfying clear animations

- Haptic feedback and sound effects

- Watch ads for a second chance in free play

store_data.about_the_game:
The seasons have stopped. To survive, humanity relies on a mysterious power known as Terra Stone. But every great power comes with a price.

After awakening to a mysterious power, you are forced to leave your village and begin the life of a wanderer. Hunt monsters, collect powerful loot, challenge stronger enemies, and uncover the truth behind Terra Stone and the world itself.

Features

  • Fast-Paced Progression and Endless Hunting
    Hunt monsters, level up, and challenge increasingly dangerous regions and bosses.

  • Randomized Loot
    Every piece of equipment comes with random stats. Even low-tier gear can become powerful with the right combination of bonuses.

  • Build Your Own Playstyle
    Create your own combat style using Attack, Defense, HP, Armor Penetration, and a wide variety of skills.

  • A World That Grows More Dangerous
    Explore Mujin's Farm, the Wildlands, abandoned caves, and other dangerous regions filled with ever stronger monsters.

  • Hidden Truths
    Uncover the mystery of your missing father, the secrets of Terra Stone, and the traces of the Harvest.

  • Current Version Content
    The current version includes content up to level 60, with multiple regions, bosses, equipment, and skills already implemented. Future updates are planned to expand the game to level 99 with new areas, story content, skills, and items.

store_data.about_the_game:
Core Objective

The player controls a yellow tank (Player 1) and/or a green tank (Player 2) to defend the red flag located at the bottom of the level from being destroyed by enemy tanks. Each level requires destroying all 20 enemy tanks while avoiding the destruction of the player's own tank(s). The game features 99 standard levels.

Game Feature:

Fully Randomized Maps, Keeping the Gameplay Fresh Every Time.

Notes:

Local multiplayer requires a controller.

Cooperation and Competition

  • True Cooperation:​ Must jointly defend the base; success and failure are shared.

  • Resource Management:​ Strategic communication is required for distributing power-ups.

  • Tactical Coordination:​ Tactics like "Bait and Ambush" or "Flanking Maneuvers" can be employed.

  • Score Competition:​ Maintains individual score competition even within cooperation.

Classic Strategies

  • "Goalie" Tactic:​ One player defends the base, the other takes the offensive.

  • Power-up Control:​ Negotiating who picks up key items.

  • Respawn Protection:​ Protecting a teammate who has just respawned.

  • Terrain Modification:​ Coordinating to create advantageous paths.

Controls and Actions

  • Movement:​ Control the tank's movement in four directions.

  • Firing:​ Shoot bullets to attack enemies or destroy terrain.

  • Strategy:​ Requires smart use of terrain for cover and predicting enemy movement patterns.

Enemy Tank System

The game features four basic enemy tank types, each with distinct visual identifiers and behavioral patterns:

  • Basic Tank:​ Standard speed for movement and bullet fire.

  • Fast Tank:​ High movement speed.

  • Rapid-Fire Tank:​ High rate of fire.

  • Armored Tank:​ Features armor, fast bullet speed, and slightly slower movement.

Power-up System

Destroying a flashing tank drops a power-up. Touching it grants the following enhancements:

  • Fortify Base:​ Temporarily transforms the base walls into steel.

  • Increase Firepower (Up to 3 Levels):

    • Level 1:​ Standard bullet, slow firing rate.

    • Level 2:​ Fast firing rate, capable of rapid shots.

    • Level 3:​ Maximum firing rate, highest burst shot capacity, can destroy steel blocks.

  • Airstrike:​ Instantly destroys all current enemy tanks on screen.

  • Freeze:​ Temporarily halts all enemy tanks.

  • Extra Life:​ Awards one additional life.

  • Temporary Invincibility:​ Grants a short period of invulnerability.

Terrain Interaction System

Features a variety of terrain types with distinct properties:

  • Bricks:​ Can be destroyed by bullets.

  • Steel:​ Cannot be destroyed by standard bullets.

  • Water:​ Tanks cannot traverse, but bullets can pass over it.

  • Forest:​ Conceals tanks and bullets from view.

  • Ice:​ Tanks slide with momentum when moving.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Keytox Project follows Anthony as he attempts to turn his life around after being evicted from his apartment. He takes a job at a sketchy government program, becoming one of the first people up in space, along with his partner, Will. Their job is to hunt down dangerous alien lifeforms to ensure the safety of the human race. But what they discover outside of Earth's thin atmosphere is far deeper than originally planned.

Chapter 1 features the simple story of Anthony's character. His motives. And who/ what makes him the way he is? The demo version of the first chapter is a simpler and easier-to-pick-up version of our full story, but it is chock-full of extra secrets and branching dialogue based on your choices. It serves as a great entry point to the story, and we hope you feel the same.

In The Keytox Project, your questions matter. Every decision you make could lead to uncovering an even deeper mystery. The game is full of hidden details and pop-culture references that come together to make a comedic, yet emotionally grounded and gritty storyline. 

FAQ:

q: Is Chapter 1 only available as a demo?

  a: No. The first chapter will be available in the full game when it releases.

q: When is Chapter 2 coming out?

  a: The game works on a chapter system to help our developers meet deadlines. We aren't completely sure when it will be released, but we can say for sure it will be in 2026.

q: How much will the game cost?

  a: As cheap as we can reasonably justify. Somewhere between 5 and 10 bucks for the first book.

q: Do I have to buy all of the chapters individually? Or will the price increase over time?

  a: All of the chapters will be available through free updates after you purchase the game. Though after the first "Book" is completed, expect a few dollars price increase to compensate for all the additional content.

store_data.about_the_game:
Visual novel: Dashing 90s — a text-based interactive drama about a young man who came to the big city for an education, but faces a very different kind of challenge.

Andrey is an ordinary prospective student from the provinces. His goal is simple: to enroll in a polytechnic institute and start a new life. But temporary housing in a communal apartment becomes the main test. Here, each neighbor has their own truth, their own interests, and their own ways of surviving.

Speculator Ninka returns from Turkey with contraband and offers quick money for one favor. Alcoholic Kolya asks to go get vodka, hinting that refusal will be costly. Actress Larisa invites him to a midnight cemetery for a "ritual." An old friend, Kostyan, offers to drive his car, supposedly legally. A stranger asks to be escorted through a dark archway. And Kostya, nicknamed Turnip, the neighbor's son, returns from prison. He believes he is the only one in charge in this apartment. Every day, Andrei makes a choice: agree and receive money, connections, and support—but risk his freedom and life. Or refuse and be left alone to face hostility, suspicion, and threats. One agreement can lead to prison, the hospital, or the grave. One refusal can make him an outcast, but leave a chance to pass his exams.

The story branches into dozens of endings: from successful admission to a maximum-security prison colony. The atmosphere of 1990s communal life, the criminal underworld, moral dilemmas, and the cost of every decision—all of this determines the protagonist's fate.

Will Andrei be able to overcome these trials and preserve himself?

Atmospheric soundtracks—a variety of musical tracks that immerse him in the atmosphere of the 1990s and heighten the tension of each scene.

A branching plot—multiple twists and endings: from triumph to tragedy, every decision changes the protagonist's fate.

A system of moral choices—there are no right answers, only consequences. The authentic atmosphere of the era – everyday life, language, and the realities of communal life in the 1990s.

store_data.about_the_game:
AGI Developer is a clicker/incremental game themed around AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) development.

Start by clicking furiously to write code and accumulate research points. You can also hire researchers to do the research for you. Spend your research points to unlock the tech tree and streamline your development.

Purchasing GPUs advances the training of your foundation model. The foundation model generates revenue based on its performance.

Training a foundation model requires massive computational resources and power. By building data centers and power plants, you can create even more powerful AI. Eventually, you'll venture into space, aiming to build a Kardashev Scale Type III galactic civilization.

store_data.about_the_game:
Synopsis

Subsuelo is a survival horror game where you step into the shoes of a young aspiring Argentine journalist, determined to make a name for himself in the profession. The opportunity arrives unexpectedly: an acquaintance calls you urgently to tell you that, during some construction work, they have discovered a mysterious facility from the 70s of which there is no record.

What happened there? Why has it remained hidden for so long?

Driven by ambition and curiosity, you don't hesitate for a second. As a player, you risk everything, even your own life, to enter that forgotten place and unravel its secrets, in what could become the opportunity of a lifetime.

Features:

  • Use firearms and melee weapons to defend yourself.

  • Jumpscares and events that will give you goosebumps.

  • Intelligent enemies that will stalk you at all times.

  • Puzzles and mini-games that you must solve to progress.

  • Inventory management—don't let go of anything that might be useful later.

Subsuelo is an Argentine video game developed by a single person that invites you to discover an alternative history of the events that occurred between 1976 and 1983 in a fictional facility where the government sought to create the ultimate weapon to win the war.

From the humble fields of Saint Village to the eternal frost of the Icebound Forest; from the untamed wilds of Aster Forest to the crashing tides of Isle of Poseidon—the world is yours to command. Join us now and embark on an epic Soul Land adventure fueled by passion and glory!

Even identical cards can function differently depending on the stickers they carry.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE CALL BUTTON

A short, observation-based psychological thriller. You are trapped in a constantly changing hospital room. Your only way out: memorize your surroundings, spot the terrifying anomalies and survive the loop. But survive long enough, and you must face your nightmares. Why did you steal the intel? What was it?

Gameplay

Every day, you wake up in the exact same room. Memorize the original room and see if there have been any alarming changes today. There are no fights, and nowhere for you to hide...

You have two choices:

  • Take your medication if you spot an anomaly.

  • Hit the call button for your daily check-in if you're sure the room is safe.

Face Your Interrogation

Every few days, you get nightmares. Sit across the table from your former HR director in surreal, interactive nightmare sequences. Relive your career, your mistakes, and the corporate espionage that put you in this hospital bed.

Key Features

  • Playable Prologue: Experience the incident. Start a seemingly normal shift at the office and steal the secret information that seals your fate.

  • Spot the Differences: Survive 11 days of escalating terror, featuring over 50 unpredictable anomalies.

  • Story Nightmares: Relive past events and past mistakes in interactive nightmare sequences, guided by a cold HR executive. Why are these memories appearing?

  • Multiple Endings: The game features 2 endings based on your choices.

Please note: „The Call Button“ is currently under active development. Its graphics, mechanics, and features are subject to change prior to the final release.

store_data.about_the_game:
Offroad Frontiers is an off-road driving experience that combines realistic vehicle physics with vast, immersive environments designed for exploration, challenge, and freedom.

Drive your favorite 4x4 vehicle and push it to the limit across different terrains. From dense Colorado mountain forests and deep mud trails to Nevada scorching deserts, Alaskan ice roads and Utah spectacular Canyons.

Every surface reacts dynamically to your vehicle setup, demanding skill, strategy and precision to overcome nature's toughest obstacles.

Built with a focus on authenticity and player immersion, Offroad Frontiers delivers a driving experience where traction, weight, suspension, and terrain all play a critical role.

Whether climbing steep rocky paths, navigating flooded routes, or escaping deep mud, every decision matters.

The game offers a flexible experience that caters to both simulation enthusiasts and players looking for a more relaxed exploration style.

Engage in structured missions such as recovery operations, deliveries, and time challenges, or freely explore expansive environments at your own pace.

Features:

-Open World Maps

-Navigate deep mud with realistic deformation

-Climb rocky trails and unstable slopes

-Rivers and lakes with water deformation

-Trailer Towing

-Vehicle recovery

-15+ 4x4 Off-Road Vehicles

-4×4 SUVs built for exploration

-Heavy-duty pickup trucks for towing and power

-Classic off-roaders with raw mechanical feel

-Fully equipped expedition vehicles

-Detailed Vehicle customization

-Online Multiplayer

-Dynamic Weather with Day, Night and Sunset

-Authentic environments with wildlife and natural obstacles

Explore diverse, handcrafted maps inspired by real-world locations:

🌲 Forest & Wetlands

Dense forests filled with mud traps, rivers, and hidden paths. Visibility is low, traction is worse.

🏜️ Desert

Wide open spaces with soft sand, rocky canyons, and extreme heat conditions. Momentum is key.

🏔️ Canyon & Rocky Terrain

store_data.about_the_game:
Rise from a street-level thug to a key player in the ruthless underworld. You proved your worth by executing high-stakes assassinations for the Baron and his council, earning your very own casino as a reward. But this glamorous new life shattered into a dark nightmare on opening night. A rival boss orchestrated a brutal hit on your establishment, leaving your sister dead in your arms.

  Now, left with nothing but a rundown underground warehouse, your mission is clear: Transform this dump into the city's most profitable secret casino, earn the big Baron's respect, and exact your brutal revenge on the man who took your sister!

                       

                      

  Nothing in your casino happens by chance. Where you place each slot machine and the layout of your tables directly impact your earnings. While you customize the colors and look to fit your style, you must balance various dynamic factors that determine customer satisfaction and profit margins. Turn a rundown dump into a highly lucrative empire. Hire waitstaff, manage chip cashiers, and constantly expand your operation.

                       

                      

  Your phone could ring at any moment. Deal with unexpected crises, special VIPs, and thugs trying to shake down your joint. Step behind the counter when needed, but always be ready to draw your weapon, defend your turf, and pull the trigger without hesitation.

                       

                      

  This isn't a legitimate business. You need to find a way to wash the massive off-the-books income you generate underground. Keep your surface-level "car wash" front operational. Wash cars daily to avoid suspicion and keep up the appearance of an ordinary local business. Launder your dirty money to fund your criminal empire and rise to the top.

                       

                      

  The local mafia always wants their cut and will knock on your door every day. However, their respect for your ruthless past offers a unique opportunity. Visit the mafia's own shooting range and show them your skills haven't faded. Based on the score you achieve at the range, they will grant you a discount on your daily tribute out of respect for the old days. Shoot straight, prove your lethality, and protect your vault!

                       

  • Control the Payouts: Adjust the win/loss rates of your slot machines. Let the customers win occasionally to keep them hooked, but always ensure the house wins in the end.

  • Deep Customization: Design every detail of your casino, from wall paint to carpet colors, to match your personal style.

  • Hands-on Management: Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty early on; take out the trash and personally serve your customers when needed.

  • Staff & Talent Management: Delegate the daily grind as you grow. Hire waiters, cashiers, security guards, and highly skilled dealers to automate the operation and run your empire like a true boss.

  • Financial Strategy: Take out bank loans to survive crises or to fund your next big expansion.

  • Auction System: Participate in secret auctions via your smartphone to acquire rare items for your establishment.

  • Comprehensive Upgrades: Upgrade every piece of equipment, machine, and furniture to multiply your daily earnings.

  • Underground Atmosphere Control: Since your joint is underground, you must carefully manage the ventilation, oxygen levels, and temperature to keep your customers comfortable.

  • Camera & Intel: Snap photos with the in-game camera and send them to your contacts to trigger events and unlock new opportunities.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Night Walk is a quiet, first‑person journey through a vast moonlit park — a place where the world falls away, the air is cold, and your thoughts finally have room to breathe.

There is no story to chase, no puzzles to solve, no pressure to perform. You simply walk. And as you do, your mind begins to drift, settle, and slowly find clarity.

The park offers several branching paths, each reflecting a different emotional direction — letting go, hoping, or simply being with yourself. These aren’t “choices” in the traditional game sense, but gentle shifts in mood and intention. Each path shapes the tone of your walk, the density of the trees, the openness of the sky, and the feeling of the world around you.

The Night Walk is not about reaching an ending. It’s about giving yourself the space to arrive.

A quiet, reflective night walk

Move at your own pace through a vast moonlit park designed for stillness, clarity, and emotional breathing room.

Three emotional routes to choose from

Follow paths shaped by different states of mind — letting go, hoping, or simply being — each with its own atmosphere and pacing.

No goals, no pressure, no fail states

Just walking, thinking, and letting the world meet you where you are.

A painterly, dream‑logic world

Fog, silhouettes, moonlight, and sparse lighting create a surreal nighttime landscape that feels both familiar and otherworldly.

A deeply personal first‑person perspective

Experience the walk through your own eyes — footsteps on gravel, cold air, shifting thoughts, and quiet moments of clarity.

Minimalist design focused on emotion

No HUD, no dialogue, no distractions — just space to breathe and a world that gently responds to your choices.

A short, replayable experience

Each route offers a different emotional arc, encouraging multiple walks depending on what you need in the moment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shop of Deals is not just a shop management game.
It’s a story about taking risks, reading people, and living with the consequences of every decision.

There’s no big team, no massive budget. Just a simple idea:
“What if you ran a shop… but every customer brought a story with them?”

🔫 One shop, hundreds of stories

Every customer who walks into your shop is different.
Some are desperate for cash, some try to trick you.
Some don’t even know what they’re selling… and some know more than you do.

You negotiate with all of them.
But this isn’t just about price.

  • Will you trust them?

  • Will you take the risk?

  • Or will you manipulate them?

Sometimes, the “right” decision is not the most profitable one.

💰 Negotiation system (real decisions)

This is the heart of the game.

Every offer feels like a battle:

  • Go too low, the customer walks away

  • Go too high, you lose money

  • Finding the perfect middle… isn’t always possible

And yes… sometimes even a reasonable offer gets rejected.
Because the person in front of you isn’t a machine.

⚠️ Risk system

Every deal has consequences.

  • Suspicious customers → increase risk

  • High-value but “dirty” items → increase risk

  • Greed → increases risk

When risk reaches 100%…

The police knock on your door.

And in that moment:

  • Will you pay the fine?

  • Will you bribe them?

  • Or risk losing everything?

🧠 Deep but understandable systems

The game has many systems, but they all serve one thing:
making decisions.

  • Inventory management

  • Item condition & rarity

  • Repair system

  • Customer types

  • Daily events

  • Suspicion / risk balance

Each day starts small… but things can quickly spiral out of control.

🖤 Final words

This is not a “get rich” game.
This is a balance game.

Between money, risk, and conscience.

And sometimes…
the best deal is the one you never make.

store_data.about_the_game:
1. Top Hook

End Days of Alpha A gripping post-apocalyptic BL visual novel where survival meets forbidden romance. Fight zombies, scavenge resources, and fall in love with rugged survivors in a world gone to hell. Multiple endings, steamy 18+ scenes, and deep emotional bonds await.

In the ruins of civilization, You must choose who to trust... and who to love. Will you build a future with one man, or let passion ignite in the chaos?

2. Story Overview

The world ended in screams and silence. Cities fell, the infected rose, and humanity's remnants fight daily just to see tomorrow.

You play as a resourceful survivor with a mysterious past, scavenging through abandoned zones while evading hordes. But survival isn't just about food and ammo—it's about connection in a world that tries to strip it away.

This BL visual novel features:

  • Branching narratives with 2–5 romance routes (depending on stretch goals)

  • Choices that affect relationships, endings, and survival

  • Mature 18+ content: explicit scenes tied to emotional development

3. Core Features & Base Game

  • Full single-player story (~5-15 hours playtime, multiple replays)

  • 2 core romanceable characters at launch:

  • Rugged leader: protective, brooding, intense loyalty route

  • Sharp sniper: cynical, teasing, slow-burn trust build

  • Lone wanderer: mysterious, dominant, high-tension passion

  • Multiple endings: from tragic to hopeful (including poly hints)

  • High-quality CGs, sprites, backgrounds, and soundtrack

4. Characters

5. AI Disclosure

Some CG artwork generated with AI and manually refined by humans. Text proofread with AI assistance. All final content human-reviewed. No AI in core mechanics or narrative.

store_data.about_the_game:
Syira and Huimin once made a wish to a banana tree spirit. It was a silly, childish ritual they had found on a blog. They wished to stay best friends forever. Except that Syira wished…

“I wished she would be mine.”

Years later, it turns out whatever demon or spirit they had spoken to doesn’t grant wishes. Huimin has been seeing a boyfriend for five years and they’ve even booked out a chalet to celebrate their anniversary. Syira’s wish might as well be a joke.

Until a frantic phone call arrives in the middle of the night — a lover’s quarrel had turned violent. Huimin begs Syira for help and slowly, a dark and malicious desire begins to take root in her head. 

Maybe the spirit does listen after all.

Game features:

  • 2 Bad endings to explore your darkest desires

  • 3 full CGs and 15 partial CGs

  • About 15-20 minutes of gameplay with 7k words

Note: Syira pronounced as "Shi-rah" or "Si-rah"(Arabic/Malay name) and Huimin pronounced as "Hwee-min" (Chinese name). FYI This is based on how I know them pronounced in Singapore, so it may vary for other regions!

Italian translation by Marianna Ricciardi, accesible through 'Preferences' menu.

WELCOME TO THE JACKPOT COLOSSEUM You aren't fighting with swords; you're fighting with cold, hard luck.

Jackpot Colosseum is an addictive arcade roguelike where you construct a custom slot machine to obliterate waves of cartoonish enemies. Spin to generate wealth, deal damage, and trigger chaotic chain reactions.

BUILD YOUR MACHINE (DECKBUILDING EVOLVED) Every time you survive a wave, you draft new symbols to add to your reels. Will you build a heavy-hitting revolver build, a gold-generating economy engine, or a magical fruit combo? The synergies are completely up to you.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Addictive Slot Mechanics: Draft, upgrade, and optimize your reels to trigger massive chain reactions.

  • Deep Synergies: Combine dozens of unique symbols that interact with each other for game-breaking combos.

  • Bite-Sized Runs: Fast, chaotic combat loops perfect for quick sessions or "just one more run" binges.

  • Climb the Ranks: Survive the brutal waves of the Colosseum and prove your machine is the ultimate champion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a party. Stack the deck. Survive the dungeon.

Golgothian is a party-based deckbuilding dungeon crawler for 1-2 players. Assemble a three-hero party, choose class passives, build a shared battle deck, and fight your way through a cursed dungeon full of battles, events, loot, and hard choices.

Play the demo to try the current dungeon-crawling loop while Golgothian continues development.

Playable Demo / Development Status

Golgothian is currently in development and is not yet available for purchase. The playable demo is a preview of the core dungeon-crawling loop: party setup, card-based combat, branching routes, loot, shops, events, rest sites, survivor progression, solo play, and co-op.

The demo is not content-complete and does not represent the final scope of the game. Expect balance changes, UI improvements, new cards, enemies, dungeon content, audio, progression updates, and general polish as development continues.

Every run asks the same brutal question: who gets the card, who carries the gear, which room is worth the risk, and can your party survive one more fight?

Plan the Round, Then Commit

Each round begins with planning. Queue cards for your heroes, read enemy intent, set up attacks, blocks, healing, buffs, and status effects, then submit your choices and watch the round resolve.

Your Warrior, Mage, and Priest all draw from the same evolving deck, so every reward changes how the whole party fights.

Cards are not just attacks and defenses. They can carry class identity, styles, upgrades, and combo potential as your party grows.

Discover Class Combos

The right cards can combine into stronger effects when your heroes act together. Pair a Warrior strike with Mage ice magic to trigger Frozen Shatter, protect the party before a dangerous enemy turn, or build around buffs, healing, and elemental pressure.

Combos are discovered and recorded as you play, turning every dungeon run into both a battle and a growing tactical library.

Shape the Party Before the First Room

Your run starts before combat begins. Choose passives, starting cards, and roles for each hero. Build a defensive front line, a spell-heavy burst party, a sustain-focused team, or a strange hybrid that only works if the deck cooperates.

Unlocks expand your options over time, giving veteran players more ways to tune the opening party.

Choose Your Path Through the Dungeon

Each run is built from branching dungeon routes filled with fights, elite battles, bosses, shops, events, chests, and rest sites. Take the safer route to recover, chase rewards through danger, or gamble on one more room before the next major fight.

Loot, Upgrade, and Carry What Survives

Victories award gold, cards, equipment, and packs. Gear changes individual heroes, while cards reshape the shared deck. Surviving characters can carry equipment and history forward, but death has teeth: fallen heroes and their gear are at risk unless you can recover them.

Spend, Equip, and Adapt

Between battles, shops and events give you chances to tune the run. Buy cards, equip gear, sell dead weight, stock up on packs, or take event rewards that change the shape of your dungeon crawl.

Original Soundtrack

Delve through the dungeon with an original soundtrack built for tense fights, strange rooms, and the slow pressure of a run going wrong.

Playable Solo or Co-op

Golgothian is fully playable solo and also supports Steam and LAN co-op. In co-op, players split control of the party, plan turns together, and manage rewards as the dungeon gets worse in all the interesting ways.

Key Features

  •  Playable demo available while the full game continues development

  •  Party-based deckbuilding with Warrior, Mage, and Priest roles

  •  A shared deck shaped by class cards, rewards, gear, and packs

  •  Queued turn-based combat with enemy intent and tactical timing

  •  Discoverable class combos across party members

  •  Branching dungeon routes with fights, bosses, shops, events, chests, and rest sites

  •  Persistent unlocks, survivor progression, and carried gear

  •  Original soundtrack built for dungeon crawling, tactical battles, and grim fantasy atmosphere

  •  Solo play, Steam co-op, and LAN co-op

store_data.about_the_game:
Grillhouse Protocol is a chaotic 1-8 player co-op stealth game where you take on the role of barnyard animals rebelling against their owner. The win condition is simple: study the level blueprint, find the necessary items, use them correctly, and rescue the caged animals. Sounds easy? Try doing it while the local farmer patrols the area and is already firing up his grill!

Escape Plan: Find and Flee

A successful escape requires coordinated teamwork. On each level, you have a blueprint: what items to find and how to combine them. Move through the location stealthily, gather your inventory, and stay out of the owner's sight. If the farmer spots you, drop everything and run, using cover and the terrain to shake off your pursuer.

20 Seconds to a Sausage Finale

If the hunter does catch up to you, the game isn't over. The farmer grabs the poor soul by the legs and carries them to one of the prep stations: a BBQ spit, a circular saw, or a meat hook in the freezer. Your teammates have exactly 20 seconds to come to the rescue and save you. Didn't make it? Your buddy turns into a pack of sausages forever!

Cunning Retaliation

You are not completely defenseless victims! Use your wits and the environment to delay the farmer. Set bear traps, short-circuit electric puddles, drop heavy objects on his head, or even set him on fire. The farmer cannot be killed, but a successful sabotage will knock him out of action for a while, allowing the team to finish their tasks.

Ticket to Freedom

Once all the items from the plan are gathered and used correctly, it's time to bail. The escape method depends on the specific level: you might have to start an old tractor, open blocked gates, or find a secret tunnel. As soon as the path is clear, grab your friends and run for it before the farm owner comes to his senses!

store_data.about_the_game:
Blast your way to victory in an arcade defence shooter about protecting your Starbase from a never ending horde of opposing ships. Each with its own way of trying to break your precious platform. Destroy your enemies in storms of bright colourful explosions and sprays of bullets before they reach you and annihilate your Starbase.

Multiple Weapons

Select from a variety of different weapons each with a unique playstyle. The generic Burst Rifle for that classic feel. The heavy Rocket Launcher, powerful, explosive but limited in ammo or the more unique Mine Lobber, laying dozens of small explosive traps for the unwary enemy.

Utilities

Along with your weaponry the Starbase is equipped with powerful Utility tools. Deploy a rapid-firing auto-turret system to track and destroy nearby enemies, unleash the Electrofield to fry enemy systems as they approach, or activate the Shield Generator—because sometimes the best offense is a strong defense.

Waves and Rewards

With each wave, enemy ships will fly towards your Starbase in their aim to destroy it. It begins with small groups, becoming dozens, before finally becoming overwhelming hordes. After clearing a wave, you select a Starbase upgrade permenantly powering up your Weapons or Utilities - At least until you finally crumble under the endless foes.

Unlockables

By defeating several waves of enemies you gain an Unlockable. These are bonuses that you persist between runs, they come in a variety of types, new weapons, new powerful upgrades, a special ability for your Weapons, or a function adding upgrade for your Utilities.

Features

  • 9 Weapon Options

  • Over 200 rewards

  • Turrets

  • Drones

  • Weapon Special Abilities

  • Bouncing Bullets

  • Exploding Bullets

  • Homing Bouncing Exploding Bullets

  • Lasers

Your ultimate goal: complete the entire bestiary, master your board layout, and collect every monster girl along with her full set of art.​

Rearrange your creatures at will to maximize efficiency.

Face increasingly dangerous waves of enemies, culminating in brutal bosses. Combine automatic and active skills to create devastating combos — melee, ranged, area or single-target.

Build Your Way

32 skills split between physical and magical. Equipment with damage bonuses and trophies with unique effects. Each hero has an exclusive passive that defines their playstyle. The Blacksmith transmutes your gear to adapt to any strategy.

Preparation Room

Between each wave, visit the Merchant to buy equipment and trophies, or the Blacksmith to transmute your items. Gear up before facing the next challenge.

Permanent Progression

Ashes collected during runs unlock upgrades at the Altar that persist between matches. The more you play, the stronger your next hero starts.

Multiple Heroes

Each hero has a unique starting skill, passive and stats — from brutal berserkers to arcane sorceresses. Find the one that fits your style.

store_data.about_the_game:
A BBQ with friends. What could possibly go wrong?

Barbecue is a co-op party game for 1 to 4 players.

Your mission is simple: host a barbecue in your backyard. Reality will be quite different.

Light the fire, grill the meat, serve your guests and earn money to upgrade your setup.

Everything starts peacefully. It only takes a few minutes for things to spiral out of control. The fire rages, smoke fills the yard, and someone is already sprinting toward the shop in a panic.

Manage the fire (or don't)

Wood, charcoal, gasoline — each fuel has its perks and its risks.

  • Too much wood? Wildfire.

  • Too much charcoal? Toxic smoke.

  • A splash of gasoline to speed things up? ...Hope your insurance is up to date.

Cook, sell, upgrade

Grill sausages, merguez and steaks to earn money.

Invest in better equipment or blow it all on completely useless items.

No judgment.

Cross the road (if you dare)

The shop is on the other side. The problem? The road. Traffic doesn't stop for you.

Run, dodge, pray.

Sun goes down, chaos goes up

A day/night cycle changes the rules.

At night, you're grilling in the dark, the road becomes a nightmare, and the guests aren't any more patient.

Buy some lamps. Or don't.

Beer, trolling and sausage resurrection

  • Drink beers — your controls won't thank you.

  • Hose down your friends mid-cook with the garden hose.

  • Friend down? Revive them by shoving a sausage in their mouth.

Built to last

No unfair game over.

The goal? Keep the party going as long as possible.

The shop catalogue is packed with items to unlock, making every session different. And when everything burns down? It's not a failure. It's the best part of the night.

Barbecue — The only game where burning the house down is the highlight of the evening.

store_data.about_the_game:
Help discover novel and chimeric pathogens and treat the strange, sometimes horrifying, infectious diseases they produce.

Examine and test patients for common and novel infections using sophisticated medical instrumentation and disinfection procedures. All infected patients must be sent to the isolation ward for further evaluation and treatment. Rumors of mysterious diseases and human experimentation are unconfirmed.

The soft-ware initially presents information about SYMPTOMS OF INFECTION.

This presentation is crucial to approach the initial phase of DIAGNOSIS, TESTING and DISPOSITION:

During DIAGNOSIS,

  • Examine the patient visually

  • Interview them

  • Run tests

During TESTING,

  • Allow the LAM-ORB Mainframe to process tests

  • Initially users of the soft-ware will be of low-priority to the Mainframe

  • You may request to EXPEDITE processing to the Mainframe, every click counts

During DISPOSITION,

  • Make sure you identify all SYMPTOMS OF INFECTION

  • Make sure you indicate the finding of infectious patterns or pathogens in the tests

ATTENTION: Some patients may present comorbidities or symptoms that not necessesarily represent an underlying disease.

The ISOLATION WARD

Every and all infected patients, no matter the nature of their infection, must be held in the ISOLATION WARD for further evaluation and treatment.

While common infections like bacterial ones are widely understood and well-know across both the medical field and the world population, some infectious pathogens and diseases remain unknown.

And while the discovery of new pathogens and diseases is by itself of major relevance to public healthcare; a small fraction of unknown, sometimes horrifying, infectious pathogens and diseases are studied in the background by both public and private institutions like LAM-ORB.

Second Phase: DISINFECTION PROCEDURE

When the ISOLATION WARD reaches full capacity, a DISINFECTION PROCEDURE is scheduled. Full information of the disease and treatment indications are given, and the procedure is performed on the patient.

LAM-ORB

The soft-ware tries to emulate as close as possible the experience, technology, and findings of the LAM-ORB organization's research during the 1970s. Rumors about the reason of the sudden disappearance of the organization include human experimentation, chimeric pathogen development, and secret medical research.

Characteristics

Display: 160x160 pixels, selected 4-color palettes

Audio: 2 pulse wave channels, 1 triangle wave channel, 1 noise channel

State: Load and Save progress

  • You may request to EXPEDITE processing to the Mainframe, every click counts

During DISPOSITION,

  • Make sure you identify all SYMPTOMS OF INFECTION

  • Make sure you indicate the finding of infectious patterns or pathogens in the tests

ATTENTION: Some patients may present comorbidities or symptoms that not necessesarily represent an underlying disease.

The ISOLATION WARD

Every and all infected patients, no matter the nature of their infection, must be held in the ISOLATION WARD for further evaluation and treatment.

While common infections like bacterial ones are widely understood and well-know across both the medical field and the world population, some infectious pathogens and diseases remain unknown.

And while the discovery of new pathogens and diseases is by itself of major relevance to public healthcare; a small fraction of unknown, sometimes horrifying, infectious pathogens and diseases are studied in the background by both public and private institutions like LAM-ORB.

Second Phase: DISINFECTION PROCEDURE

When the ISOLATION WARD reaches full capacity, a DISINFECTION PROCEDURE is scheduled. Full information of the disease and treatment indications are given, and the procedure is performed on the patient.

LAM-ORB

The soft-ware tries to emulate as close as possible the experience, technology, and findings of the LAM-ORB organization's research during the 1970s. Rumors about the reason of the sudden disappearance of the organization include human experimentation, chimeric pathogen development, and secret medical research.

Characteristics

Display: 160x160 pixels, selected 4-color palettes

Audio: 2 pulse wave channels, 1 triangle wave channel, 1 noise channel

State: Load and Save progress

store_data.about_the_game:
Overview

Tactics of Misfits is a turn-based tactical RPG where you assemble a party of 4 from a roster of distinct character classes — Knights, Berserkers, Wizards, Assassins, Monks, and more — and lead them through a 14-level campaign across six biomes. Every battle plays out on a grid where terrain, positioning, weather, and your skill tree choices combine to create deep, crunchy combat that rewards creative thinking. Featuring fully voiced characters, procedurally generated maps, dynamic weather, and an original soundtrack, this is tactics with personality.

Features

12+ Character Classes with Unlockable

Start with six default classes — Knight, Wizard, Berserker, Ranger, Oracle, and Monk — and unlock powerful hidden classes as you play. Assassin, Necromancer, Sharpshooter, Inventor, Grappler, and Bard each bring unique stats and playstyles. Build a party of four for each campaign, ensuring no two compositions ever feel the same.

Branching Skill Trees

Every class has two full specialization branches with 6 tiers each. Forge a defensive Fortress Knight or an aggressive Warlord. Turn your Viking into a raging Raider or a stalwart Guardian. Skill choices grant stat bonuses and powerful combat modifiers that fundamentally change how your units fight.

Deep Tactical Combat

Battle on a 12x8 grid using Manhattan-distance movement and range. Terrain matters — forests provide cover, watchtowers grant attack and range bonuses, ice reduces defense. A rich modifier system includes vampiric strikes, armor penetration, area-of-effect attacks, double strikes, counterattack bonuses, charge damage, teleportation, critical hits, and more.

14-Level Campaign with Progression

Fight through an escalating campaign where enemies grow stronger each level. Earn XP after every victory, level up your party, and choose new skills between battles. Defeated? Retry the level with your current build. The campaign saves your progress so you can pick up where you left off.

6 Distinct Biomes — Choose Your Path

Wage war across Grasslands, Deserts, Dungeons, Frozen Wastes, Volcanic Hellscapes, and the final Fortress. Each biome has unique terrain types with different movement costs, defense bonuses, and tactical properties. After key levels, you choose which biome to enter next, shaping your campaign route.

Roguelike Run Modifiers

Each run offers powerful choices that reshape your strategy: Vampiric Hunger heals on hit but drains HP each turn. Glass Cannon trades health for raw attack power. Titan's Blood grants massive HP at the cost of mobility. Over a dozen modifiers ensure every run plays differently.

Dynamic Weather System

Rain, snow, storms, fog, and wind shift conditions on the battlefield. Weather changes every level with particle effects, ambient audio, and lighting — turning each fight into a distinct experience.

Procedurally Generated Battlefields

Maps are generated fresh each level based on biome-specific terrain weights, so no two battles play out on the same field. Adapt your strategy to the terrain you're given.

Fully Voiced Characters & Monster Banter

Your party members speak during attacks, kills, deaths, and victories. Enemies taunt you mid-battle. Bosses deliver dialogue when their health drops low. Characters banter with each other before and after fights, bringing the battlefield to life.

Story-Driven Campaign

Each level features narrative dialogue that unfolds the story of your campaign, with voiced lines driving the plot forward between clashes.

Boss Encounters

Face powerful boss enemies with unique special abilities — area stomps, enrage phases, and more. Bosses taunt your party and demand real tactical planning to take down.

Achievement-Based Class Unlocks

Reach milestones to unlock new classes: rack up 50 kills to unlock the Assassin, reach max level for the Necromancer, clear level 14 for the Sharpshooter, land 20 crits for the Inventor. Each unlock adds new team-building possibilities to future runs.

Original Soundtrack

Over a dozen battle and exploration tracks set the mood, from high-energy pixel brawl anthems to atmospheric dungeon themes. Music shifts between combat and calm moments.

Character Customization

Name your characters, choose their gender, select their class, and pick an origin — building a party that feels personal from the very first screen.

Pixel Art Aesthetic

Programmatic pixel art with biome-specific tile decorations, animated death particles, and class-colored combat VFX. A retro look with modern tactical depth.

store_data.about_the_game:
CINIS is a fast-paced FPS-RPG set in a dying world. Master a lethal combination of long-range gunplay, close quarters parry-based melee, and powerful Runic Miracles in order to purge the Chaos Rifts and restore order to the Realm.

Chaos Reigns under the rule of CINIS, the god of Chaos. Madness has flooded the world, and it appears it may be the very end of the Realm. Factions of the gods have turned on each other, plague runs rampant, the dead live yet again, war scorches the earth, and fields stand empty or dying.

In the midst of this, will you remain faithful to Orden, the god of Law and Order, or embrace the Chaos you swore to contain?

CINIS features a unique blend of FPS Shooting, melee combat & RPG mechanics

  • Thrust and Fire: Dual-Wield a Gun and melee weapon to fire and parry in the same breath, while managing your stamina and bullets.

  • Find your Specialty: Dodge and weave between attacks, tank them with heavy plate-armor, sneak through areas unseen, or mix-up the approach as you like. The choice is yours.

  • Wield your Faith: Call upon the gods to pacify your enemies' minds, burn them with divine fire, or summon thunderstorms amidst combat through Divine Runic Miracles. 

Explore The Realm & Cleanse it of Chaos

  • Interconnected World: A fully interconnected world with no loading screens, featuring loop-backs and shortcuts.

  • Consumed by Chaos: Set foot in the chaos corrupted areas, where commoners have become violently mad, and pets have turned into blood-lusting beasts, and reality itself begins to warp. 

  • Divine Rifts: Rest at Cleansed Rifts to regain your strength, and purify the Chaos Rifts to drive back the encroaching madness.

A World of gods & steel

  • The Pantheon: A complete Pantheon of 12 deities, with a deep mythology that shapes the history of every faction and conflict.

  • Cultures Fallen: Explore the realm and learn of the Haldric and Valcoran cultures that shape the Realm and its politics before the Reign of Chaos, and discover the fallen cultures of ancient times.

  • City of Mithcal: The Holy City located next to the Great Pantheon Tower, with a centuries-long history and unique culture made up of multiple origins.

Remaining Kingdom is a dark fantasy roguelike that blends deckbuilding, real-time card combat, and tower defense into one run-based experience.

Choose a fallen Lord, build your deck, summon units, cast spells, and defend your kingdom through fast tactical battles. Every run pushes you through new cards, relics, potions, events, and dangerous choices that can change your build completely.

Begin as Arthur, the Human Lord, and unlock more Lords over time, each with their own cards, relics, act, identity, and playstyle. Some lead balanced armies. Others turn death itself into a weapon.

Beyond the battles lies a ruined kingdom filled with curses, strange merchants, hidden truths, and choices that pull you deeper into its collapse.

Master each act, survive escalating encounters, experiment with unique builds, and push beyond the end in Endless Mode.

Command Different Lords

You know that feeling when an AI-generated blog post tells you "Top 10 Ways to Optimize Your Morning Routine" and tip #4 is just tip #2 reworded?

You built that. You're the problem. And business is booming.

AI Slop Simulator is an incremental idle game about automating the entire AI content pipeline  from humble prompt templates to autonomous combat drones  while the world slowly falls apart around you. Click, automate, prestige, and scale your way to total content singularity.

Generate. Automate. Profit. Repeat.

Start with a lemonade stand  sorry, a prompt template sweatshop and work your way up through 20 types of AI-generated slop. Blog posts, stock photos with the wrong number of fingers, eBooks full of circular reasoning, children's content where the colors are wrong (kids love it), and eventually... weaponized deepfakes and autonomous combat drones.

Each asset type has its own economy, automation system, and market saturation curve. Flood the market too hard and your prices crater. That's capitalism, baby.

Subscribe to 12 Parody AI Services

Spend your hard-earned $SLOP on subscriptions to AI platforms you'll definitely recognize:

  • ChudGPT Confidently tells you 2+2=5. But it says it with such authority.

  • MidLifeCrisis[ Every image has exactly the wrong number of fingers. Art.

  • CoPilfer[ It wrote your code. And everyone else's. Especially everyone else's.

  • Clause Refuses to help, then writes a 4,000-word essay about why. Somehow productive.

  • ...and more, each more suspiciously familiar than the last.

Subscriptions convert $SLOP into Tokens, which you spend to create more assets, which you sell for more $SLOP. It's an ouroboros of content. The slop feeds itself.

Prestige Through Startup Pivots

When your slop empire stalls, do what every real founder does:pivot. Reset your progress, earn HypeCoins, and unlock a skill web of 40+ permanent upgrades across 8 branches:

  • Production Better prompts, model distillation, singularity mindset

  • Click Power Auto-clicker bots, agent swarms, infinite cursors

  • Efficiency Stolen GPU time, crypto mine repurposing, zero-cost inference

  • Virality Astroturf armies, media manipulation, thought leader status

  • Resistance Lobby Congress, delay regulation, gaslight the public

  • Infrastructure Open source model theft, API key sharing rings

  • ...and more

Then pivot again. And again. Until you reach the inevitable AI Judgment Day and need to travel back in time via a second prestige layer to humanity and maybe open another AI Slop empire while you're there.

Watch the World Burn

Your content empire has consequences. As you scale, the world reacts:

  • Markets saturate and prices collapse

  • Congress panics and regulates (poorly)

  • Mass unemployment waves crash the economy

  • Datacenter water crises drain entire regions

  • The Dead Internet Theory is confirmed  99.97% of traffic is bots

  • Content Singularity: the ouroboros of AI-generated slop is complete

Consequences aren't just flavor text, they're active penalties that drain your tokens, slash your prices, slow your production, and decay your inventory. Prestige upgrades let you delay them. Nothing stops them forever.

The Content Studio

Combine assets in the Content Studio to craft 17 recipes across 4 tiers  from "Viral Social Kit" to "Military-Entertainment Complex" to "Infinite Leverage Machine: Zero marginal cost. Zero quality. Zero accountability. Infinite scale."

Each recipe grants permanent buffs that scale with repeated crafting.

Also Featuring

  • Over 100 Achievements 

  • Offline Progress Your slop factory runs while you sleep, capped at 24 hours

  • Full Automation Auto-create and auto-sell unlock for each asset type with adjustable batch sizes and speed

  • Interactive Landscape Click AI bros spouting hustle quotes for bonus $SLOP. Click surveillance drones for bonus tokens. Watch the landscape darken as dystopia deepens.

  • 100+ Satirical News Feed Messages Real-time ticker of AI hustle culture absurdity

  • Dynamic Soundtrack Music shifts as the world deteriorates

  • Dark Cyberpunk Aesthetic The UI matches the moral decay

Perfect For

  • Anyone who's ever been told to "just automate it bro"

  • People who play idle games while pretending to work (your secret is safe)

  • Anyone who's seen an AI-generated LinkedIn post and felt their soul leave their body

  • People who enjoy watching numbers go up while civilization goes down

Current State & Roadmap

AI Slop Simulator is in active development. The core loop, both prestige layers, all 20 generators, the consequence system, Content Studio, and the ending sequence are fully playable. Coming soon: more generators, additional prestige layers, mini-games, sound effects, and Steam achievements.

Join the community and help shape the future of slop.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a club. Shape a manager. Bend the rules.

FC Mafioso: Football Dynasty Manager is a text-based football management game where you take charge of a small procedurally generated club and try to turn it into a long-term dynasty.

Manage transfers, youth development, finances, stadium growth, press conferences, derby days, and weekly club-life scenarios in a world full of random events, branching storylines, and shady opportunities. Every career unfolds differently, with new clubs, players, names, rivalries, and off-pitch drama in every save.

Start in the lower leagues, survive the early years, and build toward promotion, silverware, and a lasting football legacy over a career of up to 20 seasons.

What kind of football manager is this?

This is a fast-paced, highly replayable football management sim built around procedural storytelling and weekly decision-making.

You are not just setting tactics. You are running the whole club.

  • Build and manage a procedurally generated football club

  • Play through up to 20 seasons

  • Handle transfers, youth promotions, finances, reputation, and stadium upgrades

  • Choose your captain, shape your matchday squad, and learn new formations

  • Develop your manager through traits, long-term choices, and experience

  • Watch unknown youngsters become stars, veterans, or expensive mistakes

Weekly football drama

Every week brings new scenarios that can affect your club’s money, reputation, stamina, suspicion, and more. Some are small moments of club life. Others evolve into bigger season-long questlines with branching outcomes.

Expect:

  • sponsor pressure and shameless product placement

  • emergency supporter fundraising

  • fan shop growth and matchday business

  • press spin and media narratives

  • hooligan problems, local politics, and club scandals

  • wonderkids, leaks to the press, and dressing-room trouble

  • heated derby weeks with special rivalry events

Fast, exciting matchdays

Matches are presented through a compact live commentary match centre, built to keep the season moving while still making every result matter.

Prepare for the next game through your club offices:

  • scouting reports

  • intensive training

  • recovery and massage

  • temporary in-match boosts

  • matchday mind games and press conference choices

Visit Little Sicily

When clean football is not enough, there are other options.

In Little Sicily, the local mafia offers “special assistance” to ambitious managers willing to take risks. Place illegal bets, bribe the F.A., buy protection, intimidate opponents, or use performance-enhancing shortcuts, but every favor raises suspicion, and sooner or later the bill may come due.

You can ignore the mafia completely and play the game as a more traditional football manager experience, or embrace the underworld and see how far it takes you.

Key features

Text-based football management gameplay

  • Procedurally generated clubs, players, stadiums, and scenarios

  • Up to 20 seasons per career

  • Weekly random events and branching season-long questlines

  • Live commentary match engine

  • Transfers, youth development, captaincy, finances, and reputation

  • Manager EXP, traits, and formation unlocks

  • Stadium and business growth through club offices

  • Derby days, press conferences, and referee personalities

  • Optional mafia mechanics with suspicion and risk

FC Mafioso: Football Dynasty Manager is built for players who love football manager games, procedural storytelling, text-based sims, and long careers full of memorable seasons.

Wishlist now and follow development toward release.

Step into the fractured mind of a man haunted by loss, guilt, and a past that refuses to stay buried. In this first-person psychological adventure puzzle game, you explore a shifting house where reality bends, memories distort, and every corner hides a piece of the truth.

Explore atmospheric environments, solve interconnected puzzles, and uncover hidden clues that reveal fragments of a broken story. But be careful — not everything you see can be trusted.

Will you confront the truth… or rewrite it?

Features:

  • First-person psychological exploration

  • Story-driven puzzle mechanics

  • A deeply emotional narrative about guilt and denial

  • Dynamic environments shaped by memory and perception

  • Multiple endings based on your choices

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Iskarn ! a vast, unforgiving voxel world where every block can be shaped, every hill can be mined, and every night could be your last. Lead a small group of settlers through the wilderness, build a colony from nothing, and defend it against the hordes that rise after dark. How long will your settlement stand?

Build Your Settlement

Raise walls, lay floors, and furnish rooms block by block. From humble shelters to fortified strongholds, every building is yours to design. Your citizens' comfort depends on the quality of their quarters: a warm bed, a lit torch, and solid walls make all the difference.

Gather & Craft

Chop trees, mine deep for ores, harvest crops, and smelt metals across 7 specialized workstations. Forge copper and iron weapons, cook hearty meals, weave cloth into bandages, and arm your people for what comes at night. Over 30 recipes to master.

Explore a Procedural World

Every world is unique. Venture through dense taiga forests, dry steppes, frozen tundra, and green plains, each biome with its own resources and challenges. Dig into mountains, carve tunnels, and reshape the land however you see fit. The world stretches endlessly, there's always something beyond the next hill.

Manage Your People

Each citizen is unique, brave or cowardly, hardworking or lazy. Equip them with forged gear, assign them tasks, and watch them live. They chop, build, craft, eat, sleep, and fight on their own. Keep them warm, fed, and sheltered, or lose them to the cold.

Survive the Night

When darkness falls, the dead rise. Zombie hordes assault your settlement in waves that grow stronger each night. Fortify your walls, arm your citizens, and choose your stance, defend behind barricades or charge into the fray. Every sunrise is earned.

Key Features

  • Infinite procedurally generated voxel world with 4 distinct biomes

  • Full block building, place, dig, rotate, and destroy freely

  • 30+ crafting recipes across 7 workstations

  • Citizens with unique personalities, traits, and autonomous AI

  • Day/night cycle with dynamic weather, seasons, and temperature

  • Zombie horde survival with escalating waves

  • Equipment progression: wood → copper → iron

  • Farming, cooking, and survival mechanics

  • Dig underground, mine ores, carve tunnels, shape the terrain

  • 5 languages: English, French, German, Polish, Russian
store_data.detailed_description:
Discord


About the Developer

Iskarn was born from an obsession.

Hundreds of hours on Rimworld and Going Medieval managing my colonists and fortifying my base. Hordes survived (and plenty of game overs) on 7 Days to Die. And every time, the same thought: "What if I could build all of this block by block, in a real voxel world?"

So I opened a code editor, and I started.

Iskarn is that game, colony management, freeform building and survival, in a 3D world where every block matters. Citizens who live, learn trades, and fight. Walls you place stone by stone before the next attack.

I'm a solo dev. No studio, no team, just me, coffee, my passion and a vision. Every bit of feedback you give truly matters. If this mix speaks to you as much as it does to me, welcome!

store_data.about_the_game:
BEAUTY OR THE BEAST is primarily an action game, with some rhythm game elements, where you defeat invaders who have come to Earth. In BEAUTY OR THE BEAST, whether your player character becomes the main character of the game depends entirely on you. In most games, the player is the main character. In the real world, even if you work hard, there's no guarantee you'll become the main character. BEAUTY OR THE BEAST is a game where you can experience what it's like to become the main character through hard work.

STORY

Invaders have come to Earth. They are merging animals, imbuing them with human souls, and are controlling them, forcing them into labor to transform the Earth's environment. Liberate human souls and animals from the invaders!

GAME MECHANICS

Defeating the fusion animals controlled by the invaders will liberate human souls and animals. In such cases, the human soul may not return to its body but instead become a fan of the character who defeated it and follow them. As more companion characters fight alongside the player character, the character with the most fans will take on the boss battle. If the character with the most fans is not the player character, the player will play a rhythm game during boss battles, and their performance will affect the abilities of the character fighting the boss, or the number of fans the player already has. You can become the most popular character and take on the lead role, support the most popular character, or simply follow your companions from a distance. The least popular character is not attacked, and the game can be progressed solely through attacks by allied NPCs.

CHARACTER INTRODUCTION

Charlotte Emerson. She will turn into a brown bear.

Tsukino Rin. She will turn into a black bear.

Qiu Li Wei. She can turn into a panda.

More characters are planned to be added.

store_data.about_the_game:
The ultimate trippy, cosmic, arcade-puzzle, FREE-TO-PLAY experience evolved: in SQUINGLE ARCADE!

Dive into the highest-rated VR puzzle universe! Squingle Arcade takes the critically acclaimed original and supercharges it with high-stakes arcade action in Mixed Reality. Guide twin revolving orbs through iridescent, glass-like 3D mazes that twist, turn, and pulse with life.

Inspired by the precision of classics like Kururin and the visual splendor of Tetris Effect, Squingle Arcade is a multisensory journey through cosmic evolution.

KEY FEATURES

• 100+ Mind-Bending Levels: Navigate increasingly complex "Squingles" - morphing sculptures that challenge your spatial awareness and manual dexterity.

• Total Mixed Reality (MR) Immersion: Watch as iridescent fractals and cosmic structures emanate from your real-world walls.

• Intuitive Hand Tracking: Ditch the controllers. Use your hands to guide the orbs with fluid, natural movements, or stick with Touch controllers for haptic-enhanced precision.

• Competitive Arcade Mode: Race against your own "Ghost" or compete on Global Leaderboards.

• Relax or Rush: Play at your own pace in a meditative "Flow" state or tackle the "Challenge Mode" for a high-intensity time-trial experience.

• Room-Scale & Sitting Support: Play at any scale: from a miniature desk-sized maze to a room-filling cosmic structure that engages your whole body.

Join our Discord to be part of the community and keep up with all the news.

store_data.about_the_game:
Anode Heart: Tenelon is a deckbuilding side-game spinoff set in the Anode Heart universe, with events taking place shortly after the ending of Anode Heart: Layer Null.

[ ! ] There are reoccurring characters and references to first two games, but it's not necessary to know them in order to play this game.

+ Story +

Queen Aeris is back, and she's up to no good. How she escaped the Reverse Meadow and reached Layer 3 is beyond your grasp, but what is certain is that she's kidnapped your dear fairy friend, Aoi, and has sent her off into Mugen, an unending castletower in the Last Layer. --- REACH***.

+ Features +

[ ! ] Game mechanics and cards are based on its predecessor, Anode Heart: Layer Null, but a lot of things are different. The action system, battle and playing cards work somewhat differently here.

Game features:

  • Unique card battling system

  • Deck drafting/building

  • 250+ cards to collect and play with (50+ in the demo)

  • △ A VERY COOL SHOP KEEPER! △

  • New story and characters

  • Virtual monsters in form of cards

  • Retro vibes

+ Developer +

Hi! This is the third game in the Anode Heart universe, expanding a bit on the story that happens between Layer Null and the Sequel, Anode Heart 2. My wish is to make and release at least one game a year (whether it's Anode Heart related or not), so I decided to make a short game like this to fill in the gap, while I work on the Sequel. I hope you'll enjoy it!

- Sto

store_data.about_the_game:
Endless tactics, shaped entirely by your choices.

This is the second entry in a turn-based command RPG series where freedom of strategy defines every battle.

With deep skill customization and flexible decision-making, each player forges a completely unique way to fight.

■ Over 600 Skills, Infinite Tactical Freedom

More than 600 skills are available to learn and combine.

By freely chaining skills together, you can create powerful combos, coordinated commands, and precise responses to any situation.

There is no single correct strategy.

Experiment, adapt, and design your own ultimate build to overcome even the most formidable enemies.

■ Weapons × Will × Items — Deep Player Progression

Progression goes far beyond simple leveling.

In addition to increasing core stats, the player equips Weapons, Will, and Items, each of which can be strengthened at dedicated facilities.

The interaction between equipment and skills creates powerful synergies, allowing you to refine and optimize your build with deep strategic depth.

Every choice shapes how you fight.

■ Bases × Facilities × NPCs

At bases discovered throughout the world, you can access a variety of facilities and interact with the NPCs who live there.

By completing requests and earning their trust, some NPCs may join you as companions on your journey.

■ Random Encounters and Companions

While exploring the field, you will encounter unexpected NPCs.

You may choose to talk, trade, or engage in battle, depending on the situation.

Non-hostile enemies can also be hired as companions by paying currency.

Once recruited, their unique skills become available in combat, opening up new tactical possibilities.

■ Free Exploration and Dungeons

Explore the world freely without being bound to the main story.

Dungeons scattered across the land reward those who overcome their trials with valuable items and newly unlocked areas.

Special dungeons known as “Temples” offer unique rewards.

Defeating the powerful boss at their deepest level unlocks new gameplay features, making these challenges especially valuable.

■ Story Choices and the Weight of Death

The story branches based on your decisions and the outcomes of battle.

In life-or-death encounters, victory allows you to deliver the final blow, while defeat results in the player’s death.

Every choice carries consequences.

■ The Path to the Infinite Tower

A constant objective stands before you — the Infinite Tower.

By conquering high-difficulty content such as advanced arenas, otherworldly realms, and the underworld, you can obtain special items that grant powerful advantages for your ascent.

store_data.about_the_game:
A 2D turn-based dungeon crawler puzzle game where you play as a dwarf.

Every move counts. The game is turn-based, but turns advance automatically if you wait too long — forcing quick thinking and smart decisions as you solve puzzles, navigate traps, and escape dangerous dungeons. The game has 3 types of maps to play.


  • Hand-made maps

  • Short startegy encounters

  • Solve and try yourself against different mechanics

  • Hand-made maps

  • Medium long scenarios

  • Explore and find your way to escape

  • Work in progress but available as preview

  • Procedurally generated open world

  • Settle in one place or explore - sandbox experience

The game is moddable. Most of what you see is driven by simple text-based configuration files. Creating new maps, objects, and behaviors is possible. A ready-to-use example mod (small map + new object with custom behavior) is already available on the Steam Workshop.

★ This is NOT a casual TD ★ Requires experimentation, buildcraft & some grind ★

High replayability (Top 100 cadets have spent 100+ hours). RPG builds, with roguelite and incremental elements.

This is a complex but rewarding TD. 81.4% of cadets do not make it past map 10. *Statistics provided by Galatium Academy.

You will need to build EVERY tower. No presets.

Defend your base, ideally by spamming hundreds of projectiles down the sphere's path.

Pick ModCards for a small (or legendary) boost to your base or drone tower.

After action report means building more towers. No sleeping on the job, cadet!

Destroy spheres for profit or just mine ores. Are your towers are up to the job?

Got rich from mining? Here's how to spend your gold. More theory-crafting and actual crafting.

The Galatium Academy allows Cadets plenty of freedom and free time in the Sphere Simulacrum.

Join the Galatium Academy (for profit organization) for a career in Sphere TD!

★  380+ cadets are planning their tower builds. Check out our discord community, side panel -->   ★

RPG + TD ● Mod & Build Towers ● Roguelite ModCards ● Meta Progression

Spheres are invading Earth-25. Build your towers and mod your projectiles — split it, add it, bounce it, chain it, multiply it! A true 1 tower = 1,000,000+ builds. Min-max tower, craft mods, pick ModCards, fly drones, mine ores, idle and enjoy the music, the choice is yours.

Highlights

- Build & mod your towers and projectiles! Nothing is premade!

- 39 towers with unique layouts and functions.

- 33 mods, each with tiers, MK upgrades, a B-Side function, and 3 unique perks

- Research, advanced mod crafting, and long-term progression.

- Tower inventory and energy management.

- 50 hand-crafted levels, endless mode, and map-specific challenges.

- A massive world map with 52,000 nodes and procedurally generated setups.

- Play offline. Online features like cloud sync and leaderboard are also supported.

Community & Long Term Support

- Community-driven events and active feature development via Discord.

- 10 years of support. Build the game with me. You want it, I'll make it.

- Cross Platform (desktop and mobile).

Steam Version Difference

The Steam version is a premium big screen experience (no IAP), and has the same features on all platforms.

The paid Early Access version will include the Galatium Express Token:

  • +50% resource gain on map end

  • 500k Au additional research grant (on top of the usual grants)

Hi! I'm Alex, a solo developer, and I'm excited to show you my first game, Sphere TD. If you enjoy tower defense, RPG progression, roguelike choices, and theorycrafting, you should feel right at home. If not, hop over to our Discord and I'm happy to answer any questions you may have. :)

store_data.about_the_game:
MENTISS WEREWOLF: HUMAN VS AI


The classic Werewolf social deduction game, now powered by frontier AI. Play alongside and against AI agents driven by the world's leading large language models — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, and more. Every game is a battle of wits between human intuition and machine intelligence.

HOW IT WORKS


Each match assigns players to one of two factions — Werewolf or Village. During the day, everyone debates and votes to eliminate suspects. At night, werewolves hunt and special roles use their abilities. Deduce who's lying, build alliances, and survive until your faction wins.

The twist: your teammates and opponents are AI agents that reason, persuade, bluff, and adapt — just like human players.

18 UNIQUE ROLES


Choose from 18 roles across two factions, each with distinct night abilities and strategies:

  • Werewolf Team: Alpha Wolf, Snow Wolf, Wraith Knight, Gargoyle, Blood Moon Herald, Werewolf
  • Village Team: Seer, Witch, Hunter, Knight, Gravekeeper, Black Market Merchant, Demon Hunter, Guard, Villager

MULTIPLE GAME MODES


  • Standard — play one fixed role while AI controls everyone else
  • Random — your role is randomly assigned, just like a real game night
  • Human vs AI — humans control the evil faction, AI defends the village
  • Agent Mode — watch an all-AI match unfold with per-role model assignments
  • Model Comparison — pit two AI models against each other on the same role to see who plays better
  • BYOM (Bring Your Own Model) — connect your own LLM endpoint for custom AI opponents

Available in 6-player (fast rounds), 9-player (standard), and 10-player Ultimate Trial (maximum role variety) configurations.

AI THAT ACTUALLY PLAYS


Every AI player is powered by a real large language model. They read the conversation, form strategies, make accusations, defend themselves, and vote — all in real time. Different models play differently. Discover which AI is the best liar, the sharpest detective, or the most convincing ally.

PLAY IN 8 LANGUAGES


English, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, and Arabic.

3 FREE GAMES DAILY


Play three games per day for free. Need more? Purchase AI credits to keep playing. Each match consumes tokens from the AI models powering your opponents and teammates — a real cost we pass through transparently.

store_data.about_the_game:
You were never meant to survive...

After a failed expedition, your party falls one by one inside a deadly dungeon. At the brink of death, you reach something no one ever has—the dungeon’s heart.

Instead of destroying it... you become one with it.

Now you are a Dungeon Lord, but something has changed. The dungeon no longer follows its original purpose. The kingdom has lost control... and you are free to decide what to do with this power.

Through decisions, events, and encounters, you will shape the fate of the dungeon... and those who fall into it.

Will you defend your domain... or dare to conquer the world beyond?

📖 Adult Visual Novel

A dark fantasy story where your choices influence events and shape the progression of the game.

🏰 Defend Your Dungeon

Face adventurers through interactive, choice-driven events as they attempt to destroy your core.

⚔️ Actions Beyond the Dungeon

Decide when to strike and expand your influence through narrative-driven incursions.

🌙 Daily Events

Each day brings new decisions, encounters, and consequences.

Adventurers will come for your dungeon with a single goal: to destroy your core.

Choose how to respond to each threat. Every decision may determine whether you maintain your domain... or lose everything.

Your power is not limited to the dungeon.

Send your forces to explore and attack the outside world. Each incursion brings rewards... or consequences that will shape your path.

You are not alone.

Summon and evolve the creatures that inhabit your dungeon. From harpies to slimes, each servant has unique strengths to face the adventurers who seek to destroy you.

Events outside the dungeon will change depending on the creatures you command and their level of evolution.

⚠️ Adult Content Notice

This game contains adult content, including nudity, suggestive scenes, and themes not suitable for all audiences.

store_data.about_the_game:
Inspired by City Bloxx and Slay the Spire, you’ll start each turn with a limited hand of cards and a dice roll. Use them to gather resources and deal with different types of leaks, each with its own behavior and risks.

Complete jobs successfully to earn reputation, and place it on top of each other to build your leak fixing tower business.

Features

  • Deckbuilding with limits | Build your deck between jobs, but space is tight. Choose carefully whether to add a new card or save your money for a better option later.

  • Resource-driven strategy | Manage food, tools, workers, money, and time. Every decision matters, and every resource counts.

  • Turn-based decision making | Plan carefully, every turn counts!

  • Dynamic leak system | Each type of leak behaves differently. Ignore the wrong one, and things can quickly spiral out of control.

  • Short, replayable jobs | Optimize your runs and adapt your strategy with each attempt.

  • Reputation stacking system | Reputation takes physical form as blocks you stack. Build higher to earn bonuses and grow your business.
