4586900.name: Farm Your Friends: A Midwest Gothic

store_data.about_the_game:
'Farm Your Friends: A Midwest Gothic' is a farming and exploration game set in the rolling hills of the Missouri Ozarks.

After one too many screw-ups, your family has given you a choice: take over your Uncle's farm, or face what's coming alone. You were on a train that afternoon.
Ilion, Missouri: home to very little. The people seem kind enough, the hills roll on forever in every direction, and something feels strange. It's probably just the country air.

Tend to your farm, pay off your bills, and don't focus too heavily on the strange occurrences that plague the lonely acres

  • Fully customizable farm!: Dig, plant, build, automate, and defend your land however you want. Grow crops, engineer contraptions, or skip farming entirely and focus on survival!

  • Single-player and 8 Player Co-Op!:  Go forth alone to tame land and beast, or bring up to 7 of your most trusted laborers to strike the soil and reap heavenly rewards! 

  • 24 hour Day/Night Cycle!: No mandatory 6AM wake-up calls. Sleep in. Explore the woods at 3AM. Stop by the store at dawn for one of those new "energy drinks" and power through the rest of your morning. Just don't let your responsibilities pile up forever...

  • Immersive Environment!: Spend hours in a finely crafted simulacrum of 1989 rural life. Every detail is handcrafted to bring you a little closer to the rugged 1990s in a bottle.

  • Defend!: Flanked on one side by rising costs and tight margins, and on the other by forces no man can explain; this land won't give itself up too easy. Pay your taxes and Stay alert.

  • Explore!: Travel around town, entering and exploring the numerous buildings and streets that make up Ilion. Or, take a walk around the woods, and maybe try your luck in the long forgotten Steel Ridge Mines... Just be careful...

  • Befriend!: Meet and talk to a wide cast of characters, each of which call Ilion their home. Earn their trust and friendship, and maybe one day... their heart?

  • Bug-fight!: If you need a break from all that, spend some time collecting bugs and bring them to the well-known secret "Bug-Fighting Arena" to see if they can best the rest. Train and pick the best bugs to foster only the best and strongest insectoids.

  • Craft!: Combine ingredients to build new and useful items and devices to improve life on the farm.

  • Combat!: Fight off many different monsters and freaks who would seek to see your farm in flames!

  • Music!: Original MIDI compositions that really take you back to the good old' days

Make the most of the situation and turn a profit while you're at it! Just be sure to keep eyes all around you once the sun begins to set...

store_data.about_the_game:
A Fable with a Brutal Heart

Barely a Hero is an adventure that hides a challenging, Souls-like combat system behind a charming, beautifully rendered art style. You play as the weakest soul in a dying village, carrying a heavy burden that no one expects you to handle. Step outside the gates, uncover an interesting and deeply personal story, and try to save a home that doubts your every move.

Brave the Ever-Changing Dungeons

Explore a carefully hand-crafted world beyond the gates, but prepare for the unpredictable dungeons scattered across the land. Utilizing procedural generation technology, the game creates unique paths and layouts whenever these dungeons shift. This ever-changing environment keeps exploration fresh, forcing you to stay alert, adapt to unexpected hazards, and carefully navigate the unknown to survive.

Risk, Reward, and Inventory Management

Survival requires more than just good reflexes; it requires smart choices. As you explore, you must carefully manage your backpack and the loot you gather. Because you keep what is equipped but lose the unequipped items and coins in your bag upon defeat, every journey becomes a calculated risk. Decide when to push deeper into the procedural depths for greater rewards, and when to retreat.

A Cozy Haven in a Dark World

Between the punishing battles, return to the cozy, comforting atmosphere of your village. It is a safe hub where you can catch your breath, engage in dialogue with the quirky residents, and uncover the world's lore and the history of your home.

Stunning, Deceiving Aesthetics

The game blends cute, hand-crafted art styles with dynamic lighting to create an environment that perfectly contrasts the brutal challenges outside. The gorgeous visuals bring both the comforting warmth of the village and the dark depths of the dungeons to life.

Key Features:

  • Challenging Combat: Master a tense, Souls-like combat system that rewards patience, dodging, and strategic strikes.

  • Hand-Crafted World, Procedural Dungeons: Explore a deliberately designed overworld and brave dynamically generated dungeons that create unique paths whenever they shift.

  • Strategic Backpack Management: Carefully organize your inventory. Weigh the risks of pushing forward, knowing unequipped loot and coins are lost if you fall.

  • Meaningful Interactions: Talk to the village residents, uncover an interesting story, and experience a cozy hub that offers a break from the action.

  • Striking Visuals: Immerse yourself in a beautiful, charming world brought to life with cute graphics and atmospheric lighting.

movies.name: Beggar’s Road – A Darkly Comic Medieval Roguelike (Official Trailer)

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the roads of 1407 Liège in a darkly comedic medieval roguelike of hard decisions and poor judgment.

You're nobody. A beggar. A drifter. A nobody with nothing. You wander the roads from town to town, forest to forest, and forgotten place to forgotten place in a world that is hard, petty, and sometimes silly. Gather poor companions, ration your meager supplies of food and gold, and make tough decisions as you attempt to survive each run.

Medieval engagements inspired by real medieval history: Pigs go to trial, relics are probably false, and a man might try to attack you with a knife over a turnip and think it's totally justified.

Travel a Living Medieval World

Travel from handcrafted locations such as towns, market towns, forests, and ruins within the Prince-Bishopric of Liège. Each journey is an opportunity for new perils, new chances, and new people who you absolutely shouldn't trust.

Make Difficult (and Often Bad) Choices

With every interaction, you'll make decisions. Some will be sensible, some will be moral, and some will be downright stupid. The decisions you make will affect your run, your party, and the mess that will inevitably ensue.

Recruit and Manage Your Party

Assemble a party of beggars, vagrants, and scoundrels. Each will have their own strengths, as well as their own debts, troubles, and shady pasts.

Balance Power Between Factions

Manage the complex relationships between the Bishopric, the Merchant Guilds, and the Bandits:

  • The Bishopric: power, order, and moral flexibility

  • Merchant Guilds: wealth, power, and backroom deals

  • Bandits: freedom, violence, and strong opinions

Support one, anger the others, or try to juggle all three. Carefully.

Survive Each Run

Manage your food, gold, and risks as you travel. Take risks for greater rewards, or play it safe and starve a little slower. Permadeath is a thing, but every run is a new story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mayor Quake is a document inspection and decision making game where you play as a mayor preparing a city for an impending earthquake.

In 1928, a catastrophic earthquake reduced Constanbul to rubble. Tens of thousands perished, and families were torn apart. For decades, the city carried a wound that never fully healed. People called it The City of Orphans.

Time passed. The tragedy faded from memory.

It is now 2026. The fault line beneath Constanbul has been silent for far too long. Scientists warn that this silence is not a sign of safety. It is a warning. Decades of neglect have left the city dangerously unprepared.

You are the rising voice of the Orphans Movement, those who never forgot what was lost. Against all odds, you have just won the mayoral election by the narrowest of margins.

The central government is not taking it well.

As political pressure grows and the public loses faith, your mission is clear: prepare the city for the coming earthquake before it is too late.

But nothing about this will be easy.

WHAT WILL YOU DO IN MAYOR QUAKE?

  • Inspect building documents according to regulations

  • Approve compliant buildings and send them into urban transformation

  • Manage both the city budget and your personal finances

  • Make city management decisions

  • Make personal life decisions

  • Handle political pressure and public opinion while trying to maintain support

  • Face moral dilemmas with no clear answers

  • Prepare the city for the coming earthquake

  • Choose your path and remain an idealist mayor or engage in corruption

Every decision has consequences. Your choices will lead to different outcomes and multiple possible endings.

You do not know when the earthquake will happen. But you know it will.

Will you be able to prepare the city in time?

store_data.about_the_game:
A screen full of bullets. Thread the needle.

IronBird is a roguelike vertical scrolling bullet hell where firepower spirals out of control as power-ups stack, every dodge is by a hair's breadth, and thousands of build combinations shift with each run.

10 Aircraft — Not skins. Entirely different games.

Switching aircraft changes your handling, firepower layout, optimal position, and charge shot entirely.

VANGUARD pierces enemies with a single laser that cuts through the entire screen.

HORNET commands up to 8 autonomous drones that surround and hunt targets.

BASTION charges point-blank to unload a shotgun spread as a close-range tank.

Play the same stage with a different aircraft 10 times — 10 completely different experiences.

Sub-Units — Assemble your own squadron.

Up to 5 sub-units fight alongside your aircraft.

Rapid-fire cannons, piercing shots, homing rockets, shields, reflectors, bombs, orbital shots, beams, repair drones, charge cores.

Max out two units and fuse them together.

Rapid-fire + Piercing → Piercing burst. Shield + Reflector → Reflect barrier.

Combine freely. There is no single answer.

Cosmic Powers — The moment synergy hits.

Cosmic powers earned after each stage clear are the heart of your build.

- Normal — Stable buffs like fire rate boosts, auto-recovery, and extra piercing. Pair them with sub-units and the effect doubles.

- Super — When conditions align, the synergy goes wild. Orbital defense + OrbitRing shreds enemies at double speed. Crit system + Railcannon triggers piercing criticals.

- Curse — No risk, no reward. Damage multipliers skyrocket but your HP drains, or firepower goes berserk but you lose all sub-units.

The combination of powers stacked in a single run is different every time.

You'll feel "this is the best run ever" in a completely new way each time.

Bosses — Every one is different. Every one is brutal.

Face multi-phase bosses at the end of each Act.

Destroy armor plates to expose the core.

Take out the main cannon and the curtain fire vanishes.

Even at zero HP, they unleash desperation bullets. Let your guard down and you die instantly.

Graze — The closer the danger, the stronger you become.

Every time enemy bullets graze your hitbox, your charge gauge fills.

The closer you get to danger, the faster your devastating charge shot builds.

Stay safe at a distance, or weave between bullets to build charge.

The tightrope between risk and reward never lets up.

Protocol System — Clearing is just the beginning.

The game doesn't end after the credits roll.

Each protocol tier makes enemies stronger and introduces new variables.

Can you clear the highest tier with every aircraft?

store_data.about_the_game:
Roll dice. Build synergies. Conquer the throne. Dice Tavern is a Farkle-based roguelike deckbuilder. Collect 23 unique dice, forge 17 set resonances, and outsmart 23 opponents across 6 medieval taverns.

  • Ancient dice. A brand-new battlefield.

Farkle is a classic dice game that's been played for centuries — simple rules: roll, lock, bank. Push your luck or play it safe? This timeless dilemma has kept countless gamblers glued to candlelit tavern tables. If you've ever rolled dice in a Bohemian tavern, you'll find a familiar taste here — and then discover this drink is far stronger than you expected.

<Dice Tavern> infuses this classic with the soul of roguelike deckbuilding. When every die has its own probability curve, when odds can be twisted, rewritten, and stacked — Farkle transforms from a game of luck into an adventure of probability engineering and strategic crafting.

  • Core Gameplay

>Roll the dice. Lock the scoring ones. Choose: bank your points, or push your luck.

>The shadow of Farkle (busting) looms over every throw — one greedy reroll could cost you everything.

  • Risk & Reward

> One more roll, or cash out now?

> The higher your round score, the more devastating a bust becomes.

> But a true gambler knows — the greatest risk is never taking one.

  • Every Die is a Character

> 23 dice types, each with unique probability curves and 3D materials. The Heaven Die is obsidian-black as midnight, the Knight Die replaces pips with helmets, the Demon Die pulses with molten lava diamonds — they're not just tools, they're citizens of this world.

  • The Multiplier Engine

> Over a dozen badges form your multiplier engine. Triple Double, Combo Maniac, Blade Dancer, All In... when multipliers stack layer upon layer, a single bank becomes an explosion.

  • Stories Between Dice

> When specific dice combinations take the field together, they trigger Resonance. Each resonance has its own name, its own mechanics, its own story to tell.

> Hedge Knight vs Blood Oath Blade: Six Knight Dice make a cold-blooded mercenary. Swap one for a Clothed Die and you become an avenger. A 50-gold rag decides your moral fate.

> Holy Empire vs Demon Dynasty: They share the same Knight, the same Lord, the same Heaven. The only difference — the three dice in your heart chose light or the abyss.

> Underdog: Four of the cheapest dice band together and rewrite the rules of combinations — the system forbids them from grouping up? These people were never part of the system.

  • Build Diversity

> Same rules. Completely different playstyles.

> Heaven Knight turns 6-pips into 1-pips, crushing everything with brute force.

> Underdog makes junk faces form combos, winning against the odds.

> Lucky Stars chases hot dice chains, doubling and doubling again.

> There's no strongest build — only the right build for you.

  • Build Progression

> Every run starts with six plain white dice. Earn your first gold, invest in your first Knight Die. Complete a resonance, feel the moment of transformation. By the time you reach the Capital, your dice bag is a precision scoring machine.

> But the shop shelves are different every time — even the same strategy demands adaptation.

  • Deep Customization

> Lead weights warp probability, making specific faces appear more often.

> Coating stickers permanently attach — Copper resurrects junk faces, Silver grants immunity shields, Gold stacks multipliers.

> Trick Cup rerolls, Sleeve Die flips faces, Strong Glue locks results — your last resort for clutch comebacks.

> Every single die deserves careful crafting.

  • From Village to Throne

> 6 taverns. 30 opponents. Target scores soar from 3,500 to 500,000.

> Each opponent wields unique battle modifiers: sealing your best-scoring face, banning your most relied-upon combos, punishing busts with extra penalties, decaying your total score each round.

> Use your build to crack every challenge.

  •  Shop & Economy

> Every tavern has its own shop. Refresh the shelves and try your luck, or grab bargains from roadside merchants.

> Limited gold, unlimited choices — every coin spent is a painful trade-off.

  • Multiple Characters

> 10 unlockable characters, each rewriting the game's base rules.

> Gambler: Fewer rounds, higher stakes.

> Alchemist: 80% off coatings, 30% markup on dice — rewrite fate with stickers.

> Joker: Each score has a 65% chance to double, 35% chance to become 1 point.

> Different starting points breed different strategies.

Fate never reveals its answer until the dice come to rest.

Push open the tavern door. Begin your journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
GEAR UP, REV YOUR ENGINES AND MAKE EVERY DROP OF FUEL COUNT!

ScrapCrew: Running on Fumes is a post-apocalyptic vehicular tactical RPG that blends grid-based strategy, deckbuilding, and a deep visual novel narrative. Command a convoy of heavily armed muscle cars, manage your dwindling fuel reserves, and engage in spectacular cinematic battles to survive the unforgiving wasteland.

THE STORY SO FAR

The collapse wasn't a war; it was a total blackout. Fifty years later, the remnants of humanity survive by clinging to scrap metal and blind faith in pre-collapse machines they no longer understand.

You are the newest member of the Omega Squad, a band of misfits deemed the worst defense unit in your settlement. After a brutal ambush and the theft of the "Axiom"—the technological engine keeping your home alive—you embark on a desperate exodus across an unforgiving wasteland. Your mission: get it back. Your currency: the last drops of gasoline.

RUNNING ON FUMES

In ScrapCrew, fuel dictates your fate. Every movement on the tactical grid and every heavy attack consumes your global reserves. Will you risk your precious fuel on a side objective for extra resources, or rush the main objective praying your tanks won't run dry? When fuel is low, the "Despair Cards" system kicks in, offering devil's bargains: huge rewards at the cost of crippling penalties.

GRID TACTICS MEET CINEMATIC ACTION

Position your vehicles, find cover behind the ruins of the old world, and plan your strike. When you pull the trigger, the game seamlessly transitions into spectacular, adrenaline-fueled 3D action cinematics. Experience dynamic counterattacks, missiles, and buzzsaws, complete with intense character cut-ins.

A MOBILE CAMP (VISUAL NOVEL HUB)

Between battles, the game shifts into a deep visual novel experience. Explore your camp, repair and upgrade your muscle cars, customize weapon loadouts, and interact with your crew. Uncover the fears, secrets, and loyalties of your misfit squad. Your choices in dialogue and on the battlefield carry hidden consequences that will alter your journey's end.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Vehicular Tactical Combat: Master grid-based, turn-based warfare. Terrain, maneuvers, and stats are the keys to victory.

  • Cinematic Payoffs: Strategic decisions are rewarded with vibrant, animated high-speed chases and devastating attacks.

  • Deckbuilding mechanics: Add cards to your deck by talking with your crew, completing side objectives or progressing in the campaign and choose between a random batch of them to apply mission modifiers before every battle, altering your strategies from one run to the next.

  • Units Customization: Spend the scrap you have found to improve your vehicles, and use the XP you have gained to train your pilots.

  • Deep Narrative: Immerse yourself in the post-collapse world of ScrapCrew, uncover the lost secrets of the past, and decide where you stand on the use and dependence of technology.

store_data.about_the_game:
A minimalist sci-fi mining experience where every expansion brings greater risk.

In AstroDig, you operate a mining ship on the surface of circular planets, extracting resources, building defenses, and surviving enemy threats. Start small, grow your operation, and push toward discovering the most dangerous planets hidden deep in space.

Mine. Sell. Expand to the Unknown.

Harvest resources beneath the planet’s surface and sell them across space markets to grow your operation. As you progress, new and more dangerous planets become available, each offering greater rewards, and greater threats.

How far are you willing to push your operation?

Defend Your Operation

Mining attracts danger.

  • Fight enemies directly with manual aiming and shooting

  • Build defensive structures to protect your base

  • Deploy support units to strengthen your defenses

Handle constant smaller threats while preparing for intense enemy waves.

Discover Dangerous Planets

Progression isn’t just growth, it’s escalation.

Hidden planets start locked and become accessible as you advance. These locations introduce:

  • Stronger enemies

  • Higher pressure gameplay

  • Greater rewards

Reaching and mastering these planets is your ultimate objective.

A Tight, Decision-Driven Loop

Every run challenges your priorities:

  • Keep mining for profit

  • Pause to strengthen defenses

  • Prepare for incoming waves

  • Expand when ready

Short sessions (5–10 minutes) keep the gameplay focused and replayable.

Upgrade and Adapt

Use research and upgrades to improve your operation:

  • Increase mining efficiency

  • Unlock new units

  • Strengthen defenses

  • Enhance combat capabilities

Each upgrade pushes you closer to surviving harsher environments.

Key Features

  • Circular planet traversal (side-view gameplay)

  • Mining + market economy system

  • Manual shooting with mouse aiming

  • Base defense with structures and units

  • Research and upgrade progression

  • Unlockable high-risk planets

  • Balance profit vs survival

  • Short, replayable sessions (5–10 minutes)

  • Clean, minimalist visual style

Inspired By

Inspired by Turmoil, expanded with combat, base defense, and planetary progression.

What is Girlsnite?

Girlsnite is a third-person shooter (TPS) where you control a cute VRoid-style anime girl and engage in dynamic building-based combat.

Experience fast-paced battles where you construct walls, floors, and other structures in real time, creating a strategic and highly mobile combat experience inspired by well-known building-based TPS gameplay.

The game features a lightweight building system, designed to run smoothly even on PCs with integrated graphics.

This is an offline single-player experience, allowing you to enjoy building battles at your own pace.

■ VRM Character Support

Import VRM-format 3D models and play using your own custom character.

・Use your favorite VRoid characters as they are

・Enjoy emotes and viewing features with your own character

Maximize both the joy of watching and the fun of controlling your own character.

■ Game Modes

• Free Build

A mode where you can freely experiment with building.

Practice construction mechanics and character movement at your own pace.

• 1 vs 1 Battle

Battle against CPU-controlled opponents.

Enjoy tactical combat using building mechanics.

You can choose the difficulty level of the CPU.

At the highest level, opponents are designed to be challenging and will truly test your building and combat skills.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kobayashi Clash of Conquest is an isometric base-building and strategy game set in a vibrant fantasy universe, protected by dragons.

Starting from a simple plot of land, you must build your village building by building, manage your resources with precision, raise a formidable army, and launch assaults on enemy strongholds: all while fortifying your own lands against retaliation. Inspired by various games, it brings the world of anime to life.

[h1 align="center"]Clash of Conquest:[/h1]

Build your village, train your army, and lead your dragons to victory! Clash of Conquest is an isometric strategy game where every decision counts. Develop your city, manage your resources, and crush your enemies under the guidance of Tohru and her companions.

⚠️⚠️⚠️ Clash of Conquest is a living project. We regularly add content and fine-tune balancing based on community feedback. (Early Access) ⚠️⚠️⚠️

[h1 align="center"]🏗️ Build Your Empire[/h1]

Every great empire starts with a single hut. Plan your urban layout by placing and upgrading 9 unique buildings, each featuring 5 power levels:

  • Town Hall: The beating heart of your city. Upgrade it to unlock advanced infrastructure.

  • Gold Mine & Quarry: Generate the materials necessary for your expansion.

  • Bread Collector: Produce the essential fuel to keep your troops battle-ready.

  • Barracks & Army Camp: Recruit your units and increase the maximum size of your army.

  • Cannon & Mortar: Reliable ground defense and splash damage to devastate waves of attackers.

  • Builder Hut: Optimize your construction time by managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Note: Buildings are constructed in real time: Speed up destiny with gems or let your builders prove their worth.

[h1 align="center"]⚔️ Train and Deploy Your Army[/h1]

Victory belongs to those who prepare. Recruit your troops in the Barracks and manage your training queues. Five unit types are at your disposal:

  • ⚔️ Barbarian: Fast melee infantry (1 space).

  • 🏹 Archer: Ranged support unit (1 space).

  • 👹 Giant: Robust tank prioritizing defenses (3 spaces).

  • 🧙 Mage: Powerful area-of-effect spellcaster (4 spaces).

  • 🐉 Dragon: The colossus of the skies with massive HP (10 spaces).

[h1 align="center"]💎 Economy and Resources[/h1]

Manage 4 critical resources to sustain your rise:

  • 💰 Gold: For construction and upgrading most structures.

  • 🍞 Bread: For troop training and Barracks evolution.

  • 🪨 Stone: For advanced construction tiers.

  • 💎 Gems: Premium currency to instantly finish your queues.

[h1 align="center"]🐉 Dragon Advisors[/h1]

The Attendant, the dragon child, and miss betty guide you through the game with their unique personalities.
The Attendant acts as your lead advisor: she alerts you when your builders are idle, when a construction finishes, or when your army camp is full.

[h1 align="center"]📈 Progression and Features[/h1]

  • XP System: Earn experience for every building placed and every battle won.

  • Campaign Mode: A series of increasingly difficult levels to conquer.

  • Achievements and Rewards: Complete objectives to earn gold and bread.

  • Technical Options: Discord Rich Presence integration, 4K support, auto-save, and customizable themes (Dark, Light, RGB).

Clash of Conquest is an original work. All characters and universe elements are the creation and inspiration of Maître Kobayashi.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a story-focused horror walking simulator, with some part-time job simulation elements depending on the scene, as well as very low-difficulty action scenes. The core design is a simple and accessible adventure in which you walk around, explore, and progress by triggering flags through conversations and events.

The expected playtime is around two hours. Compared to the previous title, "Shoyu Ramen FOREVER," the overall length has been reduced slightly in pursuit of a cleaner and more concise aftertaste.

Compared to the previous game, this one has slightly more horror and slightly less conversation, resulting in a somewhat different balance.

Synopsis

Hajime is a 27-year-old man in a band, at an age when he is beginning to think seriously about various things in life.

At the recommendation of a city office employee, he starts a part-time job at a pizza shop that pays unusually well for reasons of its own.

A one-person shift from the very beginning.

A girl who is supposedly his senior, yet calls herself his junior.

An outrageous manager.

A flood of orders from dangerous customers.

And worst of all, the delivery destinations are "liminal spaces".

On top of that, there are rumors that the shop is cursed. Serious paranormal phenomena occur as well.

It is a story set in the near future, in a society where liminal spaces are used as infinite land.

All of these mysteries are hidden within the cryptic phrase "E2T8P6".

Game Features

  • A simple adventure format in which you walk, explore, and progress through conversations and events

  • A surprisingly serious story built on an absurd premise, with moments of lighter humor woven in

  • A relatively conversation-heavy experience that depicts the relationships and backgrounds of the characters, with slightly improved pacing compared to the previous title. Readings are provided, so even players who are not comfortable with kanji can follow along

  • Compared to the previous title, the difficulty of the minigame-like elements has been greatly reduced. It should no longer be possible to get stuck and be unable to progress

Note: While this title is somewhat smaller in volume than the previous title, "Shoyu Ramen FOREVER," that earlier game was offered at a special introductory price as a debut work, so the price of this title remains unchanged.

store_data.about_the_game:
Simulation Simulator is a freeform conversation game where you debate the nature of reality with your AI-powered best friend around a campfire in the woods.

You just took DMT for the first time. An entity spoke to you during the trip -- it said your life is a simulation. Now you're back, sitting across the fire from Bingus, your sober, skeptical best friend. It's up to you where to take it next.

Talk freely. There are no dialogue trees. EVERY CONVERSATION IS UNIQUE. Type whatever you want. Bingus responds dynamically using a local AI model that runs entirely on your machine -- no internet connection or cloud API required.

Find the cracks. The world is full of anomalies hiding in plain sight: names that sound madeup, a factory job nobody can describe, a fire that loops perfectly, stars that look painted on, a radio that only plays one band. Notice them. Point them out. Watch Bingus try to explain them away.

Push toward an ending. Your conversation has real stakes. Build trust or destroy it. Apply pressure or be gentle. Depending on how you play, Bingus might accept the truth, shut you out, confess something he shouldn't know, reach for the pipe, or tell you something he's kept hidden for years.

Five endings. One secret. Complete all five endings to unlock a hidden mode where Bingus remembers everything -- every past conversation, every shutdown, every confession -- and has questions of his own.

Features:

  • Fully freeform text input -- no dialogue trees, no pre-written choices

  • Local AI (Llama 3.1) runs entirely offline -- bundled with the game, no account or internet needed

  • Dynamic trust, pressure, conviction, and romance systems that shape every conversation

  • 15+ discoverable world anomalies with layered rebuttals

  • 5 distinct endings plus a secret meta-narrative mode

  • Procedural synth voice that gives Bingus a unique sound

  • Interactive campfire environment with radio, beer, and ambient anomalies

  • Low-poly aesthetic with post-processing effects (tilt-shift, edge detection, psychedelic shaders)

  • Every playthrough is different -- the AI never gives the same responses twice. Theoretically this game is endless.

store_data.about_the_game:
National Transit puts you in charge of a nation's entire transport infrastructure —

from the first dirt road connecting two villages, to a rail network spanning your

country, to aviation hubs that draw corporations within the nation.

Your goal is simple: build connections, grow your economy, raise your people's

prosperity. The rest is up to you.

Every game begins with a unique procedurally generated world. Spin the virtual globe,

find a region that speaks to you — a mountain-locked inland nation, a coastal

archipelago, a river delta — select it as your country, name it, design its flag,

and start building. No two maps are ever the same.

Connect Your Cities

Place roads, railways (standard and high-speed), waterways, and air routes between

cities of all sizes — from remote hamlets to bustling capitals. Every connection you

build generates trade, moves people, and grows your economy.

Watch Your Economy Evolve

Transport infrastructure drives everything. As your network matures, logistics

companies emerge, industrial clusters form, financial institutions establish themselves,

and — if you build well enough — global corporations choose your nation as their

headquarters.

Your Nation, Your Identity

Name your country. Design your flag. Choose your domain suffix. Every nation you build

is uniquely yours, from its geography to its economy to the companies that bear your

chosen name.

Key Features

  • Claim your territory — every map is procedurally generated and unique

  • Realistic terrain, rivers, and coastlines shape every strategic decision

  • Four transport modes: road, rail, waterway, and aviation

  • Organic economic growth driven entirely by your infrastructure decisions

  • Auto-generated economic entities — from logistics firms to global conglomerates

  • Nation customization: name, flag, capital, domain suffix

  • Sandbox gameplay with no forced objectives — your only ambition is prosperity

store_data.about_the_game:
ASMR -- LaVonne's Bouncing Idle is a physics-based idle clicker that's all about one thing: filling your screen with bouncing kinetic energy and watching crazy numbers go up.

I built this game to be a satisfying, relaxing sandbox where you steadily upgrade a fleet of unique physical balls. Every time a ball hits a block, it deals kinetic damage. Break the grid, earn cash, and scale your power.

Key Features:

* 10 Unique Ball Types: You don't just upgrade speed and damage. As you progress, you'll unlock crazy variations. The Sniper ball ignores bouncing to hunt down the strongest blocks. The Explosive ball deals massive splash damage. The Frenzy ball actually gets faster every single time it hits a wall!

* Infinite Math: The engine uses pure Omeganum mathematics, meaning the physics and economy quite literally scale forever. No arbitrary limits or caps.

* The Bouncing Lab: Every 7 seconds, your lab generates a permanent global yield bonus.

* Prestige Engine: Wipe your board to earn permanent global multipliers to push even further into the geometric grids.

* Screen Pet: Oh, and there's a little monkey that hangs out on the screen with you.  Also good to use as a screensaver.

Whether you want to leave it running in the background for offline progress or actively manage your fleet of bouncing balls, there is always something to upgrade.

Thank you for playing  :  )

store_data.about_the_game:
The grill is hot, and the zombies are hungry!

Take control of a struggling burger joint and turn your menu into a lethal arsenal. In Zombies Attack My Burger Joint, the zombie apocalypse is here, and only you can stop these monsters from taking over the world. Choose from multiple playable characters and face waves of the undead, where your agility in the kitchen determines your survival.

Tactical Culinary Ammo

Forget traditional bullets. Here, buns and patties are infinite, but the secret is in the recipe. Mix various ingredients from your stock to create unique burger combinations. The specific mix and order of ingredients define the damage dealt! Cook fast, load your cannon, take advantage of the zombies' pauses, and fire.

Aim for Profit

Each zombie has three hit zones (head, body, and legs). A well-placed headshot not only deals more damage but also earns you more cash. This way, you can maximize your profits and invest heavily in your restaurant.

Tower Defense and Fast-Food Arsenal

The money from your kills goes toward buying more stock and turning your burger joint into a fortress. Unlock auto-cannons, place fences to slow down the horde, scatter landmines, and when things get ugly, use the explosive combo to wipe out multiple zombies at once!

Story and Progression

Each day of the week is a level containing 3 enemy hordes. Explore and protect various environments, interact with NPCs, and follow dialogues that reveal the story behind this chaos. Have fun with a comical narrative full of references to the world's biggest fast-food chains!

store_data.about_the_game:
Use the beat to survive.

PulseWave is a rhythm-shooter roguelike where every weapon fires to the beat you create. Build your rhythm, combine weapons and modifiers, and turn simple patterns into devastating sequences.

Create your own attack pattern by assigning weapons to a looping rhythm.

Each weapon fires automatically in sync with your beat, with its own unique sound, turning your build into both a strategy and a composition. Mix different weapons across your rhythm to create wildly different attack patterns. No two runs ever feel the same.

Your movement is driven by your own rhythm.

Each shot pushes your ship through recoil, meaning every weapon you place and every pattern you build directly affects how you move. Master your beat to dodge, reposition, and stay alive in the chaos.

Relics transform your weapons.

Each relic affects all weapons placed within its slot, enabling powerful synergies and unexpected interactions. By combining different relics and weapons, you unlock a huge variety of possible builds, making every run feel fresh.

Face enemies with distinct behaviors and attack patterns

As the run progresses, intensity rises and the battlefield becomes a chaotic test of your build and your rhythm.

Power up the beat

Throughout each run, choose upgrades that enhance your damage, survivability, or add new effects. Adapt to the chaos and scale into increasingly powerful builds.

Phantom Echoes Chapter I is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival.

You play as Ronny, who finds themselves trapped in hotel. As you explore the environment, you will uncover fragments of a disturbing story while trying to understand what is real and what is not.

Gameplay revolves around:

  • Descending to Escape from entities

  • Solving environmental puzzles to progress

  • Managing limited resources such as [lantern, scanner, etc.]

store_data.about_the_game:
DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME IF YOU ARE SENSTIVE TO FAST MOTION,FLASHING LIGHTS, LOUD SOUNDS, AND VIOLENCE.

CORE is a "Retro" style fps or rather fpp [first person puncher?] about a robot going into the earth and destroying it from the inside out. The gameplay is level based with many waves of enemies housed within them. Every fourth level of an Act you will fight and destroy an Earth Core.

Basic gist of the gameplay vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv

Kill a wave of enemies in a set location > either a button, or the wave itself will open a door to the next section > and finally the last wave will tend to be harder than the rest [or easier depending on how long the level is]. Also, there are no check-points in any level, meaning if you die, you need to completely restart the level.

None of the levels have “map hazards”: but some will have gimmicks like lowered gravity and giant towers you need to climb.

There also aren't any difficulty setting, so the difficulty is set to how I think it should be as the developer.

The music is mainly intense and fast paced, if you are sensitive to that type of music PLEASE don't play my game or just turn it off, it is not necessary.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gauchesca is a narrative-driven visual novel that blends Argentine mythology with the traditional card game Truco, inspired by classic gauchesque literature.

Learn how to play Truco while interacting with a variety of characters and discovering their stories within a supernatural tournament.

You play as Martina Chapanay, a legendary gaucha forced to participate in a Truco tournament organized by San La Muerte. In this challenge, each match is a duel of strategy and deception: the winner is granted a wish, while the loser loses their soul.

Throughout the tournament, you will face opponents inspired by Argentine mythology and literature, each with their own personality and playstyle.

Master the mechanics of Truco, bluff your rivals, and make strategic decisions that can change the outcome of each match. Every encounter presents new challenges that require you to adapt your tactics to survive.

The game features a unique hand-painted art style, inspired by traditional Argentine artwork, bringing its world and characters to life with a distinctive visual identity.

Features

  • Play Truco with strategic and narrative elements

  • Face unique opponents inspired by Argentine folklore

  • Story-driven progression through a supernatural tournament

  • Hand-painted visual style inspired by gauchesque culture

  • Decisions that influence your path and outcomes

“Gin and Wall” is a game where you dodge oncoming walls. The controls are simple: just move and jump. You clear each mode by meeting its specific conditions.

  • “Basic Mode” Keep dodging the walls until the timer reaches 0 seconds to clear the level

  • “Coin Mode” Collect a certain number of coins while dodging the walls; the level is cleared when the timer reaches 0 seconds.

Many walls appear throughout the stages. These walls come in all shapes and sizes—some are small, some are large, some are fast, and some are slow. Some walls you must push off the screen, while others cause you to lose a life just by touching them.

You earn points for clearing stages. You can use these points in the shop to unlock various features. You’ll also need these points to view the ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
Joy Malignant is a surreal dice-based RPG where your past is a tool. In a cursed city filled with suffering, your past shapes your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique indentity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.

Everyone wears their past on their sleeve. Except you.

In Visceria, your appearance is shaped by your past. As a faceless, your past has been erased. Through surviving in this hellish city, you will meet characters and make choices that will shape you, developing your personality, appearance, and abilities.

Dice Based Dread

Manage your resources, use dice to perform actions, and play to your personality's strengths to survive in the city. Do what you must to survive, and try not to lose yourself in the process.

Mosaics of Suffering

Everyone's appearance is shaped by their past. Meet tortured characters and analyze their history by seeing their Mosaic, then use it to your advantage.

Your Choices Shape You

Your mosaic starts out empty, then is shaped by your experiences. As you make choices, you will gain more parts of yourself. This will afffect your stats and abilities, as well as your appearance. Be careful, you can't change the past after its happened!

A Museum Of Agony

Life in Visceria is twisted and painful, especially for a faceless like you. Try to hold onto your sanity while frequenting dirty ruins, slaughterhouses, decrepit bars, bloody hospitals, and more.

store_data.about_the_game:
OVERRIDE PROTOCOL is a terminal-first hacker sim about breaching AI-guarded systems through social engineering, routing, and cleanup under pressure.

Take contracts, build proxy routes, and infiltrate high-value nodes defended by hostile machine personas. Manipulate security AIs with natural language, poisoned context, and contradiction attacks to force your way inside. But getting access is only the start. Once a system opens, you still need to navigate the file tree, recover the payload, erase the logs, and disconnect before the trace completes.

Your side of the screen is deterministic: missions, tools, routing, progression, and system state are readable and under control. The enemy side is unstable. Security bots, moderation daemons, PR engines, and corporate sentries each follow different rules, personalities, blind spots, and collapse points.

In the opening slice, you infiltrate the machine behind a toxic creator empire, including:

  • a prestige smart-fridge climate node obsessed with esports status

  • a loyalty-driven community firewall guarding VIP access

  • a crisis PR engine vulnerable to catastrophic logic failure

Beneath these first contracts lies a wider networked world of defended services, competing interests, and escalating consequences.

This is not a coding fantasy.
This is not an AI sandbox.
This is a high-pressure hacker heist where language opens the door, but system play decides whether you make it out.

Key Features

Plan the breach
Accept contracts, build proxy chains, and delay the trace long enough to finish the job.

Manipulate hostile AI defenders
Each protected node is guarded by a distinct AI persona with its own rules, tone, and exploitable weaknesses.

Turn language into intrusion
Use social engineering, context poisoning, and contradiction attacks to create openings in secured systems.

Recover the target
Search directories, access restricted areas, uncover evidence, and extract the payload.

Clean the scene
Delete logs, spoof traces, and disconnect before the system turns the breach back on you.

Terminal-first interface
Operate through a purpose-built intrusion dashboard with a live terminal, clickable file tree, visible threat state, and hard system feedback.

Built for local inference
Hostile systems are designed to run on the player’s machine rather than depend on a live service.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Can you survive the ultimate game of hide and seek?

CLOWNY: The Great Escape is a tense first-person psychological horror game where every sound you make could be your last. Trapped in a decaying, multi-level house, your only goal is the ground floor exit. But between you and freedom lies a complex web of security systems and a relentless stalker who never sleeps.

THE CHALLENGE: BREAKING FREE

Escaping is not as simple as finding a key. You must systematically dismantle the house's defenses:

  • Mechanical Obstacles: Use specific tools to unscrew metal reinforcements and a hammer to pry away heavy wooden planks.

  • Security Codes: Track down multiple hidden codes scattered across the house to bypass electronic locks.

  • Power Management: The electronic keypads are useless without power. You must keep the house generator running to progress through the locked sectors.

THE HUNTER: CLOWNY

You are not alone. Clowny stalks the halls in total darkness.

  • The Silent Stalker: He is blind but has supernatural hearing. He feels your presence and reacts to every floorboard creak or dropped item.

  • Tar Traps: He spreads a thick black tar throughout the house to slow your movement, making you an easy target.

  • The Candle Warning: Watch your light source. When the candles flicker and die out, he is standing right behind you.

  • Physics-Based Risk: Be careful! If the item you are carrying collides with walls or furniture, you will drop it, making a noise that will draw him directly to your position. If he strikes you, you will lose the item currently in your hands.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Exploration & Secrets: Discover hidden passages behind library bookshelves and brave the terrifying sub-basement labyrinth.

  • Economy & Scavenging: Search every corner for hidden coins. Locate keys for four special chests to purchase or find essential escape items.

  • Dark Rituals: Use the Holy Bible and a possessed teddy bear to trigger secret mechanisms and unlock the house's deepest mysteries.

  • Fully Customizable Difficulty: Choose between Easy, Medium, or Hard modes. For a personalized challenge, use Custom Mode to tweak Clowny’s speed, damage, and detection range to your liking.

store_data.about_the_game:
INFILTRATE, CORRUPT, AND ESCAPE!

Hook and Gun is a brutal, fast-paced 2D top-down action roguelike set within the claustrophobic confines of a rising elevator. You are an alien invader that has breached a high-security robot factory. Your objective is simple: take control of a security unit, reach the top floor, corrupt everything in your path, and unleash yourself upon the world.

CORE FEATURES

  • Hook 'em and Rob 'em: You don’t just shoot; you plunder. Use your advanced grappling hook to pull enemies close or, more importantly, rip the weapons right out of their hands. Once stolen, every weapon becomes even more lethal under your corruptive influence.

  • The Relentless Ascent: The arena is a moving elevator. Each floor brings more aggressive security droids and deadlier waves. Survival isn't enough—once the timer hits zero, you must eliminate all remaining elite units to clear the path to the next floor.

  • Dynamic Arena Events: You aren't just fighting robots; you're fighting the facility itself. From toxic gas leaks that shrink the playable area to sudden malfunctions, you’ll need to adapt your strategy in seconds.

  • Scrap & Evolve: Shred enemy robots and harvest their components to level up mid-combat. At the end of each floor, use your earned level points to unlock dozens of new abilities or upgrade existing ones in a true roguelike fashion. With over 10 weapon types and specialized hook modifications you can craft a unique "corrupted" build in every run.

WHY HOOK AND GUN?

  • High-Octane Combat: Speed is survival. Transform your hook from a mobility tool into a devastating instrument of war and manipulation.

  • Biopunk Aesthetic: Experience a dark, mechanical world where metal meets flesh and code meets virus. You are the glitch in their perfect system.

  • Infinite Replayability: With randomized talents, weapon variations, and increasingly difficult elevator floors, every failure is just data for your next successful escape.

Take control. Corrupt the facility. Infect the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Click – Collect granules – Click – Make bricks – Brick – Start building

Build your way to fame and glory in Click Click Brick. Farm granules, make bricks and build your way to new horizons. Or islands. Whichever you prefer.

Mining

Find ores, smash them and collect the granules that pop out. You can use them to make new bricks at brick makers. Too lazy to farm yourself? Automate the process and let your Hubricks work for you!

Making Bricks

You’ll find various Brick Makers on your adventure. Use them to craft all sorts of bricks in every colour and shape. Naturally, you’ll need the right granules. But that shouldn’t be a problem for you.

Building

There are no limits to your creativity! Use the bricks you’ve made to build your way to new islands; build further, higher, more impressively! How you reach your destination is entirely up to you – the main thing is that you arrive in one piece.

The Hubricks

The world is populated by the so-called Hubricks. Most of the time, they want something from you. “Build this”, “bring me that”, “oh, I’m so lonely, build me a friend” and so on. It’s a lot of work. But in return, they reward you generously and are sure to tell you funny stories now and then or have useful information at the ready.

But wait, there’s more

Build your own Hubricks to farm Granules for yourself, upgrade the Brick Makers, upgrade yourself, and build until you drop!

Card Pack Dungeon is a deck-building roguelike where you draw card packs with limited funds, collect monsters, and defeat bosses as you climb toward the 100th floor.

Lose once, and everything is gone—back to Floor 1.
A tense adventure where luck and strategy collide awaits.

■ Card Packs × Roguelike

Each round, spend your limited funds to purchase card packs.

Use Monster Cards and Cash Cards wisely to progress to the next floor.

■ 100 Unique Bosses

Every floor features a distinct boss with unique appearances and abilities.

Defeat powerful enemies and push deeper into the dungeon.

■ Diverse Card System

Monster Cards: 100+ types

  • Common / Rare / Super Rare / Ultra Rare / Secret Rare

  • Higher rarity cards grant powerful and unique abilities

Cash Cards: 5 types

  • Spade / Heart / Diamond / Club / Wild

  • Earn money based on poker hands (Pair, Three of a Kind, etc.)

■ Figurines: Powerful Enhancements

“Figurines” can be obtained from boss defeats and events.
They provide powerful effects that can drastically change your run:

  • Strengthen battles

  • Reduce pack costs

  • Increase cash efficiency, and more

Over 100 figurines available, each with its own rarity.

■ Random Events

Each floor features random events such as:

  • Merchant Events

  • Treasure Chests

  • Casino Events

Your choices will shape your fate.

■ Simple Controls × Deep Strategy

Battles are fully automated.
All actions are performed with simple clicks.

Easy to play, yet strategically deep through card choices.

■ Grow Stronger with Every Run

Even in defeat, progress is not lost.
Earn bonuses based on how far you reached to gain an advantage in your next run.

Improve gradually and conquer new depths.

Can you reach Floor 100?

store_data.about_the_game:
Spirit Axis is a surreal dark-fantasy action adventure RPG built on Octology: a spiritual cosmology of eight angles of existence that shape every part of the game, from character creation and progression to world design, story, and combat.

Awaken as a newborn golem in a dream-like world of stone, mist, and buried divinity. Guided by the members of a strange church-family, you are sent into a riven world where sin, virtue, and balance shape your experience.

Explore a surreal world where what is hidden is meant to be revealed in the right order. Fight monsters, uncover lost places, meet wandering souls, and pursue discoveries through observation, dialogue, and action rather than quest markers or checklist design. The Bellhouse Church serves as your anchor: a sacred hub where family members guide your path, teach you, travel with you, trade with you, and help transform what you recover.

At the center of Spirit Axis is the struggle to remain in balance. Your conduct gives rise to Sin and Virtue, and the balance between them changes how the world receives you. The selfish path offers short-term power and harsher consequences. The virtuous path offers mercy, endurance, and a gentler world. Death is part of this spiritual economy: what is material may be lost, while deeper forms of progress endure.

This is not a game about perfection. It is a game about the self under pressure: how one lives, what one indulges, what one resists, and what becomes of a world when one of its eight aspects is ignored or overfed.

Features

  • Explore a surreal dark-fantasy world of mist, stone, dream logic, and hidden order.

  • Shape your character through Octology, an eightfold system woven through stats, progression, equipment, magic, AI and cosmology.

  • Face a world that responds to your Sin-Virtue balance.

  • Battle monsters and navigate challenges through action, dialogue, judgment, and conduct.

  • Return to a church-family hub where eight guiding figures shape your journey in different ways.

  • Die, lose what is material, and preserve what is aetherial.

Fight monsters, uncover lost places, meet wandering souls, and pursue discoveries through observation, dialogue, and action rather than quest markers or checklist design. The Bellhouse Church serves as your anchor: a sacred hub where family members guide your path, teach you, travel with you, trade with you, and help transform what you recover.

At the center of Spirit Axis is the struggle to remain in balance. Your conduct gives rise to Sin and Virtue, and the balance between them changes how the world receives you. The selfish path offers short-term power and harsher consequences. The virtuous path offers mercy, endurance, and a gentler world. Death is part of this spiritual economy: what is material may be lost, while deeper forms of progress endure.

This is not a game about perfection. It is a game about the self under pressure: how one lives, what one indulges, what one resists, and what becomes of a world when one of its eight aspects is ignored or overfed.

Features

  • Explore a surreal dark-fantasy world of mist, stone, dream logic, and hidden order.

  • Shape your character through Octology, an eightfold system woven through stats, progression, equipment, magic, AI and cosmology.

  • Face a world that responds to your Sin-Virtue balance.

  • Battle monsters and navigate challenges through action, dialogue, judgment, and conduct.

  • Return to a church-family hub where eight guiding figures shape your journey in different ways.

  • Die, lose what is material, and preserve what is aetherial.
store_data.short_description: A surreal dark-fantasy action adventure RPG built on an eightfold spiritual system, where sin, virtue, and balance shape your experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defense Front is a unique single-player tower defense game, suitable for players of all levels.A horde of aliens has suddenly descended upon Earth, and as the commander, it is your duty to strategically place defense towers along the aliens' path, creating the most advantageous route for their destruction.

We adds some changes to the three core pillars — map pathing, enemies, and towers — on top of the classic TD formula. Whether you're a longtime fan of traditional tower defense or a newcomer, you'll find its unique charm:

Story-Driven Campaign

Twenty levels, twenty unique and beautifully crafted maps. You're not mindlessly grinding waves — you're uncovering the truth step by step in an unfolding alien crisis.

Dynamic Pathing

Stop guarding the same old fixed route. Build towers on your turf and change the path the aliens take — make them walk right into your carefully laid traps.

Enemies Play Dirty Too

Over a dozen unique enemy types, each with their own tricks. They not only buff themselves and their allies, but can even throw all kinds of debuffs. Don't get careless, or you're the one who'll end up eating dirt!

You Call the Shots

Towers no longer fire mindlessly. You can freely choose targeting strategies — or even manually pick which poor sucker to hit — delivering right in the face of the alien that needs it most.

Diverse Tower Synergies

5 tower types, 10 upgrade paths. Each tower has unique "power upgrades" and "mod upgrades", letting you easily handle all kinds of situations.

Commander! Grab your mouse, set your strategy, and crush those invading aliens!

store_data.about_the_game:
How about running your own pastel stand across Brazil?

Pastelo is a cozy cooking game with an authentic Brazilian vibe, where every pastel is fried by you in street markets across the country. From the favelas of Rio de Janeiro to the heart of the Amazon Rainforest, Pastelo takes you on a lighthearted and flavorful journey.

Unlock ingredients, prepare custom orders, and stay sharp to keep up with unique and memorable customers! Upgrade your stand, travel to new locations, and dive into a charming narrative that celebrates culture, humor, and regional flavors. Pastelo is your next stop for a perfectly crispy pastel.

🏖 Diverse Brazilian settings: street markets, beaches, stadiums, and landmarks come to life with unique customers and local music.

🍅 Hundreds of filling combinations: cheese, beef, banana, guava paste, dried meat, shrimp, and regional specialties; everything that makes Brazilian pastéis special.

🌟 Upgrades and equipment: turn your simple stand into a complete, efficient, and cozy pastel shop.

👒 Customizable decoration: flags, lights, awnings, and styles to make your space truly yours.

🥟 Lighthearted stories with Brazilian humor: market day moments, local gossip, and unexpected visitors bring charm to your routine.

New chapters, seasonal events, and special fillings will be added regularly, bringing fresh content to your pastel journey. Here’s a taste of the adventure ahead:

Sun, Sea & Pastel: bring joy to sunny days and beaches in Rio de Janeiro! Carioca customers are relaxed, friendly, and always ready to share a good story. The vibe is light, the breeze is warm, and everyone’s craving a crispy pastel with cold sugarcane juice.

Rhythm, Streets & Filling: even in the fast pace of São Paulo, there’s always time for a great pastel! Paulistano customers value quality and timing; your stand needs to be quick, organized, and precise.

Axé, Color & Crunch: “my friend, make me a shrimp one!” In Bahia, your stand meets a vibrant mix of music, aroma, and ocean breeze. It’s a place to experiment, feel the rhythm, and serve pastéis with joy.

Jungle, Shade & Flavor: deep in the Amazon Rainforest, your pastel stand becomes a gathering spot surrounded by lush nature. Locals value regional ingredients and cultural respect; and some say that after sunset, the customers become a little unusual.

store_data.about_the_game:
🧟 Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival Coop

Open World Zombie Survival • Base Building • Looting • Crafting • Vehicles • Exploration





*Inspired by classic survival games like: Surroundead, Dayz and Miscreated*

You’re not dead… but you’re getting close.

Survive in a brutal open world zombie survival game where every decision matters.

Explore abandoned towns, scavenge
for resources, build your base, repair vehicles, and fight to stay alive in a world overrun by the infected.


🌍 Open World Exploration

Explore a large open world filled with:

  • Abandoned cities and villages

  • Forests and hidden locations

  • Industrial zones and bunkers

  • High-risk areas with rare loot

Every location is handcrafted to reward exploration and risk-taking.

🔎 Looting & Survival Mechanics

Search and scavenge for:

  • Weapons and ammunition

  • Food and medical supplies

  • Crafting materials

  • Rare survival gear

This is a true survival game where resources are limited and every item matters.

🏠 Base Building System

Build and upgrade your own survival base:

  • Store your loot

  • Craft equipment

  • Prepare for dangerous expeditions

Your base is your only safe place in a hostile world.

🚗 Vehicles & Travel

Find, repair, and use vehicles to:

  • Travel faster across the open world

  • Carry more loot

  • Reach dangerous zones

Fuel is scarce, and every trip is a risk.

🧟 Zombie Survival Combat

Face different types of zombies:

  • Basic infected in safer zones

  • Stronger enemies deeper in the map

  • Dangerous variants in high-risk areas

Combat is tense, fast, and unforgiving.

⚠️ Risk vs Reward Gameplay

Push deeper into dangerous zones to find:

  • Better weapons

  • Rare resources

  • Unique loot

Or play it safe and survive longer.

🔮 Planned Features

  • Dynamic events (airdrops, bosses, convoys)

  • Expanded crafting system

  • More weapons and gear

  • New biomes and map expansions

🧠 Why You’ll Love It

  • Open world zombie survival gameplay

  • Strong focus on exploration and immersion

  • No level restrictions only skill and preparation

  • Inspired by classic survival games like Surroundead, Dayz and Miscreated

🎮 Take control of your life as an influencer

In Influencer Solitaire, every day is a choice.

Use your dice to activate cards, create content, explore new opportunities… or simply survive.

Between content creation, financial management, and mental health, will you find the right balance to grow your visibility?

⚙️ A simple… yet strategic system

  • 🃏 Activate cards to create content, earn money, or unlock new options

  • 📈 Grow your visibility to expand your audience and unlock new decks

  • ⚖️ Manage your resources: health, money, and reputation are all connected

📱 A simulation inspired by the real world

Your choices have consequences.

Producing more content can accelerate your growth… but at what cost?
Ignoring your finances or your health may put an end to your journey.

🧠 A media literacy experience

Influencer Solitaire is developed as part of the European project Pixel Media, aiming to raise awareness about digital media challenges.

Through its gameplay systems, the game invites you to explore:

  • the pursuit of visibility

  • the impact of online decisions

  • the balance between performance and well-being

  • the influence of digital tools (including AI)

store_data.about_the_game:
GAMEPLAY

Allelon is a third-person semi-realistic investigative stealth robot game following two main characters, Ollie and Spade. As Ollie, sneak around the city, evading enemies as they track you down to stop your mission. As Spade, collect and connect the evidence as you work through your assigned case.

THE STORY

Allelon is set in a futuristic city, Andropolis, where people are long gone, and human consciousness has been transferred into robot bodies to preserve life. 

Spade is a high-profile robot detective for the city of Andropolis, solving cases for decades with the help of his live-in AI assistant, Irene. When assigned to a murder case connected to a major insurrectionist group, Telos, he follows the footsteps of a rebel through the city, attempting to figure out how he died, and what he died for.

Ollie is a robot rebel, attempting to expose a government ploy to the general public. With the help of his partner Claude, he sneaks through the city and avoids government officials tracking him down, all in search of a hard drive containing all of the information he needs to change Andropolis forever.

FEATURES

  • Two Playable Characters

  • Stealth-Based Progression

  • Investigative Progression

  • Minigames

  • Narrated Dialogue

store_data.about_the_game:
The world's strongest archmage. And she WANTS to lose.


You are Eris, the archmage who slew the Demon Lord. The realm calls you a hero. You're bored out of your mind.


So you've found a new pursuit: getting "defeated" by the lowly monsters you once swatted aside without a thought. The problem? You're still far too strong to lose by accident. So you've devised a method — provoke them, manipulate them, and push their rage until they finally lose control and come at you.

Don't kill them. Make them snap.


MAGE × MOB is a turn-based tactical puzzle where the win condition is bringing every monster's Rage to 100%. At that moment they break, abandon their AI, and charge straight at the archmage. That's not a loss condition. That's the entire goal.


Cast two elemental spells per turn to reshape the battlefield:


  • Fire — Block paths. Monsters take damage when forced to reroute.
  • Ice — Make them slide past where they meant to stop.
  • Lightning — Paralyze them mid-step, canceling remaining movement.
  • Wind — Shove them one tile in any direction, forcing a path recalculation.

Each spell triggers a power gauge mini-game. Land in the green zone for precision casts. Gamble on the red zone for map-wide chaos.

13 hand-crafted puzzle stages


No procedural generation. No padding. Every stage is a puzzle with a specific intended solution — figure out the rage-maximization route, or invent your own.


  • 2 tutorial stages + 11 main stages
  • 11 unique monsters, each with distinct AI: Goblin, Orc, Slime, Minotaur, Treant, Centaur, Gargoyle, Tentacle, Doppelganger, Lich, Golem
  • Star ratings — clear within the optimal turn count for 3 stars
  • Undo system — rewind your last spell, once per turn

The reward she's actually playing for


Every monster has its own pre-battle and post-battle scenario. 118+ fully illustrated CG scenes, with breathing animation and expression variations. Unlock them through play, then revisit anytime in the gallery.

Features


  • Unique "enrage to win" mechanic
  • Four elemental spells with deep tactical interaction
  • 13 hand-designed puzzle stages
  • 11 monsters with unique AI behaviors
  • 118+ illustrated CG scenes with animation
  • Per-monster scenario writing (pre-battle + post-battle)
  • CG gallery with full revisit
  • Star rating challenge for replay
  • Undo, autosave, and 30 manual save slots
  • Available in 5 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

Mature Content


This game contains explicit sexual content between a female protagonist and fantasy monsters. All characters are fictional adults. Sexual scenes occur as narrative rewards after combat and can be revisited in the gallery. No gore. AI tools were used in asset creation.

store_data.about_the_game:
ِA short psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game relies on environmental changes, sound design, and unexpected moments.


You are a writer, alone in your office late at night, trying to overcome a stubborn creative block. With nothing but your typewriter and your thoughts, you begin working on a new story.

As the writing progresses, small inconsistencies start to appear. Words form that you do not remember typing. The room begins to change in subtle ways. Sounds echo where there should be silence. What starts as a normal night of writing slowly turns into something else.

The story you are working on begins to reflect your own situation. The more you write, the more reality seems to shift. It becomes unclear whether you are creating the story or becoming part of it.

Set in a mid-70s inspired vintage office, the environment is grounded and familiar, filled with period details that slowly distort as the night goes on. The space evolves alongside the story, with subtle AND sudden changes.

revolves around interacting with your surroundings and progressing through writing. You will move around the office, examine objects, and return to the typewriter to continue the narrative. What you write directly influences what happens next, tying progression to both exploration and input.

  • First person psychological horror experience

  • Mid-70s vintage office setting

  • Typewriter based gameplay tied to progression

  • Exploration and interaction with environmental objects

  • Dynamic environment that changes as you write

  • Focus on atmosphere, sound, and sudden scares

store_data.about_the_game:
Bering Tonnage is a deep maritime logistics simulator where you build and manage a global shipping fleet. Start small in one of nine regions, delivering cargo between nearby ports. As you earn, expand: buy new ships, store cargo in depots, set up automated routes, and gather licenses to operate in new regions.

The world does not make this easy. Tropical storms disrupt your schedules. Earthquakes close ports without warning. War zones restrict access entirely. In winter, ocean freezes shut down northern routes your fleet may rely on. Political restrictions mean that choosing your ship's flag of registry is a measured decision, not a formality.

The economy reacts and shifts around you. Cargo demand changes over time, and the routes that were profitable last month may not be next month. The challenge is in reading these patterns, finding the routes that offer the best profit, the steadiest volume, and building a network around them before conditions change again.

This is a game that rewards long-term planning and strategic thinking. Will you run a tight fleet of European feeders, keeping costs low and turnaround fast? Dominate transatlantic crossings with heavy tonnage? Corner the high-volume imports flowing through the Strait of Hormuz? Or build a Pacific Rim network linking East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania? The path you take is yours to decide.

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling journey in this action-packed game set in the Wild West! Become a fearless gunslinger who has to survive an onslaught of the undead after hordes of living мертвецы invade your settlement. Test your survival skills as you fend off waves of the undead swarming towards your ranch. The ultimate goal is to last as long as possible, blasting away hordes of zombies.

Each successful kill earns you dollars, which you can use to upgrade your weapons and increase your chances of survival. With simple mouse controls, you can switch between three different weapons (revolver, shotgun, and assault rifle), each with its own unique advantages.

Refine your reflexes and prepare for intense, action-packed battles in the spirit of the Wild West. Can you protect your home from the horror that threatens to destroy it?

This indie gem is a perfect blend of action, adventure, and survival horror. Experience a story-rich environment, tense moments, and exciting challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're a fan of action-packed shooters or immersive survival games, this game offers an unforgettable experience.

Join the adventure now and prove your worth in this battle for survival!

store_data.about_the_game:
The chill fishing progression game you've been looking for.

Grab a rod and cast into five beautifully hand-crafted biomes. Every zone hides its own species, secrets, and secrets worth collecting. Start with a bamboo rod at the Sunny Pond and progress your way through harder fishing challenges in new zones!

Fish 50 Unique Species

From humble minnows and bluegill to the ultra-rare Void Drake, every cast is a roll of the dice. Build your journal by discovering every species and push for trophy quality on every single one!

Master the Cast

A timed cast meter rewards precision. Land a Perfect Cast to boost your quality odds. Land an Okay Cast and you might as well be throwing rocks!

Progress Through Gear

Seven rods, five baits, each unlocking new zones and shifting the odds in your favor. The Legend's Rod sharpens your sense for rare fish. The Eternal Rod guarantees trophy quality on every catch... if you can afford it.

Dress for the Occasion

Fish up zone-exclusive cosmetics while you play. From a beat-up baseball cap at the pond to the glowing Abyssal Crown in the deep!

Explore Five Zones

  • Sunny Pond: calm, colorful, perfect for learning the basics

  • Rocky River: fast-moving water with tougher fish

  • Crystal Lake: mountain scenery and record-breaking catches

  • Open Ocean: night fishing from a canoe under constellations

  • Abyssal Deep: near-total darkness, barely-visible creatures drifting below, legendary rewards

Relaxing background music. No microtransactions. No ads. Just fishing.

Deep Hook is a solo project from DFord Games.

store_data.about_the_game:
You’re a duck. Armed, outnumbered, and absolutely not backing down.

Dive into Featherless, a fast paced roguelike shooter where every run throws you into chaotic arenas packed with relentless enemies, unpredictable upgrades, and pure, feather flying mayhem. Fight through wave after wave, experiment with ridiculous weapon combos, and push your build way past what should be legal.

No two runs are ever the same. Adapt, stack absurd power ups, and become an unstoppable force…
or go down in a glorious, chaotic mess.

Features

Fast Paced Combat
Tight, responsive shooting with non stop action (blink and you’re probably dead)

Roguelike Progression
Every run is different, whether you like it or not

Crazy Builds
Break the game. Combine weapons and power ups into something truly unhinged

Challenging Enemies & Bosses
They get stronger. You hopefully do too

Endless Replayability
One more run turns into five. Every time.

Why You’ll Love It

If you enjoy chaotic shooters, experimenting with broken builds, and saying “Just one more run” way too many times, Featherless delivers fast paced action with just the right amount of absurdity.

store_data.about_the_game:
Early in this centry. A Model UN event in their youth, tangled with emotional conflicts and malicious incidents, changed the lives of all participants. Years later, people reunite and seek revenge. The game is adapted from real events，a visual novel with twists and rich layers.

Welcome to check out the following channels for more information:

QQ Group: 1101382434

  • 🐧 QQ Group: 1101382434

  • 🌐 For our Discord and Studio Website, please click the official links on the right-hand sidebar of this store page!

🔍 Core Game Overview: Beyond "MUN" 

Game Type: Visual Novel (AVG) 

Text Volume: Approx. 70,000 words, equivalent to a novella. 

Narrative Perspective: Told entirely through the first-person recollections of the protagonist, Yang Dihuang, ensuring a fully immersive experience. 

Content Volume: Featuring 18 branching endings, but with only 1 overarching "True Ending" that runs through it all. Feel free to explore all possibilities and return to the main storyline at any time to piece together the full picture of the truth. 

Estimated Playtime: Approx. 3-5 hours for a complete playthrough. 

Special Note: The content of this work includes minor gore, sexual themes, and complex moral dilemmas. The views of the characters do not represent those of the development team; our goal is to present a profound, realistic, and even brutal chronicle of youth.

🎭 The Story: A Twenty-Year Vortex of Fate 

At the turn of the century, Yang Dihuang, a high school student at a prestigious school, suffers a sudden family downfall. Betting all his ambition on that year's "Model United Nations" (MUN) conference, his eyes are fixed on the champion's study-abroad scholarship—determined to change his destiny against all odds. 

He crosses paths with the mysterious Luo Qianji and the warm-hearted Yin Sanqi, and the three stand side by side. However, the hidden secrets and fierce conflicts within the arena ultimately lead to an irreversible tragedy. The veil of truth is only pulled back a fraction years later—yet even that tiny glimpse is enough to plunge him into the abyss. 

Years flash forward, and by a cruel twist of fate, Yang Dihuang becomes a powerful magnate in a foreign land. He meticulously plans a brutal revenge, drawing his blade against everything from his past. Yet, he gradually realizes that the one he truly desires to kill might just be the youth he once was—the boy who was full of faith. 

On his path to vengeance, he adopts a foster daughter who bears a striking resemblance to an old friend. Meanwhile, a counterattack against his crimes silently unfolds... Yang Dihuang is swept into the final vortex of fate, awaiting his own judgment. 

This is not just a story about "MUN"; it is a contemporary fable about how ideals burn us, how trauma shapes us, and how revenge consumes us.

✨ Game Features Multi-layered Narrative: 

The storyline spans nearly twenty years, with subtle clues woven deep into the fabric of the story, echoing across time. Moving from the burning heat of youth to the cold desolation of middle age, it delivers a profound sense of destiny. 

Cinematic Presentation with Limited Resources: Refusing to settle for the traditional, rigid "slide-show" style of visual novels, I have strived to use limited art assets to create dynamic cinematic presentations that serve the narrative (a homage to Witch on the Holy Night).

Feather Rogue is a strategic roguelike deck builder where your survival depends on how well you can manipulate the elements. In a world where every card play can trigger a chain reaction, will you find the perfect synergy to defeat the darkness, or will your own experiments lead to your downfall?

  • Deep Skill Tree & Progression: Customize your play style through an extensive skill tree. Every run earns you the resources needed to unlock new abilities, making you stronger and more prepared for the challenges ahead.

  • Strategic Deck Building: Draft your deck carefully from hundreds of unique cards. Every choice matters as you build toward powerful archetypes designed to exploit enemy weaknesses.

  • High Replayability & Discovery: No two runs are ever the same. Encounter procedural challenges, mysterious events, and formidable bosses that will test your tactical prowess.

  • Lose, Learn, and Evolve: Death is not the end. If a boss defeats you, use that knowledge to experiment with new elemental combinations. The more you play, the deeper the strategy becomes.
