store_data.about_the_game:
You must survive the night in this horror experience set inside a long-abandoned funhouse. Monitor cameras, respond to triggered alarms, and navigate dark, dust-filled halls. Something still roams the building… and it knows you’re there.

Welcome to Spunky’s Funhouse!

Once a place of laughter, birthday parties, and childhood joy, Spunky’s Funhouse was a beloved destination for families. Children came to play, eat, and celebrate alongside colorful mascots that walked among them.

Then, one day, the fun stopped.

The doors were shut, the lights went out… and no one ever gave a clear reason why.

Years later, the building still stands untouched, silent, and covered in dust. Now, as the newly hired night guard, it’s your job to watch over what remains… and uncover what really happened.

The Night Shift

From your small security office, you’ll monitor cameras scattered throughout the facility, keeping an eye on empty party rooms, narrow hallways, and forgotten play areas.

When alarms are triggered, you must leave the safety of your office to investigate and reset them. At first, the nights seem manageable… but that won’t last.

Strange movements.

Shifting shadows.

Footsteps where there should be none.

Each night becomes more dangerous than the last.

The Mascots

The animatronic mascots were once the heart of the funhouse bright, playful, and full of personality. Dressed in cheerful animal costumes, they entertained children and brought the place to life.

They’re still here.

But something has changed.

Uncover the Truth

As you survive each shift, you’ll begin to piece together the story behind Spunky’s Funhouse and its sudden closure. Clues are hidden throughout the building, waiting to be discovered—if you can stay alive long enough to find them.

You are not alone in the dark.

You are being watched.

And as the nights go on…

something might start chasing you back.

store_data.about_the_game:
EcoMoguls is a strategy card game about profit, climate damage, and public outrage.

Each round, players draft projects and events into a temporary tableau, collect Megabucks, build local Climate Damage, and fight to avoid becoming the easiest target on the Public Outrage track.

The goal is not to be clean. It is to stay profitable while making sure someone else takes the heat first. Climate pressure builds locally, spills into a shared consequence system, and eventually catches up with everyone. When the game ends, the richest corporation wins.

KEY FEATURES

- Draft 4 cards each round from rotating hands

- Build temporary tableaus around profit, climate pressure, and PR positioning

- Trigger backlash through discarded events and climate overflow

- Compete on personal Public Outrage tracks while managing a shared climate system

- Play solo against AI-controlled rivals, locally with hotseat, or online in multiplayer

- Inspect full card details with satirical flavor text, historical context, and sources

EVERY CARD HAS TEETH

Every card in EcoMoguls pairs polished corporate spin with straight historical context and source material. The tone is sharp, but the subject matter is real.

MODES OF PLAY

Play solo against AI rivals, pass the turn locally in hotseat, or take the blame online in multiplayer.

CORPORATE STRATEGY, PUBLIC CONSEQUENCES

Projects can make you rich, but they also build pressure that does not stay buried forever. Climate Damage builds locally, spills into shared consequences, and turns into Public Outrage when the bill finally comes due.

Winning means building the strongest economy while staying just clean enough, or at least looking that way.

store_data.about_the_game:
A little game inspired by real bird behaviors!

"Birds Eat Bugs" is a relaxing and stress-relieving little game. You freely draw lines to move across hexagonal grids to guide two birds to eat bugs. You will play as two birds climbing trees in opposite directions, find the optimal and shortest path, clearing pests from the tree, and uncovering the concept of "ecological niches".

If you're tired from school or work, come and relax and eat bugs.

Features:

Zero Pressure: No timers, no health bars, no Game Over. Score display is hide-able. Play at your own pace.

Play Your Way: Don't care about perfect combos? Just draw casually, clear the level, and enjoy pure stress relief.

Endless Puzzles: Challenge Mode features dynamically generated levels, offering a fresh map every time.

Rooted in Nature: Inspired by real bird behaviors! Treecreepers climb up the bark, while Nuthatches climb down.

3.Upgrade your facilities to prepare for massive enemy assaults!

store_data.about_the_game:
A command-free, intuitive bullet-hell versus game.

“Bullet Barrage” is a 1v1 competitive bullet-hell shooter where players battle using simple controls.

There are no complex command inputs. With just a single button, each character unleashes unique bullet patterns while players focus on movement, evasion, and energy management to outplay their opponent.

■ Simple Controls × Deep Strategy

Attacks are executed with one button.
However, victory depends on player decisions such as:

  • Timing of bullet patterns

  • Control of spacing

  • Efficient energy usage

The game is easy to pick up, yet emphasizes mind games and tactical depth.

■ Designed for Accessibility

Unlike traditional bullet-hell games where a single mistake leads to defeat:

  • Durable combat system that avoids instant loss

  • Opportunities to recover and reposition

  • CPU battles for practice

Even beginners can learn through trial and error.

■ Unique Characters

Each character features a distinct playstyle:

  • Balanced type with straightforward attacks

  • Long-range sniper type

  • Area-control type using dense bullet patterns

  • Strategic type utilizing deployable weapons

Your approach to combat changes significantly depending on your choice.

■ High-Speed Aerial Battles

Fights take place in an aerial arena.
Players move freely while exchanging intense bullet patterns in fast-paced combat.

Dodging, approaching, and disengaging repeatedly,
finding openings is the key to victory.

■ Play Solo or Versus

  • Includes CPU battle mode

  • Play and practice solo anytime

Even players who are not comfortable with PvP can gradually improve at their own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
Read the field, shoot your cards!

Inheriting the gritty sci-fi world of the 1998 classic HARD EDGE, this title boldly reimagines the gameplay as a Real-Time Tactical Card Battler. Engage in intense 4v4 team-based combat with up to 8 players!

Game Overview

Set in the hard-boiled cyberpunk world of the original HARD EDGE, this is an all-new tactical experience that blends the tension of a shootout with the strategic depth of a card game. Form a 4-man squad and utilize your hand to annihilate the enemy team. Your tactics and teamwork will be put to the test in a war zone where turn-based deliberation meets real-time action.

Game System: Real-Time Tactical Card Battle

Combat progresses in turns. At the start of each turn, draw cards and choose your next move. The defining feature is that "all players on the same team act simultaneously." Sync your timing with allies to suppress enemies with a barrage of fire, or have one player act as a decoy while the rest launch a surprise flank. Coordinated execution is the key to victory.

The Core of Strategy: Deck Building & Mid-Match Growth

Deck building—the heart of any card game—is vital here. Before the match, construct a unique deck tailored to your character's personality and your personal playstyle. Furthermore, as characters level up during the match, you can add new cards to your deck or enhance existing ones. Victory requires both careful preparation and the ability to adapt your deck to the ever-changing battlefield.

Dominate the War zone with Diverse Cards

Your deck contains various weapons, equipment, and support items. Choose the best card for the situation:

  • 【Ranged】 (Assault Rifles / Handguns / Sniper Rifles): Powerful ranged attacks. You can snipe enemies in a straight line, but cover like walls will block your shot. Positioning for a clear line of sight is crucial.

  • 【Throwing】 (Grenades, etc.): Deals area-of-effect damage. Perfect for flushing out enemies behind walls or wiping out clustered foes.

  • 【Combat】 (Knives, etc.): High-risk, high-reward melee attacks that deal devastating damage if you can get close enough.

  • 【Defense】 (Armor, etc.): Reduces incoming damage. An essential card for those serving as the team's shield on the front lines.

  • 【Support & Tactics】: Infinite tactical possibilities with "Medical Kits" to heal allies, "Extended Mags" to boost ammo, and "Deployable Cover" to create safety anywhere.

  • 【Movement】: Positioning is key. Movement does not require a specific card; instead, you can discard ANY card from your hand to move. However, that card is lost. Will you discard your best attack card to escape danger, or stand your ground to save it for later? This "Ultimate Dilemma" defines the strategy of every step.

Two Tactical Game Modes

Adapt your strategy to the objective and lead your team to glory:

  • 【Capture the Flag】: Compete for "Disks" containing vital data. The team with the most Disks when time runs out wins. Efficiency, route planning, and role distribution are more important than simple elimination.

  • 【Team Deathmatch】: A pure, high-octane battle for dominance. The team with the most kills wins. Your combat skills, coordination, and card timing will decide your fate.

Story: The Prequel — "The Sakuraville Occupation"

Six months before the events of the original game... The "Sakuraville" research facility, owned by Machinery Gear, is suddenly seized by an unidentified armed group. Among the hostages is the high-profile scientist, Dr. Kevin. To resolve the crisis and rescue the doctor, authorities covertly deploy an elite special forces unit into the building. Among the members are Alex and Michelle—two individuals destined to be swept up in a harsh fate. Inside the sealed facility, heavy armaments and deadly traps await. Amidst clashing agendas, the desperate rescue operation begins now!

Build your deck, coordinate with allies, and survive the WAR ZONE!

爆笑又上头的谐音梗猜词游戏！《谐了个音》是一款以汉语谐音为核心的图片猜词游戏。根据魔性的提示图片，大开脑洞，猜出那些离谱而不失合理的答案，并收获一条新鲜的烂梗。游戏提供多套精选题库，包含生活常识、成语典故、网络流行语等多种主题，既适合碎片时间独自挑战，也适合聚会时的欢乐共斗。

游戏特色：

  • 1000+ 原创海量题目——涵盖生活常识、成语俗语、网络梗等多种主题。得知答案的瞬间：秒懂、会心一笑、捧腹大笑，一条新鲜烂梗就此诞生。

  • 类爬塔深度挑战——初始七条命，答对回血，答错扣血。随着关卡推进，题目越来越刁钻——你能挑战到第几关？

  • 多人好友联机——呼朋唤友同房挑战，互坑互助，集思广益一起造梗。

  • 巧妙提示——巧用提示功能，丝滑通关

store_data.about_the_game:
《山河捍卫者》是一款跨越三代军人的史诗级互动叙事游戏，从抗美援朝的冰雪战场到现代台海危机的紧张对峙，你将扮演一个家族中最新一代的军人，肩负起祖父和父亲未竟的使命。

故事主线

游戏通过回顾抗美援朝等历史战役，结合现代军事行动，展现了中华民族从站起来、富起来到强起来的伟大飞跃。你将亲身体验这种历史厚重感与时代责任感的交融。

主角角色成长

初始状态：军校学员，背负为父复仇的执念

成长历程：从特战队新兵到小队队长，从个人复仇到理解军人职责

关键抉择：是否保护"鬣狗"手中的台湾女孩，如何处理父亲牺牲的真相

最终蜕变：从"为父报仇"到"为国家统一而战"的思想升华

目标设定

最终目标：完成祖国统一大业

阶段性目标：

理解"旗角"背后的家族传承

完成特战队训练和考核

在亚丁湾护航任务中查明父亲牺牲真相

为解放台湾作战提供关键支援

命运抉择

游戏中，你将面临多种抉择，个人与国家利益的的情感平衡、任务与情感的抉择，关键节点的指挥决策，危机事件的突发处理，每一个抉择都影响最终的结局走向，上百种结局走向等你来解锁！

任务系统

主线任务：推进故事情节发展

支线任务：完成额外挑战，解锁内容

《山河捍卫者》不仅是一款游戏，更是一次关于家国情怀、个人成长与国家统一的深刻思考。你准备好捍卫这片山河了吗？

store_data.about_the_game:
You start with disappointing gear and no idea what you're doing. That's fine. Your character doesn't need you for the fighting part.

Cornerfall is a text-based idle RPG. You pick a zone. You pick a tier. Your character walks in alone and the log starts scrolling. Combat, loot, death, all of it ticking by while you do something else. When you check back, the inventory is full and something has changed.

A new sword. A better helmet. 12 Gold. A name in the log you haven't seen before.

Your job is the space between runs. Equip the sword or sell it. Allocate your stats. Unlock upgrades. Pick a zone or a boss and send your character back out. Alt-tab.

No sprites. No maps. No fluff. Are you sold yet?

store_data.about_the_game:
"Gun Massacre" is a survival horror game where the gun is only a last resort of survival. Set inside a mansion where mirrors are part of its culture, you’ll encounter “Mirrored Zombies" - powerful monsters which are hard to fully finish off, making every trigger pull a decision you may not recover from. Explore the mansion and its architecture, search for clues and complete various puzzles to reach your goal of escape.

• INVENTORY MANAGEMENT

   Your inventory is limited to 3 slots. Choose carefully which items to carry, and store the rest in save rooms. Items can be examined, equipped and then used in puzzles. Some items also provide situational advantage beyond their intended use.

• EXPLORATION

   Explore the mansion and use its environments for your own advantage, examine various objects to find clues for puzzles you will have to solve during your way.

• SURVIVAL

   “Mirrored Zombies” aren't just normal threats, they resist the damage you do to them. Pulling the trigger only delays the danger. Sometimes survival means choosing not to fight at all.

• FEATURES

  • Balanced Survival Horror experience.

  • Handcrafted environments focused on atmosphere and exploration.

  • Post-game content and Post-launch updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
DELIVER SKETCHY CARGO

After a wild night in paradise, you and your friends wake up on a remote island owned by a cartel. To start your lives anew, you must take to the skies and fly questionable missions for your new “employers”. Take contracts, stack cargo, and deliver it across a vast tropical archipelago.

COOPERATIVE SMUGGLING

If you’re going to take shady smuggling flights, you might as well do it with friends, right? Experience the life of a cartel pilot in co-op. Just don’t forget to grab a crate of cold beer before the next mission.

PREPARE AND MAINTAIN YOUR PLANES

Get your hands dirty in the hangar to ensure your planes stay airborne and reliable. Yes, it’s a chill smuggler life on these islands, but a well-maintained plane is your only way home.

STYLE IN THE SKIES, STYLE ON LAND

Express your style by customizing both your pilot and your aircraft. Choose from a variety of outfits and design custom liveries for your planes. If you’re going to be the most wanted pilots in the region, you might as well look good doing it.

TROPICAL ARCHIPELAGO AWAITS

Explore a vast world of sun-drenched islands and breathtaking ocean views. Navigate through clear skies or prepare to show your piloting skills when violent tropical storms hit the area.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the early 20th century, in Moria Bay, a catastrophe known as “Dissolution” erupted overnight.
As an Executor created by the Matron, you are about to descend into the ruins consumed by prismatic auroras, carrying out her command: observe, analyze, and reclaim the overflowing Holy Grail.

Game Features

A Fusion of Grid-Based Tactics and Card Gameplay
No longer just a clash of numbers. On a grid battlefield, your positioning and distance directly determine your survival and output.

A Unique Deck-Building System
Choose your class, then embrace the blessings of the Elder Gods. With over 180 cards available, build around collision, spells, or summoning, and strengthen your synergies to amplify your destructive power.

Explosive Power Fantasy
Chase the thrill of a fully realized build. Whether you flood the battlefield with undead ghouls or overwhelm enemies through stacked health, as long as your build forms a complete loop, you’ll experience crushing dominance.

Pure Run-Based Experience
No tedious meta-progression. Every run is a fresh evolution. Within limited nodes, you must adapt your build in real time based on the cards and relics you obtain.

Refined Grotesque Aesthetic
A retro early-20th-century atmosphere combined with a slightly cute yet unsettling hand-drawn art style, delivering a truly distinctive visual experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Elemental Ninjas stand on the brink of destiny as the legendary Sphere of Power is stolen from the sacred temple where they forged their newly awakened abilities: earth, fire, electricity, speed, shadow, and magic. What begins as a breach becomes a threat to the balance of the world itself. Prepare to dive into an epic journey across 7 adrenaline‑charged stages, each packed with fierce battles, perilous challenges, and cinematic action that will push your skills to the limit. The fate of the elements rests in your hands.

How to play

The game’s core mechanic is unlike anything seen in other ninja titles. It draws inspiration from the true tactics of ancient Japan, where real ninjas didn’t rely on brute force—they mastered deception, silence, and the art of striking only when the moment was perfect. In The Element Ninjas, charging straight into battle is a path for the reckless. Embrace the shadows, outsmart your enemies, and unleash your power from the unseen. Victory belongs to those who move like ghosts and strike like lightning.

Each ninja commands unique basic abilities and channels their mana to unleash powerful elemental magic. But beware: this power, while devastating, is limited. Only those who know when to hold back and when to strike will survive the trials ahead. In The Element Ninjas, true mastery isn’t about casting magic without restraint—it’s about choosing the perfect moment to turn a single attack into an unstoppable force.

The Element Ninjas is an action-platformer where you control a ninja capable of mastering the elements. You must overcome levels filled with enemies using fast-paced attacks, precise jumps, and special abilities. The game features challenging boss fights, gem collection, and a story told through cinematic cutscenes and dialogue.

In addition, the game features:

  • Elemental Combat: Master different elements to defeat unique enemy types.

  • Precision Platforming: Test your skills in levels designed for fast movement.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Face powerful guardians at the end of each world.

  • Immersive Narrative: Follow the ninjas' journey through full dialogues or animated sequences.

  • Secret Areas: Keep your eyes peeled! Each level contains hidden screens and secret paths for the most observant players.

  • Bonus Minigames: Discover hidden challenges to earn extra coins and boost your score.

  • Lilly`s store: Visit Lilly at mid-level checkpoints or at the end of each level. Use your collected coins to purchase health refills, mana, powerful power-ups, or to save your progress.

  • Global & Offline Leaderboards: Compete with players from around the world for the highest score! Track your performance locally or climb the global ranks to prove you are the ultimate Element Ninja.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Fifth Bell is a story-driven 2D point-and-click adventure set across Europe in 1994.

When a sealed cavity inside Strasbourg Cathedral reveals a modern cassette tape, archival consultant Evan Marek is drawn into a mystery that should not exist. By morning, the historian who found it is dead.

His warning is simple: Don’t let them ring the fifth bell.

As Evan follows the trail from Strasbourg to other European cities, he uncovers fragments of an ancient acoustic machine hidden for centuries inside cathedral bell towers. Built in secret, concealed as relics, and never meant to be reassembled, the device is more than symbolic — it is dangerous.

Explore hand-crafted locations, gather clues, solve grounded inventory and environmental puzzles, and uncover a conspiracy built on history, faith, and sound.

The Fifth Bell is inspired by classic 90s adventure games, combining elegant European atmosphere, slow-burn mystery, cinematic storytelling, a meticulously developed soundtrack, and rich ambient sound design to create a premium narrative adventure experience.

Features

  • Classic 2D point-and-click adventure gameplay

  • A grounded mystery set across multiple European cities

  • Hand-painted style environments and cinematic story moments

  • Inventory and environmental puzzles tied closely to the narrative

  • A meticulously developed soundtrack and rich ambient sound design

  • Fully voiced scenes, memorable characters, and atmospheric dialogue

  • A historical conspiracy involving cathedrals, relics, and forbidden acoustics

Power Up is a single-player story-driven strategy game about a young man who, due to his illness, has spent his entire life isolated at home with his mother—until he finally steps into the corporate world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tokinotou (Tower of  time) is a soulslike command RPG built around intense 1-on-1 mind games.
Predict your enemy’s next move, choose the most advantageous response, raise your win rate, and strike the killing blow.

Guard beats weak attacks, parry beats strong attacks, and evade beats magic.
Your win rate shifts throughout battle, and when it reaches 100%, you can instantly kill your opponent.
With this unique system, every fight becomes a tense battle of prediction rather than a simple race to deplete HP.

Build your own playstyle through stat allocation, equipment, skills, and magic.
Focus on defense, maximize damage, or expand your tactical options with more skills and spells.
Climb the tower your own way.

The protagonist possesses the power to glimpse the near future and ventures into a tower where time itself has fallen into chaos.
Discover the truth behind the world cursed by time, and defeat the one waiting at the summit.

Story

Two nations were at war: Arsonia and Jumira.

Jumira was on the verge of collapse. On the eve of its capital’s fall, a time spell was activated from the tower where Jumira had long pursued its research.
The moment it was cast, the course of history changed.

The people of Jumira disappeared without a trace. Arsonia rejoiced in victory, but before long, it discovered a horrifying truth.

No one would ever grow old again.
No child would ever be born again.

This phenomenon became known as the Curse of Time.
Many soldiers were sent into the tower in search of a solution, but none of them ever came back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Visit planets. Meet explorers. Manage crew. Scavenge, steal and craft the resources you need to get home.

Space Suits is a roguelike narrative card game where you play as the captain of a stranded starship, searching for a path home through an unfamiliar galaxy.

Craft your own epic science fiction story: When supplies run low, and they will, how will you handle it? Will you scavenge for oxygen on the next planet, or “save” some instead by throwing a crewmember out of the airlock?

  • Explore: Discover strange planets, unknown stars, abandoned outposts, and the technologies and secrets hidden on them

  • Make contact: Encounter fellow travellers and decide how to deal with them: bargain, threaten, charm, bribe…

  • Scavenge & survive: Manage the fuel, supplies and materials to survive long enough to make it home

  • Craft: Discover blueprints to upgrade your starship, “acquire” the parts, and craft the odds in your favour

  • Carry the burden of command: Recruit drifters, train them, and lead them. Every decision you make will come with a cost

  • Hand-Drawn Cards: The galaxy is brought to life by painstakingly hand-drawn and shaded comic-book illustrations

  • Try, die and try again: Often your story will come to a tragic end, and when it does the procedurally-generated universe ensures no two journeys will be the same

store_data.about_the_game:
A perfect home, a practiced smile—and three quiet choices that can crack the foundation beyond repair.

In The Honored Wife, you play as Graham Hargrove—a respected architect, founding partner, and devoted husband with a life that looks flawless from the curb. A restored Craftsman home he designed, a wife who made it glow, and twenty years of rituals that read like proof. But on the morning after their anniversary, three small, harmless moments open three doors—and one irreversible choice forces Graham to confront the question at the heart of the story: is goodness who you are, or what you can perform until it stops working?

Meet the Cast




Zara — The Fault Line
Emory's college roommate: young, confident, and woven into the Hargrove household with the casual intimacy of a frequent guest. Her curiosity and attention feel harmless—until Graham realizes the danger isn't temptation, but the moment he starts treating the wrong door like an exit.



Adrienne — The Blueprint
A senior associate on the partner track—brilliant, fearless, and precise enough to turn admiration into leverage without ever raising her voice. She doesn't seduce Graham with flirtation; she seduces him by seeing the architect he used to be, pulling him back toward impossible designs and impossible choices.



Paige — The Mirror
Claire's best friend—family in everything but blood—newly divorced and trying to rebuild a life that no longer feels like hers. With Graham, she doesn't reach for desire so much as the shape of stability he represents, reflecting back the marriage she lost—and the one she might help destroy.

Key Features


  • Single-choice branching romance: One pivotal decision launches you into a full route—each with its own tone, risks, and consequences.
  • A mature domestic thriller: Explore betrayal not as melodrama, but as accumulation—texts, glances, missing degrees of warmth.
  • Architecture as metaphor: Blueprints, glass walls, load-bearing lies—the spaces you inhabit reflect the secrets you build.
  • Power, intimacy, and consequence: Routes explore workplace dynamics, friendship boundaries, and the weight of trust within a family.
  • Themes-driven storytelling: Every scene is shaped by questions of performance, identity, and the cost of being seen.

Adult Content


Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes. Contains adult content in every route.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Trader's Life! Step into the shoes of an ambitious shopkeeper in a bustling medieval fantasy world. Take charge of your very own trading post, manage your resources, and make shrewd business decisions. Buy low, negotiate with customers, and upgrade your wares to rise from a simple peddler to the most renowned merchant in the realm!

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Negotiation: Engage in a deep haggling system. Read your customers, accept offers, or push for higher prices. Be careful, pushing too hard will lower your shop's popularity!

  • Blacksmith Upgrades: Use your hard-earned materials to improve weapons and armor, increasing their rarity and overall market value.

  • Elemental Enchantments: Apply Fire, Ice, and Lightning magic directly to your items to create powerful, highly profitable set bonuses.

  • Living Economy: Adapt to daily world events. Material shortages, royal festivals, and sudden wars will dramatically shift the supply and demand of specific items.

  • Protect Your Goods: Wealth attracts thieves. Hire varying tiers of guards to protect your inventory during the dangerous night phase.

  • Expand Your Shop: Reinvest your gold to upgrade your shop's interior, expand your counter space, and attract wealthier, premium clients.

  • Research Tree: Unlock permanent passive bonuses and new abilities across three distinct branches: Trade, Blacksmithing, and Alchemy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Its 1983.

You were playing around with your Grandfather's shiny new computer terminal, where you stumbled upon a strangely addictive game: Numbers Go Up is a 2048-inspired roguelike deckbuilder all about crafting powerful builds and pushing your luck on a 4×4 grid.

In Numbers Go Up, you Slide tiles - and try to catch as many combos as you can, scoring on merges, and spend gold between rounds on mods and tile enhancements that completely transform how the board behaves. You'll need every edge you can get to beat rising score targets, survive boss blinds, and clear all eight antes.  

  • The definitive 2048 roguelike experience.

  • Every slide is a decision. mods and enhancements turn simple merges into cascading score engines.

  • With each boss beaten, the terminal reboots - escalating the steaks that break your strategy and force you to adapt.

Challenge your firends and other players in competitive lobbies with dedicated matchmaking. 

You + a Rival, play the same game, highest score wins. 

Control the terminal with powerful hacks you buy off of the blackmarket hacking bazaar. Each giving you unique control over the program.

Lose yourself in the flow. The board fills, the pressure builds, you find the slide — and the score counter erupts. Number Go Up is built for the moment where your whole build clicks and the numbers stop making sense.

  • 30-minute runs. Short enough for one more. Deep enough for one hundred more.

  • Build diversity across thousands of mods and enhancement combinations — no two runs play the same.

  • Scoring theater: watch chips arc, multipliers stack, and counters  punch with every merge.

  • Multiplayer: same seed, same conditions, only decisions differ. Highest score wins.

Edward Blackwood, shipping magnate, is found dead in his first-class cabin. The door was locked from the inside. Five suspects. No way off the ship.

This is not about finding the killer. This is about breaking people.

Talk to anyone. Ask anything. Every suspect is powered by AI — they remember every word you've said, they'll deflect, contradict themselves, and unravel under pressure in real time. No dialogue options. No scripted paths. Every conversation is unique.

Find the contradictions. Build your case. Apply the pressure. And listen carefully when someone finally cracks.

Four voyages. One truth.

Your detective's license grants passage for four complete investigations of the Blackwood case — four chances to approach the truth from different angles, four chances to press harder, four chances to fail. Each voyage ends when you submit your final report, and the file is sealed forever. Whatever you missed — every secret almost told, every moment you didn't push far enough — will be waiting for you in the archive.

They all have something to hide. So does the truth. All of it finds you eventually.

A competitive multiplayer territory conquest game where quick thinking matters just as much as strategy.

On a neon-lit hexagonal grid, 2 to 8 players clash in intense matches. Capture tiles, generate mana, cast your spells, and prevent your enemies from doing the same. Easy to learn. Harder to master.

The battlefield is a weapon. Tiles you control deal damage to enemies who step onto them. The more territory you claim, the more mana you gain—and the more dangerous you become. But your enemies see it too. Every second counts.

- **Bump** — Knock your enemy away

- **Wave** — A devastating wave

- **Punch** — A brutal direct hit

- **Bomb** — A delayed explosion, perfect for claiming territory

- **Mine** — Invisible, sneaky, non-lethal, stuns the enemy

- **Turret** — Place a turret on one of your tiles to increase the damage of adjacent ones

**Death is not the end.** For 10 seconds, you become a ghost: invisible, invulnerable, untouchable. Just enough time to catch your breath…

store_data.about_the_game:
Cursed Clouds 64 is a N64-Inspired 3D platformer with collectathon elements and a classical-ocarina-like spell mechanic.

Story:

You play as Pawzibal, a young cat-magician who lives together with his grandfather near a big banish-crystal. This crystal was created to ban an ancient evil fog, thousands of years ago…

But someday you wake up and the grandfather is missing. At the same time, the banish-crystal losts his power and the whole world is covered with the evil fog again!

Find out what happened and try to re-empower the banish-crystal to chase away this evil fog.

Go on an adventure with a lot of mysteries, platforming challenges and puzzles.

But you’re not on your own! A mysterious book accompanies you and supports you with magic-spells and useful tips along your journey.

Features:

  • A Hub-area with a lot of verticality and hidden places to explore

  • 5 unique Levels to unlock

  • A spell mechanic with over 10 various magic abilities to learn

  • A classic moveset with some extras like a roll-jump and ledge-grab

store_data.about_the_game:
RanaRangam transforms classic chess into a step-based tactical battle where every command matters beyond a single turn. Instead of pieces instantly reaching their destination, they move only one step per turn toward the command you give them. This means you can issue an order to your Queen, then on the next turn command a Pawn, and both pieces will continue carrying out their assigned actions at the same time. Your army keeps moving, creating a battlefield where planning ahead, timing, and coordination are everything.

Winning is no longer about a simple checkmate. In RanaRangam, pieces have health, attacks happen through battle, and the King must be defeated to win. Checks are still important, but instead of ending the match immediately, putting the King in check causes it to lose health, adding constant pressure and making positioning far more dangerous.

The strategy goes even deeper with ultimate abilities, allowing pieces to unleash powerful effects that can change the course of a match. Pieces can also support allies by restoring their health when they are in valid positions, making offense, defense, and team coordination equally important.

Built on familiar chess foundations, RanaRangam turns every match into a living tactical fight where pieces keep following commands, battles unfold over time, and victory comes from smart movement, pressure, healing, and killing the enemy King.

store_data.about_the_game:
Celestial Routes is a space exploration game in which players take on the role of galactic citizens, tasked with paying taxes and collaborate with the colonial and the galactic government authorities. And survive as an individual. To do that, navigating through various galaxies, discovering new planets, and interacting with alien environments is unavoidable. The game is designed to provide a sense of economical and physical survival, as well as wonder and adventure. And, collaboration may not be the only choice that player makes. The other choice might be going on rebel against the authorities.

The environment is a star ayatem, where player starts inside their apartment flat under expropriation at a space station. There may be a number of planets, moons, other planets, debris areas, and conflict areas depending on the system properties. Economy, security level, and celestial body types of the system are defined per star system basis. 

Missions are the core part of the game. There are several types of missions: making deliveries, recovering a lost package, capturing a creature, destroying a creature nest, destroying outlaws presence, stealing data, preventing an asteroid attack. When completed, some of these missions  may trigger additional missions which initiates small storylines when engaged. 

These missions can only be listen and accepted on a base computer present inside a player base. A basic base building is provided to the player during the voice directed initiation period of the game in building deed form placed in inventory. Then, player constructs this deed on a planet of their choice. Player bases are subject to government taxes and lost when these taxes are not paid on due date. Tax rates may change from planet to planet. 

Space flight is one of the core activities in the game. Distances may be vast and careful fuel planing is needed in order not to get stuck in deep space. Players can call help in such a situation which provides an expensive fuel purchase service that may put the player in debt. A minus sign before in-game credits amount shows the total debt of the player. Suggested way of travelling huge distances is using warp gate services. There facilities can be found outside space stations but not all of them have those, and the service fee is hight. These and similar opportunities makes earning in-game credits an important aspect of the game.

The game provides combat in both third person and ship modes. For third person mode, several weapons are designed to give the experience of different combat styles. These weapons can be looted on the coarpses or can be purchased at the base compurters inside player bases. 

Expansion of the base is possible through the purchased base parts also which can be found at the base computers. However, every expansion part adds an amount to the overall tax amount of the main base building. It may be easy to expand but hard to maintain in some occasions.

Another useful service at the base compuetr is marketplace services. Here, it is possible to earn in-game credits by buying some amount of the goods listed here, and selling them on space stations or in the surface facilities found on planet surfaces. Some of these goods are mined elements which can also be mined on an asteroid. 

Base computers also provide items for purchase which are used to modify ships and weapons providing fuel efficiency, increased fuel capacity, speed modification, extra damage, and more. 

Improving flight capabilities is the key part for the exploration. Players are provided different spaceship models which demonstrate various capabilities on flight range, max speed, fuel efficiency, fuel capacity, damage rate, manoeuvrability, and warp range, the last of which is an important stat for completing interstellar time based missions. These purchasable ships can be found at exhibition areas inside space stations. 

As a summary, the main task is to survive under these heavy tax and fine economy. Player can choose between gaining influence on the government to receive tax incentives, or completely go rebel agains the government which may add some disadvantages to the gameplay on some systems and provide advantages on others. In either case, earning credits is the most important part of the game.

The game is designed to provide a sense of economical and physical survival, as well as wonder and adventure. And, collaboration may not be the only choice that player makes. The other choice might be going on rebel against the authorities.

The environment is a star ayatem, where player starts inside their apartment flat under expropriation at a space station. There may be a number of planets, moons, other planets, debris areas, and conflict areas depending on the system properties. Economy, security level, and celestial body types of the system are defined per star system basis. 

Missions are the core part of the game. There are several types of missions: making deliveries, recovering a lost package, capturing a creature, destroying a creature nest, destroying outlaws presence, stealing data, preventing an asteroid attack. When completed, some of these missions  may trigger additional missions which initiates small storylines when engaged. 

These missions can only be listen and accepted on a base computer present inside a player base. A basic base building is provided to the player during the voice directed initiation period of the game in building deed form placed in inventory. Then, player constructs this deed on a planet of their choice. Player bases are subject to government taxes and lost when these taxes are not paid on due date. Tax rates may change from planet to planet. 

Space flight is one of the core activities in the game. Distances may be vast and careful fuel planing is needed in order not to get stuck in deep space. Players can call help in such a situation which provides an expensive fuel purchase service that may put the player in debt. A minus sign before in-game credits amount shows the total debt of the player. Suggested way of travelling huge distances is using warp gate services. There facilities can be found outside space stations but not all of them have those, and the service fee is hight. These and similar opportunities makes earning in-game credits an important aspect of the game.

The game provides combat in both third person and ship modes. For third person mode, several weapons are designed to give the experience of different combat styles. These weapons can be looted on the coarpses or can be purchased at the base compurters inside player bases. 

Expansion of the base is possible through the purchased base parts also which can be found at the base computers. However, every expansion part adds an amount to the overall tax amount of the main base building. It may be easy to expand but hard to maintain in some occasions.

Another useful service at the base compuetr is marketplace services. Here, it is possible to earn in-game credits by buying some amount of the goods listed here, and selling them on space stations or in the surface facilities found on planet surfaces. Some of these goods are mined elements which can also be mined on an asteroid. 

Base computers also provide items for purchase which are used to modify ships and weapons providing fuel efficiency, increased fuel capacity, speed modification, extra damage, and more. 

Improving flight capabilities is the key part for the exploration. Players are provided different spaceship models which demonstrate various capabilities on flight range, max speed, fuel efficiency, fuel capacity, damage rate, manoeuvrability, and warp range, the last of which is an important stat for completing interstellar time based missions. These purchasable ships can be found at exhibition areas inside space stations. 

As a summary, the main task is to survive under these heavy tax and fine economy. Player can choose between gaining influence on the government to receive tax incentives, or completely go rebel agains the government which may add some disadvantages to the gameplay on some systems and provide advantages on others. In either case, earning credits is the most important part of the game.
store_data.short_description: A sci-fi space flight, exploration, and survival game in third person. Survival is important in this universe, both physically and economically. Exploring different planets, spacestations, and debris areas, and surface facilities is the key part for scavenging and collecting materials and tools.

store_data.about_the_game:
Time is broken. People from every era are being pulled into the anomaly and converted into grey-shelled constructs powered by temporal energy. You are one of the few who resisted.

Anachronistic Survivors is a bullet heaven where weapons from across history collide. Swing a Bronze Khopesh alongside a Tesla Coil. Fire a Flintlock Pistol while a medieval Thurible orbits around you. Then fuse them together into something that shouldn't exist.

WEAPON FUSION

9 base weapons spanning 5 eras, from Obsidian Shard to Void Siphon. Every weapon upgrades 3 times, each level adding a meaningful new behavior. Max out two weapons and fuse them into one of 36 unique combinations. The fusion frees a weapon slot, letting you pick up something new and fuse again. Chase different fusion paths every run.

6 SURVIVORS

Each character is from a different era, with a unique starting weapon, passive ability, and drawback. The Hunter-Gatherer hits harder but can't rely on invincibility frames. The Oracle sees more choices but gains XP slower. The Displaced can fuse weapons earlier but deals less base damage.

15 WAVES OF ESCALATION

Waves start calm. A few grey shapes shuffling toward you. By wave 10, the screen is full of spectral rushers, explosive constructs, and things that used to be human. Three hand-crafted bosses punctuate the run at waves 5, 10, and 15. The final boss mirrors your own weapons back at you.

BETWEEN-WAVE SHOP

Spend gold on relics that modify your build with passive effects. 3 relics offered per wave. Reroll if nothing fits. Lock what you want for later. Weapons come from leveling up. Relics come from the shop. Two systems, two currencies, clean decisions.

THE ANOMALY GROWS

As waves progress, the world destabilizes. Visual distortion creeps in. Colors shift. Reality frays. By wave 14, the screen is barely holding together. Then everything collapses into a single point, and the final boss appears in the sudden silence.

FEATURES

- 9 base weapons with 3 upgrade levels each

- 36 handcrafted weapon fusions

- 6 playable characters with distinct playstyles

- 3 multi-phase bosses

- Between-wave relic shop

- Persistent fusion codex tracking your discoveries

- Meta-progression with permanent upgrades

- 15-20 minute runs

- Eerie, unsettling atmosphere that escalates throughout each run

Void Runner is a fast-paced arcade game where your reflexes are essential for survival. You control a character using the arrow keys and must avoid red obstacles that deal instant damage. With only three lives represented by hearts, every mistake can be fatal.

To help you, different power-ups appear:

Yellow items make you temporarily invincible, allowing you to touch red obstacles without losing a life.

Blue items quickly increase your score.

The game features multiple difficulty levels as well as a ranked mode to challenge other players and improve your performance.

Simple to understand but difficult to master, Void Runner will put your reflexes and concentration to the test.

Happy fishing!

store_data.about_the_game:
Outta Space

Outta Space is a cozy, idle space exploration game designed to live right on your desktop. While your cat sails from the Moon to Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and even distant star systems, you can continue working or playing other games, checking in on your feline explorer's progress whenever you like.

Key Features

  • Desktop Widget Mode: The game runs in a small, non-intrusive window in the corner of your screen. Even when minimized, your cat continues its lonely but beautiful voyage through the cosmos.

  • Global Input System: Your daily productivity fuels your journey! Outta Space detects your system-wide activity: every keystroke charges your Booster, and every mouse click earns you Credits. Your work literally becomes your progress.

  • Dynamic Booster Mechanics: Once the booster gauge is full, it automatically triggers, tripling your travel speed. Use your credits to upgrade booster capacity and multipliers for even faster exploration.

  • 17 Real-World Destinations: Experience the vastness of space through 17 scientifically inspired locations. Journey through the 8 planets of our solar system and venture out to interstellar giants like Proxima Centauri, Sirius, Vega, and Betelgeuse, all based on real astronomical distance data.

  • Deep Upgrade & Collection System: Invest your hard-earned credits into core ship stats like Thrust, Booster Capacity, and Speed. You can also collect and unlock a variety of unique cats to lead your mission.

  • Steam Friends Integration: You’re not alone in the void. See where your Steam friends are currently located in the galaxy. If you and a friend are exploring the same sector, their cat will appear on your screen for a brief encounter!

  • Relaxing Pixel Art Aesthetic: Featuring warm, lo-fi pixel graphics and a calm atmosphere, the game is designed to be kept on for hours without causing eye strain or distraction.

How to Play

  • Launch and Forget: Open the game and position the widget wherever you like.

  • Live Your Life: Go about your usual computer tasks. Your cat travels further with every word you type and every link you click.

  • Upgrade and Advance: Occasionally return to the window to purchase upgrades and optimize your voyage.

  • Reach New Horizons: When you arrive at a new planet or star, hit the "Land" button to explore the docking screen and prepare for the next massive leg of your journey.

  • Loadout experiments: Test and combine dozens of weapons, items and boosts from one run to the next.

  • Adaptative strategy: Think fast, move well and react cleanly to the ever-more powerful enemies, the increasing constraints and the growing chaos in each new game.

store_data.about_the_game:
🚜 Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales

Beyond the Soil: Farming & Tales is a comprehensive farming simulation with deep mechanics where you can build your own world in the heart of nature. 

🌟 KEY GAME DYNAMICS

Deep Farming and Livestock: Cultivate the soil, sow your seeds, and water your crops to grow. Farm a wide range of crops, from strawberries and tomatoes to wheat and squash, while raising animals like cows, sheep, chickens, and pigs to liven up your farm.

Advanced Camera and Viewing System: Your view is never interrupted as you pass through houses or navigate between town models. Thanks to our intelligent camera system, obstacles become transparent, always giving you the best angle.

Crafting and Building: Build your own structures with the resources you gather (wood, rock, straw). Customize your farm completely to your needs, from fences and barbecue areas to chests and special shelters.

Survival and Development: Balance your character's health, hunger, and thirst. Protect yourself from the cold using heat sources and unlock new bonus effects by improving your skills with the leveling system (XP).

🛠️ DETAILED MECHANICS

Inventory and Equipment: Manage the resources you gather in an advanced inventory system. Dominate nature with tools like hoes, scythes, axes, pickaxes, and fishing rods.

Hunting and Fishing: Don't just farm! Fish in lakes or hunt in the wilderness, tracking animals like deer, bears, and squirrels.

Culinary Arts: Carry the fruits, apples, and meats you gather to the kitchen. Refresh your energy by cooking delicious meals like tacos, popcorn, and bread.

Dynamic World: Manage time with the day/night cycle and game clock. Develop your strategy by considering the durability of your crops and the spoilage times of food.

Friendly Pets and Protection: Take your pets with you; they can attack for you, chase enemies, and even help you by digging.

🏘️ A LIVING TOWN ATMOSPHERE

With town models, streetlights, benches, and shop stands, the game world is more than just a field! With custom 2D icons and animated male/female characters designed for interactive models, you'll feel like you're part of a real community. Whether you defend yourself with melee or ranged attacks, a new adventure awaits you at every turn in this valley.

store_data.about_the_game:
PREPARE FOR CHAOS, BUILD YOUR DEFENSE, AND PROTECT THE CRYSTAL!

Shard Defender: Rogue is an adrenaline-fueled survival struggle that tests your marksmanship and strategic intellect. The enemies are ruthless, the waves are endless, and time is running out. To survive, pulling the trigger isn't enough; you must also weave a deadly network of defenses.

The Perfect Harmony of Action and Strategy

Fighting against waves of enemies requires split-second decisions. Right in the heat of battle, support your own firepower with automated defense systems by building tactical towers at the right spots. You must be both a mobile shooter and the architect of the battlefield.

Build an Impenetrable Line

Turn every path leading to the crystal into a deadly trap. Strategically place towers with different damage types and areas of effect based on enemy weaknesses. Slow down enemy swarms, funnel them into a single chokepoint, or turn them to ashes with concentrated firepower.

A Different Power Fantasy Every Run

Thanks to roguelike mechanics, no two encounters are ever the same. Create your own build with randomized upgrades offered after each wave. Whether you push your weapon's fire rate beyond its limits or multiply your towers' destructiveness to massive proportions, finding the right combination is the key to victory.

Ruthless Swarms and Giant Bosses

Increasingly difficult enemy waves and powerful Bosses that will disrupt your defense strategy await you. Enemies will look for your weak points and try every path to reach the crystal. You must constantly keep moving, optimize your towers, and use your reflexes to the fullest.

Key Features:

store_data.detailed_description:
PREPARE FOR CHAOS, BUILD YOUR DEFENSE, AND PROTECT THE CRYSTAL!

Shard Defender: Rogue is an adrenaline-fueled survival struggle that tests your marksmanship and strategic intellect. The enemies are ruthless, the waves are endless, and time is running out. To survive, pulling the trigger isn't enough; you must also weave a deadly network of defenses.

The Perfect Harmony of Action and Strategy

Fighting against waves of enemies requires split-second decisions. Right in the heat of battle, support your own firepower with automated defense systems by building tactical towers at the right spots. You must be both a mobile shooter and the architect of the battlefield.

Build an Impenetrable Line

Turn every path leading to the crystal into a deadly trap. Strategically place towers with different damage types and areas of effect based on enemy weaknesses. Slow down enemy swarms, funnel them into a single chokepoint, or turn them to ashes with concentrated firepower.

A Different Power Fantasy Every Run

Thanks to roguelike mechanics, no two encounters are ever the same. Create your own build with randomized upgrades offered after each wave. Whether you push your weapon's fire rate beyond its limits or multiply your towers' destructiveness to massive proportions, finding the right combination is the key to victory.

Ruthless Swarms and Giant Bosses

Increasingly difficult enemy waves and powerful Bosses that will disrupt your defense strategy await you. Enemies will look for your weak points and try every path to reach the crystal. You must constantly keep moving, optimize your towers, and use your reflexes to the fullest.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Hybrid Gameplay: A seamless blend of fluid first-person shooter mechanics and deep tower defense strategy.

  • Endless Replayability: A roguelike progression system offering different ability combinations on every run.

  • Tactical Building: A variety of towers with different tactical advantages that can be built mid-combat.

  • Customizable Builds: The ability to create devastating weapon and tower synergies tailored to your playstyle.

  • Challenging Enemies: Diverse enemy types and epic Boss fights that will constantly test your defenses.

store_data.about_the_game:
ChompBurg is a modern arcade roguelike, mixing the fast and precise arcade-y gameplay and the player freedom of modern games

PREY UPON THE FEEBLE VILLAGERS

Bound to undeniable servitude by Dracula's spell, you're now cursed to spend your nights hunting the meek villagers of Chompburg. Move through the streets of the county collecting blood to satiate your master's thirst, while avoiding the hunters that seek to rid the village of your wicked presence and using your master's blessings to create powerful combinations.

EXPERIMENT WITH BLOOD MAGIC

Buy, merge and experiment with over a 100 different blood strains, mixing them into your flasks to create unique strategies. Eat, kill, create, promote, control their lives so that you can make the most of each night. Collect the flasks during the hunt to harness their effects and become Fearsome, so you can show those pesky hunters who really runs this town.

BUILD THE COUNTY, SHAPE THEIR LIVES

They think it's their town, it's not. Customize Chompburg to your linking by choosing over 40 different buildings and 10 special road tiles that further enhance your strategy and manipulate the layout of the county, taking into account their positioning on the maze to customize your runs. Add new villagers to the county with unique abilities that will help on your quest for blood.

BEWARE THOSE OPPOSING YOU

Dracula's influence is felt in the realms beyond, and Angels will descend from haven to protect Chompburg and it's residents. Although incapable of intervening directly, their power will change the rules of the game. Each run, will encounter a different set of bosses with unique rules that will test your skills and understanding of the game, choosing when to face them for greater rewards!

SMASH THE SCORE!

Collect villagers, defeat hunters, score hundreds upon hundreds of points. Build your synergies just right, and you may become strong enough to break Dracula's hold over you and regain your freedom. And maybe, just maybe, revenge is due…

store_data.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Into the Hole is an indie horror experience inspired by Backrooms lore — but this is not just another level.
This is a parallel liminal space, where reality feels off, paths don’t make sense, and the only way forward… is down.

You navigate eerie, non-linear environments by jumping into holes, each one leading to unpredictable places. Some paths bring you closer to escape. Others take you deeper into something you don’t understand.

Play solo or with friends in co-op, explore together, split up, or take risks as a team. Every decision changes your route.

But you are not alone.
Entities inhabit this space — watching, moving, hunting. One wrong move is enough.

🔥 Features:

  • Indie horror set in a liminal, Backrooms-inspired space

  • Core mechanic: progress by jumping into holes

  • Co-op multiplayer — survive and explore with friends

  • Multiple paths and alternative routes

  • Unpredictable, unsettling environments

There is no clear direction.
No guaranteed exit.

Just one question:
Do you jump?

store_data.about_the_game:
Farm Harbeest is a top-down farm shooter with light incremental progression. Become an armed little bee, leave your cozy home, and set out across wild farms for an all-in-one harvesting adventure!

Frenetic Combat & Harvesting:
Take on mischievous farm animals, defeat them for drops, and harvest plant resources across the field. The more you fight and collect, the faster your efficiency grows—and the fuller your backpack becomes.

Base Upgrades & Tech Tree:
Return home with a pack full of resources, sit down at your computer, and begin your “hacker evolution.” With a huge branching tree of 100 skills, you can shape your own upgrade path: boost damage and fire rate, summon Black Holes for automatic harvesting, push dash speed to the limit, or unleash Split Stingers for overwhelming firepower. Become the strongest bee on the farm!

Explore Fantastical Farms:
Unlock multiple unique biomes—from lush forests to lively summer beaches, from vibrant autumn valleys to quiet snowy towns. Each area has its own animals and plant resources waiting to be discovered.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fractured - a psychological episodic horror that exposes the true nightmare of our world.

You're playing the third part.

In life, you always have to choose. Sometimes that choice is painfully difficult. Especially with the job of a train driver. You can't abandon your family for another week, just like you can't abandon your job. But maybe the isolation inside the train cab can help you think clearly... or leave you completely alone when it matters most.

Fractured: Snowpine Strangers tells the story of Matt, a freight train driver. The endless clatter of the wheels could drive anyone insane, but Matt finds a strange comfort in it. Until this run.

Days before Christmas, he's called in for one more haul. He has no choice but to leave his family behind. This time, the distance feels different. This time, he's not alone on the rails.

Will he make it back?

Gameplay:

First-person narrative-driven story with a train driving system.

Features:

  • Voice acting inspired by 90s movies

  • Atmospheric low-poly art style

  • Immersive environments

  • Train driving system

store_data.about_the_game:
Choose your Trainer and master a world of strategic autobattles in this replayable roguelite deckbuilder-inspired creature battler.

Every run starts with a critical decision.

Select a Trainer with unique passives, exclusive unit pools, and game-changing mechanics. Your opening choice defines your path and shapes every future decision.

Build a team of strange creatures called Pauls, each with distinct abilities, roles, and synergies. Frontline tanks, ranged attackers, summoners, supports, death triggers, sustain engines, and scaling carries can all become part of your strategy.

Combat plays out automatically, but victory depends entirely on preparation.

Position your units carefully, manage your reserve, adapt to enemy compositions, and create powerful combinations that grow stronger over time.

Defeat enemies—or capture them mid-battle.

Weaken opponents and recruit them into your roster, turning dangerous threats into key pieces of your build.

Choose your route across a branching map filled with normal battles, elite encounters, upgrades, shops, rest sites, and bosses. Every node is a strategic tradeoff between power, greed, recovery, and risk.

No two runs play the same.

Features:

• Unique Trainers that redefine each run
• Deep team-building and synergy crafting
• Capture enemies during battle
• Strategic positioning and roster management
• Branching map progression with meaningful choices
• Elite fights and boss encounters
• High replayability through evolving builds
• Easy to learn, difficult to master

store_data.about_the_game:
Revenant Survivors is an action horde survival roguelite with impactful combat. Carve through endless waves of enemies in a dark fantasy world. Absorb souls, defeat bosses, and become the world’s final evil.

Bosses are more than a reward. They are your next source of power. Absorb their souls to grow stronger, claim their gear to wield boss skills, and usurp their bodies to unlock new playable characters. Every boss you defeat also gives you a new choice that reshapes the run.

Combat is not just about bigger numbers. Every soul you absorb and every boss you defeat opens up new build choices. Usurped boss gear, set effects, and altar relics create powerful synergies. Stack elemental debuffs, then unleash devastating follow-up attacks.

Craft stronger equipment from the gear and materials you gather. Complete boss gear sets and prepare for the next battlefield. Expand both character and player skill trees to deepen your long-term progression and unlock new ways to dominate future runs.

Every Keystroke Counts

Whether you're looking to improve your typing speed or just want a fun way to practice, Keeb Quest turns every keypress into an adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hotdog stands are disappearing.

One by one, they’re gone…

Until only one remains.

The Last Hotdog Stand.

Your hotdog stand...?

Step into the role of a hotdog stand owner and serve up tasty creations in a fast-paced, chaotic food management experience. Take customer orders, assemble each hotdog correctly, and serve them before patience runs out!

🔥 Fast-Paced Food Frenzy

Orders come in quick, and every second matters! Balance prepping, assembling, and serving to keep your customers satisfied and your stand running smoothly. Over time customers will lose patience, cutting into your tips, or leaving altogether.

Customers also get annoyed if they have to repeat themselves, so you'll want to do your best to remember their orders when they arrive!

🌭 Customize Your Creations

As you grow your hotdog business, you can expand your menu with new toppings, buns, sausages, and even sides! The more you unlock, the more complex (and lucrative) your hotdog orders become.

📍 Grow Your Hotdog Empire

Start out in a quiet park and work your way up to bigger and more demanding locations by purchasing permits to move your stand. Each new location brings a different crowd, with their own pace, patience, and tipping habits.

🎮 Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Simple controls make it easy to jump in and start selling hotdogs, but as you unlock new ingredients and locations the difficulty increases significantly, as you have to manage juggling more complex orders, a higher flow of customers, and more impatient customers.

store_data.about_the_game:
What Is Vatan?

Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama experience set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, your decisions change the story's tone, relationships, and path to the finale.

An Emotional, Choice-Driven Story

Each scene emphasizes not "the right choice," but the question of "which sacrifice you are willing to take on." As the bonds you build with characters grow stronger, your decisions become heavier and more personal.

A Vivid Period Atmosphere

Poverty, migration, front-line reports, burdens within the family, and social pressure do more than describe the spirit of the era; they make the player feel it. The story brings major historical fractures to life on a human scale.

Relationships and Character Bonds

Your relationship with Mother, Father, Fatma, and other characters is shaped by your dialogue, your approach, and your choices. You can reach the same event through different emotions and experience the story through your own Ahmet.

Artistic Presentation and Atmosphere

A stylized visual language, close to an oil-painting texture, combines with an interface that supports period aesthetics and scene transitions that carry emotion to create a powerful atmosphere.
store_data.detailed_description:
What Is Vatan?

Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama experience set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, your decisions change the story's tone, relationships, and path to the finale.

An Emotional, Choice-Driven Story

Each scene emphasizes not "the right choice," but the question of "which sacrifice you are willing to take on." As the bonds you build with characters grow stronger, your decisions become heavier and more personal.

A Vivid Period Atmosphere

Poverty, migration, front-line reports, burdens within the family, and social pressure do more than describe the spirit of the era; they make the player feel it. The story brings major historical fractures to life on a human scale.

Relationships and Character Bonds

Your relationship with Mother, Father, Fatma, and other characters is shaped by your dialogue, your approach, and your choices. You can reach the same event through different emotions and experience the story through your own Ahmet.

Artistic Presentation and Atmosphere

A stylized visual language, close to an oil-painting texture, combines with an interface that supports period aesthetics and scene transitions that carry emotion to create a powerful atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
One new rule changes everything.

Place a piece. Flip your opponent's pieces.
Simple enough — except every time a piece gets flipped, its score doubles.

2, 4, 8, 16, 32…
And when a piece finally hits 2048, the board shakes.

🎮 Features

◆ More pieces won't save you
Every piece starts with a score of 2. Each flip doubles it. Victory is decided not by piece count, but by total score. You can hold 30 pieces and still lose to a single "2048."

◆ Built for comebacks
No lead is safe. One chain of high-score flips can swing the entire game in an instant. Even letting your opponent flip your pieces can be part of the plan — tension lasts until the very last move.

◆ Multiple game modes

  • 🧩 Solo puzzle mode

  • 👥 Local 2-player

  • 🤖 vs CPU

  • 🌐 Online multiplayer (with rating)

◆ Something to chase
Your highest total score and highest single-piece score are saved locally. Keep playing, keep breaking your own records.

Easy to learn. Hard to master.
If you know Reversi, you'll feel it on your very first move — this isn't the Reversi you remember.

store_data.about_the_game:
You lost because you're worse. Not because of RNG, not because of gear, not because someone paid more than you. You lost because you used your trinket too early, missed your kick, and panicked when you should have kited.

Fix that and try again.

Ebon Crucible is arena PvP. Real-time, skill-based, no-excuses combat. 1v1 and 2v2 ranked with 3v3 on the way. If you played WoW arena, you already know. If you didn't, think fighting game decision-making with RPG class depth.

Five classes. 63 abilities. Stuns, roots, fears, interrupts, gap closers, shields, burst windows, healing. Every match is a puzzle where the other piece is trying to kill you.

THE FIVE

TYRANT - Melee pressure that doesn't stop. Build Rage, shred armor, execute at 30%. Two gap closers. Good luck running.

WRAITH - Stealth opener into Combo Points into a finisher that ends fights. If it doesn't kill, Vanish and reset. Your opponent never feels safe.

INFERNAL - Stack Cinders from range. At 5 stacks, Cataclysm Flare one-shots. Get kicked mid-cast and you're the one who dies.

HARBINGER - Death by a thousand cuts. DoTs, drains, and Fear. When the damage stacks up, Hex Rupture detonates all of it at once.

REVENANT - The hybrid everyone hates. Build Holy Power, then choose: kill them with a finisher or heal yourself back to full. Good luck figuring out which one is coming.

THE COMBAT

12-15 abilities per class. Cooldowns, costs, cast times. Chain CC to set up kills. Kick their heal to finish them off. Blow your shield too early and you're dead in 3 seconds.

This is not a game where you hold right-click and auto-attack. Every global cooldown matters.

CLIMB

Ranked 1v1 and 2v2 with separate ratings. Five tiers: The Broken, The Proven, The Exalted, The Dread, The Ascended. The #1 player is the Crucible Champion. You can spectate their matches live.

3v3 is coming.

MORE WAYS TO FIGHT

Custom Games - 4-letter room code. Settle it with your friends.

VS AI - Three difficulties. Learn before you queue.

THE ECONOMY

Coins - Every ranked match pays. Win streaks pay more.

Battle Pass - 50 tiers per season. All cosmetic.

Shop - Frames, portraits, titles. Nothing that makes you stronger.

CROSSPLAY

Steam and browser. Same servers, same ladder, same matchmaking. Your account works on both.

store_data.about_the_game:
About the Artists:

Married for over 20 years, Elias and Promise still share their love for music and creative development. Truly a marriage of music, this husband and wife duo share a love and creativity for the art of poetry and music expression. Male Lead Vocalist/Rapper and Music Producer: Elias (Eli)  Female Vocalist: Promise

Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life (Original):

The album "Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life" was originally recorded and published years ago back in 2002 under another group name. Now re-mastered and re-released, the original album and songs are available in an interactive experience. Explore the map or follow the designated path and experience each song and visual video. (NO AI was ever used during production or recording of music, lyrics or vocals) *Beats, music production, mixing and pre-mastering and lyrics are original studio productions from artist Elias from Forever Epic Story. Vocals were performed by original artists Elias and Promise from Forever Epic Story.

Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life (Reimagined):

The album "Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life (Reimagined)" is a remake of the original album. Now using the assistance of AI for both beats and vocals, the album is now "reimagined" in an interactive experience. Journey through the map and experience each song with it's own animated background and music or experience the story mode with story based music videos for select songs.

Each song delivers a different story and tale to captivate and stimulate the imagination of the listener. Prepare to enter an epic journey into a world of creative sound and thought provoking lyrics. A never ending tale of inspiration, courage and fortitude, your Forever Epic Story now begins…

*Lyrics and production direction are by Elias and Promise from Forever Epic Story. *AI was used in the development of the cover art and video animations.

You will receive access to the interactive album application.

MP3 downloads of all 12 songs plus bonus tracks.

Access to our online community.

7.  Angels Up Above (Eternity)

store_data.about_the_game:
"Okinawa Soba Simulator" is a 3D simulation game where you run an Okinawan soba shop all by yourself.

Take on the role of the shop owner and handle everything from taking orders, cooking, serving, to managing payments. Work efficiently under time pressure and keep your customers satisfied by delivering meals without delay.

Boil noodles, prepare toppings, and serve freshly made dishes. While simple at first glance, the game focuses on timing, workflow, and decision-making.

Enjoy running your shop at your own pace in a calm, Okinawa-inspired atmosphere.

Key Features

  • Run a full restaurant workflow by yourself: order, cook, serve, and manage payments

  • Time management gameplay that rewards efficiency and planning

  • Prepare and serve Okinawa soba and other Okinawan dishes

  • Simple and intuitive controls

  • Relaxing and cozy atmosphere

Controls

  • Mouse: Look

  • Left Click: Interact

  • E: Interact / Hold interaction

  • Shift: Dash

store_data.about_the_game:
Take command of your fleet in Void Commander: Armada — a roguelite auto-battler where strategy, positioning, and smart deployment decide every battle.

Build your armada, choose your path across a dynamic campaign map, and face an overwhelming alien swarm that evolves with every encounter. No two runs are the same — only the strongest commanders survive.


Void Commander: Armada

Humanity didn’t see it coming.

Without warning, the outer systems fell silent. Colonies vanished. Fleets stopped responding.
From the darkness between stars, a new force emerged — the Roa'Khar.

A species that does not negotiate.
A species that does not retreat.
Only expands.

The Hierarchy of the Invaders

At the top stands the supreme ruler, the Resha'Khar — an entity rarely seen, yet felt across every battlefield.

Beneath him, two war commanders lead the endless assault:

  • Ben'Khal Adon – Master of direct annihilation, overwhelming enemies with brute force.

  • Ben'Khal Zoaar – A strategist of adaptation, evolving tactics with every encounter.

Their armies? Countless.

Human soldiers gave them a name:
“Swarmies” — because they come in waves… and they never stop.

Humanity’s Last Move

As system after system fell, humanity made a desperate decision.

They deployed a classified asset:

The Void Commander

Not just a fleet.
Not just a ship.

A mobile war factory, capable of rebuilding itself and producing new ships from salvaged wreckage — turning destruction into survival.

Your Mission

You are the Void Commander.

  • Build your fleet from scrap

  • Adapt to overwhelming enemy forces

  • Push deeper into enemy-controlled space

And most importantly:

Find the source of the Roa'Khar invasion…



before they reach the SOL system.
Choose Your Path

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Experiment with builds, discover powerful combinations, and refine your strategy with every attempt.



The War Has Already Begun

You are not here to win easily.
You are here to survive, adapt, and push back the swarm.

Every battle brings you closer to the truth.
Every loss feeds your next fleet.

Eliminate the Enemy Commander

TACTICAL AUTO-BATTLER COMBAT

Deploy your fleet and watch battles unfold automatically. Victory depends on smart positioning, fleet composition, and strategic decisions before the fight begins.

Smart Tactical Engagements

MEANINGFUL CHOICES

Every decision matters — from your route on the map to the upgrades you select. Adapt, take risks, and shape your run.

Master Your Arsenal

A species that does not negotiate.
A species that does not retreat.
Only expands.

The Hierarchy of the Invaders

At the top stands the supreme ruler, the Resha'Khar — an entity rarely seen, yet felt across every battlefield.

Beneath him, two war commanders lead the endless assault:

  • Ben'Khal Adon – Master of direct annihilation, overwhelming enemies with brute force.

  • Ben'Khal Zoaar – A strategist of adaptation, evolving tactics with every encounter.

Their armies? Countless.

Human soldiers gave them a name:
“Swarmies” — because they come in waves… and they never stop.

Humanity’s Last Move

As system after system fell, humanity made a desperate decision.

They deployed a classified asset:

The Void Commander

Not just a fleet.
Not just a ship.

A mobile war factory, capable of rebuilding itself and producing new ships from salvaged wreckage — turning destruction into survival.

Your Mission

You are the Void Commander.

  • Build your fleet from scrap

  • Adapt to overwhelming enemy forces

  • Push deeper into enemy-controlled space

And most importantly:

Find the source of the Roa'Khar invasion…



before they reach the SOL system.
Choose Your Path

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Experiment with builds, discover powerful combinations, and refine your strategy with every attempt.



The War Has Already Begun

You are not here to win easily.
You are here to survive, adapt, and push back the swarm.

Every battle brings you closer to the truth.
Every loss feeds your next fleet.

Eliminate the Enemy Commander

TACTICAL AUTO-BATTLER COMBAT

Deploy your fleet and watch battles unfold automatically. Victory depends on smart positioning, fleet composition, and strategic decisions before the fight begins.

Smart Tactical Engagements

MEANINGFUL CHOICES

Every decision matters — from your route on the map to the upgrades you select. Adapt, take risks, and shape your run.

Master Your Arsenal

store_data.about_the_game:
Valvontaa begins on a star vessel sent by Fellen, the leading organization striving to expand the borders of known space. You have been asked by Dr. Hanclaw to participate in an experiment, critical for the future of humanity. You will control the character Thomas, puppeteering him to explore the town of Trin Hollow and a mysterious mine. 

  • The town is located in an asteroid belt surrounding the planet Driigon.

Find unique armor and equipment to aid on your descent into the depths. Throughout the journey, you will interact with townsfolk and fight off hostile aliens. Uncover the source of the disturbance, which has sent the town into a state of disarray following the Eclipse of Shards. 

Key Features

  • Enemies. 

Prepare to face a variety of dangerous enemies. From the scuttling Hollow Crab to the vicious Red Imp, there is no shortage of encounters to overcome. As you descend deeper into the mines, the enemy types will continue to increase in difficulty. 

  • Player Choice & Exploration. 

In Valvontaa, no NPC is essential. You can avoid or even fight almost anyone in the game. Backtracking is always an option. You’re free to re-run a level of dungeon or return to a merchant to make a trade. The area around the main town is massive and offers a lot to explore. 

  •  Characters. 

During your time in Trin Hollow, you will encounter various NPCs. Interact with these characters to gain insight into the narrative and the mystery behind the Eclipse of Shards. Additionally, you will encounter merchants where you may buy items. Just be careful not to accidentally attack any of the passive NPCs… they will defend themselves or run if your karma drops too low.

  • Items/Loot.

Loot can be gathered through trading, killing enemies, and finding treasure chests. Upgrading your armor and weapons will help in combat encounters. 

  • Original Soundtrack.

What lurks below? That is the mystery you have been sent to investigate. Find the source of the flood of alien monsters before it’s too late.

Hope you enjoy the game and your time in Trin Hollow.
