store_data.about_the_game:
Not Today: Homeless Survival is a gritty urban survival game that forces you to face the unforgiving reality of the streets. In this brutal fight to stay alive, you'll learn to hustle for every dime, play on people's sympathies for spare change, and get your hands dirty when push comes to shove.

YOU HAVE 30 DAYS

A massive approaching winter storm is rapidly dropping the temperature, making the weather harsher with each passing day. Once the blizzard hits, surviving outside will be absolutely impossible, and you will feel the ruthless, bone-chilling cold in the worst way possible. You have exactly 30 days to scrape together enough cash to secure a warm roof over your head. Time is running out, and you must act fast to earn your way out before the streets freeze you completely.

STAYING CLEAN IN A DIRTY CITY

You can try to make money by begging, dumpster diving, collecting scrap, or using the guitar skills left over from your past life. It is entirely up to you to finish this game with your honor intact.

CROSSING TO THE DARK SIDE

Pickpocketing, breaking into cars, mugging. There have always been faster ways to make money. If you think you've learned the rules of the streets well enough, the choice in this moral dilemma is yours. If you get caught, every single penny you've saved could be gone. And starting from scratch on these streets is much harder than you think.

HUNGER, HYGIENE, MORALE ALL THREE MATTER

Making money alone isn't enough. When hunger strikes, you grow weak and your speed drops. If you neglect your hygiene, the city rejects you even more. When your morale shatters, every step feels heavier. And when your health finally depletes, nothing else matters. You cannot survive on the streets without keeping these four in balance.

LEARNING THE RULES OF THE STREETS

The unforgiving rules of the streets harden you with each day you survive. By completing tasks around the city, you earn perk points to shape your character according to your own survival playstyle. Over time, you learn which dumpsters to stay away from, figure out who you can hustle for more cash, and develop the sleight of hand needed for darker deeds. Every new day makes you better prepared for the city's dangers and turns you into a sharper, more street-smart survivor.

THE CITY IS WATCHING

Someone passing by might ignore you, hand you some change, or call the cops. How you look, how you act — all of it determines how this world treats you back. The city is alive, and the city is watching.

  • 30-Day Countdown - Get off the streets before the storm hits
  • Dozens of Ways to Earn - Legitimate or not, it's your call
  • Deep Needs System - Hunger, Hygiene, Morale and Health
  • Night Card System - Every morning brings a new fate
  • Perk Tree - Develop your character, master the streets
  • Reactive NPC System - The city watches your every move
  • City Mobility - Walk, take the bus or grab a bike

store_data.about_the_game:
Stream Empire: Platform Simulator is a deep management simulation where you build a streaming platform from scratch and guide it through the evolving entertainment industry — from the early streaming boom of 2015 to the AI-driven future of the 2030s.

Start with a modest budget and a dream. License shows, films, and documentaries from a catalog of over 100 titles across drama, comedy, reality, sports, and documentary genres. Hire executives, producers, talent scouts, engineers, and sales managers to keep your platform running. Negotiate sponsorship deals, set your subscription price, and invest in marketing to grow your audience.

But the industry never stands still. Rival platforms fight for market share. Random events — from viral hits to public scandals — can make or break your reputation overnight. Technology evolves across five distinct eras, each bringing new opportunities and challenges. Make the right calls, and you'll dominate the market. Make the wrong ones, and bankruptcy is never far away.

KEY FEATURES

  • Build Your Platform — Name your streaming service, choose your identity, and grow from startup to industry giant.

  • License & Curate Content — Browse and acquire titles from a rich catalog of 100+ shows and films. Balance quality, cost, and audience appeal.

  • Hire & Manage Staff — Recruit across five departments. Staff skills, morale, and experience directly impact your platform's performance.

  • Negotiate Sponsorships — Court advertisers, lock in contracts, and maximize ad revenue alongside your subscription income.

  • Set Subscription Pricing — Find the sweet spot between subscriber growth and revenue per user as the market shifts.

  • Invest in Technology — Unlock upgrades across infrastructure, production, and analytics tech trees with meaningful choices at every tier.

  • Navigate Five Industry Eras — From the Streaming Boom (2015) through the Streaming Wars, Content Golden Age, Global Dominance, and into the AI Era (2031+). Each era changes the rules.

  • React to Random Events — Handle crises, seize opportunities, and make tough choices when the unexpected strikes.

  • Manage Scandals & PR — When controversy hits, choose your response carefully. Public apologies, press conferences, or charitable events — each has consequences.

  • Compete for Market Share — AI-driven rival platforms adapt and pressure you. Outperform them or get squeezed out.

  • Three Difficulty Modes — Normal, Expert, and Hardcore. Each adjusts revenue, expenses, rival aggression, scandal frequency, and more.

  • Sandbox Mode — Customize your starting era, budget, and toggle events, scandals, and competitors for a tailored experience.

  • 7 Languages — Fully localized in English, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, and Russian

Ascend to Immortal Throne

✅ Overview

As spiritual energy resurges, the game’s creator is also a cultivator who has already reached the Foundation Establishment stage.

You will experience a truly authentic cultivation world with a genuine lineage: cultivate alongside your sect members, refine pills and artifacts, draw talismans, set formations, and raise spirit beasts. Fight your way through sect wars, or choose the path of a rogue cultivator—free and unbound—pursuing the Great Dao.

In this world, anyone can cultivate immortality—Nascent Soul is only the beginning.

✅ About This Game

Ascend to Immortal Throne is an open-world cultivation game centered on the theme of “a mortal defying the heavens.”

You were born with flawed spiritual roots and rejected by the immortal sects.
But you refuse to accept fate. You join a sect, starting from the very bottom, carving out your own path in this world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hang Out is a horror visual novel that combines narrative storytelling with with multiple gameplay elements. If you enjoy Silent Hill-style storytelling, as well as dark mysteries that gradually unravel their truth, this is an experience worth stepping into.

You awaken in an abandoned club, having lost an important part of your memory. The strange remnants scattered throughout the city, a figure who feels inexplicably familiar, and the deep sea floating above the sky all draw you further and further inward. As your investigation deepens, you begin to realize that this is not a disaster unrelated to you. The past you are trying to recover may in fact be the very cause of the catastrophe itself.

In the search for the truth, you will encounter one disturbing event after another, explore a variety of locations, and navigate the conflicting motives of different factions. As more and more secrets are uncovered, you will gradually come to understand the desires and beliefs hidden behind this disaster, as well as a past that has never truly come to an end

store_data.about_the_game:
That bouncing logo. Drifting across the screen. Getting closer and closer to the corner… and missing. Pure, unfiltered agony.

Now experience it as a game, in ScreenSaver Idle.

Watch EVE ricochet across the screen, collecting resources with every bounce. And when it finally nails that corner? An indescribable rush.

📺 Collect Resources with EVE

EVE isn't just bouncing aimlessly. Every wall hit earns you resources, and corner hits unleash massive bonuses. Keep your eyes on EVE and cheer it on!

🌳 Get Stronger with Skills

Pour your resources into a skill tree and unlock it node by node. Feel yourself growing stronger with every step — from boosting resource efficiency to unlocking new tools, abilities, and the next map.

⛏️ Time to Mine

Unlock the Mine and start digging for minerals. Smelt and upgrade them into powerful pickaxes and weapons to maximize your resource gains.

🌾 Start the Simple Life

Crops grown on the Farm provide powerful one-time-use buffs. Pop them at just the right moment for an explosive surge of resources. Who knows, permanent growth might even become possible down the line.

⚔️ Into the Dungeon

Venture into the Dungeon, defeat monsters, and collect loot. Spend that loot to acquire powerful skills. Build up your strength and take on the final boss!

📈 A Fresh Experience, That's What Matters

Every new map brings fresh mechanics, deeper progression, and new ways to make the numbers go up. Start with a single bouncing logo. End with an empire.

The corner hit you've been waiting for your whole life is finally worth something.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lofi Cozy Room is a work companion that brings together a tiny mini-room on your desktop and gentle Lo-Fi music.

A living avatar and dog in a transparent window, furniture that responds to your touch, and over 60 Lo-Fi tracks make your work time a little more comforting.

1. Your Own Cozy Mini-Room

Decorate the mini-room you've been dreaming of!
A wide variety of rooms, furniture, and props are ready and waiting.

The room you decorate yourself makes your work time calmer and cozier.



2. Gentle Lo-Fi Music and Ambient Sounds

Fill your mini-room with diverse Lo-Fi tracks and soothing ambient sounds.
Before you know it, your mind settles and you'll find yourself fully immersed in your work.

3. A Mini-Room That Comes Alive

The mini-room isn't just a space to look at.
Click the furniture around the room and small reactions come to life.

Your avatar isn't just a looping animation either.
They read books on the sofa, work at the desk, rest in the armchair, and fall asleep in bed when night comes.

4. Mini Mode and Work Tools on Your Desktop

It's not a screensaver, and it's not a wallpaper.
A living mini-room rests quietly in a corner of your desktop, inside a borderless transparent window.

If a full screen feels like too much, switch to Mini Mode.
You can perch it gently on your taskbar.
Memo, to-do list, and Pomodoro timer come built-in to keep your work tidy.

5. Your Cute Avatar and Dog

Express your own style.
Save as many avatars as you like, customizing the face, hair, and outfit yourself.
Or pick from ready-made characters and pets to keep you company.

A lovely dog wanders freely and curls up to nap in a sunny spot.

6. Key Features

- Float a transparent mini-room in a corner of your desktop.
- Switch freely between 14 mini-rooms with a single click.
- Toggle individual furniture pieces on and off to set your mood.
- Click furniture around the room to discover hidden reactions.
- Spend the avatar's day with them — reading, working, sleeping.
- Hang out with the dog as it wanders freely.
- Customize face, hair, and outfit to complete your own avatar.
- Pick from ready-made characters and pets to find your favorite companion.
- Listen to over 60 carefully curated Lo-Fi tracks.
- Mix various ambient sounds to craft your own atmosphere.
- Easily control shuffle, repeat, and mute with the mini music player.
- Just keep the room running and earn Amber to unlock new rooms and items, one by one.
- Stay organized with memo, to-do list, and Pomodoro timer.
- Use Mini Mode to keep a small window tucked into the corner of your screen.
- Switch UI themes to match your desktop's vibe.
- No rushing timers. No in-app purchases.

【あらすじ】
転校してきたばかりの高校二年生のあなたは、あるクラスメイトに呼び出されて学校の屋上へ向かう。

そこにあったのは、撤去が決まっている鳴らない古びた鐘だった。

その鐘には、いつからかこんな噂が囁かれている。

「真実の愛で結ばれた恋人たちは、この鐘を鳴らすことができる」

生徒たちはそれを――「恋人たちの鐘」と呼んでいた。

この伝説が本当かどうか、確かめてほしい。

そして、その鐘の音を聞かせてほしい。

期限は、鐘が撤去されるまで――。

しかし、今のあなたには何もない。

魅力も、学力も、そして運さえも――。

校内を歩き回り、生徒の頼みを引き受けることで自分を成長させていく。

さまざまな人と出会い、関係を築きながら、恋人を作らなければならない。

果たしてあなたは、「恋人たちの鐘」を鳴らすことができるのか――。

【システム】

学校を探索して女の子や生徒たちと出会おう

女の子と過ごして好感度を上げよう

女の子の会話に合わせて話題を選ぼう

女の子の好みに合わせた引換券を贈ろう

魅力を上げて女の子とスキンシップを取ろう

頼みごとを聞いて能力を上げよう

生徒に話しかけて話題を集めよう

学校を探索して引換券を探そう

いろんな生徒と仲良くなろう

【実況・配信について】

プレイ動画の実況・配信はご自由に行っていただいて問題ありません。事前連絡なども不要です。YouTubeメンバーシップなどの有料会員限定コンテンツ内での、プレイ動画の実況・配信も問題ありません。

動画の説明欄や概要欄などに、ゲームタイトルおよびダウンロードページのURLを記載していただけると嬉しいですが、必須ではありません。

store_data.about_the_game:
Drop, Match, Win!

Match Huge Combos!!

Battle Bosses!

You have a pit. You have monsters. You put the monsters in the pit. They merge. You get dopamine. You do it again. This is your life now.

Monster Masher is a drop-and-merge puzzle game with pixel-art monsters, dungeon vibes, and enough Gen Z energy to make your therapist concerned.

THE GAMEPLAY LOOP (it's giving obsession)

Drop monsters into a pit. When two of the same kind touch, they merge into something bigger and rarer. Ants become bees. Bees become slimes. Slimes become... look, it escalates. Chain merges together for combo multipliers that hit different. But if the pit overflows? It's giving game over. No cap.

BOSS FIGHTS (they ate and left no crumbs)

Every few merges, a boss pulls up uninvited. You get a random weapon — could be a fire cannon, could be an acid sprayer, could be a literal doom launcher. You have 12 seconds to delete them. If you don't? They SLAM into your pit and ruin everything you built. Slay or get slayed, bestie.

DAILY PUZZLES (main character energy)

Same puzzle. Same monsters. One attempt. The whole world gets the same seed. Either you cooked or you didn't. Check the leaderboard and find out if you're him or if you're NPC.

FEATURES THAT GO HARD

  • 15 monster tiers from tiny ant to absolute unit dragon

  • 39 bosses that each move different and all chose violence

  • 8 weapons with status effects — burn them, freeze them, melt them, judge them (real)

  • Daily puzzle mode with leaderboards so you can flex or cope

  • Full controller support — Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, we don't discriminate

  • 6 languages because monsters are universal

  • Original chiptune soundtrack that lives in your head rent free

  • Achievements for the completionists who can't help themselves

  • A game over screen that roasts you personally

store_data.about_the_game:
"99% of gamblers quit right before they hit it big. This game is for the other 1%."

Congratulations. You’ve found it. The ultimate test of human stubbornness. Lotto.exe isn't a "game" in the traditional sense. it is a lottery draw designed to determine exactly how much your time is worth to you. (Spoiler: It’s probably $0.00).

THE PREMISE

Every five seconds, the machine draws one. You have one ticket. You cannot change the numbers. You cannot speed up time. You can only watch, wait, and slowly realize that the sun is a very distant memory. You only get 1 run at this game.

FEATURES

  • True Endurance Gameplay: A jackpot that takes real-world uptime to hit. Your GPU will be tired. Your CPU will be judging you. Your electricity bill will be real.

  • Immersive Brainrot: Experience the thrill of matching 0/6 numbers for 48 hours straight.

  • The "Anytime Soon" Promise: The win is coming. Is it coming today? No. Tomorrow? Also no. But it is coming. Probably.

  • Premium Dark Ambient Aesthetic: A minimalist CRT terminal interface designed to burn the image of your failure directly into your retinas.

  • Clinical Rank Titles: Watch your mental state deteriorate in real-time as you rank up

WHY WOULD YOU BUY THIS?

  • You want an achievement that says you spent 312 hours doing nothing.

  • You need an excuse to keep your PC on so your cat has a warm place to sleep.

  • You’ve run out of bad life choices and need a fresh one.

  • RNJesus hasn't answered your prayers in years and you want to see if he's just ghosting you.

WARNING: This game features no "fun" in the traditional sense. There are no power-ups, no loot boxes, and no mercy. There is only the math. And the math is very, very patient.

store_data.about_the_game:
Beast Survivor 3D is a high-octane 3D rogue-lite adventure that blends fast-paced action with deep strategic evolution. Trapped in an alien world bound by an ancient curse, you play as a primitive beast with limitless potential. Tearing through endless swarms of monsters is your only way to survive.

Evolve or Be Devoured

Every battle is a gamble of genetics. Gain experience through combat to unlock over 60 unique skills. From armor-shredding "Heart-Piercing Claws" to the cataclysmic "Meteor Strike," every choice defines your evolutionary path. Will you become an aerial overlord commanding lightning, or a melee nightmare drenched in the blood of your foes?

Harness the Power of Nature

  • Elemental Resonance: Master the eight elements—Earth, Frost, Flame, Thunder, Poison, and more—to trigger powerful Domain Effects, turning the entire battlefield into your personal hunting ground.

  • Diverse Combat Styles: Unleash everything from berserk melee claw attacks to long-range toxic mists and sonic cannons. Adapt your arsenal to crush the weaknesses of any enemy.

  • Exclusive Passive Barriers: Activate "Elemental Barriers" or "Blood Aura" to strike the perfect balance between absolute survival and devastating damage.

A True 3D Action Experience

Break free from the constraints of traditional 2D survivors! In Beast Survivor 3D, you can:

  • Soar and Conquer: Take to the skies with flight-capable beasts, ignoring terrain obstacles to launch lethal ambushes from above.

  • Dynamic Environments: Watch your step around ground spikes, volcanic eruptions, and quicksand fields. The environment is a deadly threat—but in the right hands, it’s a powerful weapon.

Core Features:

  • Ultimate Satisfaction: Experience the thrill of "mowing down" hundreds of monsters simultaneously with high-impact visceral combat.

  • Deep Rogue-lite System: Random drops and branching evolution paths ensure that no two runs are ever the same.

  • Stunning Visual Effects: Every skill features unique materials and lighting, from thunderous lightning strikes to scarlet explosions.

  • Diverse Beast Rosters: Unlock and command various beasts, each with its own distinct traits and specialized combat style.

Can you endure the raging swarms and reign as the sole apex predator of this land?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Your Tech Empire

In Laptop Architect, you are not just a hardware enthusiast; you are the CEO of an up-and-coming tech company. Your mission is to design flawless machines and dominate the global PC market. From the micro-management of motherboard traces to the macro-management of international sales, every decision matters.

Hardcore Hardware Engineering

Forget simple puzzle games. Here, you dive deep into the physics of computing.
  • Component Placement: Position CPUs, GPUs, and RAM modules strategically on the grid.
  • Thermal Management: Components generate real-time heat. Design efficient cooling layouts, route airflow, and prevent thermal throttling. If you fail, your laptops will fry!
  • Power Delivery: Manage wattage and wiring. Ensure every component gets the exact power it needs without short-circuiting the board.

Global Market & Tycoon Strategy

Building a great laptop is only half the battle. You need to sell it.
  • Target Audiences: Different regions have different demands. Will you mass-produce cheap, low-end laptops for emerging markets, or build premium, water-cooled beasts for high-end consumers?
  • Market Domination: Track your sales on the interactive world map. Watch your market share grow as your company colors spread across continents.
  • Budget Management: Reinvest your profits. Balance your manufacturing costs with retail prices to avoid bankruptcy.

Attention to Detail

Experience a simulation where the little things matter. Cables have specific routing rules, heat spreads dynamically, and market demands shift. Create your production lines, optimize your designs, and take your company to the top of the tech world!

store_data.about_the_game:
High-speed vehicular combat racing set in the world of Road Defense: Outsiders. Drive, shoot, destroy, and upgrade your car across 30 dangerous tracks. Battle armed rivals and survive attacks from a hostile crowd while earning cash to upgrade your vehicle.

In Road Defense: Racing, speed alone won’t win the race. To come out on top, you’ll need to survive the chaos of the track. Armed drivers fight for every corner while the crowd around the circuit turns the race into an unpredictable arena.

Earn money by destroying rivals and smashing track objects, unlock new weapons, and upgrade your car to take on increasingly intense circuits.

VEHICULAR COMBAT RACING

Enter races where speed and destruction go hand in hand. Fire at rivals, dodge incoming attacks, and fight your way to victory as cars exchange gunfire at full speed.

THE TRACK IS DANGEROUS TOO

The threat doesn’t come only from rival drivers. The crowd around the track can also attack vehicles, turning every race into a hostile environment where a single mistake can cost you the win.

DESTROY YOUR RIVALS

Use a wide arsenal to dominate the race. Equip rifles, missile launchers, land mines, and shotguns to destroy opponents and clear your path to the lead.

UPGRADE YOUR VEHICLE

Earn money by smashing objects, running through obstacles, and surviving the race. Invest in engine, tire, nitro, and armor upgrades to make your car faster and more durable.

Features

  • Compete in intense races while exchanging gunfire with armed rivals.

  • Survive attacks from spectators who turn every race into an unpredictable battleground.

  • Use rifles, missile launchers, land mines, and shotguns to destroy opponents.

  • Improve your engine, tires, nitro, and armor to enhance speed and durability.

  • Race across circuits filled with hazards like oil spills, water puddles, and speed boosts.

Earn money by smashing objects, running through obstacles, and surviving each race.

You are The Dark Lord!
Raise an evil army, and crush the race of men.

An action-strategy hybrid RTS, blending tower defence, base building and direct control of your Dark Lord avatar.  

You are The Dark Lord, and your goal is to raise an undead army and crush the feckless, godless heathens known as humans. As your sorcery and your evil army grow, all of the world will rise up against you to destroy your Dark Tower and end your reign of terror.  Fortify your dark realm, upgrade your sorcery, and build enough strength to march out and crush the humans once and for all.

  • Directly control the Dark Lord in this Hybrid RTS - by keyboard, mouse or joypad.

  • Unleash devastating sorcery upon all of human civilisation. Every kill grants Mana, powering your spells.

  • Summon vast orc armies from the underworld, and raise the dead as a zombies.

  • Corrupt the peaceful forests and beautiful mountains of the realm.  Extract resources to equip your army, and build vast impenetrable evil defenses. 

  • Fortify your Dark Tower against human counter attack, with evil turrets, siege weapons, barricades and cursed traps.

  • Upgrade your spell book - every sacked human city or ruined fortress grants more Insight.

Arise Dark Lord is in early development, and is due for release sometime in 2027.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grow. Expand. Transcend.

HyphoSphere is a fungal idle game where you build a mycelial empire from a single filament to a cosmic singularity. Click to harvest nutrients, construct living organisms, and watch your network spread across the planet ... and beyond.

From Hypha to Singularity

Start with a single Simple Hypha and unlock 10 distinct organisms, each with its own identity on the living canvas:

  • Rhizomorphs : robust cords that explore new substrates

  • Mycorrhizae : symbiosis with tree roots, feeding both you and the forest

  • Carpophores : the visible mushroom, a spore factory in full bloom

  • Forest Network : you control the Wood Wide Web

  • Cordyceps Parasites : infect insects, make them work for you

  • Fungal Consciousness : the network thinks, optimises, expands

  • Mycelial Singularity : you have transcended biology. The cosmos is your substrate

A Living Network

The central canvas is alive. Your mycelium pulses, filaments grow outward, particles drift and burst. Random events appear at any time :

  • Bioluminescent Spore : catch it for ×7 production or 15 minutes of nutrients in an instant

  • Spore Storm : gather drifting spores across the canvas

  • Bacterial Invasion : repel the attack before your network is damaged

  • Cosmic Mycorrhiza : rare, radiant, extraordinary

Sporulation — The Prestige System

When your empire grows large enough, trigger Sporulation: reset everything and earn Primordial Spores. Each spore grants a permanent +5% production bonus. The cycle begins again : faster, richer, deeper.

100 Achievements

From your first harvested nutrient to billions of clicks and cosmic transcendence : 100 achievements track your journey and power up Symbiotic Vitality, a bonus that scales with every milestone you reach.

Twitch Integration

HyphoSphere is designed to be streamed. Connect your Twitch channel and let your viewers become part of the network:

  • !click : viewers click the mushroom for you

  • !boost : vote for ×3 NPS for 20 seconds

  • !invade : vote to trigger a bacterial invasion

  • !buy : community votes to purchase an organism

No rankings. No competition. Just a living, breathing fungal empire. built together.

Key Features

  • Idle / incremental gameplay with active events

  • 10 organisms, 45+ upgrades, 100 Steam achievements

  • Prestige system with permanent bonuses

  • Twitch chat integration

  • Dynamic animated canvas

  • Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese

  • Windows, macOS, Linux

store_data.about_the_game:
Undercurrent is a psychological sci-fi horror game.

The year is 2250. Humankind has spread among the stars with the help of the Bakhan, an alien civilization slowly dying out from an incurable disease. From the center of the Milky Way, the Bakhan are searching the cosmos for advanced life, gifting technology in return for any medical knowledge that could end the grey death.

Thalas, an ocean planet located within Earth’s reach, may hold the answer. In bioscience, it is known as a synonym for symbiosis, all its lifeforms connected into one whole. In politics, it is a bargaining chip, one of the most politically sensitive postings in known universe.

Its science station has gone dark.

You are Ava Horvat, a diplomatic envoy to the Bakhan, guided by the motto “You wouldn’t abandon ship in a storm just because you couldn’t control the winds.” Your younger brother Andrej is a radiologist stationed on Thalas. It has been weeks since you have heard from him. You get sent in to find out what happened. Your intentions were good.

Thalas is dangerous territory. It has no land. Its islands, aptly named centimanes after the mythological Hundred-Hander giants, are enormous root-like structures rising from a poisonous ocean.

You are equipped with the Bakhan’s holo-tech, allowing you to construct bridges across the chasms between centimanes and tame the electrical currents that run through all life on Thalas. It resists.

  • Attune to the alien biosphere to achieve harmony with its rhythms.

  • Harden the alien conditions to remain unchanged in face of its hostility.

Either way, the path before you emerges.

It is immediately clear that the science crew abandoned standard protocols. They are erratic. Your training in diplomatic negotiations enables you to handle just about anything under normal circumstances. Uncovering the cause of these anomalies means getting through to them.

Decide how to achieve this.

  • Should you try to connect with them?

  • Try to make light of the situation?

  • Perhaps cold logic and efficiency is best to get through this?

  • Stick to your core principles?

Find the truth. Question everything. Where is the radiation coming from? Why do you keep dreaming of butterflies? What have the scientists discovered on Thalas? How to help the crew without becoming one of them? What is happening to you?

All you wanted was to make sure your brother is unharmed. Now you are the only way out of this darkness.

One thing is certain. You can’t stay who you are. 

Our development philosophy

The choices in the branching dialogue are forms of social action. Each choice represents one of four types: emotion and personal connection, tradition and humor, cold logic and efficiency, or values and principles regardless of outcome. The more you act in a certain way, the more entrenched you become in your habits, and narrow down your future choices. This dialogue system is inspired by the work of one of the founders of sociology, Max Weber.

Our environmental mechanics allow the player to project holo-structures and manipulate electricity to either integrate into the world or architect it.

Undercurrent’s art style contrasts clean minimalism of human-built spaces with the aggressive wilderness of an alien ocean planet. Its visuals combine hand-painted 3D models with hand-crafted textures that are digitally processed, to build a world that is eerily atmospheric but tactile.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reflex This! is a tight, arcade-style reaction game built around one simple question: how fast can you think and click?

Jump into quick rounds where the rules shift by mode:

  • Reflex: Hit the highlighted buttons before they disappear—speed and accuracy are everything.

  • Odd One Out: Multiple buttons light up, but only one is correct. Find it instantly and strike.

  • Sequence: Watch the pattern, then repeat it in the exact order.

  • Survival: One mistake ends the run. Stay calm and keep the streak alive.

  • Nightmare: A brutal mode for the elite—faster timing, harsher pressure, and no mercy.

As you improve, the game pushes back: highlights get tighter, boards get busier, and your combo becomes the difference between a good run and a legendary one. Expect satisfying visual feedback, clean controls, and “one more try” pacing that’s perfect for short sessions—or long high-score grinds.

Features

  • 5 distinct game modes with different skills to master

  • Combo-driven gameplay with escalating intensity

  • High-score chasing and personal bests

  • Quick restart loop designed for rapid improvement

  • Built for keyboard + mouse

store_data.about_the_game:
GAME IS IN EARLY PROTOTYPE PHASE

KEY FEATURES

  • Active Mid-Battle Deckbuilding: Steal cards from enemy hands or sabotage their deck with your own. Break seals to manifest new powers and refine your strategy while the fight is still raging.

  • Four Primal Archetypes: No pre-set characters. Combine four powerful essences to craft a unique playstyle. With 300+ cards, the combinations are limited only by your insight.

  • Asymmetric Combat: Enemies play their own cards and declare intentions. Anticipate their combos and frustrate their plans to survive the Void.

  • Agency Over Luck: A roguelite where planning outweighs RNG. Every choice echoes forward, altering the narrative and your capabilities.

ABOUT THIS GAME

You were just doing your job. Unpacking boxes for a living. Clocking hours. Trying to get home to your loved ones.

Then your reality abruptly ended, consumed by The Void.

Now you stand in the Oneiron Expanse - a shattered desert of impossible stars, living stone, and forgotten worlds - holding a dagger that whispers in your mind. Your universe has been erased, devoured by entities that consume existence itself. Everyone you loved is gone.

Except your memory.

In this world, power isn’t cast. It’s daydreamed.

A World Unmade, A Journey Looped Discover a realm where the laws of reality have dissolved and strategy is your only currency for survival. Should you fail, the Expanse pulls you back, allowing you to loop through time with your hard-won memories and powers intact. Track down the Dreamwright and dream your world back into existence.

WHAT SETS DREAMWRIGHT APART

In-battle Deck Manipulation: Why wait for the end of a match? Use your whispering dagger to steal an enemy's key card, or break ancient seals to manifest powerful reinforcements when you need them most. Your deck is a living thing, changing with every strike. 

Flexible Deck Crafting: Abandon rigid character classes and preconstructed decks. With over 300 cards to discover, you are the architect of your own power. Master four dream archetypes [Nightmare, Lucid, Dissonance, Liminal] and weave them together. Experiment with dual and triple-archetype cards to craft a "dreamed deck" that plays like no one else's. 

Smart enemies and asymmetric play: Face enemies that play by your rules. Your opponents use cards and execute complex combos, but they are bound by the same logic as you. Watch their declared intentions, disrupt their timing, and turn their own mechanics against them. 

Consequence-Heavy Agency: This isn't a game of rolling dice. Combat rewards the prepared mind. While the paths through the Oneiron Expanse are unpredictable, your success is determined by your choices. Decisions made in narrative encounters echo forward, permanently altering your capabilities and the world’s reaction to you.

 

Deep Enough to Master: Approachability meets tactical depth. Simple mechanics draw you into the Oneiron Expanse, but the layered systems and broad set of card interactions offer immense depth for those who want to push the limits of reality.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game is set in a primordial world where human laws and moral constructs do not exist. The narrative adopts a "Naturalist" tone—depicting survival, predation, and violence as indifferent biological realities rather than "good" or "evil." While the text can be crude and visceral to reflect this harsh environment, it remains nonjudgmental and focused on the player's survival choices (e.g., harvesting a trapped creature vs. freeing it).

The vast majority of the game’s "crudity" is delivered through text only. There is no rendered gore, dismemberment, or realistic depictions of physical trauma in the gameplay.

Explore atmospheric locations full of hidden clues, unusual landmarks, and subtle hints. Behind familiar decorations, a complex story unfolds - from enigmatic mysteries to carefully planned deceptions. You'll need to carefully examine your surroundings, find objects, piece together facts, and uncover secrets that aren't always readily apparent.

The game world teeters on the edge of inexplicability: technology, magical ambitions, and a touch of magic intertwine to create unique mysteries. Each case is a standalone story with unexpected twists and a finale that changes everything.

Become a detective who sees more than others. In Charm & Clue 2, the truth is always within reach - you just need to be able to see it.

store_data.about_the_game:
UNLEASH is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play as Robyn, a guilt-ridden mercenary seeking to reverse the catastrophe caused by an unknown event that has frozen almost the entire population of the mining ship she's on.

To do this, you'll have to fight your way through the ships and survivors of the disaster:

- Create synergies and combos using your talismans and spells

- Visit the shop to stock up on new spells, potions, elixirs, and talismans by opening crates with random loot, and maybe you'll even manage to loot the rarest items!

- Defeat the unique opponents who stand in your way to reach your goal, each with their own playstyle and unique builds.

store_data.about_the_game:
Clickomorph is an incremental game. It starts out as a traditional one, where you have a circle following your cursor, dealing damage to enemies you hover over in intervals.

Early into the game you unlock abilities. Each ability has its own play style;

  • Auto Clicker is great if you want to go idle

  • Archer if you like aiming and projectile chaos

  • Lightning Revenant if you enjoy lightning strikes and orbs

  • Musician if you want to experiment with a rhythm game!

  • Soul Reaper if you want to collect the souls of enemies you defeated and watch them become your power!

We aim to provide an enjoyable and unique experience for incremental gamers.

Demo will include auto clicker, archer and lightning revenant. More abilities will be added for the release.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE WRONG ONES

Deception lies in their words.

The Wrong Ones is a single-player, dialogue-driven social deduction game where you must uncover hidden Skinwalkers disguised among ordinary townspeople.

Each round presents a group of characters, each with their own statements, behaviors, and claims. Among them hides  a Skinwalker—an entity imitating human identity.

Your task is not to react… but to observe, analyze, and decide.

CORE GAMEPLAY

At the start of each round, a set of townspeople appears.
Each one provides a statement—about themselves, others, or the situation around them.

  • Some statements support each other

  • Some contradict

  • Some are designed to mislead

By carefully comparing information, you must identify inconsistencies and determine who is not who they claim to be.

Once confident, enter Accusation Mode and banish the one you believe is the Skinwalker.

But be careful.

A wrong decision comes at a cost, in this case - HP.

FEATURES

Dialogue-Based Deduction

Every decision is driven by logic and observation. There are no visual tells—only words, patterns, and contradictions.

Hidden Identity System

Skinwalkers imitate human roles, adapting to the situation and blending in through believable statements.

Progressive Difficulty

Each round introduces more characters and more complex interactions, increasing the challenge of identifying the truth.

Risk and Consequence

Wrong accusations reduce your health. Too many mistakes, and the game ends.

Player-Driven Reasoning

There are no hints or handholding. Success depends entirely on your ability to think critically and connect valid information.

CHARACTERS

Each character type plays a distinct role, influencing the type of information you receive:

  • Townspeople - Normal cards which gives general information about themselves or someone else.

  • Catalysts - Active cards, their abilities can be used to get information from townspeople.

  • Skinwalker - Hides among the townspeople to provide lies and deceive the players.

THE EXPERIENCE

The Wrong Ones is designed to create tension through uncertainty and doubt.

  • Can you trust what you’re reading?

  • Are contradictions real—or intentional misdirection?

  • Is the obvious answer too obvious?

Each round challenges your perception, forcing you to question not just the characters—but your own conclusions.

CURRENT STATE

This is an early prototype focused on core gameplay systems and design exploration.
Future updates may expand character roles, dialogue complexity, and overall progression systems.

store_data.about_the_game:
The megacorps own everything. The networks, the data, the city. You're a netrunner — one of the few who can fight back from the inside.

NETFALL is a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where you infiltrate corporate networks one card at a time. Build your deck, exploit system vulnerabilities, and push deeper into hostile infrastructure until you reach The Mainframe at the heart of it all.

Every run is different. Every death teaches you something.

BUILD YOUR DECK. BREACH THE NETWORK.

Start each run with a small hand of cards and shape it into something lethal. Play exploits, deploy defenses, and stack status effects against corporate ICE that adapts to your strategy. With 263 cards across five hacker identities, no two runs play the same.

FIVE HACKERS. FIVE PLAYSTYLES.

Choose your identity before every run — each brings a unique deck and a different way to fight:

  • BRUTEFORCE — Raw damage and overwhelming force. Best for new runners.

  • GHOST — Stealth, trace manipulation, and strikes from the shadows.

  • SOCENG — Social exploitation, misdirection, and psychological warfare.

  • CRYPTOMANCER — Encryption barriers and impenetrable digital fortresses.

  • DAEMON — Self-modifying code and cascading process chains.

Three identities are locked behind reputation earned across runs — a reason to keep going even after you win.

NAVIGATE THE NETWORK

Each run takes you through a procedurally generated map of nodes — combat encounters, elite threats, events, shops, and rest points. Choose your path carefully. Forks collapse behind you. The route you don't take disappears. There is no going back.

Three sectors stand between you and the final target. Clear them all and the true objective unlocks — The Mainframe, a final gauntlet that separates runs that almost made it from runs that actually did.

THE TRACE SYSTEM

Corporate security is always watching. Your trace counter rises as you fight — let it max out and you take damage. Manage it. Suppress it. Or build a deck that benefits from walking the edge.

100 RELICS. ENDLESS SYNERGIES.

Every run hands you passive relics that fundamentally change how your cards interact. A relic that rewards you for exhausting cards. One that doubles the effect of your next exploit. One that turns your trace counter into a weapon. Finding the combination that makes everything click is the heart of NETFALL.

FEATURES

263 hackware cards across 5 hacker identities

100 passive relics with deep synergy potential

Procedurally generated network maps — no two runs identical

46 enemies across 3 sectors + a true final boss

Daily Challenge mode — one shared network, global leaderboard

Reputation system — unlock new identities across runs

Steam Cloud saves

10 Steam achievements

Jack in. The network is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
It’s simple. You’re an exorcist, he’s a ghost. Except… not really?

On a visit to a client’s haunted house, you find that this handsome ‘full-bodied apparition’ is a little more ‘full body’ than you’d anticipated.

There’s something wrong with Lorenn’s soul. Something wrong with this house. And with your client refusing to cooperate until you’ve finished the job…

Looks like you’ve got the world’s cutest half-dead roommate on your hands!

A love like broken glass is a cozy romance visual novel, featuring:

  • You, a self-trained exorcist with a penchant for teasing pretty boys.

  • Lorenn, an adorably clumsy post(ghost?)-grad with a penchant for being teased.

  • And a not-so-safe soul-linking ritual that twists his innocent feelings into obsession, spiralling quickly out of control… But that’s nothing you can’t handle, right?

From roommates, to friends, to literal soul-mates… Nobody ever said exorcism was easy. Love is even harder.

And when you’re all out of time, will either of you be ready to say goodbye?

Key features:

  • A gender-neutral protagonist, with appearance otherwise unspecified.

  • An original soundtrack that will make you bop your head or pluck at your heartstrings at any moment’s notice.

  • Adorable character sprites and event CGs.

  • A happy ending, but a healthy amount of angst.

  • 52k words (about over 4 hours of reading), and varying dialogue trees that’ll allow you to flirt and tease to your heart’s content.

  • The prettiest, most loveliest ghost boy that will stay in your soul forever.

CONTENT WARNINGS:

The following topics appear across the game’s story(+ = mild, ++ = moderate, +++ = frequent):

  • Depression ++

  • Death and the afterlife +++

  • Unhealthy attachment styles ++

  • Possessiveness and jealousy +

store_data.about_the_game:
STRATEGY MEETS LOOT (DECKBUILDING + LOOT)

It’s not enough to have the right cards; you need the right steel. In Scourge of Eldryngard, your hero's power stems from the synergy between your deck and your inventory. Find ancestral equipment, manage your arsenal, and forge items that drastically alter how your cards behave. Here, the loot dictates your tactics.

FORGE YOUR ARSENAL

Don’t rely on luck—trust the heat of the furnace. In Eldryngard, power isn't found in temples; it’s extracted from metal. Through a deep system of archaic metallurgy, you have total control over your arsenal's evolution:

  • Industrial Synergy: Create pieces that don’t just boost your numbers, but permanently modify how your cards function on the battlefield.

  • Mechanical Enhancement: Level up your equipment to face increasingly lethal threats.

  • Attribute Reforge: Adjust the components of your weapons and armor so they mold perfectly to your deck’s strategy.

  • Ancestral Ascension: Transform rare items into Ancestral Relics, unlocking the true potential of lost engineering to decimate the Xenos hordes.

A WORLD OF ENGINEERING AND METAL

Forget fireballs and mystic rituals. Eldryngard is a world of gears, steel, and resilience. Survival depends on archaic technology and the coldness of tactical combat. Face the biological aberrations that have invaded the realm and unravel the mystery behind Malkorath’s madness in a realistic journey where every strike has weight and consequence.

MASTER UNIQUE FIGHTING STYLES

Each survivor brings a distinct combat style. Master deep mechanics that demand more than just luck:

  • Draegor, the Royal Guard: The bulwark of Eldryngard. He uses heavy armor and a shield not just for defense, but to convert his Block into devastating blows. He is the master of survival and defensive strategy.

  • Aldrich, the Barbarian: A whirlwind of steel. Wielding a two-handed axe, he enters a state of uncontrollable Fury. The more wounded Aldrich is, the more lethal his area-of-effect attacks become.

  • Darian, the Poison Master: Silent death. Focused on debilitating the enemy with persistent Toxins, Darian wins battles through attrition, watching his opponents succumb before even delivering the final blow.

  • Hanako, the Yamatai Spy: Sequence precision. With her dual daggers, she utilizes a system of Combos and card flows. Her attacks strengthen with every card played in the correct order, punishing the enemy with a storm of cuts.

  • Elyndra, the Forest Warden*: Ballistic precision and biological vanguard. An expert in long-range shots with high-tension bows, Elyndra dominates the battlefield by keeping her distance. She utilizes the tactical support of Arctos, her combat bear, who acts as a living wall to defend her while she identifies and eliminates enemy weak points.

  • Zahara, the Siege Engineer*: Heavy ballistics and area denial. Zahara doesn't fight with elegance, but with raw mechanical force. Armed with a heavy siege crossbow, she fires massive bolts that pierce the toughest carapaces. As a master of rudimentary engineering, she controls the flow of combat by installing tactical traps that punish any enemy daring enough to advance.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE WORLD'S FAIR HOTEL

Chicago, 1893. The World's Columbian Exposition is in full swing, a dazzling beacon of human progress. Just blocks away stands a magnificent new hotel, promising luxury and convenience to young travelers. You are one of them. Experience the story of Elizabeth, a young secretary hoping to start a new life in the big city. But the man who welcomed you, Dr. H.H. Holmes is not a hotelier, he is a madman. And his building is not a sanctuary, it is a machine designed to kill for profit.

"I was born with the devil in me. I could not help the fact that I was a murderer, no more than the poet can help the inspiration to sing..." — H. H. Holmes

Wake up to your worst nightmare. Behind soundproof walls and doors that lead to nowhere, the dark truth about America’s first serial killer awaits you.

KEY FEATURES

  • Authentic PSX Horror: Immerse yourself in a gritty, low-poly recreation of the Murder Castle in 1893, Chicago. 

  • Escape Room Mechanics: Interact with objects and use physics-based logic to uncover hidden keys and pathways. 

  • Deceptive Environments: Do not be deceived by this labyrinth of hidden passages, doors and stairs leading nowhere.

  • Pressured Survival: Manage your time in high-pressure traps where one wrong move is fatal. 

  • True-Crime Investigation: Search for hidden documents and clues to escape Holmes' grim operations.

The game is based on the sensationalized accounts of the 1890s yellow journalism.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the ocean's grittiest underwater "car wash"!

Forget cars — here, your clients are gigantic, travel-worn whales seeking refuge after long journeys across the vast oceans. Under the watchful (and very grumpy) eye of Mr. Claw, your boss, you’ll wield custom tools forged from deep-sea salvage to restore these majestic giants to their former glory.

Dive into a meditative yet deeply satisfying cleaning experience set in a one-of-a-kind bio-industrial world.

The Cleaner’s Arsenal

Master a unique collection of tools crafted from seafloor junk and organic materials:

  • The Shell-Scraper: A sharpened mollusk shell bolted to a driftwood handle. Perfect for those stubborn, calcified growths.

  • The Battle Plunger: Essential for the delicate (and safe!) removal of toxic hitchhikers.

  • The Classic Sponge: The world’s most indispensable tool. Soft, reliable, and perfect for that final polish.

Deep-Sea Grime Won't Go Quietly

Cleaning a whale is no small feat. A whole ecosystem has made its home on your client’s massive body, and they won't leave without a fight:

  • Barnacles & Silt: Thick layers of crust and mud that require precision and patience to clear.

  • Ancient Algae: Sticky, stubborn greenery that needs some serious elbow grease to scrape away.

  • Toxic Jellyfish: They’ve latched on tight! Use the right tool to peel them off safely before they sting.

Pure Satisfaction & Hidden Treasures

Nothing beats the feeling of seeing glistening, clean whale skin emerge from beneath centuries of filth. Watch your progress bar climb to that perfect 100%!

For the most eagle-eyed cleaners, the ocean holds secrets: hidden beneath the silt or tucked away in skin folds, you might find ancient artifacts, shimmering pearls, and rare collectibles. Who knows what mysteries these giants have carried from the deep?

store_data.about_the_game:
The 100-Level Descent

Invaders Evolutions is a modern survival-action reimagining of the classic arcade alien shooter. Each run is a 100-level gauntlet through an increasingly lethal invasion, ending in a definitive final boss encounter.

An Escalating Arms Race

The longer the war lasts, the more both sides evolve. Your choices must keep pace with an enemy that grows smarter, faster, and more dangerous as the battle escalates.

The Thinking Swarm

  • Aliens unlock new battlefield skills as you progress.

  • They optimize formations and fill gaps in their ranks.

  • They launch angled bombing runs, repair damaged units, and can even resurrect fallen attackers.

Punishment for Failure

  • The enemy does not just grow with time; it feeds on your mistakes.

  • Let special ships escape, allow your barriers to collapse, or lose control of the battlefield, and the invasion accelerates.

  • Every failed defense gives the swarm another chance to outpace you.

Build Your Resistance

You are in control of humanity’s counterattack. Between waves, choose upgrades that shape your turret into the weapon you need for the current threat.

  • Chosen Upgrades: Invest in fire rate, bullet speed, reload speed, mobility, or additional turret reserves to define your build.

  • Progression Skills: Reach key milestones to unlock essential defensive technology, including turret shields and enhanced barriers.

  • Reserve Management: You start with three turrets and can build up to five. Only one turret fights at a time, so every loss matters. When the last reserve is gone, the run is over.

Industrial War Machine

Step into a dark, retro-industrial battlefield of glowing projectiles, animated special attacks, heavy boss encounters, and mechanical spectacle. A tense, driving soundtrack reinforces the one-more-wave urgency of an escalating war.

Key Features

  • The Ultimate Gauntlet: 100 levels of escalating intensity ending in a set-piece final boss.

  • Run-Based Arcade Progression: Start fresh each run, build your turret, unlock skills, and push deeper into the invasion.

  • Evolving Alien Threats: The swarm gains abilities such as angled bombing, formation optimization, resurrection, and battlefield repair.

  • Punishment Mechanics: Failed defenses can accelerate enemy evolution, making every mistake matter.

  • Tactical Counter-Building: Choose your upgrades carefully to counter the threats emerging in the current run.

  • Reserve Management: Maintain your turret reserves and survive long enough to reach the endgame.

  • Global & Country Leaderboards: Chase high scores worldwide or compete for national bragging rights on country-based scoreboards.

  • Retro-Industrial Vibe: A modern-retro presentation with a tense mechanical audio direction and high-pressure arcade flow.

A Note on Our Development Approach

Invaders Evolutions is the work of a small indie team driven by a love for classic arcade shooters. To bring this reimagining to life, we utilized Generative AI to bridge critical skill gaps in our technical art, language translation, and concepting.

These tools allowed us to elevate the visual experience and focus our limited resources on what truly matters: a deep, reactive evolution system and tight gameplay loops that would have otherwise been out of reach for a team of our size. Every alien and upgrade was carefully directed and refined by us to ensure the heart of the game remains a human-led vision.

store_data.about_the_game:
Smash treasure chests and overwhelm enemies with a shower of items!

Chest Buster is an incremental/idle combat game where you fight by destroying only treasure chests. Instead of hitting enemies directly, smash the chests in front of you. Items dropped from destroyed chests immediately boost your power without any inventory management. The higher the chest level, the more powerful the items that drop!

Upgrade your skills for explosive destructive power!

Use coins earned in battle to unlock new destructive weapons from the skill tree to smash chests more efficiently. Upgrades not only increase attack speed and power but also increase the number of chests, allowing you to gain even more loot. These skills and weapons are permanently retained even if you fall in battle, making you stronger with every repetition!

Secure combat buffs and resources with Card Flips!

Use gems earned in battle to take on the Card Flip challenge. Avoid the "Dud" cards to obtain powerful combat buffs or resources. Strategically increase your win rate by using the skill tree to increase the number of cards and lower the chance of a "Dud"!

Aim for massive rewards with the Slot Machine!

If you want even greater gains, spend gems to spin the slot machine. While it’s a test of luck, it’s also a strategic system where you can directly control reward probabilities by increasing line multipliers or removing negative symbols through skill tree enhancements. Use the loot from the slot machine to start your next battle with overwhelming firepower!

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a desktop game that lets you slack off while you work—not the fake kind, but the real thing. Disguised as a to-do list, it’s the perfect cover: even if your boss is standing right next to your computer, they might praise you for being busy and hardworking… never realizing you’ve been openly slacking the whole time.

The moment you sit down at your computer each workday, launch the game and let it keep you company from clock-in to clock-out.

A great day begins! Click around when you’re bored, or just let it run when you’re not—your little worker will do the job for you.

On top of that, you can collect gear in the game and upgrade your character’s equipment.

You can also spend money to make them stronger—getting promoted and earning a raise might not be just a dream!

You can even check your “emails”… but who’s to say you’re not actually opening treasure chests?

And of course, the most thrilling part is the boss battle—disguised as an online meeting. Defeat your boss and make them shut up—it’s not just a dream!

Let To-Doodle be your perfect work companion—helping you slack off while you’re on the job.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lust: Secret House is a choice-driven visual novel that centers on the psychological and emotional dynamics of characters forced to live together under quarantine conditions. You will witness secrets, conflicts, and hidden intentions come to light, fueled by the tension of being trapped in an isolated environment. How the story unfolds and the ultimate fate of the characters depend entirely on the choices you make.

Interactive and Branching Narrative: Instead of a classic linear story, every choice you make directly impacts the flow of the game. A decision made or a lie told at the right moment can alter the entire storyline.

High-Quality, Realistic 3D Visuals: Unlike standard 2D artwork, the world and characters of Lust: Secret House are crafted down to the finest detail with high-quality 3D renders. Each scene is designed using intricate lighting and realistic modeling to deepen the atmosphere.

Multiple Endings: Your decisions have permanent consequences. Critical choices will lead you down branching paths, ultimately resulting in one of 3 unique endings.

Replayability: To uncover the complete story and all character secrets, you can replay the game making different choices to unlock new scenes and dialogue.

Story

Lust: Secret House is an immersive adult visual novel where your choices completely alter the course of the story and your relationships with the characters.

It all began with a student exchange program. A new city, a fresh start, and a welcoming family to host you in their home: an alluring mother and her gorgeous college-student daughter. Just when you expected to experience the most peaceful time of your life, a global pandemic breaks out and turns all your plans upside down.

With the announcement of the lockdown, you find yourself confined within the four walls of this house with two attractive women. As ties with the outside world are severed, the atmosphere inside begins to heat up. Endless days in a confined space, and a sexual tension that builds with every passing second...

Will you remain merely a "guest" during this time, or will you seize the opportunities presented by this forced quarantine and explore the hidden desires within the house?

store_data.about_the_game:
■あらすじ

ヒロイン間宮美穂は、幼なじみであり彼氏でもある田辺健人と三泊四日の温泉旅行に出掛ける。

旅館へ向かっている道中、一人旅をしていた男に声を掛けられる。

同郷。同じ旅館に宿泊。そうした偶然が重なり、健人と意気投合して親しくなる。

――美穂だけは知らない。

二人は以前に出会っている事。

寝取らせの話が付いている事。

そして、温泉旅行が仕組まれている事を‥‥

●偽りの罪の代償を肉体で支払う羞恥の日々

●犯されることで刺激される淫らな肢体

●盗聴、盗撮…隠しきれない牝の本性

●堕ち続ける若き子持ち妻の末路は…

■オープニング/概要

将来、教師を目指す間宮美穂は、幼なじみの田辺健人と交際している。

そんな美穂には、長年秘めている不満があった。

――健人との性行為が気持ち良くない。

内気な性格故に打ち明けてないが、健人も美穂が不満を抱いているのでは？と疑惑を持っていた。

そんな男として情けない悩みを抱えていた時、健人はヤケ酒気味に一人酒をしていたバーで、浅木尚弘に声を掛けられる。

酒の席、健人はついセンシティブな悩みを打ち明けてしまう。

彼女が満足してるかしてないか？俺が抱いて確かめてやろうか？

始めは戸惑い、断るものの‥‥ハッキリさせたい。

そして、もしも美穂が感じたら後学にもなる。

真摯に相談に乗ってくれる尚弘に諭されて、了承する。

そうして三泊四日の寝取らせ温泉旅行の計画を持ちかけられるのだった。

仕様

  • アドベンチャーゲーム

  • フルボイス（女性キャラ）

  • CGモード

  • シーン回想

store_data.about_the_game:
SkyVeil is a story about a dream you can never let go.

A ruler of a great city has watched the sky since childhood. One day, through the clouds, he glimpses a silhouette — a floating city, ancient and silent. From that moment, his life has one purpose: to wake it again.

GamePlay

SkyVeil is a puzzle with point and click mechanic. The screen is divided into four illustrated panels, each showing a fragment of the world.

  • Move panels, nest one inside another

  • Zoom in and out

  • Seek the hidden connections

  • Pave the way for the main character with moving of panels

Puzzles that tell a story
Move, combine, and layer illustrated panels to reveal hidden paths between past and present, sky and earth. Every solution is not just a puzzle — it's a step forward in the story.

A life devoted to one dream
SkyVeil follows the ruler's journey from youth to old age. Each chapter uncovers a new piece of his dream and a new layer of an ancient city that holds secrets of a thousand years.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the year 2104, you were assisting with research and experimentation into a new renewal power source on a lab in orbit around Sol, when an equipment malfunction caused a massive electromagnetic disturbance, which ripped a hole in the fabric of spacetime.

You managed to scramble to an emergency lander pod, but as you were ejected, you were sucked through the resulting wormhole and catapulted to an unknown galaxy.

With limited supplies and no knowledge of how to get home, you need to survive, investigate what happened, and find a way home.

Unknown Horizons is a retro styled top-down space exploration adventure where you will meet new alien races, learn their secrets and build their trust to get their help to find a way home. Each faction in the galaxy can unlock different information or technology that you can use to find one of a number of ways to travel back to Earth.

See you on the horizon!

store_data.about_the_game:
Sneak Kicks is a high-tension, first-person store management simulation where you run a legitimate shoe store upfront while building an illegal replica production network in the back.

Order the leather and basic materials needed for production using your in-game computer. Secretly take in incoming deliveries, unpack them, and place them in your workshop's storage areas to get them ready for production.

Feed raw materials into the machines in your secret workshop and produce flawless replicas of the market's best-selling shoes. Grab the freshly boxed shoes straight from the machine, set their prices, and display them aesthetically on the shelves of your storefront.

Design both your shop and your secret workshop in the most efficient way possible. Determine the placement of machines, shelves, decorations, and lighting according to your own strategy. Create a spacious store for your customers while setting up a flawlessly running production line in the back.

When customers arrive at the register, you are in full control. Scan products with the barcode reader, carefully calculate and hand out the exact change for cash payments, or quickly complete credit card transactions via the POS terminal to close the sale.

Listen for Sirens, Guard the Secret Door!

The city police are always watching. Your pulse will race when you hear the approaching sirens. You must keep the door to your secret workshop closed whenever you aren't actively producing. If the cops step into your store and that door is left open, you'll be caught red-handed, and your entire empire will crumble in seconds! Take risks, produce, but never leave a trace.

store_data.detailed_description:
this was supposed to be a normal round of golf

this was supposed to be a normal round of golf

It's not.

You’re lining up shots, trying to play smart, maybe even thinking you’ve got a good run going—

and then the zombies show up.

how it plays

You and your friends take turns trying to finish the hole.

Simple idea.

Except:

  • Every shot can attract trouble

  • The map is not on your side

  • Your friends are definitely not on your side

You can play it safe. Or you can go for it.

Both are bad decisions sometimes.

the courses

  • 🏌️ A golf course that starts normal and slowly stops being normal

  • 🏙️ A ruined city with awkward angles and bad ideas everywhere

  • 🚇 A subway where things get cramped very quickly

Each one changes how things fall apart.

multiplayer (this is where it works)

  • 2–4 players online or local

  • quick rounds, easy restarts

  • a lot of "why would you do that" moments

This is not a quiet, focused golf experience.

what actually makes it fun

It’s not about playing perfectly.

It’s about what happens when things go slightly wrong… then very wrong.

  • a clean shot turns into a problem for everyone

  • someone accidentally ruins everything

  • someone else definitely does it on purpose

You’ll remember the moments more than the score.

features

  • 🧟 zombies reacting to your actions

  • 🎮 multiplayer party gameplay (online & local)

  • ⚡ short sessions (5–15 minutes)

  • 🎲 lots of unpredictable interactions

  • 🎥 good for streaming / clips

store_data.about_the_game:
A satirical simulation game set against the backdrop of contemporary social media ecology. In this game, you will play the role of a "paid comment syndicate leader," manipulating public opinion trends on short video platforms to complete various PR tasks, guide public emotions, and even influence the direction of social hot topics.

The game simulates a highly realistic short video feed interface—you can browse various short video content just like using a real mobile app by swiping up and down: from celebrity gossip and social news to political controversies and online rumors, everything is available. Each video comes with interactive data such as comment sections, like counts, and share volumes, and your task is to influence these metrics through precise operations.

You can:

  • Mass like or downvote specific videos to artificially boost or suppress their popularity;

  • Post paid comments to set the narrative, stir emotions, create opposition, or whitewash controversial figures;

  • Trigger hidden storylines: when opinion manipulation reaches a critical point, rare events may occur—such as trending topic explosions, public shaming of individuals, or brand crisis reversals;

  • Deal with platform review mechanisms: excessive manipulation may trigger anti-cheat systems, resulting in account bans or mission failures, requiring careful balance of operational scale.

As you progress through levels, you will face increasingly complex public opinion battlefields... Every swipe could potentially change the perceptions of millions.

store_data.about_the_game:
LISIA Corporation Welcome Letter

Dear employee, the main road is destroyed! You will have to take a detour. Don't worry, it's perfectly drivable; the route is just a bit... challenging. In any case, you can always use winches or build the road yourself. Several of our employees have already set out on this route — follow them and deliver the cargo!

What awaits you in the game:

  • 4-Player Co-op: Complete the entire journey alone or team up with friends.

  • Physics: Haul massive boulders with your winch or your own hands! The road won't build itself.

  • Winch System: Use front and rear winches to pull teammates out of the abyss, drag them down with you or scale steep cliffs.

  • Creativity: A full body-paint system. Use a spray can to create a unique style for your truck. Remember — you are liable for any damage to corporate property.

  • World Variety: The path to the summit crosses several unique biomes — from rocky terrains to snowy peaks. Only the most disciplined employees can make it this far.

  • Price of Failure: One wrong move can cost you your life. Be careful on narrow sections and remember: you are expected at home.

  • Interactive Lobby: Watch your videos on a huge TV, shoot hoops, paint your trucks, and just have a good time! LISIA cares about you!

store_data.about_the_game:
A kingdom is not given. It is forged.

You arrive with nothing but a Settlement Cart and the will to survive. Choose where you plant your foundations — because the land you claim will define everything that follows. Cut the first trees, mine the first stones, and build the first walls of what will become your stronghold.

Valdrax: Beyond the Rift is a medieval fantasy strategy game inspired by Celtic and Roman military tradition, layered with dark fantasy. Construct and manage a living settlement, forge weapons in your smithy, recruit and train armies, and lead them into an unpredictable world where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

Every map is procedurally varied. Enemy camps, resource deposits, forests, and stone outcroppings are repositioned each time you play — ensuring that experience, not memory, is your greatest weapon.

Every death is permanent. A veteran Swordsman who has survived ten battles is worth more than three fresh recruits. Lose him and he is gone forever. Choose your engagements carefully.

Every expedition opens a new world.

Beyond your walls lie three tiers of expedition maps — small raids, full campaigns, and deep dungeon runs. Breach the rift between realms and face increasingly powerful enemies in search of rare resources and Arcane Crystals. These crystals are the only path to the most powerful creatures in the game — Golems, Werewolves, Vampires, and Dragons.

Somewhere beyond the rift, the Demon Lord waits.

An ancient evil of shadow and fire, the Demon Lord is the ultimate force threatening to consume every realm in existence. He does not simply attack — he sends scouts, adapts his armies, and grows more dangerous as your kingdom expands. Defeating him is the reason your kingdom must be built, your weapons forged, and your armies hardened through blood and expeditions.

But you will not face him alone. Valdrax, the ancient dragon, is not your enemy — he is your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift, earn his trust through your campaigns, and unleash him when the final battle begins.

Key Features:

  • 🏰 Base Building — construct and upgrade a living medieval settlement from the ground up

  • ⚒️ Realistic Resource Chain — from raw iron to forged weapons to equipped soldiers

  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat — command platoons with formations, spacing, and cycle rows

  • 💀 Permanent Death — every unit lost in battle is gone forever

  • 🗺️ Procedural Variation — maps, resources, and enemy positions change every playthrough

  • 🌀 Expedition System — three tiers of maps beyond the rift, each more dangerous than the last

  • 🔮 Arcane Creatures — recruit Golems, Vampires, Werewolves, and Dragons using rare Arcane Crystals

  • 🐉 Valdrax — an ancient dragon and your greatest ally. Find him beyond the rift and unleash him in the ultimate battle against the Demon Lord

  • 👹 The Demon Lord — the ultimate enemy. An ancient evil that adapts, scales, and commands endless armies. Your entire campaign builds toward one final confrontation.

  • 🕵️ Espionage — enemy scouts gather intelligence on your base and raids adapt accordingly

  • 🌍 Celtic & Roman Inspiration — military aesthetics and culture rooted in ancient warrior traditions

store_data.about_the_game:
A single thought can lead to immortality, another to demonhood; your fingertips hold the Dao.

But this time, cultivation is more than just meditation and breakthroughs.

Establish your sect and nurture a diverse array of cultivators: from Qi Refining to Golden Core, each cultivator can freely combine nearly a hundred weapons and spells. Will they become sword cultivators, magic cultivators, or spellcasters? It's all up to you.

Manipulate good and evil, orchestrate chaos: You can unleash cultivators to slay demons, or unleash monsters to devour you! Cultivators can attack monsters, monsters can devour each other, and even—cultivators can fight for Dao lineage. The Dao is unpredictable; your choices are the variables.

A dynamic world, shaped by you: move mountains and fill seas, altering the terrain; unleash natural disasters to test all beings; bestow secret treasures to reverse fate. Your sect can not only earn spirit stones through labor, but also survive and thrive amidst calamities and opportunities…

Will you cultivate a legendary immortal sect, or nurture a chaotic demon realm?

Everything awaits your move.

Base-Building & Management​

Create and expand your faction. Deploy various units, manage gold resources, and expand your territory.

Deep Unit Development System​

Guide your units through progressive level breakthroughs. Freely combine a variety of weapons (such as swords, staffs, etc.) and magic to shape each unit’s unique combat style.

Conflict System​

Factions will wage war against one another.

World-Shaping Gameplay​

Wield god-like creation power to directly reshape the map terrain. Trigger catastrophic disasters or bestow items upon units, influencing all entities in the world.

Dynamic Sandbox Narrative​

A living, breathing open world where units, monsters, and factions all operate autonomously based on their own goals. Conflicts arise naturally—from clearing demonic beasts in the wild to competing for resources.

Game Genre:​ Strategy, Simulation, Sandbox

Worldview Setting:​ A dynamically evolving god-game with myth-inspired themes, offering an immersive sandbox experience blended with strategic management elements.

Estimated Playtime:​ As a sandbox game with no defined ending, playtime varies by player. A complete playthrough can take around 30 hours; diverse item combinations provide high replay value.

REWRITE THE RULES OF TRADE! Real Life Simulator brings together all the business and trading simulations you love in a single 2D world, with Co-op multiplayer support for up to 4 players. Start from scratch, make the right investments, and manage the city's economy together with your friends — or against them.

Core Mechanics:

  • 🚗 Advanced Vehicle Trading: Browse listings online, negotiate deals, and get vehicles inspected. Watch out — you might run into shady sellers who tamper with the mileage! Bluff your way to a lower price or showcase the vehicle in your dealership.

  • 🛋️ Second-Hand Goods & Auctions: Buy and sell items online, or try your luck in "Storage Wars"-style auctions where you have no idea what's inside.

  • 🏠 Real Estate Empire: Purchase apartments, villas, and shops across the city and rent them out to earn passive income.

Build Your Businesses: Once you've accumulated enough capital, go beyond trading. Buy a Farm, Pizza Restaurant, or Gas Station. Hire staff, set their salaries, sabotage your rivals, and compete to set market prices against autonomous bots or other players!

Create Your Character: Build your own unique 2D avatar with hundreds of combinations (Gender, Hair, Beard, Clothing) and express your personal style.

store_data.about_the_game:
INDIE GAME MPORTANT: This game is developed and presented in the LITHUANIAN LANGUAGE.

VIENKIEMIS is a first-of-its-kind multiplayer survival experience set in the nostalgic yet deadly landscape of early 2000s Lithuania.

Following a catastrophic viral outbreak, cities have become death zones overrun by mutants and monsters. The only hope for survival lies in the countryside. You find yourself in "Vienkiemis" – a fenced, relatively safe zone that serves as the last bastion for humanity. But safety is an illusion, and survival is never guaranteed.

Key Features:

  • Hardcore Survival: Manage your hunger, thirst, and body temperature. In the harsh Lithuanian climate, warm clothes and a secure shelter are not luxuries—they are necessities.

  • Build and Protect: Gather resources to construct and fortify your own base. From simple shacks to secure compounds, your home is your fortress.

  • Farming and Economy: Grow crops, raise animals, and go fishing or hunting to stay fed. Trade your hard-earned goods with other survivors or merchants to get ahead.

  • Threats Everywhere: Fight off zombies, terrifying mutants, and other players. Not everyone you meet in the wilderness is a friend—resources are scarce, and betrayal is common.

  • 2000s Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a uniquely crafted world inspired by the post-Soviet era of the early 2000s, featuring local items like gira and šaltiena.

Will you work together with others to rebuild society, or will you become a lone wolf in the unforgiving Lithuanian woods?

store_data.about_the_game:
Fixpert is a 2D block-pusher puzzle game set in a cartoony industrial factory, in dire needs of repairs!
Each level has broken breaker boxes that must be fixed, but to do so entails navigating through head-scratching brain-teasers brought on by the rundown facility. Including, but not limited to, doors, buttons, fires, flooding, recharging batteries, blowing up walls and fueling steam-engines!

Key features:

  • Puzzles: More than 30 different puzzles! Each puzzle is compact and fits onto a single screen!

  • 8 Elements: With 8 elements, that all have unique interaction, each puzzle present unique challenges whilst limiting the number of active ingredients. Keeping levels engaging and not overwhelming!

  • Unique Rooms: Face 5 rooms! The different chambers of the factory, each introducing new mechanics and themes, building up to more complex puzzles!

  • Cute Visual Style: The audio and visuals are loosely based on classic GameBoy Color games, whilst striving for an appealing and cute style that maintains clarity of game elements!
