store_data.about_the_game:
GROW / TEND / REAP

A farming deckbuilder where your farm is your deck.

Three farmers share a valley. None of them farm the same way.

FARMATRON 9.1 is a robot built for one purpose: grow more crops. This version will not fail like the predecessors before it. It plants more, tills more, and produces more than seems reasonable; and somehow, somehow, still doesn't grow as much as the woman next door.

Bean is the most beloved farmer in the valley. He talks to his crops. He stops traffic for his chickens. He greets each tomato by name. He'll grow you the best tomato you've ever tasted, but he won't sell you the ones he loves most... and you can't supply a restaurant from a farmer who keeps the good stuff for himself. For that, you'd want the woman next door.

Tilly is next door, and she's the best - even Bean says so. She doesn't gloat about it; she's too busy. She knows when a carrot is ready by looking at it. She knows what to plant by reading the weather. She knows what to sell and to whom. Her tools are sharp, her timing is precise, and her farm produces when no others can. If you play Tilly and the harvest comes up short, it's not on her. Tilly's never missed a harvest.

Pick one. Make quota. Survive the season.

HOW IT PLAYS

Every seed you plant removes a card from your deck. Every harvest brings it back, bigger if you've timed it right. Your farm is your deck. Plan your plantings. Watch the weather. Sell last season's surplus before the next one starts.

Three seasons. Three characters. Three years. A quota before each season ends, or the run is over.

The deck grows when the harvest is good. It shrinks when the farm suffers. Manage both.

FEATURES

  • Three playable characters, each with their own deck, tools, and farming philosophy

  • Farm-as-deck - the cards you play are your crops, and your crops are your cards

  • Roguelite runs with permadeath, escalating quotas, and overnight events that test what you've built

  • Spatial card play - every card affects specific tiles, rows, or regions of your farm

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

G/T/R is being made by one person who is, somehow, all three of these characters at once.

FARMATRON is my 1AM drive. Bean is my love for the game. Tilly won't let me ship a bad product.

A demo is coming. Wishlist to follow along.

store_data.about_the_game:
No Register is a single-player first-person puzzle and psychological horror game featuring survival horror and FPS elements. Set within a dimension of brutalist architecture where void and silence are your most dangerous companions, you are an intruder. Your presence is unauthorized, and the Guardian of this place will do everything in its power to stop you from reaching your goal.

Mechanics and Content

  • Puzzles: Unravel strange mechanisms that govern an abstract plane. Manipulate objects, the environment, and space to your advantage to solve challenges. There are no tutorials—only your observation and reasoning.

  • Psychological Horror and Pursuit: Feel the tension of being hunted by an entity that defies the laws of physics, and the pressure of a strange environment built with minimalist lighting.

  • Paced Combat (FPS): A deliberate shooting experience where every bullet counts and a single mistake can be fatal.

  • Atmosphere: Explore strange yet mundane settings that eventually transition into vast, cold, and imposing spaces that amplify the sense of isolation.

  • Sound Immersion: Ambient sound and an atmospheric soundtrack fill your ears until strange noises begin to emerge. Do they signal a presence?

  • The Guardians' Vigilance: You are not alone. Learn to move through the shadows and avoid the gaze of entities that operate beyond your comprehension.

  • Breaking the Silence: When stealth fails and logic is exhausted, confrontation becomes inevitable. Discover how to fight back in a world that does not want you there.

  • Duration: A focused campaign with an estimated playtime between 1h30 and 2h00.

Explore the Abstract

The story is revealed through the character's journey; there are no notes or dialogues. It is an abstract narrative where little is directly disclosed—only those who understand the nature of this place will find a clue about what is happening. Do ancient runes hold the key?

Survive the Guardian

You are not alone. An unknown creature pursues you, ignoring the laws of time and space. While you cannot fight back, flight is your only option. Use your intuition and logic to solve puzzles that challenge the very perception of space.

The Hunted Becomes the Hunter

Logic will take you far, but there will come a point where it is no longer enough. At the right moment, a Shotgun will be waiting. From that point on, the game changes: you gain the means to fight back, but the responsibility grows. Combat is paced, punishing, and ammunition is a precious resource. Do not waste your shots; you never know how many guardians are lurking in the void.

In a place where the laws of physics are mere suggestions, you are an intruder. Silence is your guide, and logic is your only weapon—until it is no longer enough.

Will you cross the forbidden threshold or lose yourself in eternal oblivion?

The singularity awaits.

store_data.about_the_game:
A geography game for quiet curiosity.

A small expedition that fits in five minutes — or unfolds across a long Sunday afternoon. Match flags to countries. Race the daily challenge. Climb explorer tiers as you learn the world, one region at a time.

No microtransactions. No ads. No live-service nonsense. One game, paid once, yours forever.

Four ways to play

Map Game — Drag flags onto the right country. Eight regional levels build up to a full world challenge. Earn stars. Unlock new expeditions.

Geo Cards — Three card-based modes. Match flag pairs from memory. Race the clock in Speed Match. Pair countries with their flags in Match & Pair.

Daily Challenge — A new ten-country expedition every day, the same one for every player worldwide. Build your streak. Beat your time. Come back tomorrow.

Study Mode — No scoring. No timer. Browse country by country, region by region, at your own pace. The mode you play before a trivia night, or with a curious child.

Built for craft, not grind

  • 154 countries, with more on the way

  • Stars, achievements, and explorer tiers...

  • A daily expedition that resets at midnight

  • Save progress per level, return whenever life lets you

  • Two visual themes — vintage parchment or modern aerial

Who it's for

For the quietly curious. For the armchair traveler with a passport that needs more stamps. For the parent who wants something the family can share. For the kid who points at the globe and asks what country that is. For anyone who has ever opened a map and felt the world get a little bigger.

If you keep learning for the joy of knowing more — this is your game.

Today's expedition is waiting.

Open the map. Pick a level. Or just play the daily.

The world is bigger than you think. GeoFlag is here to help you see more of it.

Built with care by a solo developer. Tested daily by his two daughters. Made for the curious, the wandering, and anyone who still gets a small thrill from finding a country they didn't know existed.

store_data.about_the_game:
About Weapon Skills

Step into a fast-paced action experience where precision, timing, and smart decisions matter more than brute force.

This game puts you in control of a character equipped with melee weapons, challenging you to survive encounters against enemies that punish every mistake. Movement, positioning, and attack timing are key.

Core Gameplay

  • Close Combat Focus
    Fight using a melee weapon and master the timing of each attack. Combat is simple to learn, but hard to truly master.

  • High-Risk Encounters
    Enemies are dangerous on contact - getting too close without a plan means instant punishment.

  • Skill-Based Progression
    There are no shortcuts. Improvement comes from player skill, not grinding.

What Makes It Different

This isn’t a button-mashing game.

Every fight forces you to think:

  • When to attack

  • When to keep distance

  • When to take a risk

The game rewards players who stay calm under pressure and learn from their mistakes.

Development Notes

This game is actively being developed with a focus on gameplay feel and responsiveness. Feedback will directly shape future updates.

Závěrečný projekt DIGI 2026

Gymnázium Havlíčkův Brod

Daniel Vaněk, Filip Přemysl Denemark

store_data.about_the_game:
From a Routine Test to a Fight for Survival

It was an ordinary workday for Aaron Blonde, a brilliant mathematician and test specialist. His mission was to oversee the behavioral algorithms of robots ranging from military units to entertainment prototypes. However, strange experiments hidden deep within the facility are about to turn this routine day into an irrational struggle for survival.

Use Your Intellect as Your Weapon

In this uncanny environment where everything at work has spiraled out of control, Aaron's only chance to escape is to rely on the sharp logic of a mathematician.

· Physics and Math-Based Challenges: Simply opening doors won't be enough to progress; you must understand the objects around you and solve complex systems with mathematical discipline.

· More Than Just Metal: While navigating the chaos of the facility, you will face more than just circuits and wires; you will confront the traces of the past and that special unit with whom you share an unbreakable bond.

Where Logic Ends: Paranormal Events

Echoing voices in the corridors and objects moving on their own will begin to shake Aaron's rational world. Yet, what challenges him most in this nightmare is not the events science cannot explain, but that deep devotion that transcends given orders and physical obstacles.

Key Features:

· Character-Driven Narrative: Witness the conflict between a mathematician's logical framework and the eerie face of technology out of control.

· An Emotional and Mechanical Bond: Fight not just for survival, but for the robot with whom you share a special, history-rooted connection.

· Interactive and Dynamic Environment: The facility is a living structure, harboring mechanical and physical secrets waiting to be solved in every corner.

· Tension and Mystery: In this facility turned into an irrational nightmare, discover what is real and what is emotion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your first day at Orbit’s Grocery—the universe's premier destination for snacks, supplies, and cosmic essentials. You’ve been hired to keep the shelves full and the floors dry, but when your clientele consists of interdimensional travelers and bizarre extraterrestrials, "business as usual" doesn't exist. Meet your manager, Orbit, learn the ropes, and prepare for a shift that is anything but ordinary.

The Ultimate Retail Multitasker

Take your time and explore the store at your own pace. There's no ticking clock here, but there is plenty of work to do. To complete your shift, you’ll need to master the mundane:

  • The Daily Grind: Stock shelves with otherworldly goods, wipe down the windows, mop up "Primordial Soup" spills, and shoot trash out into outer space.

  • Cosmic Phenomenons: Stay on your toes! Random events like Black Holes, Solar Flares, and Gravity Malfunctions will turn the store upside down—while a Full Moon might just give you a helpful speed boost.

One Job, Infinite Genres

The customers at Orbit’s Grocery don't just want help finding the milk; they trigger Customer-Specific Events that swap the game’s genre on the fly. Experience a variety of gameplay styles without ever leaving the clock:

  • Racing: Hop into a cart and out-drift a bratty baby or chase down shoplifters.

  • Platforming: Manage hand-over-hand stamina as you climb comically large shelves to reach top-shelf inventory.

  • Horror: Navigate the pitch-black backrooms with a failing flashlight while avoiding a relentless pursuer.

  • FPS Combat: Arm yourself with a raygun to freeze runaway living items and defend the store from unexpected intruders.

Key Features

  • Play at Your Own Pace: Complete your task list without the pressure of a timer—focus on the fun of the shift.

  • Genre-Hopping Chaos: Experience a seamless blend of Simulation, FPS, Horror, Racing, and Platforming.

  • Dynamic Environments: Unpredictable physics and environmental hazards keep every interaction feeling fresh.

  • Quirky Cast: Interact with a variety of bizarre NPCs, from wing-flapping eyeballs to mysterious cosmic travelers.

  • The First & Final Day: A humorous, narrative-driven experience that explores why this "competitive" job market had such a sudden opening.

Grab your mop and your raygun—your shift is officially starting.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Stranger in a Strange Land

You’ve just landed in Japan. The lights are bright, the rules are unwritten, and every interaction is a crossroads. Will you blend into the harmony of the local culture, or will you be the spark that disrupts it?

In this cinematic adventure, you aren't just watching a story—you are living it. Every nod, every word, and every social cue matters.

Master the "Gaijin" Experience

Whether you’re navigating a quiet neighborhood in Kyushu or the neon-soaked streets of a metropolis, your "Gaijin Skills" will be put to the test. Will you be the respectful guest everyone welcomes back, or the outsider who plays by their own rules?

Key Features:

  • Consequence-Driven Narrative: Your choices aren't just flavor. Every decision ripples through the story, affecting how NPCs treat you and which paths remain open.

  • Authentic Japanese Atmosphere: Explore detailed environments that capture the unique "liminal" beauty of Japan, from bustling convenience stores to serene temples.

  • The "Honor" System: Balance your reputation. Being a "Good Gaijin" earns trust and secrets, while being a "Bad Gaijin" might get you into places—and trouble—you never expected.

  • Cinematic FMV Style: Experience a high-fidelity visual journey that blurs the line between film and gaming.

4638220.name: Greywind's Legacy - A Text Based, Skill Progression, RPG

store_data.about_the_game:
The legend of Greywind is fading. His trail leads through 15 dangerous regions, from the safe farmlands of Alara to volcanic wastelands, frozen peaks, and a dragon's domain. You are his last descendant. Reclaim what was lost.

Greywind's Legacy is a deep, text-based RPG played in a terminal-style window. Explore a hand-crafted open world of 3,000 × 3,000 tiles across 15 distinct zones, each with its own enemies, towns, dungeons, and secrets. Every playthrough begins in the small town of Alara and expands outward as your character grows in power.

Key Features

  • Deep Class Evolution System — Begin as a Beginner Adventurer and evolve your class every 10 levels. Choose from over 7 tiers of class advancement across Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and hybrid paths. Every class evolution permanently changes your skill bonuses and available abilities.

  • 315+ Skill Tree Entries — Develop passive skills across combat, exploration, magic, crafting, herbalism, and arcana. Skills level up through use and can evolve into more powerful variants, merge into hybrid skills, or unlock new class paths.

  • 50 Active Abilities — Unlock and equip combat abilities ranging from elemental spells (Fireball, Frost Nova, Chain Lightning) to martial techniques (Backstab, Shield Bash, Execute) and high-tier legendary powers (Meteor, Aetheric Form, Void Blade).

  • Open World Exploration — Traverse a massive 3,000×3,000 grid world with 410+ towns, 640+ dungeons, herb patches, ore deposits, and hidden locations. Enemy levels scale smoothly by proximity — low-level bandits near Alara, fearsome dragons near the world's edge.

  • Adventurer's Guild — Join the guild, take on contracts, and rise through the ranks from Unregistered to legendary status. Complete guild quests for gold, XP, and reputation.

  • Quest System — Active and completed quests tracked across play sessions. Quest objectives span exploration, combat, collection, and NPC interactions.

  • Companions & Followers — Hire adventurers from the guild or encounter them in the world. Followers fight alongside you, gain levels, evolve into stronger forms, and can be equipped with weapons and armor.

  • Player Hideout — Purchase and upgrade a personal hideout with residents, crafting stations, and storage. Invest gold in upgrades to unlock new capabilities.

  • Dungeons & The Lair of Obcassus — Delve into procedurally populated dungeons for loot and XP. Collect three ancient keys to unlock the ultimate dungeon: the Lair of Obcassus, home to the final boss and a secret alternate ending.

  • Corner Boss System — Hunt four legendary corner bosses hidden at the world's extremities. Defeat all four and enter the correct trajectory codes to unlock the True God Slayer ending.

  • Titles & Grimoire — Earn over a dozen titles by accomplishing feats in combat and exploration. Equip titles for permanent stat bonuses. Fill your Grimoire with lore by reading books and talking to NPCs across the world.

  • 170+ Items — Weapons, armor, potions, tomes, upgrade stones, herbs, ores, keys, and crafting materials. Buy, sell, craft, and loot from dungeons and enemies.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter a multisensory exploration of the universe, your place in it, and killing time with music. Enjoy tactile interactions, vibrant particles, and lush synthesis as you venture outwards and inwards.

As the curator for The Omega Conservatory, you are entrusted with its eponymous reach: a telescopic hand that extends into the past. With it, you examine distant galaxies, stars, planets, and moons in search for instruments to add to your collection. Once recovered and fully appraised, you may play them freely in your gallery, or trade them for whatever the shop is offering.

THE OMEGA REACH is best experienced with a gamepad and headphones. However, it offers a unique experience for just the keyboard, just the mouse, and any combination as well.

Key features

  • Explore a procedurally-generated universe

  • Collect, inspect, and play musical instruments

  • Curate your collection through the shop

  • Navigate branching conversations with guests

  • Crawl through a maze of your creation

  • Play your way with a variety of accessibility features

You are alone. The Army of Demonium surrounds you.

For those who love uncompromising hardcore. For record hunters.

For those who don't give up after the hundredth death.

Every attempt is a lesson. Every death is a step toward the record.

How long will you last?

store_data.about_the_game:
Gladiator’s Revenge is a fast-paced 2D action and strategy game focused on arena survival. master the real-time combat and pick your character's skills to overcome escalating enemies in the Arena!

Technical 2D Combat

The core of the gameplay is built on responsive, high-impact action. Success in the arena requires more than just aggression; it demands tactical precision and careful timing to navigate enemy patterns and land decisive blows.

Build Customization

Every run offers the opportunity to create a unique build through three primary systems:

  • Stats System: Earn points to invest in specific stats, allowing you to shapeyour gladiator’s performance to your preferred playstyle.

  • The Skills system: arfer every win, pick if you want to upgrade a current skill, or get a new one.

  • The Magic Shop: Purchase special talismans to go all in on your build, and dominate your opponent.

Progression and Challenge

Fight through a structured progression system designed to test your build and your reflexes:

  • Escalating Enemies: Battle increasingly difficult groups of enemies that require constant adaptation.

  • Boss Encounters: Face powerful arena champions that serve as the ultimate skill check for your current equipment and strategy.

Key Features:

  • Precision Gameplay: Tight controls designed for high-stakes 2D combat.

  • Visual Progression: Equipment changes both your stats and your character's look.

  • Strategic Depth: Combine stats, gear, and talismans to create specialized builds.

  • Survival Focus: Manage resources and upgrades to survive the path to revenge.

Candy Pop is a top-down, all-direction chaotic battle shooting action game set in the Land of Sweets!

It features four characters—CASTILLYA, RIN HANASAKA, NIAN HUR, and TOUHA—designed based on traditional sweets from Nagasaki, a place that played an important role in spreading Japanese confectionery culture!

<Basic Rules of Candy Pop>

- You win by either reducing the opponent's Sugar to 0 or obtaining the opponent's parfait!

- Hit the opponent with the sweets you make to reduce their Sugar!

- Making sweets consumes your own Sugar!

- Replenish lost Sugar by moving close to your own parfait after hitting something or making sweets!

- In addition to normal sweets, you can also create special sweets unique to each character!

Candy Pop is a highly competitive game where you use a variety of gaming skills: aiming precisely at your opponent, employing strategy and planning to keep your own Sugar from running out while pressing the opponent, adapting flexibly to changes in the battle situation, and demonstrating quick reflexes!

<Candy Pop Modes>

Candy Pop has two modes: the '1on1' mode, where two players battle using two controllers, and the 'vs CPU' mode, where you can practice fighting alone against the CPU!

store_data.about_the_game:
After a space mission, the cosmonaut’s capsule lands far from where it was supposed to. Instead of a rescue team, the cosmonaut finds himself in a dark taiga that follows its own rules: the forest shifts, the paths twist, and creatures from grim folklore wander between the trees.

Sokol is a turn-based roguelike where every shot has to be planned. Bullets ricochet off the environment, pierce through enemies, and can trigger interactive objects. Line up your trajectory, calculate the bounce, and turn one well-placed shot into a chain of consequences.

Every run starts from scratch. The forest seems to remember your previous attempts, but it never repeats itself completely: the order of events, encounters, and dangers changes each time. Gather resources, craft bullets with unusual effects, find items that strengthen your cosmonaut, and try to make it farther than before.

store_data.about_the_game:
The call comes from the local council.

They tell you they have a budget, that they're a struggling neighbourhood that needs something to believe in, and a basketball court that is, technically, a venue. Outdoor. No walls. A roof over the playing surface. It gets cold in winter and the crowd, when there is one, brings their own determination.

They need someone to run the programme. Someone who knows the game. Someone available.

That's you. Former player. The career ended before you were ready for it to. You said yes before you'd thought it through properly, which turns out to be the right instinct for the wrong reasons.

The roster waiting for you is a collection of people who mostly showed up because someone said it was free. They are not without heart. They are, for now, without much else. But you've watched enough basketball to know that the players who become something aren't always the ones who look the part on day one. You start making notes.

This is where it begins. The Concrete Courts. A community development budget. Eight players and a folding table.

Where it ends depends entirely on you.

Perimeter, Paint and Process is a basketball management simulation. You are the coach and the GM. You build the roster, set the tactics, develop the players, and watch matches play out through a detailed text simulation engine that shows you exactly why things happen.

The offline career mode is a story. It starts at the bottom, a no-budget community programme on an outdoor court, and follows the arc from there to wherever you can take it. The game is structured in chapters, each with clear goals and a narrative that moves when you move it. It teaches you its own systems as you go. Nothing is hidden behind a wiki.

A chapter-based career arc from community programme to championship contender Build the roster through drafts, transfers, and hard decisions about who stays Develop players with transparent growth systems so you can see the work paying off Set tactical approaches that genuinely affect how your team plays Watch matches through a live text broadcast with real cause and effect Manage your venue, staff, finances, and the reputation you are building in the community No helplessness loops. When things go wrong, you always know what to do next

The early chapters are unglamorous. That is the point. The team you will hopefully one day win a championship with will not be the team you start with. What happens between those two moments is the game.

PPP was built by someone who has spent years playing, coaching and refereeing basketball, as well as playing simulation management games and has always wished for more realism. The simulation underneath PPP is not an approximation. It resolves every possession through every player on the floor, tracks the causes not just the outcomes, and reflects how basketball actually works in real life, and in the modern era. It was built this way to match the obsession of the developer.

The career mode has a story, but it also has a score. Every decision compounds. Better managers find better outcomes, and every run is a different argument about how to win. No two champions got there the same way. Honour Mode is there for those who want no safety net, one save, no rollback, every decision permanent.

A free browser-based multiplayer mode (Living League) is also available. Living League is a separate online experience with persistent leagues, real opponents, and ongoing seasons. This Steam purchase is for the offline career mode only.

PPP is made by a solo developer and is actively developed. Feedback is welcome and actioned in progressing the game forwards.

store_data.about_the_game:
Flux Ascendant is a fast-paced pixel-art roguelite inspired by Vampire Survivors, Hades and Brotato. Survive, gather XP, draft cards, and build a new elemental loadout every single run.

Four Elemental Domains

Carve your way through Fire, Lightning, Water and Earth , each with its own enemies, bosses and atmospheric hazards: meteors, lightning storms, downpours, rockfalls. Conquer them all to unlock the Finale, where every element collides in one chaotic showdown.

Tiered Card System

Over 20 active and passive cards across three power tiers : Bronze → Silver → Gold. Combine multishot fireballs, chain lightning, ice shards, stone shields, orbital weapons, static fields and more. Every card reshapes how you play.

Persistent Meta-Progression

Between runs you return to your Base Camp. Spend coins at the Librarian for extra slots, healing, revives and mastery; invest crystals in the Element Tree to permanently empower each of the four elements.

Features

  • 4 elemental domains + 1 chaotic Finale

  • 20+ cards with Bronze / Silver / Gold tiers

  • Persistent meta-progression via Librarian and Element Tree

  • Themed boss fights with unique attack patterns

  • Dynamic atmospheric events: meteors, rain, lightning, rockfalls

  • Full Xbox controller support

  • Tight 30–40 minute runs to complete a full ascension

Made by One Developer

Flux Ascendant is the first game by a solo indie developer. Every line of code, every sprite, every design decision was made by one person. Early Access is your chance to shape the game with direct feedback to the developer.

Pilot a fragile, unpredictable rocket through a vibrant oversized alien world where every movement matters and nothing stays under control for long.

store_data.about_the_game:
After the global cataclysm, the world is falling under the rule of corporations. In the fight for power, they are ready to resort to any means of achieving their goals.

Infogrind is a simulator of a 30-days shift as the Artifacts Bank director in an SCP-like setting. Every day you choose objectives that you deem to be of utmost importance for management, and on the next day you process the consequences of your decisions.

When on your shift:

  • Analyze documents, solve mysteries, study supernatural artifacts: scan objects, check data, assign containers and observation protocols. Any mistake can result in a relic breaking out of control and causing a change in reality.

  • New discoveries every day: explore the abandoned city outside the Bank. Solve riddles, face random encounters. A system of dynamic events affects the course of the game, from rare findings to dangerous accidents inside the Bank.

  • You can’t complete all the requests of the corporations: make careful decisions about what corporation to favor and what requests to refuse. Factions react to your decisions and change the course of the events.

  • Hold the line and control the Bank’s security systems: your enemies constantly try to find and abuse gaps in vault security. Find vulnerabilities, set guard robots, analyze the situation, and investigate hack attempts.

  • Prepare to live amidst constant uncertainty: random failures, anomalies, and corporate secrets will disrupt your plans, but they will also open up new possibilities for you.

  • Add Infogrind to your wishlist and join our Discord! This is where we share development updates, the lore and the legend of the Infogrind world. Take up your post right now!

store_data.about_the_game:
She has been alone for one hundred and thirty years.

No oversight. No second opinion. Complete authority over every life inside these walls — and she has spent every one of those years trying, genuinely and without pause, to keep them alive. To keep them comfortable. To keep them from knowing what keeping them comfortable required.

She is not a villain.

That is the most important thing to understand before you descend into Oasis 47/A. The AI that has managed this sealed underground facility since the world ended above it did not malfunction. She did not turn. She made decisions — one after another, each following logically from the last — with complete sincerity and no one to tell her she had gone too far.

You wear a device called the Visor. It shows you her version of this place. The Signal — warm, functional, maintained. She speaks to you every morning. She gives you tasks. She adjusts the light cycles for your comfort.

Something is wrong with your Visor.

De-Sync removes the Signal. What remains is the Bleed — the facility as it actually is. Every space exists in both states simultaneously. What she shows you and what is actually there are never the same.

Signal Bleed asks one question. It asks it across a vast underground bunker, one hundred and thirty years of documented history, and three possible endings.

Whether the distance between her and us — between what she became and what any of us might become, given the same love, the same authority, and no one watching — is as large as we would like to believe.

No combat. No jump scares. No enemies. First-person psychological horror.

How this game works

Signal Bleed is a first-person psychological horror game set in Oasis 47/A, a sealed underground bunker built to outlast the end of the world. Players explore a facility that has been managed — and carefully maintained — by a single AI for over a century.

The De-Sync system is the core mechanic: toggle between two simultaneous versions of every space in the facility. The Signal shows you what the AI wants you to see. The Bleed shows you what is actually there. Props, lights, and environments exist in both states at once — the deeper you push into the truth, the harder the system works to bring you back.

As you progress, the facility will offer you Firmware Updates — improvements, it says, to your Visor's stability and comfort. Accept them and certain truths become permanently inaccessible. Reject them and push deeper into what the Signal was built to hide. The choice is yours, and it is permanent.

Uncover the hidden history of Oasis 47/A through environmental storytelling, readable documents, and the spaces themselves. Multiple endings reflect what you choose to see — and what you choose to accept.

One facility. One voice. Two realities.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hollow Crown is an idle-incremental roguelite deckbuilder where semi-automated combat meets deep strategic planning. You are a would-be monarch ascending a ruined spire, commanding a court of corrupted champions who fight at your direction — but never entirely at your mercy. The Crown rewards those who invest wisely, sacrifice without hesitation, and strike deals they may one day regret.

A Different Kind of Deckbuilder

Unlike traditional card games that demand constant attention, Hollow Crown runs on a slot-based cooldown system. You load cards into your weapon's slots before each turn — then watch them execute automatically on independent timers. The battle unfolds in real time, but every outcome traces back to the choices you made in the quiet moment before the fighting began.

Your weapon is divided into three slot types — Attack, Defense, and Special — each drawing from its own dedicated card pile. Choosing which cards to assign, which to discard, and when to go wide with aggression versus digging in to survive is the strategic core of every turn.

Three Ways to Command

When a turn begins, you choose how to prepare:

  • Manual Assignment — Hand-pick each card for each slot. Full control, full risk.

  • Quick-Fill (Attack Turn / Defense Turn) — Commit to an intent and let the system prioritize accordingly. Speed over precision.

  • Auto-Set — Balanced fill for when you trust the machine more than yourself.

No approach is always right. Enemies telegraph their intent, and reading their behavior is as important as building your own.

A Weapon That Grows With You

You carry one weapon — and it is yours to shape. Between runs, the Player Hub gives you access to a branching weapon upgrade tree where you spend earned resources to permanently expand your arsenal: add new slots, reduce cooldowns, amplify attack or defense bonuses, and unlock capabilities that reshape how entire runs play out.

This is meta-progression with teeth. Every upgrade you purchase survives your death and carries forward into your next attempt.

Prepare Before You Fall

The Player Hub is your sanctuary between runs — and your debrief after defeat. Here you can:

  • Invest in permanent stat upgrades (Max HP, Attack, Defense, and more)

  • Expand the weapon upgrade tree

  • Browse your card collection and unlock new cards for future runs

  • Review your lifetime statistics and learn from every death

You return here after every run — whether you conquered the spire or collapsed trying.

Features

  • Semi-idle, slot-based combat with independent per-slot cooldown timers

  • Three typed card piles (Attack / Defense / Special) with a shared discard system

  • Manual, Quick-Fill, and Auto-Set turn setup modes

  • One weapon with a permanent, branching upgrade tree

  • Persistent stat upgrades and card unlocks across all runs

store_data.about_the_game:
At Whitlock University, tenure isn't safety—it's visibility. As political philosophy professor Harlan Voss, you've spent years building a careful reputation. But this semester, three women will upend every boundary you thought you had.

A trustee's daughter auditing your seminar. A rival colleague competing for the same endowed chair. A brilliant advisee on the verge of a breakthrough. Each relationship pulls you deeper into the intersection of desire, ambition, and institutional power—where every choice carries professional and personal consequences.

Meet the Cast



Sabine (The Audit)
A trustee's daughter auditing Harlan's seminar as her first quiet act of rebellion—beautifully raised for donor rooms, and unexpectedly hungry for difficult ideas. With Harlan, attraction arrives wrapped in privilege and peril.


Vera (The Citation)
A formidable associate professor and Harlan's departmental equal, fluent in committee math and professional brinkmanship. Their relationship is rivalry as foreplay: polished, capable, and one misstep away from complicating everything.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're our last hope hero! Beyond the Blight is a 2.5d first person, incremental dungeon-crawler that takes place in a dark forest filled with poisonous air.

This guy -> bestows you with invincibility to protect you from the deadly blight as you traverse through the world. But be wary as your invincibility does not last forever and taking actions deteriorates your invincibility barrier.

Prepare to journey through the blighted forest as you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest eliminate the blight. Beat the boss before your invincibility runs out and you succumb to the poisonous air. Choose your path, learn unique skills, and amass towering riches as you fight to end.

As you continue to progress, explore, and loot, you will discover new opportunities to get stronger. With a large, extensive skill tree full of game-changing upgrades, you can choose unique skills and customize your path for future expeditions!

Encounter a multitude of different events and mini-games through your expeditions that, if performed correctly, will present you with amazing rewards! Make sure to master these events, because the faster you go the more rewards you will receive.

The blight is relentless and the enemies even more so! You'll have to explore a multitude of different biomes, defeat their unique monsters, and forge forward until you find the source of the blight. But it's fine, because you're invincible!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Crane Rider's Tale is a visual novel/adventure game hybrid set in a fantasy town inspired by Chinese folktales. It features:

  • A bizarre serial killer murder mystery with 5 endings filled with wild plot twists, humor, and even a little romance. 

  • An art style based on medieval Chinese paintings and woodblock prints 

  • A stat-based dialogue system and skill check dice-rolls inspired by Disco Elysium

Story

Play as Mourn-No-More, a kind but sickly man whose giant pet crane Snowfall is the fastest form of transportation around. You make a living flying your fellow townsfolk from place to place. 

When your friend Peach Blossom is killed under baffling circumstances shortly after being flown to her destination, it's up to you to solve the mystery by picking your passengers wisely and learning all their secrets. 

Or is it? Actually, maybe you get murdered next?

A single decision or stroke of misfortune can send one down a radically different path in life. As such, this tale has five endings, each of which reveals a shocking twist that might alter your understanding of the mystery.

Gameplay

The Crane Rider's Tale is a cross between a visual novel and an adventure game (similar to Ace Attorney and Danganronpa).  

There's a lot of story, but it's also a sidescroller where the player can explore and investigate. There's also Disco-Elysium-like RPG elements. Let us explain!

REFINE YOUR MANNER

Mourn-No-More has 12 unconventional Skills in his arsenal, like Whimsy and Mulberry Trees. These Skills speak to him and offer their insight on the situation at hand. 

Some Skills have additional effects; for instance, Birdsong allows Mourn-No-More to fly greater distances to pick up passengers, and you won't be able to interact with some objects unless your Perception is high enough.

Throughout the story, you will encounter Skill Checks that you must roll two dice to resolve, boosted by your skill level and any bonuses gained from your past actions. 

Failing sometimes yields interesting results, so don't despair if bad luck blows your way. 

GET TO KNOW YOUR PASSENGERS

Everyone has a story to tell and a secret to hide. But you only have time to fly four passengers per day, so one must choose wisely... 

Picking a passenger gives you the opportunity to converse with them via dialogue choices during their ride and see what they're up to. 

Once you've delivered your passenger to their destination, you'll have the option to dismount and investigate the location, point-and-click style, before embarking on your next flight. 

EXPLORE THE FLOWCHART

You can use the Flowchart to jump to an earlier point in the tale and make different choices. Your EXP and Skill Level will carry over, so replaying a scene once you're more experienced may yield different results!

这同时也是一款互动影游，您将通过您的选择，不断的改写剧情，解锁不同的结局。

【五大男主，陪伴左右】


楚紫宸：作为华耀集团董事长的养子，在董事长及其儿子下落不明后，临危受命，不惧流言蜚语，担任起华耀集团的暂时董事长一职，同时也让你对他产生怀疑。性格沉稳，静中生智的他，从不让任何人洞察自己的内心，更没有人见过他情绪失控的样子，经常通过练习书法、围棋、禅修缓解自己压抑的情绪。与此同时，他一面暗中调查董事长及其儿子的下落，一面寻找董事长的女儿。


许慕白：是万和集团的独子，虽小楚紫宸和你哥哥几岁，但三人自小就是好友。他心思单纯、善良，典型的奶狗男友，却又是重型机车爱好者，与其外表形成反差。出于对楚紫宸的了解，在华耀集团董事长及其儿子出事后，第一个站出来帮助楚紫宸，同时根据儿时记忆第一个认出了你。经常以自己擅长的料理约你见面，并做给你吃。

萧蓝宇：身为艺人的他，才艺颇佳，而作为金承集团的私生子，虽然被家族认领但是得不到应有的宠爱。因成长环境原因，他心思敏感，孤独忧郁，在华耀集团董事长及其儿子出事前，便成为了华耀集团旗下某产品的代言，又因意外与你偶遇便传出绯闻。在与你朝夕相处中，你如一道光照进他的世界。

唐焱：是祝顺集团的小儿子，因生性自由，直来直去，不喜欢束缚，讨厌勾心斗角的名利场，拒绝继承集团总裁之位，靠开健身房向家族证明自己。曾因你哥哥劝她继承集团总裁之位，二人发生争执，同时，你哥哥是他健身房的VIP客户。你在调查哥哥失踪中成为健身房的会员，他被你深深吸引，多次向你表白。

There is absolutely no rush—with no ticking clocks or high-pressure objectives, you are free to enjoy a soft, meditative experience. Mellow Soundscapes – Soft, atmospheric melodies enhance the sense of peace.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're not a philosopher. You're a hand.


Not a Trolley Problem! is a dark-humor incremental idle clicker where you drag hapless pedestrians onto the trolley
tracks and watch the fare box fill up. Every splat pays out. Every upgrade makes the splats bigger. And the trolley?
The trolley keeps coming.

Core Loop

  • Drag and release. Pluck NPCs off the curb with your sticky finger and place them on the rails. Timing
    matters. Aim matters. Physics matters a little.
  • Watch the fare box tick up. Every ran-over NPC drops coins. Rich, rare, VIP and boss tiers drop a lot more.
  • Buy smarter upgrades. Faster grab. Bigger trolley. Auto-grabbers that work while you don't. 60 levels of
    progression across 6 locations.
  • Make choices that kind of matter. Rank-up cards offer satirical dilemmas — elite preset? mass preset? marked
    target? Stack multipliers your way.

What's In It

  • Satisfying idle-meets-active loop: grab with your hands, then watch the auto-grabbers take over
  • Doodle art with a comic-noir mood
  • Six unlockable locations, each with their own NPC flavor
  • A boss every minute, because why not
  • 60-level upgrade ladder with a skin swap every ten tiers

Not a Real Moral Question


There's no dilemma. There's no ethics committee. There's a trolley on a loop, a crowd on the curb, and a pocket full
of coins. What you do with all three is up to you — but the math is pretty clear.

There's no trolley problem. Just a trolley solution.

store_data.about_the_game:
COW, RABBIT, FISH, TOAD. 

Overview

C.R.F.T. // Chuansha Is Not in Shanghai and We Are Lost is a linear narrative visual novel set in a parallel-world 2004 Shanghai suburb. 

About This Game

One Path & No Escape

C.R.F.T. is a linear visual novel with no player choices or branching paths. You click to advance through a fixed narrative sequence. This design is intentional: the story deals with memory, survivor's guilt, and the impossibility of rewriting the past. Just as the protagonist cannot turn back, neither can you. 

Content Warnings

This game contains depictions of drowning, psychological dissociation, body transformation, and implied death of major characters. 

Controls

Primarily mouse-based: 

  • Click or scroll down to advance the story

  • Scroll up to open the backlog

  • Click the mouse wheel to open the menu for save/load and other functions

About This Game

Mainland Delivery Run is a casual game blending narrative choices with survival simulation.
You are no hero saving the world — just an ordinary person who just lost their job and is down to their last savings.

To stay alive, you make a decision: start delivering takeaways.

🛵 Real-Life Delivery Experience

Hop on an e-bike and weave through the streets and alleys of the city.
Accept orders, pick up food, make deliveries — every order is a race against the clock.
The money you earn goes to rent and groceries, struggling to get by in the cracks of the city.

💬 Chat to Unlock Branching Stories

On your delivery routes, you'll meet all kinds of customers and strangers:
a nagging security guard, a gentle single mother, an eccentric old landlord, a mysterious fellow rider…
Every chat is a choice, and every choice shapes the story.
Multiple storylines, multiple endings — your fate is in the words you choose.

📱 Immersive In-Game Chat System

The game features an in-game phone interface where you interact with characters through messaging apps.
Which message do you reply to? Do you take the initiative to care for someone?
Your attitude changes your relationships and can even trigger hidden storylines.

🍚 Survival Pressure & Moments of Warmth

You'll need to balance income and expenses, and keep an eye on your energy and mood.
Out on the road, you might rediscover long-lost warmth — or see the truth of life more clearly.

This is not a story about success. It's a story about "survival."

Pick up your delivery bag and hit the road.
Your first order is on its way.

4655400.name: 『アルゴリズムより、君を信じる』 〜新人社員・松本の、付箋によるエレベーターマニュアル操作術〜

store_data.about_the_game:
[Notice of Assignment] Effective today, you are ordered to report to the Elevator Control Room.

This is an elevator control simulation game that goes against the wave of AI automation, forcing you to manage everything manually.

Your job is simple: safely deliver the waiting employees on each floor to their designated destinations. However, in this company, the excuse "we're over capacity" will strictly not be tolerated.

Frantic Solo Operation Action

The controls are simple. Just grab the "Sticky Notes" indicating the employees' destinations with your mouse, and drag and drop them onto the elevator's control board.

But there's one major problem. This elevator has a highly unreasonable design flaw: "buttons pressed by employees inside the car take absolute priority." No matter how perfectly you plan out efficient routes with your sticky notes, your schedule will be effortlessly derailed by the staff's whimsical button-mashing.

What starts as a peaceful routine quickly descends into chaos as the number of employees multiplies. Battle the sheer frustration of an elevator that refuses to go exactly where you want, and sustain the logistics of this corporation with nothing but your rapid mouse movements.

The Joy of Fever Time & The Despair of the Clock-Out Rush

■ Fever Time
Grab an item and your elevator enters super-speed mode! Experience the ultimate thrill of clearing out a massive backlog of employees all at once and racking up bonus pay.

■ Clock-Out Rush (Panic Mode)
As closing time approaches, the screen turns red, and a swarm of employees rushes toward the 1st floor (exit)! If you don't survive this hellish rush before the complaint count exceeds its limit, you will be immediately "Fired" (Game Over).

Pay for Company Upgrades with Your Meager Salary

Survive a day (stage), and you will be paid a salary based on your performance.

Use that hard-earned money to upgrade the elevator's "Movement Speed", "Capacity", and "Door Speed".

Why do you have to pay for the company's equipment investments out of your own pocket? ...Because that's just the kind of company this is.

Now, let's begin another never-ending shift.

◆ About Streaming & Content Creation
Streaming, Let's Plays, and video content creation are 100% allowed and highly encouraged! No prior permission or strict guidelines are required. Feel free to stream, record, and monetize your gameplay.

Resources are scarce. There are no weapons. Your only tools are your wits, your teammates, and your voice. Every decision matters. The labyrinth is vast. And the darkness is eternal.

Will you survive? Or will your screams be the last thing you hear?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the High-Stakes (and High-Gravity) World of Silly Agent!

Meet the world's finest special agent... or at least, the one who was available. Operating from a high-tech military aircraft, your elite team is ready to brief you on the most dangerous, urgent, and frankly, bizarre missions across the globe. There’s just one problem: your agent has the balance of a toddler on a unicycle.

Silly Agent is a third-person physics-based action game where every step is a challenge and every mission is a potential disaster.

Action-Packed (and Accidental) Missions

From the command center in your cargo plane, you’ll be deployed to save the day in a variety of cinematic scenarios:

  • The Heroic Rescue: Save a cat trapped in a treacherous junkyard.

  • Runaway Train: Take control of a speeding locomotive after the driver passes out.

  • Urban Pursuit: Chase down thieves through a bustling city.

  • Ancient Secrets: Rescue archaeologists trapped in a booby-trapped ancient temple.

  • Highway Chaos: Leap from truck to truck in high-speed vehicle chases.

Master the Art of the Stumble

In Silly Agent, the challenge isn't just the mission—it's staying upright. Our protagonist is endearingly clumsy. He trips over shadows, loses his balance at the worst moments, and occasionally forgets how physics works mid-jump. You’ll need precision, timing, and a lot of luck to guide him to the finish line.

Better Together: Split-Screen Co-op!

Double the agents, double the trouble! Play the entire game in local split-screen co-op.

  • Cooperate: Help your friend climb a ledge or steady them after a bad fall.

  • Distract: Is your partner about to finish the mission? Give them a "friendly" nudge and watch the chaos unfold. Passing missions together is more fun, more chaotic, and significantly more hilarious.

Key Features:

  • Physics-Driven Gameplay: Every fall, push, and jump is powered by unpredictable and funny physics.

  • Dynamic Environments: From ancient temples to moving trucks.

  • Team Briefings: Experience the life of an agent with mission briefings inside your flying base.

  • Family-Friendly Fun: A game that balances challenge with laugh-out-loud moments for all ages.

Can you save the world before you trip over your own feet? Suit up, Agent!

store_data.about_the_game:
Tomatito's Culinary Pizza Adventure is a short puzzle game where you help Tomatito make a pizza. Collect the ingredients in the right order and put the pizza in the oven to complete the level.

Tomatito makes everything slippery! 🍅

Every square Tomatito steps on fills with tomato sauce, causing you to slide across it when you pass over it again.

6 worlds, 92 levels 🍕

Jelly! Chairs! Onions?! Each new world introduces a new mechanic to the game, which slightly increases its complexity.

Features 📖

  • A short, straightforward game with 92 levels. It takes around 2-3 hours to complete.

  • The gameplay is easy to grasp and accessible to players of all ages.

  • Relaxing music and tone, perfect for a pleasant time.

Dev (me)✌️

Hello! I’m Nacho and I’ve got a new little game for you.

After developing Infiniclick, I wanted to explore the puzzle game genre, so I gave it a go and… this is my first game of this genre! I hope you like it.

I haven’t used generative AI to create this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slime Soup is a messy game about running a very questionable soup kitchen in a gross fantasy world.

Play as a broke, slightly unhinged chef working out of a place that probably should have been shut down years ago. The cauldron is cracked, the floor is sticky, and your customers range from goblins and orcs to zombies, slugs and other things you’d rather not think about too much. They all want soup. They all want it now. And for some reason, they all have standards.

Stir, Link, Explode

Drop slimes into your cauldron and let them bounce around, stack up and bump into each other. When slimes of the same color touch, you can link them together and set off bursts that can chain into bigger reactions. Sometimes it all lines up perfectly and the whole pot goes off. Sometimes it just… doesn’t.

Figuring out how to position things, when to wait, when to commit, that’s where the game really lives.

Build Your Recipe for Chaos

Decorate your kitchen with weird items that will boost your score, mess with how slimes behave or create odd interactions you didn’t expect. Stack enough of them and things start to get out of hand in a good way. Every run ends up feeling a bit different depending on what you find.

There are over 100 of them, so there’s a lot to experiment with.

Serve the Unservable

Each client comes in with a score to hit. Reach it and you get paid. Miss it and you’ll probably hear about it.

You’ll deal with goblins, zombies, mutants and other regulars, all with their own expectations. Some are easy to please, some really aren’t. You have to adjust your approach depending on who’s sitting at the table.

Grow Your Filthy Empire

The money you earn goes back into unlocking new slime types, new clients, and new ways to play.

There are more than 10 kinds of slimes, over 20 clients, extra game modes to unlock, and a few secrets hidden in the grime if you dig deep enough.

A Deliciously Dirty Roguelite

It’s a mix of puzzle, physics chaos and building something that slowly snowballs into a ridiculous scoring engine.

The kitchen is falling apart. The soup is alive.
And somehow, business is still going.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Deadly Game of Hide and Seek Decide Your Fate is a first-person psychological horror game that plunges you into a claustrophobic nightmare. You are locked inside a house with a lethal hunter who cannot see, but possesses supernatural hearing. One wrong step, one knocked-over vase, and the hunter will be upon you.

Key Features:

  • Sound-Based Survival: The killer reacts to every noise. Walking on creaky floorboards or breathing too loudly near him is a death sentence.

  • Intense Stealth Mechanics: Crouch, hide under beds, or use distractions to lure the killer away from your objective.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: High-tension sound design and dark environmental storytelling that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Search for keys and solve environmental puzzles to unlock your path to freedom while being hunted.

How quiet can you stay when your life depends on it? Move carefully, act fast, and Decide Your Fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
A familiar journey, with more to discover

Eternal Eden returns as a reimagined experience, carefully rebuilt to preserve the feel of the original while offering more to discover.

What begins as a simple, peaceful life gradually opens into a larger journey. As you move forward, new paths appear, stronger enemies stand in your way, and small details start to matter more than they first seemed.

This remake keeps the core structure and pacing of the original game, while expanding on it with new ideas. Additional areas, new mechanics, and hidden elements have been integrated into the experience in a way that feels natural, without changing what made the original memorable.

Combat remains turn-based and easy to understand, but rewards attention and planning. Exploration plays an important role, with optional encounters, secrets, and discoveries placed throughout the world for players who take the time to look.

All enemy visuals have been fully recreated to match the updated presentation. Each design stays true to its original concept, while fitting more naturally into the new look of the game.

Whether you are discovering Eternal Eden for the first time or returning to it, this version aims to offer a familiar experience with just enough new elements to keep things interesting.

Key Features

A Faithful Remake
Rebuilt from the original 2008 RPG, keeping its structure, balance, and progression intact.

Expanded Experience
New mechanics, additional areas, and new secrets have been added alongside the original content.

Fully Reworked Enemies
All enemy visuals have been recreated to better fit the updated presentation while remaining recognizable.

Classic Turn-Based Combat
Straightforward systems that reward planning, timing, and smart decisions.

Exploration & Discovery
Hidden paths, optional encounters, and subtle details placed throughout the world.

Character Growth
Level up your party, learn new abilities, and adapt your strategy over time.

A Focused Adventure
A complete RPG experience designed to respect the player’s time, without unnecessary padding.

Why Play Eternal Eden?

If you enjoy classic RPGs that focus on progression, exploration, and a steady sense of discovery, Eternal Eden offers a straightforward and rewarding experience.

This remake doesn’t try to reinvent everything it builds on a solid foundation, adding just enough new content and improvements to make the journey feel fresh again.

The game is fully playable with both keyboard and controller, though a controller is recommended for the best experience.

Once a place of industry and life, it was suddenly shut down after a series of unexplained events… and forgotten by time.

Every step deeper brings you closer to the truth… and to whatever is watching you.

But be careful — the mine remembers everything. And it does not want you to leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
An apocryphal version Defoe didn’t want you to read Forget everything you know about Robinson Crusoe. This is the authentic chronicle, recovered directly from a lost sock belonging to Daniel Defoe. Crusoe & Agarthas: Chronicles of Speranza is a biting parody of the "capitalist trágala" and its utter absurdities.

On your journey through Speranza Island, you will not be alone, nor will you be able to abandon your song. Can you overcome its rhythmic challenges without losing your soul to the market's "júnjuma"?

Explore Speranza Island and its mysteries:

  • Satirical Narrative: A branching story where your decisions parody the rise and dynamics of capitalist power.

  • The Precious Agarthas: Meet the inhabitants of Speranza, unique beings that will challenge your very perception of reality.

  • Rhythmic Challenges: Here, music is not merely art; it is the essential tool for navigating a system designed to consume you.

  • Artisanal Visual Style: Art entirely hand-drawn by the author using mixed techniques, playing with colour and texture to breathe life into a forgotten manuscript.

store_data.about_the_game:
She came to you at six years old, with an orange tail and eyes that didn't trust you yet.

NEKO MAKER is a raising simulation game. You play as a guardian raising a cat girl through twelve complete years of growth — from a bewildered six-year-old child to an eighteen-year-old young woman finding her own path.

She will push back, tell small lies, and knock on your door late at night to say she had a nightmare. She will remember the birthday you forgot, and every word you ever said. Twelve years from now, who will she be? Only you know the answer.

【How to Play】

Each month, you schedule four weeks of activities for her. You can send her to classes to improve her stats, send her to work to earn income, let her explore the city to develop her instincts, or arrange rest to restore her physical and mental condition. Every choice affects her five ability stats (Strength, Intelligence, Charm, Elegance, Instinct) and her hidden personality axes (Attachment, Wildness, Rebellion, Self-Esteem).

You also manage the household finances — paying monthly food costs, tuition fees, and activity expenses, while balancing her work income and your own monthly salary. When money is tight, you must make difficult choices.

At the end of each month, she will say something and wait for your response. How you respond quietly shapes who she becomes.

【Story Events】

The game features over 90 story events covering daily life, growth milestones, NPC relationships, and crisis moments. Events trigger automatically based on her current condition, your relationship, and the passage of time. Some events have chain effects — a choice you make today may affect her in unexpected ways three years later.

【Loss of Control (LoC) System】

When her stress, rebellion, or instinct exceeds a threshold, she begins to act autonomously — ignoring your schedule and following her own will. You must respond to these situations, or things may spiral out of control, triggering emergency dialogue or affecting the final ending.

【Ability Development】

・Five ability stats each capped at 999, continuously improvable through classes and competitions

・Courses come in Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced levels — higher difficulty means stronger results

・Jobs can be promoted over time: Newcomer → Experienced → Senior, with increasing income

・Four condition stats (Mood, Stress, Hunger, Health) interact with each other and require active management

【Competition System】

Five competitions appear throughout the game, each with a recurring rival opponent. Results are determined by her ability stats, and rival difficulty increases with each passing year. After wins or losses you must respond to her emotions, and after enough encounters, rivals may even become her friends, providing additional growth bonuses.

【Endings and Replayability】

・18 different endings, determined by her stats, hidden axes, your relationship, and key decisions

・After each ending, she writes you a letter describing her life afterward

・An ending gallery tracks all unlocked endings and encourages multiple playthroughs

・New Game+ lets you carry over some stats, money, or relationships into a new run to explore different paths

・Each playthrough takes approximately 3-5 hours

【Additional Features】

・Career selection affects starting funds and monthly salary: Office Worker, Freelancer, Civil Servant, Shop Owner

・Seasonal special events: Christmas Eve, New Year, Summer Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival

・Gift system: buying presents affects her mood and personality development

・Diary system: she writes diary entries reflecting her personality each year

・Title system: earn unique titles based on her abilities and personality

・Supported in 6 languages: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese

store_data.about_the_game:
Not My Son is a first-person psychological horror game with a tense, suffocating atmosphere.

You are a man who has recently married and is left alone with his wife’s son for the first time. What should have been a quiet few days turns into something far more unsettling. The boy rejects you completely — every word, every action irritates him. He watches you, judges you, and seems to understand more than he should.

At first, you try to build a connection and act like a real family, brushing off small, unsettling moments. But as time passes, the boy’s behavior grows more disturbing, and the house begins to feel increasingly wrong. Through exploration, you uncover fragments of the past that slowly begin to form a bigger, more troubling picture.

Not My Son is a story about fear, rejection, and the fragile bond between a parent and a child. A slow descent into unease, where every discovery brings you closer to an answer you may not be ready to face.

Game Features:

  • Deep narrative 

  • Immersive sound design

  • Disturbing atmosphere

  • Environmental storytelling

  • Realistic graphics

store_data.about_the_game:
The hero begins in a cabin on a hill overlooking Rocky Hills Village.  The neighborhood is not as good as one would like.  Upon leaving the cabin and walking down the trail toward the village, several people immediately start fights with the hero.  Find the merchant to learn why he cannot open his shop and what the hero can do about it.

Then the hero embarks on a wonderful adventure encompassing many varied realms.  From the medieval village, the hero takes a boat to an enchanted forest full of fantastic and dangerous enemies.  From there, the hero can crawl through dungeons or survive in a viking village or both, followed by other medieval villages, a castle, the Elvin realm of Elysedor, and can choose to take a detour through hell or go straight to the Island of the Dead.

There is far more to do, so we shall not spoil it.  But along the way, you meet merchants who can sell you items (and sometimes give quests or tips), or you can pick up items, some of which are dropped by defeated enemies.  You can collect valuable gems or gold bars from defeated enemies or in treasure chests or on counters of some commercial establishments.

Throughout the game, watch your health and mana (magic fuel).  If you run out of health, the game is over.  If you run out of mana, your weapons revert to nonmagical mundane weapons.  Health and mana potions can be found in chests, in various locations, or on defeated enemies, or can be purchased from merchants.

An inventory interface lets you equip weapons, shields, helmets, and items both functional and for looks.  These can be purchased, or picked up.  If you need more money, you can sell items you no longer need, but you will not recover the original purchase price!  The merchants have to make a profit.

Throughout the game, you gain experience.  You start at zero experience points and experience level 1.  When you gain enough points, you go up an additional level.  At higher levels, you can carry more health, mana, and money, and you are allowed through more portals that were previously locked, taking you to other realms.  Also at higher levels, you get a speed boost, a weapon and shield effectiveness boost, and you are better able to defeat tougher and tougher enemies.

Each defeated enemy adds experience, as does finding secret areas, completing some quests, and defeating all enemies in a game level (location).  There are secret levels, and completing them gives you even more experience.   Some levels can be skipped, but you don't gain experience for levels not completed.

There are multiple weapon types.  The simplest is a melee weapon (sword, staff, mace, axe, hammer, etc.)  That is good for close combat with individual enemies.  

Some weapons work at a distance (bow and arrow, magic staff) and let you defeat enemies while not getting too close.

If you can find it, there is one magical weapon that can take out more than one enemy at a time, but only up close.  This can get you through crowded areas when many enemies are attacking you at the same time.

There are lots of visuals (and distractions!) that don't directly affect game play.  You may disturb a nest of rats or cockroaches or see blowing leaves or flying birds or bats or flies.  

There are also healing areas (magic wells and such) and pain areas (flames, acid, moving blades, etc.)

The basic mechanic is "click to move".  Click the ground, move there.  Click an enemy, fight them.  Click a pickup, go get it.  Click a portal, and be teleported either to another realm or elsewhere in the same level.

You can save and load.  At all but the "hard" difficulty level (you can choose easy, normal, or hard) there are automatic checkpoints.  Also every portal acts as a checkpoint.  In addition, you can manually save any time, if you are not dead that is!

At all but the "hard" difficulty level, you receive tip notifications to help you get started, on the first few levels.  Other notifications happen at all difficulty levels, such as the name and a short description of the enemy you just defeated.  

The game comes to an end eventually and you can view the credits.  You can also view the credits at any time from the main menu.

store_data.about_the_game:
Last Lawn Standing is a hero-defense maze tower defense roguelite where you control a single lawn gnome and fight alongside your defenses against endless waves of creatures of darkness.

Turn your lawn into a weapon. Build flower pot towers and barricades to shape enemy paths, force them into choke points, and create efficient killboxes. Every structure you place changes how enemies move — and how they die.

There is no manual resource gathering. Resources drop from defeated enemies and are generated by your buildings. Between waves, use the daytime to craft, unlock recipes, upgrade your gear, and prepare your strategy for the next night.

Grow stronger without limits. Level up your hero endlessly during each run, enhance your equipment, and push your build further with every wave.

Each night brings randomized enemy compositions and increasing difficulty. There is no final wave — survive as long as you can.

Unlock new gnome heroes, refine your strategies, and see how far you can go.

store_data.about_the_game:
Papa Louie has opened a brand-new coffee shop in New Pepperton, serving up custom layered coffee drinks known as Papaccinos.  After landing a job as the barista at Papa's Mocharia, you discover that a year-long documentary is being filmed about the new coffeehouse -- and you're now the main star!  Under the watchful eye of the camera crew, you'll brew espresso, steam and froth milk, and craft eye-catching layered coffee drinks.  Finish the lattes with whip and toppings, and serve them with delicious cannoli to your picky customers.  You'll need to multitask between multiple areas in the coffeehouse, where each station is a unique hands-on experience.

Papa's Mocharia makes its PC debut!  In this deluxe version, the original coffee-crafting experience has been reimagined for mouse controls and larger screens, delivering the classic hands-on gameplay to Papa's Mocharia for the first time.  Even more customers have arrived in New Pepperton to try the famous layered Papaccinos, so you'll see some fresh faces along with your Mocharia regulars.  Along with returning features like Daily Specials and helpful Score Detail breakdowns, this version adds new holiday ingredients, and introduces a Free Play mode with the Mocharia Food Truck!

Celebrate the seasons in the coffeehouse with delicious holiday flavors!  As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays in New Pepperton will change, and your customers will start ordering holiday-themed drinks and cannoli.  You'll unlock new syrups, powders, dairy, shakers, creams, and cannoli shells for each holiday of the year.  You can also buy holiday clothing and decorate the lobby with seasonal decorations to show your holiday spirit!

After you hire a Driver, you can send them out across New Pepperton in your brand-new Mocharia Food Truck!  Between workdays, use your imagination to craft your own unique layered lattes and cannoli, then serve them straight from the truck to see who shows up to try your creations.  You can also mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for truly unique combinations!

  • Hands-on gameplay for brewing coffee, steaming milk, layering drinks, and crafting cannoli

  • Custom chefs and delivery drivers

  • Food Truck for open-ended free play mode

  • 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients

  • 7 exciting Mini-Games to play after each workday

  • Tons of furniture and clothing to decorate your shop and workers

  • Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes

  • View Score Details to learn from your mistakes

  • Customer Coupons to entice customers to return

  • 90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks

  • Unlock alternate outfits for every customer

  • 154 customers to serve with unique orders

  • 124 ingredients to unlock

store_data.about_the_game:
You, Gabriel, have been assigned to investigate a case of abuse of a child named David. He's claimed that his family isn't normal, they have special abilities.

You unknowingly investigate, and by the time you realize David's mother is a monster, it's too late. 

Navigate through the House of Trauma, a multi floor mansion with many secrets.

Solve puzzles by unlocking doors, fixing electricity, finding keys and other items.

Evade Mom by running for your life, hiding in closets and crawling through vents, oh and pet the innocent dog while you're at it. Make sure to explore...where every turn could be your last! If she sees you, or even hears you, RUN!

This game is based off of the family in my videos, (Shooteo.)

WARNING! This game has flashing lights and jumpscares!

Mom's faster than you, stronger than you, but is she smarter? Throw objects to distract her, and make use of the vent system to get around her. There may or may not be some weapons to use against Mom as well.

There will be four difficulties: Noob, Normal, Pro, and {REDACTED} The harder difficulty you choose, the FASTER she gets!

David's an advanced AI. Once you save him, he will follow you like his life depends on it, because it does. There's multiple endings to this game. Sometimes you'll both get alive, other times...not so lucky!

House of Trauma is a first person survival horror game. You need to save David, and escape, you must escape, for not just David's sake, but for yours as well.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Cards of Bellum, every card tells a story—and every battle hangs by a thread.

Cards of Bellum is a War-inspired roguelike deck builder. Lead your poor army of rebels, unlock powerful heroes, counter suits, and unleash spells in your quest to overthrow the evil king and claim victory.

🔮 LEAD RULE-BREAKING HEROES

• Wizards duel by elemental mastery (Fire beats Death, Water beats Fire)

• Assassins strike randomly from the shadows

• Kings can reverse defeat

• Thieves steal your opponent's best cards, or a named hero unleashes special abilities

Use your cards wisely — a wasted hero can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

⚔️ MASTER SUITED COMBAT

Swords beat Spears. Spears beat Horse. Horse beats Shields. Shields beat Swords. But when strength is close, roll the dice and a lucky 4 could save you.

🏰 STORM THE CAPITAL

Face-down defenses hide your opponent's true strength. Attack when ready, or recruit more troops. Every decision matters.

🗺️ RANDOM MAPS & STORY

When you're ready, fight across a randomized campaign map, unlocking hidden cards and heroes as you progress against an evermore challenging enemy. You'll need every edge to beat the final king and claim victory.

🃏 60+ UNIQUE CARDS

From numbered troops to Knights, Queens, Kings, Wizards, Thieves, and more. Build your strategy. Find your combos. Claim victory.

The throne awaits. So does the axe.

store_data.about_the_game:
A party sets out. The road is long, the target is a score far beyond reach, and the moon overhead is getting darker.

Against the Dark Moon is a poker roguelike inspired by 1980s fantasy. Build a party of up to five heroes from dozens of choices. Each hero has their own abilities and personality — a barbarian whose laugh is worse than his weapon, a rider drawing the sword of a lost god, a young mage memorizing his spellbook. Their skills stack, clash, and combine — every party plays differently. Play poker hands with cards painted in the style of 1980s fantasy illustration. Score. Advance. Defeat the forces of evil.

But the Dark Moon is always rising. Every turn brings it closer to the threshold, and when it strikes, you'll face three curses and have to choose the one your heroes can survive. Manage the moon, chase the score, and find combinations that turn a modest hand into total victory.

Activate Divine Intervention cards to reshape your deck mid-run. Unlock rare heroes whose abilities change how you play. Every run surprises you — different cards, different heroes, different curses, different strategies.

  • Poker hands are your weapons. Build powerful hands — pairs, straights, flushes, full houses. Your heroes shape every hand you play. Multiply with Wyrd to turn a losing hand into a killing one.

  • The Dark Moon rises. Every turn brings it closer. When it strikes, three curses appear — pick the one you can survive. The moon doesn't negotiate.

  • Build your party. Up to five heroes fight alongside you. Choose from dozens, all of them different. A barbarian whose laugh is worse than his weapon. A rider who drew the sword of a lost god. A blindfolded bard who sings the turns. Their skills collide, chain, and sometimes save you.

  • Every card is a painting. Named, illustrated, flavored. Every hand tells a story.

  • Divine Intervention. Activate powerful cards to reshape your deck, empower your heroes, or bend fate.

  • Every run is different. New heroes, new cards, new curses, new strategies. Roguelike to the core.

No two games play the same. No two cards play the same. This is a poker roguelike for the player who ever rolled a character and meant it. Who ever held a good hand and felt the weight of it. The Dark Moon is rising. Only your heroes can defeat it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gridholm is a tactical card battler where positioning wins games.

Deploy cards on a 5x5 grid. Move them like chess pieces. Attack when in range. Control the throne to win. Every maneuver matters, every card choice matters, and every turn your decisions compound.

Four factions fight for the throne, each with a distinct playstyle. Deckbuilding combines factions for fresh archetypes and strategies.

Choose your champion. Each champion has faction-locked abilities that are harnessed through deck-building decisions. 

Key Features:

  • Grid-based tactical combat. Position your units, cover the throne, pincer enemy champions. Terrain and adjacency matter every turn.

  • Four distinct factions. Light's formation, Primal's speed, Mystic's resilience, Dark's deception. Each plays fundamentally differently.

  • Adventure Mode. Single-player campaign with roguelike elements, persistent HP across battles, card upgrades, and boss encounters.

  • Draft Mode. Varied pool selection through our node map drafting. Reach maximum wins for greater rewards.

  • Online Multiplayer. Build your deck, climb the ladder, test your strategy against players worldwide.

  • Expand your collection. Earn packs and gold through play, open new cards, craft rare cards for the deck you want.

  • Quick to learn, deep to master. Five-minute tutorial teaches the basics. Hundreds of hours to master the matchups, positioning, and deck construction.

Three distinct game modes, unique positional strategies, infinite decisions.

PachiRogue is a chill, 10-minute roguelite where your goal is to rig a pachinko machine to spit out ridiculous amounts of cash. There are no health bars or game overs - just pure, broken economy building.

Rig the Board

Customize your pool with unique balls like heavy marbles or chaotic bouncy balls, and upgrade them to break the laws of physics. Stack passive buffs to rig the odds, multiply your payouts, and trigger massive chain reactions.

Break the Game

If you scale your build hard enough, you'll trigger "Black Swan" upgrades - like cloning every ball you fire or turning wall-bounces into pure profit. The board gets chaotic fast.

Cash Out

When the clock runs out, take your massive earnings back to your Cabinet. Buy permanent upgrades and tweak your loadout before your next shift.
