store_data.about_the_game:
You Never Truly Knew Your Father

Wuxia Life is a single-player wuxia RPG set on the fictional island of Yingzhou.

You begin in Luzhou Village, investigating your father’s death and the truth of your origins. The clues he left behind lead you into sect rivalries, rumors across the jianghu, the shadow of the Blacktide Gang, and a Yingzhou slowly falling out of balance.

Some people refuse to speak. Some leave only half a sentence. Others hide the truth in old letters, torn manuals, and drunken rumors. You are not only hunting for an enemy — you are trying to understand the path your father once walked, and why Yingzhou is being pulled into the Blacktide.

On this journey, you will join martial sects, befriend companions, build bonds, capture pets, forge equipment, and decide again and again who you want to become amid the pull of Killing Intent, Compassion, Pride, Dao Heart, and Guile.

Five Inner Voices, Inner Demons, and the Heavenly Storyteller

Your choices do not simply change a morality score. They make certain voices within you grow louder.

  • Killing Intent: Blood must answer blood. No more waiting.

  • Compassion: Even in pain, do not let hatred live your life for you.

  • Pride: Be no one’s shadow, and let no bloodline define you.

  • Dao Heart: Truth must be revealed, but justice needs a line it will not cross.

  • Guile: Read the board first, then decide when to strike.

As your decisions accumulate, inner demons may build and trigger dangerous breakdown events under pressure. Meanwhile, the Heavenly Storyteller drives events and clues through three narrative rhythms: the righteous path, the hidden path, and the chaotic path.

The same journey through the jianghu can leave very different echoes depending on what you choose.

ATB Combat and 6-Slot Skill Builds

Combat follows an ATB rhythm, where speed affects the order of actions. You can manually control each move, or enable auto-battle for low-pressure fights and material farming.

  • 6 active skill slots: Build around cooldowns, weapon requirements, equipment affixes, and party roles.

  • Speed controls: Switch between 1x / 2x / 4x / 8x battle speed.

  • 3D battlefields: Character positioning, skill effects, impact feedback, and combat pacing.

  • Dungeon challenges: Waves, bosses, drops, staged encounters, and clear rewards.

Five Martial Sects

Yingzhou’s jianghu features five martial sects you can join. Each sect has its own initiation, martial arts path, missions, and promotion events.

  • Qingyun Sect: Uphold the Dao with the sword, where sword heart and sacrifice matter.

  • Iron Lion Hall: Temper bone and will through fist and blade, where loyalty and responsibility are tested.

  • Medicine King Valley: Medicine and poison share the same root; saving lives and punishing evil both come at a cost.

  • Xuanwu Pavilion: Guard, endure, and counterattack while holding the line.

  • Wanderer’s Gate: Information, hidden weapons, and the open road — freedom matters, but friends are not for sale.

Sects are not just skill shops. As you advance, you may have to decide whether to publicly interrogate a traitor, how to deal with a poor porter who made a grave mistake, whether to open the valley to a plague-stricken village, whether to shelter refugees, and which secrets should never be sold.

Companions, Bonds, Pets, and Mounts

You do not have to walk Yingzhou alone.

  • Protagonist: Martial sect techniques, internal arts, lightness skills, equipment, titles, and milestones.

  • Companions: Recruited through quests, each filling different combat roles.

  • Bond characters: Affection events, exclusive skills, and combo techniques.

  • Pets: Capture, raise, deploy, and gain skills or battle bonuses.

  • Mounts: Travel speed, terrain suitability, racing, and selected combat abilities.

Build your party around the protagonist, then combine companions, bond characters, pets, mounts, martial arts, equipment, and titles to face the main story, secret realms, arena battles, and jianghu events in your own way.

The Jianghu Remembers You

Yingzhou is not a map that simply waits for quests to be accepted.

What you say, whom you spare, whom you kill, and which lines you cross may all leave traces in the world.

  • A rival from a martial arts tournament may remember your choices.

  • A childhood friend may leave you a protective charm.

  • Your master may entrust you with an old sword at a critical moment.

  • Passersby may talk about local rumors, whispers, and things you recently did.

  • Wanted criminals have their own obsessions, lines before and after battle, and consequences if spared or killed.

These systems are not here just to add more items to a feature list. Their goal is to make you feel that Yingzhou slowly remembers what you have done.

A Playable Jianghu Loop

The current version includes multiple lines of progression that can be pursued in parallel:

  • Main story, side quests, bond quests, daily tasks, and sect mission chains.

  • Sect training, sect tournaments, martial arts tournaments, and arena ranks.

  • Martial matchmaking events, wanted bounties, escort routes, and world encounters.

  • Forging, alchemy, crafting, enhancement, collection logs, in-game achievements, and ending collection.

  • Martial art fragments, moments of insight, secret realms, dungeons, boss challenges, and late-game trials.

You can focus on following the clues your father left behind, or first strengthen your party, sect progression, pets, equipment, and resource routes before returning to face the Blacktide of Yingzhou.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE SUN GOES DOWN IN TWO HOURS.

YOU HAVEN'T FINISHED THE FENCE.

Welcome to AFTERLIFE WEST — a cross-platform co-op survival

frontier where the dead walk after dark, the fog carries

teeth, and your homestead is only as strong as the last

nail you hammered before sundown.

Build your ranch by day.

Survive the Afterlife by night.

☀️ BY DAY — YOU ARE THE FRONTIER

Ride out across a massive cursed West. Mine silver from

played-out shafts. Fell timber from blackwood forests.

Hunt bison across the plains. Haul your spoils back to

camp and turn a patch of dust into something worth

defending — a smithy, a stable, stone walls, watchtowers,

trap lines, and lanterns that push back the dark.

Every plank matters. Every bullet counts. Every hour burns.

🌑 BY NIGHT — THE VEIL FALLS

When the sun dies, the rules change.

The fog rolls in thick enough to swallow a horse. Lanterns

flicker. Unlit trails become graves. And from the mist come

the things that used to be men — ghost sheriffs with rusted

badges, hangman riders dragging broken nooses, widow

marshals who never missed a shot in life and don't miss

one in death.

Hold the gate. Cover your friends. Pray the walls hold.

🤠 BUILT FOR YOUR CREW — AND YOUR CLIPS

Play solo if you've got the grit. Play co-op if you've got

the friends. Either way, Afterlife West is where the stories

write themselves:

The last-second revive as the fence splinters behind you.

The trap line that clears a whole wave — or takes out your

best friend instead.

The suicide run into the fog for one last crate of ammo

before dawn.

The siege under a blood moon that you barely survive.

👻 HUNT THE WANTED LEGENDS

Push deeper. Past the plains. Into the poisoned canyons.

Across the bone deserts. Each new biome hides a Wanted

Legend — a mythic predator that must be tracked, hunted,

and put down to unlock the next tier of weapons, forges,

and frontier magic.

Beat them and the West opens wider.

Fail and… well. You've seen what happens to the dead out

here.

🌾 A WEST THAT REMEMBERS YOU

Your ranch is permanent. Your crew is persistent. The

world scars and heals around your choices. The Afterlife

is patient — but so are you.

Build your ranch.

Load your rifle.

Light your lantern.

Because out here, nightfall isn't the end of the day.

It's the start of the game.

content_descriptors.notes:
Afterlife West is a co-op Wild West survival game with 
supernatural horror elements. Intended for mature audiences.

⚠️ Violence: Combat with period firearms (revolvers, rifles, 
shotguns) against human bandits and supernatural enemies. 
Blood effects and on-screen deaths. Traps and environmental 
kills.

⚠️ Horror Themes: Ghosts, undead outlaws, cursed imagery, 
dark atmospheric fog, jump scares, and supernatural enemies 
including hanged figures and spectral lawmen.

⚠️ Death & Peril: Player character and allies can die 
violently. Night sieges involve intense, potentially 
distressing combat scenarios.

⚠️ Alcohol & Tobacco: Period-appropriate depictions of 
whiskey, saloons, and cigars.

⚠️ Mild Language: Western-style profanity and threatening dialogue.

store_data.about_the_game:
DRIVE A SINGLE VEHICLE TOGETHER, LITERALLY.

In this chaotic co-op experience, gather up to four players and share the controls of a single van. Each player handles every inputs, turning even the simplest movement into a test of coordination, communication, and patience. One presses forward, another steers, someone else might be braking at the worst possible moment. Maybe you will the one that sets the gear to reverse on a steep road. The result is unpredictable, often hilarious, and sometimes completely out of control.

WHAT IS UP WITH THE RV?

Your grandpa had a dream of traveling that path, but debate between his friends about who is the driver has never resolved. Grandpa built the RV which allows to be controlled by four people, but his fate decided otherwise.

WHY ALL THIS STRUGGLE?

Travel through the road filled with narrow paths, cliffs, and caves as a duty of your grandpa's quest. Take his ashes to destination that he never could reach and fullfill his last wish. Oh, please do not forget to bring the ashes with you. Simple yet important advice, don't even think about scratching this beauty.

store_data.about_the_game:
Water Truck Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a heavy-duty tanker truck where every mission is about skill, timing, and safe delivery. Start each job at the water station, load your tanker, and begin your journey across city streets, countryside roads, and rough off-road terrain. From busy traffic city areas to scenic off-road landscapes, every route offers a new driving challenge in this Water Truck Simulator.

Take control to your water mini truck, manage sharp hilly turns, handle heavy water loads on mountains path, and reach the marked destination point. Park in the correct unloading zone to save delivery time, turn on the backside nozzle of truck tanker take out big pipes and transfer water to village big tanks successfully, Empty mini truck water tank and complete missions to unlock new levels in gameplay environments.

With detailed maps, smooth driving gameplay, and a variety of transport challenges, Water Truck Simulator offers an enjoyable trucking experience for players who love driving and delivery games.

Features

• Realistic Loading Missions

Each level begins at the water station where you carefully move your tanker into the marked loading area. Once parked correctly, the tanker manhole cover opens, fills with water, and gets ready for the road.

• Challenging Delivery Routes

Drive across long roads, narrow streets, and difficult offroad paths while carrying a full tanker. Every mission tests your driving skills and ability to deliver safely to your mini water tanker truck.

• City and Off-Road Levels

Explore busy city maps with traffic, village roads, open countryside, and rough off-road tracks. Every level brings a beautiful environment and unique drive challenges.

• Traffic and Safe Driving

Share the road with moving traffic and drive carefully to avoid crashes. Good control and smart driving are important for mission success.

• Destination Parking Tasks

Reach the final delivery point and park your tanker in the correct marked zone. Smart driving is required to complete each mission properly.

• Beautiful Environments

Enjoy clean maps, detailed terrain, scenic landscapes, and different sky views during every journey. Each route feels lively and have adventurous fun to drive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone leaves something behind.

In the space between life and death, you stand alone as the Judge.
One by one, twelve souls come before you, carrying regret, secrets, and unfinished wishes.

There is only one thing you can do: listen… and pass judgment.

Accidents. Illness. Farewells. Choices.
Each case is a fragment of a life once lived.

Some were taken without warning.
Some chose their own end.
Some never found the courage to say the words that mattered most.

All you are given is the scroll before you.

Then, the twelfth soul appears.

Features

  • 12 standalone stories, each centered on a different emotional truth

  • Immersive scroll-based narrative experience

  • No dialogue choices — only judgment

  • Special Case 06: the bond between a human and a dog

  • Supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese

  • Playtime: approximately 15–20 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
【About the Game】

Hello everyone! I'm an independent game developer from China. "Awakening at the End of the Century" is my first work, a future life simulation game that starts with cryogenic awakening.

【Game Background】

You play a character who was cryogenically preserved in the early 21st century and successfully awakens in 2099. By 2099, the future population has sharply declined due to diseases, and society is divided among three powerful factions. After awakening, you'll have 24 turns to adapt to your new life, and every strategy you choose will determine your ultimate fate.

【Core Gameplay】

The game employs a turn-based schedule management system. In each turn, you can choose to visit different scenes to freely socialize or complete tasks. There are a total of:

10+ finely drawn 2D scenes and 3 immersive 3D scenes

You can take the following actions:

Exploration and Synthesis: Explore scenes and collect materials to craft items or upgrade brain-computer interfaces.

Character Socialization: Meet a variety of characters and develop emotional relationships with those from different factions.

Faction Intelligence: Uncover the secrets, stances, and needs of the three major factions.

Trading and Missions: Accumulate resources and goodwill by completing tasks or engaging in trades.

【Factions and Endings】

The three major factions represent the concepts of technological salvation, escape and revival, and defending the homeland, respectively. Your goodwill towards each faction will fluctuate based on your actions, and ultimately, a combination of these factors will determine one of 8 unique endings. Therefore, every choice you make is of utmost importance.

store_data.about_the_game:
REACH THE HEAVENS OR BURN IN THE ABYSS

The ultimate challenge. The world is collapsing, and the only way out is up.

Welcome to the most intense and high-tech vertical survival adventure. This is not just a game—it is a monumental test of will, reflexes, and strategy. You are trapped in a collapsing reality where the sky spews destruction and the ground turns into a roaring furnace of primordial fire. Your mission is simple: Build. Survive. Transcend.

THE ART OF THE IMPOSSIBLE ASCENT

Manage chaos on the battlefield where every falling monolith is both a threat and your primary tool. Build your path to the stars in real-time, dodging dazzling lightning strikes, devastating hurricanes, and unpredictable cataclysms. When the earth turns to lava and the air turns to ice, only chosen architects of chaos will survive. Seek rare Saving Platforms—your only oases in a world that wants you dead.

FROM SURVIVOR TO DEITY

Deep and rewarding RPG systems lie at the heart of your journey. This isn't just jumping; it is full character development.

  • Infinite Progress: Gain experience with every breath and every block placed. Upgrade base stats, becoming faster, stronger, and more resilient.

  • Pantheon of Power: Master a massive library of active skills, passive perks, and game bonuses.

  • Celestial Spells: Watch the sky—there is not only danger but also spells falling from above. Catch ancient magic mid-air to turn the fury of the elements against themselves.

ULTIMATE LOOT AND INVENTORY SYSTEM

You are creating a legend. Manage a detailed inventory filled with rare items.

  • Cases: Open legendary loot and obtain rare artifacts.

  • Backpack System: Every item is crafted to perfection.

UNRIVALED CUSTOMIZATION: REIGN WITH STYLE

In the apocalypse, your appearance is your legacy. Thanks to thousands of combinations, no two players will ever look alike.

  • Elite Fashion: Choose from a massive wardrobe of clothes, hats, and accessories.

  • Legendary Wings and Trails: Soar with majestic wings and leave behind a dynamic trail of light, fire, or shadows.

  • Auras and Effects: Surround yourself with stunning visual effects, declaring your power to everyone around.

  • Loyal Pets: You don't have to climb alone. Equip animated pets that will follow you even into the mouth of the abyss.

CLASH WITH THE GUARDIANS OF THE SKY

The higher you climb, the fiercer the universe becomes. Enter cinematic battles with a whole pantheon of bosses. These terrifying titans use all elements to bring your tower down. Defeat them to take their power and continue the path toward the light.

ASCENSION WITH THE WORLD

Why face the end of the world alone? Enter seamless multiplayer and unite with friends or rivals.

  • Collaborate to build monuments of incredible scale.

  • Compete to prove who truly deserves the crown of the heavens.

  • Shine: Demonstrate your rare wings, pets, and trails in a living community of survivors.

The abyss is hungry. The heavens await. The choice is yours. WILL YOU BURN, OR WILL YOU LEARN TO FLY?

store_data.about_the_game:
Blueprint: EV is a single-player strategy game about founding an electric vehicle company and running it through its first six fiscal years. You begin at the drafting table where every decision you make will be felt in quarters you haven't reached yet.

It is built for the kind of player who reads the patch notes, opens the spreadsheet, and wants the simulation to actually mean something.

Five binding decisions, then twenty-four quarters

The game opens with the founding: an eight-act sequence in which you make five decisions that cannot be undone — battery chemistry, vehicle platform, manufacturing model, software stack, and funding source — and choose the management style you'll lead with.

Each combination produces a different starting cash position, a different cost structure, and a different set of covenants with your bank. There are no "obviously correct" answers; there are trade-offs that play out over the next six years.

Then the quarters begin.

What a quarter looks like

Every quarter you work through a four-step decision sheet:

  • Pricing & Marketing — set MSRP for each model, allocate consumer advertising and dealer support

  • Production & Capacity — plan units per shift, authorise overtime, decide whether to expand the factory

  • R&D — one action: facelift an existing attribute, or develop a new model in a new segment (two-quarter pipeline)

  • Market Intelligence — buy from a slate of nine market reports; some are worth their cost, some aren't

Then you submit. The market clears using a multinomial logit demand model, and you read the quarterly ledger: revenue, COGS, marketing, R&D, admin, depreciation, interest, tax, net profit, equity, cash. Briefs arrive. Internal events fire. Your phone buzzes once. The next quarter begins.

The arc of a run

A full game is twenty-four quarters across three phases:

  • Phase 1 (Q1–Q8): Market Entry. You are alone with three slow-moving incumbents. Establish a position, keep your covenants healthy, do not waste cash.

  • Phase 2 (Q9–Q16): Competitive Pivot. Imports arrive, margins compress, the R&D pipeline you started in Q3 begins to pay off — or doesn't. Somewhere in here, the Ordeal: one hard choice that defines the rest of your run.

  • Phase 3 (Q17–Q24): Maturity. The market peaks and contracts. Survivors consolidate. If you've built well, an acquisition offer arrives at Q24.

Eight endings are possible. Tech Titan. Market Leader. IPO Candidate. Niche Champion. Legacy Survivor. Covenant Stress. Acqui-Hire. Forced Liquidation. Most players will not see all of them in their first ten runs.

Replayability

  • 243 founding combinations across four management styles — close to a thousand distinct opening positions

  • Three rivals are drawn from four NPC archetypes; your management style determines who you face

  • A single run takes 90 to 120 minutes

What it feels like

Blueprint: EV is the kind of game you play with a coffee, not a controller grip. The board is a navy blueprint where you sketch your decisions on. The cards on top of it are paper. There is no soundtrack telling you how to feel — just a lamp humming in the background that you stop noticing until the numbers start to slip.

What it is not

  • Not a tycoon game. There is no idle income.

  • Not a roguelike. Runs are deterministic from your founding decisions; outcomes come from your decisions, not from a seed.

Steam features

  • 40+ achievements across progression, performance, strategy, and management style

  • Steam Cloud — continue any run on any machine

  • Lifetime stats: games played, best score, peak market share, units sold

  • Leaderboards: high score, best profit, units sold, peak share

  • Steam Deck supported, optimised for handheld

  • Languages: English

store_data.about_the_game:
An Interactive FMV Anomaly Experience: Watch the Tapes, Watch Your Back.

Graveyard Cabin is a psychological FMV anomaly horror game where observation is your only weapon.

Work the night shift inside an isolated graveyard security cabin and monitor a network of black-and-white surveillance cameras. Detect anomalies, report supernatural activity, and survive until morning.

Spot the Anomalies

Memorize every corner of the graveyard and carefully monitor the live camera feeds.

If a gravestone moves, a figure appears, or something changes unexpectedly, report it before it’s too late.

But be careful...

Too many false reports will anger the entities hunting you.

You only have 3 chances.

If You Hear Crying, Hide

Not every anomaly should be observed.

If you hear the crying of a little girl, immediately shut down the cameras and stay silent in the dark until the sound disappears.

Looking too long may attract something you cannot escape.

The Cabin Is Not Safe

The danger is not limited to the cameras.

While monitoring the graveyard, supernatural entities can appear inside the cabin itself. Check the internal cabin camera frequently and stay alert to movement beside you… or directly behind you.

The observer can quickly become the victim.

Defend Yourself

If an entity breaches the cabin, you must react instantly.

Use the Cross against hostile creatures.

Use the Amulet to banish the Dead Woman.

Choose the wrong item or hesitate for even a second and your shift will end permanently.

Features

  • Psychological FMV horror experience

  • Anomaly detection gameplay

  • Multiple supernatural entities

  • Surveillance camera monitoring mechanics

  • Audio-based survival mechanics

  • Defensive item system

  • Increasing tension and paranoia

  • Immersive graveyard atmosphere

Can you survive until morning, or will the graveyard claim its newest resident?

store_data.about_the_game:
Blightfall is a real time city building game where you control a band of expeditioners trying to salvage the ruins of an ancient kingdom. The city consists of multiple layers that need to be cleared of Blight: a rapidly spreading eldritch plague taking control of plants, people, and machinery. Players are given different approaches on how to deal with Blight: to cure it, to eradicate it, or maybe something else entirely?

Harvest the sap

Tree Sap is a valuable resource that grants unique and unexpected powers to your soldiers and buildings alike. Extraction of it requires time and care.

Research new tech and improve your units

Invest in research that will improve the efficiency of your operating units. You may find artifacts and blueprints scattered around the world that will help you accelerate the process. As you develop, you will need bigger, more efficient buildings to care for all your needs.

Experience the combat

Mechs, zeppelins, flamethrowers and many more vicious units duke it out day and night for the control of every piece of rock there is. You need to handle military logistics and strategize in real time.

Watch your people’s morale

The population is vulnerable in more than one way. Casualties and relentless assaults will reduce general morale. You have to raise their spirits via giving concessions or making promises. But be careful, unkept promises may result in fully fledged riots.

Step into the unknown

The city’s lower level holds the entrance to a Catacomb system that offers ancient mysteries to uncover. Follow the old explorer Mattheus into the inky darkness and learn what happened to the previous expedition. Make sure your scouts bring along enough supplies to survive the journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a turn-based card game set in a xianxia cultivation universe, themed around resource gathering, character progression and narrative choice-making. Within a limited time, you will face a constant stream of events across the game map, manage your resources and allied cultivators you’ve befriended, and decide the fates of others as well as your own.

The Cultivation World

This is a world where all things possess spirit: humans, beasts, insects, even artifacts… all can cultivate and attain immortality. Yet it is also a world where heavenly spiritual energy has dried up, and all living beings may be used as ingredients for alchemy

Narrative Choices

In this game, you are not merely a pawn controlled by immortals — you can become the chessmaster who decides others’ fates and reshapes the world. Use the resources at hand to make your choices. Your trade-offs and decisions will determine the ending of the entire world.

Within a limited time, you will face endless events unfolding on the map, allocate your resources and the fellow cultivators you have befriended, and shape both your own destiny and that of others.

Unique Combat

Cast spells, summon spirit pets, wield magical treasures, deploy talismans, and form battle formations — with hundreds of combat skills available, you can freely craft a completely unique combat dice set.

The combat system is simple and direct: in battle, you only need to roll the dice and choose whether to reroll, while enjoying the spectacular visual spectacle of clashing skills.

Characters & Factions

The lower realms are split into countless warring factions locked in endless conflict. You may choose to establish your own sect and gradually annex other forces, ally yourself with existing factions to stand united, or simply crush and destroy your enemies as an overwhelming powerhouse and seize their resources.

Faced with this world, what choices will you make? Where will your path lead…

Unlock a variety of upgrade modules and combine different abilities to create your own unique playstyle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your shop. The cauldron is warm, the shelves are waiting, and customers will be here soon.

Witch Shop Simulator puts you in the apron of a witch running her very own sorcery store. Inspired by the magical worlds of games like Hogwarts Legacy, this is a cozy, first-person experience built around the quiet satisfaction of a well-managed shop and a perfectly brewed potion.

Brew Your Potions Gather ingredients, follow recipes, and craft a growing catalogue of magical concoctions. Each potion you brew is one more product ready to stock, and one more satisfied customer walking out the door.

Run Your Shop Keep your shelves organized, manage your inventory, and make sure nothing runs out. A good witch knows her stock as well as her spells.

Your Pace, Your Magic No combat, no pressure, just the gentle rhythm of a shop that’s yours to grow. Arrange your space, build your catalogue, and settle into the most magical small business in town.

A World That Feels Like Home Warm lighting, bubbling cauldrons, and shelves lined with curious bottles. Witch Shop Simulator is designed to feel like a cozy corner of a much bigger magical world.

If you’ve ever lost yourself in the potion-crafting loop of Potion Craft or the shop management depth of Potionomics, you’ll feel right at home here. Witch Shop Simulator channels that same slow-burn satisfaction of building a business from nothing — discovering recipes, fine-tuning your stock, and watching your little storefront grow one brew at a time.

Fans of cozy life sims like Stardew Valley and Coral Island will recognise the rhythm immediately: days that feel meaningful, a space that’s entirely your own, and a quiet sense of progress that never pressures you. Whether you came from the sun-soaked fields of Fields of Mistria or the fantasy islands of Sun Haven, the gentle pace of Witch Shop Simulator will feel like a natural home.

There’s something deeply satisfying about running your own shop — the same pull you feel in games like Travellers Rest, Tavern Master, or Cozy Keep, where every shelf stocked and every customer served feels like a small personal win. In Witch Shop Simulator, that feeling gets a magical twist: your shelves hold healing draughts and enchanted elixirs, and your most loyal regulars might just be a dragon or a wandering ghost.

The crafting heart of the game will be familiar to anyone who’s spent time with Potion Shop Simulator or Witchy Business — gather, combine, brew, and sell. But Witch Shop Simulator wraps that loop in a world rich with atmosphere and character, where even choosing which ingredients to stock feels like part of a bigger story.

If you enjoy the creative management challenge of games like Graveyard Keeper, My Time at Portia, or Dinkum — where you’re always balancing resources, unlocking new options, and making your corner of the world a little more special — you’ll find plenty to sink your evenings into here. The shop grows with you, and no two playthroughs need to look the same.

Players who loved the cooperative brewing chaos of Witchtastic or Potion Party will find a more relaxed solo take on the same magical fantasy: you’re the one witch in charge, setting your own pace, building your recipe book, and deciding which concoctions make the cut. No timer. No yelling. Just you, your cauldron, and the satisfying clink of a customer’s coins.

The world-building draws on that same sense of warmth and whimsy you find in games like Witchbrook, Little Witch in the Woods, and Wylde Flowers — places where magic is woven into the everyday, where tending a garden of enchanted herbs feels just as meaningful as the biggest magical discovery. There are stories in every corner of your shop, if you take the time to look.

For those who’ve explored the management depth of Inn Tycoon, Blacksmith Master, Tidehaven: Ale & Trade, or Shop Simulator: Supermarket, the familiar loop of stock management, customer satisfaction, and business growth is all here — just with a decidedly more magical flavour. You’re not running a grocery aisle or a forge; you’re the most enchanting shop in the entire village.

Life sim fans who’ve put hours into Rune Factory 4 Special, Moonstone Island, or Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town will find the gentle daily structure of Witch Shop Simulator instantly comfortable. Each in-game day brings new ingredients to gather, new recipes to try, and new customers to delight — a rhythm that’s easy to settle into and hard to put down.

Even players coming from the meditative calm of PowerWash Simulator or the island-hopping wonder of Dave the Diver will recognise that same ‘one more day’ pull — the quiet compulsion to just check the shelves one more time, brew one more batch, and see who walks through the door at opening.

The magical shopkeeper fantasy has lived on Roblox for years too. If you grew up running businesses in Wizard Tycoon, building your dream home in Brookhaven RP, or trading rare finds in Adopt Me!, Witch Shop Simulator offers that same joy of ownership and creativity in a fully realised PC experience. Fans of Royale High’s dress-up magic and MeepCity’s social warmth will find Witch Shop Simulator gives the cozy magical vibe a whole new home — your very own sorcery store, run exactly the way you want.

The farming and gardening instincts you’ve built in Roblox’s Grow a Garden translate naturally here too: tending your ingredient supply, nurturing rare herbs, and watching your cauldron’s output grow more varied and more powerful over time. And if you’ve spent time climbing Tower of Hell or battling through Blox Fruits for the thrill of progress and discovery, you’ll find that same rewarding sense of unlocking something new — just at a much cosier pace, with the smell of brewing potions instead of the clash of swords.

Witch Shop Simulator is for everyone who has ever wanted a magical small business of their own. No deadlines, no defeat screens — just a warm shop, a growing catalogue of wonders, and the quiet magic of a day well spent.

Players who loved the cooperative brewing chaos of Witchtastic or Potion Party will find a more relaxed solo take on the same magical fantasy: you’re the one witch in charge, setting your own pace, building your recipe book, and deciding which concoctions make the cut. No timer. No yelling. Just you, your cauldron, and the satisfying clink of a customer’s coins.

The world-building draws on that same sense of warmth and whimsy you find in games like Witchbrook, Little Witch in the Woods, and Wylde Flowers — places where magic is woven into the everyday, where tending a garden of enchanted herbs feels just as meaningful as the biggest magical discovery. There are stories in every corner of your shop, if you take the time to look.

For those who’ve explored the management depth of Inn Tycoon, Blacksmith Master, Tidehaven: Ale & Trade, or Shop Simulator: Supermarket, the familiar loop of stock management, customer satisfaction, and business growth is all here — just with a decidedly more magical flavour. You’re not running a grocery aisle or a forge; you’re the most enchanting shop in the entire village.

Life sim fans who’ve put hours into Rune Factory 4 Special, Moonstone Island, or Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town will find the gentle daily structure of Witch Shop Simulator instantly comfortable. Each in-game day brings new ingredients to gather, new recipes to try, and new customers to delight — a rhythm that’s easy to settle into and hard to put down.

Even players coming from the meditative calm of PowerWash Simulator or the island-hopping wonder of Dave the Diver will recognise that same ‘one more day’ pull — the quiet compulsion to just check the shelves one more time, brew one more batch, and see who walks through the door at opening.

The magical shopkeeper fantasy has lived on Roblox for years too. If you grew up running businesses in Wizard Tycoon, building your dream home in Brookhaven RP, or trading rare finds in Adopt Me!, Witch Shop Simulator offers that same joy of ownership and creativity in a fully realised PC experience. Fans of Royale High’s dress-up magic and MeepCity’s social warmth will find Witch Shop Simulator gives the cozy magical vibe a whole new home — your very own sorcery store, run exactly the way you want.

The farming and gardening instincts you’ve built in Roblox’s Grow a Garden translate naturally here too: tending your ingredient supply, nurturing rare herbs, and watching your cauldron’s output grow more varied and more powerful over time. And if you’ve spent time climbing Tower of Hell or battling through Blox Fruits for the thrill of progress and discovery, you’ll find that same rewarding sense of unlocking something new — just at a much cosier pace, with the smell of brewing potions instead of the clash of swords.

Witch Shop Simulator is for everyone who has ever wanted a magical small business of their own. No deadlines, no defeat screens — just a warm shop, a growing catalogue of wonders, and the quiet magic of a day well spent.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tempest of Nations is a real-time, historical grand strategy game set during the Industrial Revolution. Lead your nation through one of the most transformative eras of history as you manage diplomacy, economics, and politics.

GAMEPLAY

  • Choose to play as any one of the dozens of nations that existed at the start of the 19th century.

  • Grow your economy by expanding industry, exploiting natural resources, and balancing trade.

  • Research technology to give you an edge over your rivals. 

  • Influence internal politics to ensure stability, pass reforms, and appease opposing political interests.

  • Use diplomacy to forge alliances, negotiate treaties, and maintain the balance of power—or strive to do away with it entirely.

  • Engage in warfare across the world, ordering your armies to achieve war aims or by manually taking charge.

  • Expand your nation outward through conquest and colonization, or choose to focus on developing what you already have. All playstyles are feasible.

FEATURES

  • A highly detailed map of the world with thousands of pieces of land that can be individually conquered or administered

  • A historical starting scenario where each country feels different based on the unique circumstances it finds itself in

  • Detailed population units with their own cultures, religions, languages, and professions

  • Over 30 distinct map modes, including population density, religion, diplomatic relations, resource distribution, and more

  • A built-in editor for creating custom scenarios or start dates, adding new countries or populations, and editing the map

4660280.name: DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles

store_data.about_the_game:
DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles

How much can you trust someone you cannot see? Track clues behind locked doors as Agent Eva, or manage the operation from analog terminals as Analyst Miles. One is in the heart of danger on the field; the other is at the desk, buried in data. You cannot see each other's screens, yet you must become each other's eyes and mind. Dual Protocol is a pure Noir asymmetric detective experience where your voice and the information you relay are your only weapons.

Silence is Your Worst Enemy

In this investigation, the only way forward is to keep talking. You must instantly describe every complex symbol, every mysterious object, and every lock you encounter to your partner. A single miscommunication or a missing detail in the halls of the Castellari Manor could lead to the case being closed forever.

Two Screens, One Bloody File

The mysterious murder at the city’s most prestigious estate is too deep to be solved from a single perspective. As Eva, touch the physical evidence on the ground; as Miles, dive into the archives to decrypt technical blueprints. Eva finds the clues Miles cannot reach; Miles analyzes the complex data Eva cannot decipher.

A Retro-Cyber Noir World

A bleak universe where the technological texture of the 90s collides with classic noir atmosphere. Search for the truth amidst CRT flickers, heavy shadows, and the tactile clatter of vintage computers. Manually enter terminal commands, scan documents, and piece together the Castellari murder bit by bit.

Dive into the Heart of the Investigation

  • Cross-Data Verification: Connect the dots by matching real-time field info with hidden central records.

  • Asymmetric Operation: One player physically triggers mechanisms in the manor while the other reads complex system manuals to guide the way.

  • Critical Deduction: When Miles's data and Eva's observations unite, the veil of mystery over the Castellari murder will finally lift.

Separate rooms, the same case. How much can you trust your partner's descriptions?

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, manage, and expand your very own agricultural empire in Agro Tycoon!

In this management simulator with a charming isometric pixel art aesthetic, you are not just a farmer, but the CEO of your own operation. Start with a modest plot of land, invest your initial capital wisely, and transform a small plantation into a true agribusiness powerhouse.

KEY FEATURES:

🚜 Operate a Heavy Fleet: Forget manual labor. Your success depends on technology. Buy, equip, and manage a complete fleet of vehicles. Prepare the soil with tractors and plows, use precision planters, control pests with crop sprayers, and secure your harvest with combine harvesters and heavy cargo trucks.

🌱 Strategic Farming & Dynamic Seasons: Start by mastering the cultivation of essential grains like wheat, corn, and soy, with many other crop varieties becoming available as your farm grows. Plan your harvests carefully, as the game features a dynamic season system that directly affects planting times and harvest windows.

🗺️ Real Estate Expansion & Land Management: Space is your only limit. Accumulate capital to buy neighboring plots of land. Manage the logistics of multiple fields simultaneously to optimize transport between the harvest and the market.

👷 Hire and Scale: There will come a time when you can't drive every tractor at once. Hire staff to operate your machines and automate your farm's processes. Manage your team, pay salaries, and focus on the macroeconomics of your business while your workers tend to the land.

Do you have the vision needed to dominate the market, modernize your fleet, and become the biggest Tycoon in the region?

store_data.about_the_game:
Every Second Feels Like a Day; Every Decision Means Life or Death

In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

Survival Against All Odds

Your people need food, wood, and shelter—but there are never enough hands to do the work. Should you send workers to the fields or reinforce the walls? Every idle citizen is wasted potential, and every misstep in resource allocation could be fatal.

  • Seasonal Challenges — In spring, monsters multiply rapidly; summer brings deadly plagues; autumn demands frantic food storage; and winter drastically reduces food production. Fail to prepare, and watch your kingdom starve.

  • Precision Workforce Management — Assign your population in real-time to any of 43 professions: farmers, lumberjacks, miners, militia, scholars, priests, blacksmiths... every role is vital, and hands are always scarce.

Construction and Research

Start from a humble village and evolve into a formidable capital. As you unlock buildings and technologies, your territory undergoes eight distinct visual transformations.

  • 80+ Building Types — From granaries and barracks to arcane towers and alchemy workshops. Each structure unlocks new jobs, raises resource capacity, and strengthens defenses.

  • 80+ Technologies — Spanning gathering, military, arcane, and knowledge branches. Unlock production boosts, new buildings, and game-changing abilities.

  • Progressive Discovery — Content isn’t all unlocked at once. New buildings, technologies, and professions become available as you meet prerequisites, offering a genuine sense of exploration.

Defending Against Monster Hordes

The threat level rises daily. When it hits 100%, a massive monster army will attack your domain. You’d better be ready.

  • Tactical Group Combat — Six unit types with intricate rock-paper-scissors dynamics. Archers, militia, and mages face off against monsters in strategic, automatically resolved battles.

  • 10+ Active and Passive Skills — Status effects, auras, damage over time, healing, and cooldown management. Your specialists gain experience and level up through combat.

  • Combat Consumables — Craft healing potions in the alchemy workshop to take into battle. Use them wisely—defeat means total loss.

World Exploration

Send teams of trained fighters deep into procedurally generated wilderness maps.

  • Procedural World Map — 15 to 25 interlinked regions with graded difficulty. Every playthrough feels unique.

  • Real-Time Exploration — Teams consume food, encounter monsters, find treasures, and face dangers. Hunger is a serious threat.

  • Risk and Reward — Venturing deeper yields rarer loot, but retreat costs progress. Total party wipe results in losing all carried items.

Ancient Gods

Uncover four ancient gods lurking in the world’s depths. Collect legendary shards, perform purification rituals, and confront multi-phase boss battles featuring accumulating health pools and devastating special abilities.

Game Highlights

  • Intense Time Pressure — 1 second equals 1 day; 6 minutes equals 1 year. Time never pauses automatically.

  • 40+ Resource Types — Across 5 crafting tiers (from Primitive to Legendary).

  • 20+ Guild Quests — With outcomes based on probability.

  • 80+ Buildings — From granaries and barracks to arcane towers and alchemy workshops, each unlocking professions, expanding capacity, and strengthening defenses.

  • 80+ Technologies — Covering gathering, military, arcane, and knowledge branches; unlocking bonuses, buildings, and powerful abilities.

  • 40+ Professions — From basic farmers and lumberjacks to specialists like blacksmiths, mages, and priests, each with unique skills.

  • Multiple Save Slots and Auto-Save Support — Manage your progress with ease.

store_data.about_the_game:
Get ready for an incredible journey of mental challenges! Embark on this adventure to solve 20 Sokoban-style puzzles. You will take control of a skilled worker who needs to push the boxes to their proper places. With skill and strategy, you will overcome each challenge and become a master in this captivating game. Ready to start?

He looked at some crates huddled in the corner. If he pushed the middle one against the wall, he would be trapped. A single mistake, a solitary lapse in spatial judgment, and the path would be blocked forever.

If this is a dream, why is it so relentlessly logical? Dreams are supposed to be fluid, shifting like watercolor under rain.

If this is reality, why is it so empty? There is no hunger here, only the phantom itch of a puzzle needing to be solved.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grab your mower, call your friends, and turn chaos into a perfectly trimmed lawn!
Mow Simulator Together is a fast-paced co-op multiplayer game for up to 4 players, where teamwork, rivalry, and smart decisions decide who becomes the ultimate lawn master. 🌿🚜

🌱 Cut, Compete, and Outsmart

Spawn in different areas and race toward grass zones that need to be cleared. Each session drops players into unique maps filled with opportunities to score points. Reaching them is part of the challenge. Choose your route carefully, move fast, and outplay your friends by mowing more grass before time runs out.

🚜 Choose Your Mower

Pick from different mowers, each with its own strengths. Some are faster, others are more stable or durable. The right choice can give you a strong advantage, but only if you know how to use it.

🔥 Manage Your Machine

Your mower reacts to how you play. Push too hard and the engine can overheat. Hit obstacles and your blade may lose efficiency. Collisions and rough driving can damage your machine, forcing you to adapt quickly during the match.

🛠 Limited Repairs

You can only carry one repair tool at a time, which means every decision matters. Fix your engine, repair your blade, or restore your mower body depending on the situation. Choosing the wrong moment can cost you the match.

😈 Friends or Rivals

Work together or turn against each other. Block paths, crash into opponents, and create chaos to gain an advantage. But every action has consequences, and your friends can always fight back.

🌍 Dynamic Matches

Each session offers different layouts and mowing zones, creating variety and replayability. No match plays the same, and every round brings new strategies and unexpected moments.

Only one player can come out on top. Will you play fair, or do whatever it takes to win?

store_data.about_the_game:
Worldview Introduction

Past Westward Journey-themed games are mostly confined to the worldview framework of "gods, demons and chaotic battles", simplifying the journey to the West into a series of exhilarating showdowns of slaying demons and subduing monsters. Yet they overlook the ultimate true meaning of Journey to the West written by Wu Cheng’en — the westward journey is never an outward conquest, but an inward self‑questioning. Dispelling misfortunes is never an achievement of exterminating external demons, but a spiritual practice of overcoming inner obsessions.

Gameplay Introduction

Game Genre: Single-player Turn-based Tactical RPG

Basic Operation Logic:

Square grid map, each unit occupies one grid.

Turn‑based alternating actions: All player units act → All enemy units act.

Each unit per turn: Move (consume movement points) + Action (Attack / Skill / Item / Standby), either chosen individually or combined.

Operations: Select a unit → Blue highlighted movable grids → Target grid → Choose Attack / Skill / Item → Select target → Execute.

Core Protagonist Mechanic: Level failure if the protagonist perishes.

Worldview Introduction

Past Westward Journey-themed games are mostly confined to the worldview framework of "gods, demons and chaotic battles", simplifying the journey to the West into a series of exhilarating showdowns of slaying demons and subduing monsters. Yet they overlook the ultimate true meaning of Journey to the West written by Wu Cheng’en — the westward journey is never an outward conquest, but an inward self‑questioning. Dispelling misfortunes is never an achievement of exterminating external demons, but a spiritual practice of overcoming inner obsessions.

Gameplay Introduction

Game Genre: Single-player Turn-based Tactical RPG

Basic Operation Logic:

Square grid map, each unit occupies one grid.

Turn‑based alternating actions: All player units act → All enemy units act.

Each unit per turn: Move (consume movement points) + Action (Attack / Skill / Item / Standby), either chosen individually or combined.

Operations: Select a unit → Blue highlighted movable grids → Target grid → Choose Attack / Skill / Item → Select target → Execute.

Core Protagonist Mechanic: Level failure if the protagonist perishes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Skate Rush: 90s Retro Arcade is a fast, colorful arcade skating game inspired by the energy of classic 90s games.

Jump into quick runs, dodge obstacles, keep your speed, and chase a better score every time you play. With real life TRICKS. It is built for short, replayable sessions where timing, rhythm, and clean reactions matter more than complicated controls.

Features

- Fast arcade skating action

- Simple controls and quick restarts

- Retro-inspired 90s presentation

- Score-focused gameplay

- Obstacles, jumps, and tight timing

- Single-player runs built for replayability

- Lightweight free-to-play experience

Skate Rush is easy to start, but each run pushes you to react faster, survive longer, and beat your best score.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Prologue】

'Blooming Canvas' is a visual novel about painting, and also Pygma's new exploration of "creation." In this hurried world, may everyone rediscover the purity of creation, the emotion stirred by beauty, and the longing for love. We hope this work brings a positive and uplifting feeling to all.

【Story Synopsis】

Ji Xingyu, a painter who achieved fame at a young age, once fell into a long, gray-white dream.

When he woke from the dream, he found he could no longer retrieve the liveliness that had vanished from his brush.

Now, having shed the halo of a prodigy, he lives as an ordinary painter after graduation, making a living through his art.

Day after day, staying up late to meet deadlines, he gradually grows accustomed to a busy yet quiet life.

— Until that summer.

A mysterious blonde girl visits him, bringing with her a damaged masterpiece…

As the Flower and Bird Festival art exhibition draws near, the past and the truth buried deep within the strokes of his brush will slowly come to light.

【Charactors】

  • All characters in the game are adults over the age of 18.

  • 枫丹水梦（Shuimeng Fontaine)

A foreign girl who stumbles into the studio by chance, possessing an extraordinary passion for painting.

As Xingyu's student and assistant, she stays in the studio to practice, awaiting the opening of the Flower and Bird Festival exhibition.

Hoping to fulfill a promise made to someone, she dreams of painting the most perfect sunflower the world has ever seen.

  • 苏绫菲 (Su lingfei)

By day, she's a maid playing the role of the little devil "Mephis" at a café, and also a trustworthy underclassman.

She once signed a strange contract with Xingyu and often looks after him under the pretense of fulfilling its terms. Coming from a well-known artistic family in the local city of Funiao, she gave up painting due to a lack of talent and has since returned to an ordinary life.

  • 芙洛·古根海姆 (Flora Guggenheim)

A mysterious blonde girl Xingyu encounters by chance in the garden. Elegant in speech, she carries a surprising sense of trustworthiness.

She is a patron of the renowned artist collective "The Order of the Golden Knights" and an exceptional art collector. She brings a severely damaged precious painting and commissions Xingyu with an almost impossible restoration task.

  • 季星雨 (Ji xingyu)

The male protagonist of this story.A highly skilled yet unpopular painter.

He recently purchased a second-hand studio from a senior who had switched careers and began living a life of painting with reversed day and night.

Once a rising star highly anticipated by the industry, he has since unfortunately fallen from grace.

【Game Features】

  • Dual-playthrough storytelling – uncover the truth through two completely different storylines.

  • Build emotional connections with the heroines, creating an immersive romantic experience.

  • Unique art style and atmospheric music offer a distinctive audiovisual experience.

  • More than just romance – also includes a touch of philosophical reflection on art and aesthetics.

【Closing Remarks】

You can join the player group (1082329086) or follow "Pygma山鬼工坊" on Bilibili.

If you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to support us. That means a lot to us. Thank you for your support!

A foreign girl who stumbles into the studio by chance, possessing an extraordinary passion for painting.

As Xingyu's student and assistant, she stays in the studio to practice, awaiting the opening of the Flower and Bird Festival exhibition.

Hoping to fulfill a promise made to someone, she dreams of painting the most perfect sunflower the world has ever seen.

  • 苏绫菲 (Su lingfei)

By day, she's a maid playing the role of the little devil "Mephis" at a café, and also a trustworthy underclassman.

She once signed a strange contract with Xingyu and often looks after him under the pretense of fulfilling its terms. Coming from a well-known artistic family in the local city of Funiao, she gave up painting due to a lack of talent and has since returned to an ordinary life.

  • 芙洛·古根海姆 (Flora Guggenheim)

A mysterious blonde girl Xingyu encounters by chance in the garden. Elegant in speech, she carries a surprising sense of trustworthiness.

She is a patron of the renowned artist collective "The Order of the Golden Knights" and an exceptional art collector. She brings a severely damaged precious painting and commissions Xingyu with an almost impossible restoration task.

  • 季星雨 (Ji xingyu)

The male protagonist of this story.A highly skilled yet unpopular painter.

He recently purchased a second-hand studio from a senior who had switched careers and began living a life of painting with reversed day and night.

Once a rising star highly anticipated by the industry, he has since unfortunately fallen from grace.

【Game Features】

  • Dual-playthrough storytelling – uncover the truth through two completely different storylines.

  • Build emotional connections with the heroines, creating an immersive romantic experience.

  • Unique art style and atmospheric music offer a distinctive audiovisual experience.

  • More than just romance – also includes a touch of philosophical reflection on art and aesthetics.

【Closing Remarks】

You can join the player group (1082329086) or follow "Pygma山鬼工坊" on Bilibili.

If you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to support us. That means a lot to us. Thank you for your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
DarkCage is a mystery escape-room adventure where you must solve puzzles and gather clues alongside others trapped in an unfamiliar place. Only by uncovering the truth can you hope to escape.

Synopsis

"Where... am I?"

You awaken to find yourself imprisoned in an unknown space. Around you are others—strangers, yet clearly sharing the same fate.

To escape, you must solve puzzles and collect clues. But mere problem-solving will not be enough. You must piece together what you find, deduce the situation, and uncover the hidden truth. Only then will a way out reveal itself.

Will you make it out of this place alive...?

Key Features

  • Escape Room–Inspired Puzzle Design
    Built upon the structure of real-world escape room experiences, the game offers immersive and intuitive puzzles. Its carefully layered design allows players to progress naturally, one step at a time.

  • Integrated Hint System
    Even when you find yourself stuck, the journey doesn't have to end. A built-in system allows the protagonist to assist with puzzle-solving, offering optional guidance so you can continue without breaking immersion.

  • A Fusion of Puzzles and Deduction
    This is more than just solving puzzles. You must analyze the clues you gather, interpret the situation, and draw your own conclusions. Only sound judgment will lead you to the end of the story.

  • Branching Failures Based on Choice
    Your decisions shape the course of the game. Wrong choices may lead to unexpected consequences, and every judgment you make could determine whether—or how—you escape.

store_data.about_the_game:
You signed the deal...

Now the table is waiting...

A minimalist, atmospheric roguelike where every decision is a trade-off between power and pain.

You don’t just play cards — you pay for them.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Play cards onto the table to deal damage

  • Every move can hurt you back

  • Manage Blood Force, self damage, and limited moves

  • Survive against increasingly hostile entities

This is not about luck.

This is about how far you’re willing to go.

BUILD YOUR RUN

  • Collect powerful Relics between circles

  • Accept or reject Omens during battle

  • Modify your deck with:

  • Bloodmarked Cards (double damage)

  • Scars / Sigils that change behavior

Create broken combinations… or die trying.

FACE THE MONSTERS

Each entity bends the rules:

  • The Witness — it sees everything

  • The Bone Dealer — it trades your loss

  • The Many — it overwhelms

  • The Architect — it controls the system

  • The Infestation — it spreads

They don’t just fight you.

They change the game itself.

15 RITUAL CIRCLES

Progress deeper into the deal:

  • Each circle introduces new mechanics

  • New relics and omens become possible

  • The pressure grows

You are not meant to reach the end.

FEATURES

  • Dark, minimal horror atmosphere

  • Deep risk/reward gameplay

  • Multiple build archetypes

  • High replayability

  • Cryptic narrative that unfolds as you play

The deal does not end.

It deepens.

It started with a burning hot dog stand. Now the whole city won't stop calling you. You're not a firefighter. You're not trained. But somehow… you're the only one showing up.

Put out fires. Stop gas leaks. Smash through smoke-filled apartments. Handle bizarre accidents, exploding equipment, and chaotic emergencies that spiral out of control in seconds. Every call is unpredictable. Every second counts.

Move fast. Think faster. Improvise everything. Explore a living, breathing open city where anything can go wrong at any moment. Race to emergencies on foot or jump into vehicles and get there before it's too late. The more jobs you take, the better your gear gets. But the city keeps getting worse.

Something strange is happening. Incidents are escalating. Patterns are forming. You're not here to investigate. You're here to save whoever you can.

• Open city sandbox - go anywhere, respond to anything

• Unpredictable emergencies - no two missions play the same

• Fast, chaotic gameplay - act now, figure it out on the fly

• Upgrade your gear - become faster, stronger, better equipped

• Drive multiple vehicles - reach disasters before they escalate

• Dynamic call system - the city constantly throws new problems at you

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Happy Country.
The happiest country in the world… they said.

Step into the worn-out shoes of an ordinary person trying to survive life in 1990s recession-era Finland. In Happy Country, the postcard image of happiness slowly cracks, revealing the cold winds, empty wallets, and tough choices.

Happy Country is a first-person life simulation set in a fully 3D world where survival isn't just about staying alive, but about staying afloat.

Explore a wide and living environment inspired by rural and urban Finland of the 1990s. Take on jobs, complete tasks, manage your hunger, health, and money, and make choices that shape your journey. Whether you're scraping together coins for food, fixing problems, avoiding dangers, or simply trying to get through another grey morning, every decision matters.

Experience Finland as it truly feels:
long winters, unpredictable weather, quiet forests, stubborn machinery, and a culture that rewards resilience… and occasionally strong coffee.

Features

  • Live Your Own Story
    No single path. Solve problems your way, make choices that affect your survival, and shape your own journey through hardship and hope.

  • Deep Survival Simulation
    Monitor vital needs like hunger, health, and money. Life isn't cheap, and neither are mistakes.

  • A Unique Setting
    Experience the rarely explored world of 1990s Finland during the economic recession, blending realism with dark humor and cultural authenticity.

  • Large Open Areas to Explore
    Travel across varied locations, complete missions, discover secrets, and learn how to survive in an unforgiving environment. Listen to the game's 16 different radio channels.

  • Dynamic Finnish Atmosphere
    Face changing weather, time-based clock system and the everyday realities of Finnish life such as power outages and other bigger problems.

  • Authentic Language Experience
    English subtitles guide the story, while Finnish voice acting delivers an authentic and immersive cultural experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Engage enemy fleets in this tactical space RPG where every decision matters. Battles take place on an 8 X 5 grid with each team locked to their half of the battlefield. Each battle is a test of planning and execution. Victory requires managing a fleet that can defeat your enemies through upgrades, equipment, and supplies. You will be given all the tools and information required to prepare your fleet for the next battle.

Gameplay

Each character has a base unit type: Attacker, Sniper, Warship, Medic, etc. As you progress through the campaign, you choose what attacks and abilities each unit has, how each unit is able to move, and ultimately how your fleet operates. Whether your ships are armed with overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defense, or a focus on a balance, you have complete control on how you upgrade and manage your fleet.

Attacks are position-based and require two resources: Energy and Charge. Certain abilities feature unique attack ranges capable of striking multiple enemies at once. You must decide if using the extra resources are worth the extra firepower.

Story

The story of this game deals with an unknown enemy manipulating human events in order to gain control. As the conflict unfolds, what everyone assumed to be true about the enemy begins to change. Allies begin to question allegiance, unfamiliar technology destroys the beliefs that everybody assumed to be true, and motives no longer make sense. What once appeared to be random attacks by pirates are revealed to be a calculated and long term plan...

Each decision improves your efficiency, and every layer of growth feeds into the next, creating the rewarding loop that makes incremental games so compelling.

  • Incremental progression with a strong sense of momentum

  • Post-battle upgrades that keep every run meaningful

  • Multiple growth paths through skill trees, shops, and relics

  • Easy to enjoy casually, with plenty of room for optimization

Watch a small, adorable hero grow into a force capable of conquering an ever-expanding battlefield.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of MUSO.

Five misfits find their way through fate and overcome a bad hand of cards dealt to them - and despite their flaws - ensure that they're always right behind one another, having each others backs no matter what!

In this game, you'll experience all kinds of stuff.

What does this game feature?

MUSO features...

  • A rhythm-based battle system, where you can land up to 16 total hits on an enemy!

  • A side-rolling HP meter that allows you to save yourself in battle before it's too late!

  • Short, witty, dad joke-esque humor that is guaranteed to make you hang your head in shame.

  • Five total party members! (Yeah, that's five total HP meters to keep track of...)

  • 8 total chapters, alongside a Prologue and an Epilogue. (Basically 10 Chapters.)

  • Heart-felt moments guaranteed to make you think twice on all of your decisions leading up to them.

  • Environments inspired by the late 1960's America. 

  • One ending, but it's about the journey anyways - not the destination.

  • Pixel-art environments and characters reminiscent of older games designed with both modern monitors and CRT displays in-mind. 

  • One wacky soundtrack made entirely by the director and lead of the project!

So, what else?

MUSO has a story, and it's waiting for you to listen to it.

With the kindness of my heart, I welcome you to the world of MUSO.

  • A side-rolling HP meter that allows you to save yourself in battle before it's too late!

  • Short, witty, dad joke-esque humor that is guaranteed to make you hang your head in shame.

  • Five total party members! (Yeah, that's five total HP meters to keep track of...)

  • 8 total chapters, alongside a Prologue and an Epilogue. (Basically 10 Chapters.)

  • Heart-felt moments guaranteed to make you think twice on all of your decisions leading up to them.

  • Environments inspired by the late 1960's America. 

  • One ending, but it's about the journey anyways - not the destination.

  • Pixel-art environments and characters reminiscent of older games designed with both modern monitors and CRT displays in-mind. 

  • One wacky soundtrack made entirely by the director and lead of the project!

So, what else?

MUSO has a story, and it's waiting for you to listen to it.

With the kindness of my heart, I welcome you to the world of MUSO.
store_data.short_description: A ragtag, misfit group of five band together, defying fate and work to solve their world's many mysteries. Explore strange worlds! Meet colorful friends! Fight wacky foes! Near the end...you'll be met with the final question: Which side prevails? Hope, or despair...? Welcome to the World of MUSO.

store_data.about_the_game:
Granby, Colorado. 2003.

The dozer didn't sell at auction. Nobody wanted it. Now it sits in your workshop. You have a grudge, a welding torch, and thirty-five thousand dollars.

PHASE 1 — THE WORKSHOP

A man alone in a garage at 2am.

Spend on armor, engine, cooling, treads, cameras. Every upgrade draws suspicion. Every day costs cash. The neighbor peers over the fence. The hardware clerk asks too many questions. An inspector heard the welding. A reporter's been asking about your zoning dispute.

You cannot afford everything. Every run is a conversation about what to sacrifice.

PHASE 2 — THE RECKONING

Drive. Destroy. Survive.

Six priority targets. One machine. Six thousand kilograms of concrete and steel on tank treads. Ram buildings at speed — heavier armor and stronger engines turn walls into dust. Heat builds as you demolish. Overheat, and the engine stalls for three long seconds while the sirens close in.

Every choice you made in the workshop plays out here. The cooling you skipped. The cameras you couldn't afford. The armor that's keeping you alive.

FEATURES

  • 30–45 minute complete runs — built for a single evening

  • Five upgrade paths that reshape how the rampage plays

  • Twelve branching workshop events with real consequences

  • Force-based destruction physics — mass and momentum matter

  • Escalating police response across five wanted levels

  • Original soundtrack with adaptive music across three phases

  • Save anytime, resume mid-workshop

A NOTE ON THE SOURCE

This game is a work of fiction inspired by a real event. On June 4, 2004, Marvin Heemeyer drove a modified Komatsu D355A through Granby, Colorado. No one else was killed. The grievances, the machine, and the man were real.

Project Haymaker is not about celebrating what he did. It's about understanding how someone gets there — and handing the wrench to the player.

"Sometimes reasonable men must do unreasonable things."

When the greatest detective in the tropics is dead, who can solve the mystery of his death? Play as Helen, Patrício Jânio's maid, the prime suspect in her boss's murder. Race against time, prove your innocence while escaping the spotlight and mysteries of your own past.

Do you trust your memory and deductive skills? Don't rely on the game to remind you of the details; write everything down, be suspicious of everyone, and investigate every corner of the city of São Paolo.

Talk to my lawyer! With the help of João, Jânio's former lawyer, gain access to restricted areas and use your smooth talk to obtain information and gossip. Don't let anything slip by!

The secrets of the city's most famous detective's past return to haunt those who remain. Call it fate or karma, but a story left unfinished always returns for a—in my view—cinematic ending!

Game characters come in all shapes and sizes. They can be brave knights, brilliant scientists, or superheroes who save entire worlds. This game offers a more unusual experience. Here you can become a starfish. Yes, that's right. You're an ordinary starfish, and your only purpose in this world is simply to exist. No challenges, no rush, no worries, no responsibilities. Nothing is required of you; simply enjoy the singing of birds and the sound of the wind. You can comfortably lounge on the warm sand of a sunny beach or deep beneath the sea, or in other rather strange and even illogical places. Become the best starfish you can be.

 

In terms of gameplay, this is a meditative game about contemplating a starfish against a backdrop of beautiful landscapes. From the menu, you can choose one of the starfish, as well as the location that suits you best: a tropical beach, a desert, the ocean floor, space, or a futuristic city street.

 

Features

- Dynamic gameplay

- Birdsong and beautiful landscapes

- Choose from 18 levels and 36 starfish

store_data.about_the_game:
Create Your Alien!

Weapons, armor, and origins can be mixed and matched to create a wide range of playstyles. An assortment of customization options exists including heads, suits, weapon variations, and color schemes.  Origins determine the abilities an alien has and also changes the effects and color of the selected weapon.

Stats As Loot!

Loot comes in the form of crystals for each stat.  If an item or ability has a stat, a crystal that contains the same stat can be used to improve it.  To use a crystal, players simply need infusion essence that drops from enemies and as rewards for completing objectives.  Rare loot comes in the form of legendary crystals that have various uses such as increasing rarity or allowing items and abilities to be reset back to their original state.  Unneeded crystals can be salvaged for extra infusion essence.

Levels and Scaling

Invasion level is raised by completing objectives.  The world map, all objectives, and areas to explore are randomly generated so the world is everchanging.  As invasion level goes up, more difficult areas will appear on the map and enemies will become stronger.  This rise in difficulty also comes with better chances at finding rare crystals!  Being defeated will result in lowering the invasion level and being sent back to the ship.

Features

  • Create bizarre alien builds with mix-and-match weapons, armor, and origins.

  • Customize your alien with unique heads, suits, weapon variants, and color schemes.

  • Smash, launch, grab, and throw enemies into each other.

  • Unleash destructive alien powers across chaotic battlefields.

  • Explore procedurally generated areas filled with randomized objectives and encounters.

  • Collect crystal-based loot that directly upgrades your stats, gear, and abilities.

  • Use legendary crystals to reroll, reset, and enhance powerful equipment.

  • Salvage unwanted crystals for infusion essence used in upgrading builds.

  • Raise invasion level to unlock harder areas, tougher enemies, and rarer rewards.

  • Enjoy streamlined auto-pickup loot without inventory clutter or micromanagement.

store_data.about_the_game:
We Die Below

We Die Below is a brutal co-op dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Select your class, manage your kit, and descend into shifting hellscapes where the environment is as hostile as the things living in it. Every objective is a gamble, and the exit is never a given.

The Pressure Increases

The deeper you go, the more the world reacts. Enemies become faster and more aggressive the longer you linger, turning your extraction into a desperate gauntlet. In these depths, the most dangerous moment of the mission is often the walk back to the door.

Refine Your Kit

Survival earns you more than just a reprieve; it unlocks the tools you need to go deeper next time.

  • Modular Progression: Unlock new gear and abilities to solve specific tactical problems.

  • Adapt or Die: Experiment with varied loadouts to counter new threats, or specialize in a "signature build" and see how much punishment it can actually take.

  • No Fixed Meta: Shifting mission parameters mean the strategy that worked last time might get you killed this time.

Tactics Over Chaos

Whether you’re anchoring the frontline, managing crowd density, or capitalizing on high-value targets, every role is a load-bearing pillar of the team. When your coordination clicks, you’re a force of nature. When one person overextends, the whole run can collapse in seconds.

Shifting Hellscapes

Procedurally generated environments offer more than just different layouts; they force you to change how you move. One run might be a calculated hunt; the next might be a frantic scramble through a layout that feels designed to trap you.

High Stakes, Brutal Returns

Every mission is a series of "stay or go" decisions. Push further for better loot and risk losing everything, or extract early and live to upgrade another day. The world will eventually find a way to break your winning streak—the only question is how much you’ll claw out of the dirt before it does.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dive into a requiem for a world in its death throes.

At the heart of a collapsing world, chaos is the only certainty. As deities tear each other apart in a conflict that consumes existence itself, you move through the shadows, nameless. Your true challenge is to unravel the mystery of this decay, to understand the forces at play, and finally act accordingly to impose your will in the final moments of this moribund world.

Key Features:

  • Master Elemental Chaos: Combat is at the heart of the experience. Forget simple button mashing. Experiment with a devastating magic combo system. Combine ice and lightning for explosive reactions. Exploit your enemies' vulnerabilities. This is a battle of precision and reaction.

  • A Shattered World, Ruins to Explore: Explore an interconnected Metroidvania world, crafted with painstaking attention to detail. Discover secrets in stunning environments like the Great Library of Fallen Deities. Acquire new abilities to overcome environmental obstacles and access uncharted areas.

  • A Hand-Drawn Masterpiece: Every frame, every enemy, and every magical effect is carefully hand-drawn and animated in a unique 2D anime style. Immerse yourself in a dark, melancholic, and visually stunning atmosphere.

  • Forge Your Nameless Destiny: The gods ignore you, and you will use that to your advantage. Forge your own legend amidst the chaos. The divine conflict is an opportunity; how will you exploit it to carve your path?

store_data.about_the_game:
Chess 2 is a turn-based strategy game that combines chess with 4X systems.

You capture territory, build farms, grow your economy, spawn units, and fight for control of the map. It is not just about moving pieces well. You also need to expand, defend key areas, manage resources, and deal with diplomacy.

The game has both singleplayer and multiplayer, with matches built around map control, army management, and long-term decision making.

Alongside familiar chess units, Chess 2 also includes special pieces that change how matches play. Expect pieces like the Dragon, which copies movement patterns, the Nuke, which can blow pieces up, the Portal, which lets units teleport, and other unusual units that add new tactical options to the board.

Features

  • Chess-inspired turn-based strategy

  • Territory control and expansion

  • Economy systems, including farms

  • Unit spawning and army management

  • Diplomacy

  • Singleplayer and multiplayer

  • Special units with unique abilities

  • Multiple modes, from more controlled rulesets to chaotic ones

  • Custom maps

  • Replay and planning tools like premoves and arrows

Chess 2 is for players who like chess, strategy games, and map control, but want more than a normal match on a fixed board.
