store_data.about_the_game:
Follow the rules. Survive the night.

Gaslit Bay is a co-op psychological horror game where up to players must survive a night shift at a remote gas station… by obeying strict, ever-changing rules.

What seems like a simple job like serving customers, stocking shelves and pumping gas, quickly turns into something far more disturbing that you could ever have imagined. The rules are there to protect you. Break them, and reality starts to fall apart.

The convenience store

Work the night shift in an isolated gas station surrounded by a dark, endless forest.

Handle customers, monitor cameras, restock items, keep the business running... But beware, something is watching you from the shadows.

Follow the rules.

Each shift brings a randomized set of rules you must follow.

  • Sometimes you can only answer the phone after the second ring.

  • DO NOT look at the fuel truck driver.

  • Sometimes you need to ignore the knocking from the freezer.

Be careful... If everything seems too quiet, maybe it is a good time to find some place to hide.

Every mistake invites something closer to you.

Co-op survival

Play solo or with friends and coordinate to survive.

  • Decide who is going to risk going into the dark.

  • Communicate events that are crucial for your survival (or maybe not...)

But do not forget... not everyone you see is your teammate.

The rules are there to protect you.

This gas station was never meant to stay open.

The rules aren't random, they are warnings.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE CELL MUST SURVIVE

In Project: C.E.L.L., you are a scientist running a corporate immortality experiment. As a retro-terminal sci-fi roguelike management sim, the project challenges you to build organelles, manage living systems, and keep a fragile experimental cell alive for as many years as possible.

What begins as a controlled test quickly becomes a fight against biology itself. Energy must be produced. Resources must stay balanced. Waste, pressure, acidity, ROS, and DNA damage must be contained before they spiral into catastrophic collapse. Every choice matters, every failure teaches, and every extra year brings the corporation closer to the breakthrough it wants to own.

How many years can you keep Project: C.E.L.L. alive?

RUN THE EXPERIMENT

Guide a living cell through increasingly unstable simulations, making constant decisions to expand, repair, optimize, and survive.

BUILD ORGANELLES

Develop the cell from the inside out with specialized organelles that power production, reduce danger, and unlock new strategic options.

SURVIVE THE AGING CURVE

The simulation gets harsher with every passing phase. Early runs reward growth and efficiency, but long-term survival demands adaptation and hard choices as the cell begins to break down under age and stress.

DIE, ITERATE, IMPROVE

Each failed run feeds the next. Gather research data, unlock permanent upgrades, and refine your approach across repeated experiments as you push each new cell beyond the limits of the last.

MASTER THE CORPORATION'S MOST IMPORTANT EXPERIMENT

  • Build and upgrade organelles with distinct functions and tradeoffs

  • Manage interconnected resources and prevent cascading system failures

  • Counter rising threats like acidity, pressure, waste, ROS, and DNA damage

  • Adapt to increasingly hostile late-stage survival conditions

  • Earn permanent progression between runs and develop stronger strategies over time

  • Chase longer-lived cells, cleaner runs, and better data with every attempt

The corporation is watching. Keep the cell alive. Gather the data. Chase immortality.

store_data.about_the_game:
Entiled is an infinite spatial tile clearing puzzle game with endless replayability.

Click and remove tiles from the board without colliding into others. Build your multiplier by matching the active color, trigger satisfying chain reactions with Special Tiles, and maintain your streak to maximize your score.

As puzzles grow in size and complexity, you’ll need to think ahead, preserve movement space, and adapt your strategy on the fly. One mistake can break your momentum, but smart planning can turn a single move into a massive combo.

Compete in Ranked Play through Steam Leaderboards, climbing the ranks in both High Score and Fastest Tiles Per Second (TPS) clearing across multiple puzzle size classes.

Create and share your own puzzles using the built-in Puzzle Maker. Design custom layouts with unique tile combinations, export and import puzzle files, and upload your creations directly to the Steam Workshop for the community to play.

Browse, download, and play community made puzzles from the Steam Workshop, expanding the game with endless new challenges and player-made creations.

With multiple game modes, scaling difficulty, ranked leaderboards, community puzzle sharing, and short replayable sessions, Entiled is designed to reward both quick thinking and long-term mastery.

Perfect for quick sessions or extended play, whether you’re chasing leaderboard positions, building puzzles, or just looking to unwind.
store_data.detailed_description:
Entiled is an infinite spatial tile clearing puzzle game with endless replayability.

Click and remove tiles from the board without colliding into others. Build your multiplier by matching the active color, trigger satisfying chain reactions with Special Tiles, and maintain your streak to maximize your score.

As puzzles grow in size and complexity, you’ll need to think ahead, preserve movement space, and adapt your strategy on the fly. One mistake can break your momentum, but smart planning can turn a single move into a massive combo.

Compete in Ranked Play through Steam Leaderboards, climbing the ranks in both High Score and Fastest Tiles Per Second (TPS) clearing across multiple puzzle size classes.

Create and share your own puzzles using the built-in Puzzle Maker. Design custom layouts with unique tile combinations, export and import puzzle files, and upload your creations directly to the Steam Workshop for the community to play.

Browse, download, and play community made puzzles from the Steam Workshop, expanding the game with endless new challenges and player-made creations.

With multiple game modes, scaling difficulty, ranked leaderboards, community puzzle sharing, and short replayable sessions, Entiled is designed to reward both quick thinking and long-term mastery.

Perfect for quick sessions or extended play, whether you’re chasing leaderboard positions, building puzzles, or just looking to unwind.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Haunted Spot is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a century-old abandoned haunted house to experience the paranormal.

The house was built during the 1900s and located at a remote location in the US, where a family used to live. During the 1940s, some tragic incidents occurred inside the house, which marked the beginning of paranormal activities. During the 1980s, the family moved out of the house and never came back. Rumor had it that the house was built on cursed land. Even though nobody lived there for a long time, people passing by the house reported lights going off on their own, and weird growling as well as crying sounds could be heard.

There have been reports of several break-ins in the house, and the various Satanic rituals were performed there, which unleashed dark forces inside the house.

You play as Jack, a paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the abandoned house for experiencing paranormal activities.

Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire abandoned haunted house!
  • Different kinds of evil spirits lurking in the shadows!
  • Collect items like keys, haunted doll, etc.
  • Avoid deadly traps like big blades, fire, etc.
  • Explore the unknown spirit dimension!
  • Nearly half-an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
In MYRIORAMA, players control Ou, a sort of wandering handyman, to explore a charming world inspired by classic stop-motion animation. Using versatile magic abilities, players will guide Ou across a varied landscape full of unique characters that change in significant ways according to the progression of a dynamic story about loss, hopelessness, and supporting one another in the face of despair.

This Stop-Motion World is Your Oyster

Explore every nook and cranny of a massive diorama that channels the Rankin Bass Animagic films, the works of Piotr Kamler, and animé of the 80s and 90s. Low framerate animations will create the illusion of plastic toys moving around a vast playset.

Rearrange! Rework! Reimagine!

Using a set of slick augmented reality goggles, players can rotate and rearrange dungeons rooms to solve puzzles. Each dungeon will work differently, so keep your thinking cap on!

Unlock the Power of Sight

Ou's goggles can also send Commands to swarms of nanites, granting fantastic, spell-like  abilities. Find and install Commands to—

  • light objects or enemies on fire

  • freeze objects or enemies

  • push or pull objects and enemies

  • push or pull yourself toward/away from objects and enemies

  • shine a light in the dark

  • absorb light to create a shadow to hide in

—and more!

Rich Lore & Complex Characters

Get to know a motley crew of outsiders living in a strange land. Progressing through the game to learn more about not only Ou's neighbors but the mysterious “ancients” hidden deep beneath the surface of the world. What unfathomable secrets do their arcane techno-caverns hold? How did the world Ou inhabits come to be? These questions shape the narrative of MYRIORAMA, a game that asks what happens when there is no hero to stop the sky from falling.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alone on a small vessel, you drift through a silent, fog covered ocean with no clear direction, only the instinct to keep moving forward.

To survive, you must gather what little remains. Scattered debris drifts across the water, remnants of a world long gone. Every piece matters. Every journey into the unknown is a risk.

Wreckage, ruins, and the remains of a drowned world block your path. To move forward, you must leave the safety of your vessel and step into what lies beyond the fog.

Somewhere beyond the fog, there may still be survivors.

If you can keep moving long enough to find them.

Game Features

  • Survival at Sea: Gather floating debris and manage your vessel to stay alive in an endless ocean.

  • Drowned World: Navigate through sunken towns, cities, and forests hidden within dense fog.

  • Progress-Driven Exploration: Leave your vessel to overcome obstacles and continue your journey.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Thick fog, limited visibility, and the decaying remains of a drowned world create constant unease.

  • A Distant Hope: Venture into the unknown and discover whether any survivors remain.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Dance of Y》是一款以律动、节奏与优雅交锋为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在经典 RPG 战斗机制中呈现流畅而富有变化的策略体验。玩家将踏上一段充满韵律感的冒险旅程，通过精准的回合操作指挥角色行动，在攻防转换之间展现属于自己的战斗节拍。

游戏采用传统回合制战斗系统，玩家需要在攻击、防御、技能释放与资源运用之间做出判断。每一回合都如同一次步伐变化，既要把握进攻时机，也要及时调整防守节奏。面对不同敌人与连续挑战，只有合理安排行动顺序并灵活应对局势变化，才能在战斗中保持主动。

随着冒险推进，角色能力将不断成长。玩家可以提升基础属性，强化战斗表现，并根据自身偏好的战斗风格规划成长路线。持续增强的能力与逐渐丰富的战术选择，将让后续战斗拥有更多层次与策略空间。

《Dance of Y》以“舞动对决”的独特氛围诠释经典回合制 RPG 的乐趣，在熟悉的角色成长与战术部署中加入轻盈而鲜明的表现主题。对于喜爱单人 RPG、热衷策略思考与角色培养的玩家而言，这将是一段兼具节奏感与挑战性的冒险旅程。

store_data.about_the_game:
《Beacon of Y》是一款以光芒与指引为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在经典 RPG 战斗机制中融入鲜明的探索氛围与稳健的策略体验。玩家将踏上一段追寻信标的旅程，在清晰而富有节奏感的回合战斗中指挥角色前进，通过每一次行动逐步点亮通往胜利的道路。

游戏采用传统回合制指令战斗系统，玩家需要在攻击、防御、技能释放与资源分配之间做出判断。面对不同类型的敌人与不断升级的挑战，单纯依靠数值优势并不足以取胜，合理观察局势、把握技能时机以及制定稳定的战斗节奏，才是突破难关的关键。

随着冒险不断深入，角色能力也将持续成长。玩家可以提升基础属性，强化战斗表现，并根据自身偏好的策略方向塑造成长路线。每一次强化都会带来新的战术选择，让后续战斗拥有更多变化与可能性。

《Beacon of Y》以“光之引导”为核心意象，为经典回合制 RPG 赋予独特的氛围表达。它既保留了传统角色扮演游戏的成长乐趣与策略深度，也让玩家在一步步前进的过程中体验不断接近目标的满足感，是一款适合喜爱单人冒险与战术思考玩家的作品。

store_data.about_the_game:
《Petal of Y》是一款以花瓣意象与自然韵律为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在经典 RPG 战斗框架中展现柔美而富有张力的冒险体验。玩家将在层层展开的旅途中操控角色，通过回合制指令完成攻击、防御、技能释放与成长规划，在稳定而富有策略性的节奏中感受传统角色扮演游戏的魅力。

游戏采用经典回合制战斗系统，每一次行动都需要谨慎思考。玩家需要根据敌人的状态与战场变化，在进攻与防守之间寻找平衡，并合理安排技能使用时机。看似平静的花瓣之下隐藏着激烈的较量，只有善于判断局势并灵活调整策略，才能在连续战斗中稳步前进。

随着冒险深入，角色将不断成长并获得更强的能力。玩家可以提升基础属性，强化战斗表现，打造更适合自身风格的成长路线。不同阶段的敌人与挑战也将推动玩家持续优化战术，在熟悉的 RPG 机制中体验循序渐进的成就感。

《Petal of Y》以清新鲜明的主题包装经典玩法，让传统回合制战斗拥有更加柔和而独特的表现氛围。对于喜爱单人 RPG、享受策略部署与角色培养的玩家而言，这将是一段值得投入其中的冒险旅程。

store_data.about_the_game:
No sound. No destruction. And yet… everything begins to change.

In Hollow Descent, you enter Ganides, the physical layer sustained by five core crystals.

Years ago, a green sphere descended upon the continent of Baedrish. Shortly after, a strange mist known as The Black Storm began to consume cities and distort reality.

Now, a new sphere has fallen in Escia… and history threatens to repeat itself.

Story & Experience

Take control of multiple characters, each with their own backgrounds and motivations, as they investigate the origin of the anomaly.

Explore cities and unknown regions as corruption spreads, threatening to consume everything in its path.

Complete quests and make choices that directly affect the world… and those around you.

Some allies will change. Others will disappear. Not all will survive your decisions.

Key Features

  • Narrative inspired by tabletop RPG campaigns, with an emphasis on choices and consequences.

  • Multiple playable characters with personal story arcs and unique abilities.

  • Exploration of cities, dungeons, and areas affected by the anomaly.

  • Turn-based tactical combat with strategic options and party management.

  • Main and side quests that influence the story and character relationships.

  • Impactful decisions that alter dialogue, character availability, and lead to multiple endings.

  • Deep lore set within an original universe.

  • Original art and music adapted to a classic RPG style.

Content & Format

  • Free demo: experience the first hour of the adventure and get a feel for the tone, mechanics, and characters.

  • Chapter 1: initial paid release featuring 4–6 hours of complete story content, complex side quests, and meaningful choices with consequences.

  • The full game will be released episodically until the campaign is complete (estimated total length: 50 hours). Each chapter will introduce new areas, characters, and narrative branches; decisions may impact future installments.

As The Black Storm spreads, reality begins to distort… and some will be unable to resist entering it.

The fate of Ganides will depend on your decisions.

Welcome aboard the flagship, Captain! Your mission?

Simple… Keep the Mothership fed, and leave nothing behind. Unlock upgrades to expand your operation and push deeper with every run. This is a piece of cake for you! 

TEAR APART THE PLANETS

Use bombs from your flagship to tear planetary cells apart and reveal the core beneath. Each planet is built from layered structures. Just... watch out for running out of fuel, Captain!

GATHER RESOURCES

Every planetary cell you tear apart drops resources. Haul them back to your Mothership to keep the system running. Each planet has its own resource types, so yes… you’ll need a plan.

UPGRADE YOUR FLEET

100+ permanent upgrades await you in the skill tree, Captain! Upgrade the flagship and Mothership, unlock autonomous units, and deploy wingmen to make runs faster, stronger, and more chaotic.

UNLOCK NEW PLANETS

18 planets, with different layers and various resources, have the same problem: they’re still intact. Choose your targets, expand your reach, keep pushing forward. Some planets are easier. Some… you’ll come back to later.

"The cyberpunk city is restless, exhausting, and never quiet. Even so, people still need somewhere to lean."

S4NCTU4RY is a cyberpunk deckbuilding idle game. Collect cocktail cards, arrange them across a 3×3 grid, and design the perfect synergy. Collect furnishings from across the cyberpunk world and bring your own bar to life.

  • 50+ Cocktail Cards: Collect and upgrade cards, each with its own tags and rarity.

  • Augments & Utility Cards: Specialize your playstyle with cybernetic utility cards earned as you play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set sail into danger, mystery, and dark magic in Seven Seas Jewels 2!

A dark siren named Narissa has cast a cruel curse on Rowan, binding his life to an ancient vow of love for love. With each passing day, the spell drains his strength, pulling him closer to the depths where the curse was born.

Polly, the woman who loves him, refuses to accept this fate. Leaving behind safety and certainty, she sets sail across stormy seas, forgotten islands, and cursed shores in search of a way to break Narissa’s spell. Along the journey, she uncovers relics of old magic, faces supernatural threats, and learns how much love is truly willing to risk.

With 250 handcrafted levels, Seven Seas Jewels 2 invites you on a Match-3 adventure that unfolds alongside Polly’s quest to save Rowan. Each puzzle brings her closer to breaking the curse, revealing new story moments, magical locations, and secrets hidden beneath the waves. Choose Puzzle Mode for a satisfying challenge, or Relaxed Mode to enjoy the journey at your own pace.

Blending engaging puzzles with a heartfelt story, Seven Seas Jewels 2 is an adventure shaped by courage, sacrifice, and devotion.

Every puzzle matters.
Every choice brings hope closer.

Will love be strong enough to break the curse?

  • Story-driven Match-3 adventure

  • A heartfelt tale of love and sacrifice

  • 250 handcrafted Match-3 levels

  • Face 14 foes on your journey

  • Six new gameplay features with unique mechanics

  • 14 Spot the Difference mini-games

  • 13 relaxing picture tile puzzles

  • Fun mini-games like labyrinths, cards, and memory

  • Puzzle Mode or Relaxed Mode play

  • Beautiful, detailed visuals

store_data.about_the_game:
Coinqueror: Luck, Strategy, and Conquest!

Turn your mouse into a sword and your luck into your greatest weapon! Coinqueror is a turn-based strategy game that will drive your friends crazy, where you draw the borders yourself and the outcome of battles is decided by a coin flip.

Draw Your Borders, Take the Risk

Spotted an enemy or a neutral territory? Start your attack by drawing around it with your mouse. Will you attack a small village, or will you try to swallow a massive empire in one move? The choice is yours, but remember; a big bite means a big risk!

Once you draw your attack, it's all up to your luck. Flip the coin!

  • If you win: You conquer the entire area you drew and expand your borders.

  • If you lose: You forfeit a portion of your own lands to the enemy!

Festival Time!

In Chaos mode, a joyful Festival begins every 5 turns! Things change during this special turn:

  • Players cannot attack each other and peace prevails.

  • All attacks on neutral territories are 100% successful! Don't miss this chance to quickly conquer the map and grow!

Play with Friends

Coinqueror is best played with friends! Create a custom room code and battle it out on the same map with up to 4 players. Form alliances, make secret pacts via the diplomacy panel, and stab your best friend in the back when the time comes. Only one person can be the sole ruler of the map!

Chaos Mode: Economy and Walls

If you want to take the game to the next level, Chaos Mode is perfect for you!

  • Economy: You earn gold (Coins) every turn from Castles and Villages on the map.

  • Defensive Walls: Build walls on your borders with the gold you earn (60 Coins). If you lose the coin flip, your walls will be destroyed but your lands will remain yours! Building walls in strategic locations is the key to survival.

Flip the coin. Conquer the world or lose it all. Welcome to Coinqueror!

You're very good at this.                                          

Thirty seconds in, your paws start moving on their own. Your ears track beats you haven't heard yet. Your tail balances against musical phrases two bars ahead. The thinking part of you has left the building. Humans call this flow state.    

Then the staff flips upside down. Your paws know. The camera gets drunk. Your paws know. A fish falls from the rafters. Your paws were already there.                      

 

The melody arrives on time regardless of whether reality is upright.

  - Three moods per level: **Tutorial** (learn), **Play** (score), **Disaster** (transcend)

AUGUST WISEMAN: NO MORE BREAKUPS A fast-paced QTE boss rush with roguelite elements where love isn’t something you say, it’s something you survive. You play as August Wiseman, a high schooler who picked his game over his girlfriend one too many times. So she takes his phone and gives him a simple challenge: reach her at the end of the train if he wants it back. The catch? She, and everyone in her life, are aliens. Friends, family, exes… all waiting in the next car, each with their own way of “testing” you. And for them, love means fighting. The game is presented in a bold comic style with a mix of humor and honesty. Every boss feels ridiculous but they actually have something to say about love and relationships. FEATURES

QTE Combat

It’s all about timing. Miss the moment, and you’re done.

Boss Rush Only

No filler. Just one weird, personal fight after another.

Comic-Style Presentation

Panels, motion, and bold visuals that keep everything moving fast.

Roguelite Progression

Gain permanent upgrades and make each run easier than the last.

It’s funny, until it isn’t.

store_data.about_the_game:
About Thieves

About Thieves is an old-school, first-person dungeon crawler with real-time combat and grid-based movement. Descend through festering sewers, abandoned ruins, and royal dungeons, and loot every corner of them. Gold is experience, and secrets are everywhere. The more you steal, the stronger you get.

Features:

  • Exploration-driven progression: Your main source of XP is treasure. Hunt for secrets, crack open hidden rooms, and fill your pockets. Every coin counts.

  • Real-time grid-based combat: Classic dungeon crawling feel with fast, demanding fights against slimes, giant worms, corrupted Ratkins and worse.

  • Six playable classes with a rogue twist: Forget paladins and wizards. Here, the warrior is a guild strongman, the healer is a shady plague doctor, and the mage is a street illusionist with a knife up her sleeve. Classic fantasy archetypes, reimagined for a crew of thieves.

  • A story bigger than a heist: You went in for the gold. You might just save the entire province. Against your will.

The king hasn't left his castle in months. The people of Ashad are hungry. Someone has to do something, it might as well be someone who gets paid...

Overview
Gold & Brown is a choice-driven visual novel experience set in the harsh yet captivating atmosphere of the medieval era, telling the story of an impossible love and a perilous journey. As a knight, you bind your heart to the fate of a princess, where every decision you make shapes both the course of the story and your own destiny.

Story
A forbidden love blossoms behind the grand walls of a kingdom… Despite the barriers of society, war, and fate, you set out on a dangerous journey to reach the one you love. But this path demands more than courage; it requires wit, strategy, and the right choices.

Gameplay
Gold & Brown blends classic visual novel storytelling with card-based decision mechanics. Every encounter, dialogue, and turning point is shaped by the cards presented to you. These cards are not just choices—they represent risk, reward, and consequence.

What is the story about?

Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. After the death of her loved one, a young woman finds herself trapped in a maze of memories, trying to understand what really happened. By exploring its winding corridors, discovering notes, and unlocking new areas, she gradually reconstructs a chain of events where every new answer reshapes everything she thought she knew.

But the path to the truth will not be easy. To move forward, you will need to solve puzzles, open new passages, and find ways to reach hidden fragments of the past. The maze offers no easy explanations — it leads through broken memories, recurring details, and pieces of the past that only reveal their meaning over time.

And this place is not empty. Enemies roam the depths of the maze, determined to stop you from going any further. The closer you get to the truth, the more dangerous the journey becomes, and the more it feels that your loved one’s final words carried something far heavier than a simple wish to protect her from pain.

Will she reach the end and uncover the full truth? Or will she remain trapped in a world where memory clings to the past more tightly than reality itself?

Key features:

  • Explore an atmospheric maze of memories

  • Uncover the story through notes and hidden fragments of the past

  • Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and reach key parts of the story

  • Face enemies that stand in your way as you move deeper into the maze

  • Experience a narrative where each new discovery changes your understanding of the story

  • Immerse yourself in a tense psychological atmosphere with a strong focus on storytelling

  • Different zones bring different dangers.

  • Give your character a unique style

  • Upgrade your abilities to withstand dangerous zones in the maze

WHAT IS THE TRUE MEANING OF THE MAZE?

store_data.about_the_game:
Stone to Stove is a medieval-themed management game that combines daytime economic management with nighttime survival defense. During the day, you earn money by serving people, and at night, you use that income to build defense systems. The decisions you make each day determine whether you survive the next night.

The main goal of the game is to grow a small settlement into a self-sustaining base over time. You can generate income and increase your earnings by serving travelers quickly and accurately. However, every choice comes at a cost: if you take risks to earn more, you might neglect your defenses.

When night falls, enemies attack your base. You must counter these attacks by building defenses with your earnings and wisely planning your settlement.

Stone to Stove offers a deep strategy experience built on a simple cycle: earn, invest, and survive. Each new day brings greater opportunities, while the nights become more deadly.

Key Features:

Earn by day, defend by night: a cycle combining economy and survival

Build your base as you wish with a free-laying system

Different customer types and earning strategies

Risk-reward based resource gathering system

Defense building mechanics

Increasingly difficult enemy waves every day

In this world where every decision matters, how far can you go?

store_data.about_the_game:
THE ULTIMATE SPEED LIMIT AWAITS Start from a dead stop in the vast emptiness of space. Your objective is absolute: push your ship's velocity to 299,792,458 m/s and breach the speed of light. Lightspeed is a focused incremental simulation where physics, resource management, and rapid progression collide.

HARVEST, ACCELERATE, REPEAT Take direct manual control of your ship's collection arrays. Hover over drifting cosmic particles and exotic substances to scoop up fuel, watching your HUD tick upward as your velocity, acceleration, and percentage of lightspeed climb.

But momentum is fleeting. When your fuel inevitably runs dry, your velocity zeroes out. The downtime during refueling is your crucial window to access a sprawling upgrade tree, turning every hard stop into your next massive launch.

SYSTEMS MANAGEMENT & FRICTION Going fast isn't just about burning fuel; it's about engineering survival. You must balance multiple tiered systems to maintain your momentum:

  • Thermal Dynamics: Engines overheat if pushed too hard for too long. Invest in tiered cooling systems to extend your burn times.

  • Kinetic Shielding: The faster you travel, the more dangerous space becomes. Constantly upgrade your hull shielding to survive high-velocity cosmic impacts.

  • Velocity-Gated Matter: The rarest, highest-energy particles can only be seen and harvested while traveling at extreme speeds, forcing you to constantly push your limits to reach the next tier of technology.

DEEP INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION

  • Tiered Technology: Progress through increasingly complex tiers of particles, magnetic collection arrays, and propulsion engines.

  • Hypnotic Visuals: Enjoy a clean, minimalist aesthetic where different cosmic substances feature distinct, satisfying visual effects as they are collected.

  • Active Anomalies: Stay alert during your runs for random, high-density fuel tanks and anomalous particle clusters that require quick reflexes to capture for massive boosts.

  • Comprehensive Telemetry: Track every metric of your journey with a detailed HUD tracking velocity (m/s), distance traveled, total mass collected, fuel reserves, and shield integrity.

store_data.about_the_game:
The king must eat.

In this medieval incremental game, you begin with a few manual food stations and a simple kitchen. Click to process ingredients, combine them into dishes, and keep production moving long enough to turn humble supplies into meals fit for the crown.

As the days pass, your workshop grows into a sprawling food machine. Unlock new stations, automate old ones, improve ingredient quality, and discover better ways to turn basic ingredients into more valuable dishes. Better ingredients lead to better meals, and better meals bring better pay.

Each day is about preparation. Build your output, refine your production chains, and fill the kitchen before night falls. Each night, the king and his guests consume what you created and reward your work.

Then the court offers a darker path.

After enough progress, you can serve the king his last dish and trigger a prestige reset. Lose most of your current operation, keep powerful permanent bonuses, and begin again with faster production, stronger efficiency, and a new plan for the next reign.

Features

• Start with manual stations and automate your kitchen step by step.

• Process ingredients through layered medieval food production chains.

• Mix ingredients into a growing variety of dishes.

• Improve ingredient quality to increase the value of every meal.

• Play through a day-and-night loop of cooking, serving, and earning.

• Feed the king daily and prepare larger feasts for noble guests.

• Use a prestige system that resets progress for lasting upgrades.

• Optimize each run and push your royal kitchen further every cycle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Starry Station, a station that took children to space. Visit an old abandoned place called 'Starry Station'. Even though it has gone through a very ruined state after the shutdown some life still seems to lurk beneath the shadows.

A place with children excited for their first day at camp now rots with their and other's corpses. A place where the music has been frozen and replaced with nature's dark ambient creeks. Creatures that have rotted and lived through the horrors still walk through these ruined walls.

Even from the fame everything is unpredictable and no one knows the future leading Starry Station to close due to a disregarded event. However, you come back only a year later to find your missed loved one who was a highly regarded co-worker.

Cosmo & Her Friends:

Introducing one of Starry Station's most revolutionizing creations, "Cosmo Paw". a child's best friend. You can communicate with Cosmo through a newly founded cosmetic item "The Cosmo Radio". The Cosmo Radio was designed to look like a walkie-talkie mixed with a new screen with your favorite pal from Starry.

However, there is more than just one, there are four more in the earth wave of the creatures. But something has happened to the other four, some have gone rogue, and something has happened to their poor souls to make them act the way they do.

Exploring This Ruined Station:

Even if the place is ruined and starting to rot, your best friend Cosmo is always on your side. Explore Starry while finding new beasts, new and cute collectibles, and talking with your new silly best friend. Could you make sure to uncover the many hidden and secret areas that you were not meant to see?

Finally, find your way to a hidden and backup spacecraft to make your way out and find a new planet to explore to see what happened to this place and where your loved one has gone.

store_data.about_the_game:
A joke masquerading as a game. (The game is pretty fun too.)

You are the messiah. The miracles are wrong. The water becomes boxed wine. You walk under the sea instead of on it. Your disciples follow you around saying the wrong things. Roman soldiers drain your faith. You have to keep performing miracles to stay alive. Jesus lasted 33 years. You'll be lucky to last five minutes.

The Perfect Gift

Know someone who takes Jesus a little too seriously? This is for them. Know someone who genuinely thinks they're the Messiah? This is definitely for them. Messiah Simulator is a loving, blasphemous, surprisingly tender reminder that being the Messiah is impossible—and that's kind of the point.

Give it to your ultra-religious friend who needs to lighten up. Gift it to the person in your life who's convinced they're here to save everyone else. They'll figure out which one they are by the end of the first run. You can't fix them. But you can buy them a game where they get crucified and see how long they lasted.

Features:

  • Turn water into boxed wine (with a spigot)

  • Flip money-changer tables and watch the coins scatter

  • Throw unlimited loaves and fishes

  • Be followed by disciples with distinct personalities and terrible advice

  • Evade Roman Guards who slowly, creepily hunt you across the map

  • Watch your faith tick down as the Romans close in

  • Get crucified. See your survival time. Try again.

Delightfully blasphemous. Surprisingly tender. Buy it for the joke. Keep playing because it's actually fun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend your stars against an invading army of monsters led by a powerful Demon King.

In Glowbot Tower Defense, you must strategically place glowing robotic defenders along twisting space paths to stop waves of enemies before they overrun your galaxy. Each Glowbot has unique abilities, from energy blasts to chain lightning and explosive attacks, allowing you to build powerful defenses and adapt to increasingly chaotic waves.

Plan your layout, upgrade your towers, and survive intense battles as enemies grow stronger and faster. Only the smartest defenses will hold.

Key Features

Strategic Tower Placement
Carefully position your Glowbots along the path to maximize efficiency and stop enemies before they reach your base.

Unique Glowbot Abilities
Deploy a variety of towers, including:

  • Energy-based attackers

  • Chain lightning bots

  • Area-damage explosives

  • Support units that boost nearby towers

Online Leaderboards

Compete against players around the world on fully integrated online Steam leaderboards for every map. Your highest round survived is permanently recorded, allowing you to climb the global rankings and prove your defensive mastery.

Compare strategies, challenge friends, and see how far your defenses can truly go against endless waves of enemies.

Competitive Leaderboard Achievements

Glowbot Tower Defense features global online Steam leaderboards for every map, along with a set of prestigious competitive achievements for the most skilled defenders.

Leaderboard Achievements Include:

  • Reach the Top 10 on any map leaderboard

  • Reach the Top 10 on all map leaderboards

  • Become the #1 ranked player on any map

  • Become the #1 ranked player across all maps

These achievements are intentionally designed to be extremely challenging and highly competitive. Rankings can constantly change as players discover stronger strategies, optimize tower placements, and survive increasingly difficult waves. Only the greatest defenders in the galaxy will secure the top positions and earn these rare accomplishments.

Challenging Enemy Waves
Face multiple enemy types. From fast attackers to heavily armored units and powerful bosses that will test your defenses.

Multiple Space-Themed Maps
Defend your stars across vibrant, neon-filled environments with unique layouts and strategies.

Upgrade & Optimize
Earn diamonds, upgrade your towers, and refine your strategy to handle increasingly difficult waves.

Fast-Paced Gameplay Options
Speed up the action and push your defenses to the limit as chaos fills the screen.

Can You Survive the Invasion?

The Demon King’s forces are relentless. Build, adapt, and defend your galaxy before it’s too late.

store_data.about_the_game:
Good news:
The protracted struggle between the cult and the corporation has come to an end.

Bad news:
All the chickens have turned into mad chickens!

Creatures have become gigantic and ferocious. Defensive weapons—now attacking everyone.

What happened? How will you survive?

1. Scavenger Everything

Food, water, ammunition, gasoline, spare parts—every supply point could be a trap, or it could be your only hope.

Don't throw away the trash either; some trash can be fermented into gasoline or used to create useful/powerful items.

2. Upgrade Your Equipment and Tank

Strengthen your weapons and eggshells to survive longer.
Upgrade your tank's armor, modify its main gun, optimize its engine—turn this tank into your mobile fortress.

3. Uncover the Truth

Follow the clues, defeat the mutant leader and Deep Guard, piece together the origins of the "Mad Chicken Incident"—then, stop the world from collapsing further and escape!

Game Systems:

Vehicle Equipment System:

Main Gun - The primary method of attack, balancing weight, ammunition capacity, and power.

Secondary Gun - Less powerful but lighter, capable of carrying a large amount of ammunition.

Special Weapon - A bulky weapon with a small ammunition capacity but immense power.

Engine: Determines the vehicle's load capacity

Special Armor: Equipping these makes your vehicle immune to missiles/lasers/poison gas/freeze

Engine Load Capacity - Vehicle Weight = Maximum Armor Load

Modification System:

Modify your vehicle's weapons to make them more efficient

Modify your vehicle parts to increase load capacity

Modify your vehicle chassis to allow for more attachments

Modify your items/helmets/shells to make it easier to survive after dismounting

Prayer System:

If a shrine is built and suitable offerings are made, a special bonus can be obtained for a certain period of time.

Hardcore Survival System:

Constantly monitoring hunger and thirst levels to maintain basic physiological functions is fundamental to survival.

So we made Foxwood. A cozy survival game designed to be relaxing and approachable.

A small world where curiosity is rewarded, not punished.

Play on your own, or share the experience with someone new to the genre.

And maybe… a first step toward bigger adventures later.

EXPLORE MANY CITIES

Set course to neighboring cities and afar, find promising merchants to trade with.

  • Diversity: Find human, dwarf and fairy merchants.

  • City Requests: Accept and complete city requests for rewards, or abandon for resources.

TRADE FOR WEALTH

Set course to neighboring cities and afar, find promising merchants to trade with.

  • Warehouse: Hand pick your trades for maximum efficiency with limited space

  • Matched trades: Access the auto matched trades between merchants

GUILD YOUR WAY

Explore common and character specific guild buildings

  • Relics: Find relics with your adventurer guild

  • Recruit Army: Recruit army from your barracks

KEEP A LOW PROFILE

Time is always ticking. As you build your empire in the shadows, the crown is searching for you.

  • Weekly Pressure: At the end of every week, Royal Scouts survey the land, increasing the global Suspicion Gauge.

  • Bribe the Scouts: Use your wealth strategically to pay off the scouts, pausing the suspicion meter to buy yourself crucial time.

  • Inevitable Conflict: When Suspicion inevitably hits 100%, your location is compromised, forcing an immediate tactical battle against the royal armies.

MANAGE YOUR ARMY

You cannot win a war with gold alone. Build and maintain a standing army capable of repelling royal attacks. Balance your forces across three distinct unit classes:

Final combat is designed with Direct and Counter interactions.

  • Might: Heavy, frontline bruisers with varying direct and counter abilities.

  • Swift: Rapid-striking flanking units with varying direct and counter abilities.

  • Arcane: Magic units with varying direct and counter abilities.

RALLY THE NOBILITY

As the rightful head of House Fairheart, you can leverage your status and growing wealth to turn the King's court against him.

  • Gather Support: Rally other noble houses to your cause before a battle begins.

  • Cripple the Enemy: Successfully gaining noble support directly weakens the enemy army's stats and troop numbers, turning the tide of war in your favor before swords ever clash.

THREE PLAYABLE CHARACTERS

  • Garrick (Human)

  • Brenda (Dwarf)

  • Olis (Fairy)

store_data.about_the_game:
IDENTITY

Agent 22, you have been assigned a new mission for T.U.N.C.H. You will infiltrate Unitas, assume a new identity, and relay intelligence.

You will operate as a repair technician at a military base.

MISSION OVERVIEW

During your shift, you will repair the devices brought to you by soldiers.

These devices will belong to military personnel and will play a critical role in our intelligence network.

You will have a limited amount of time to repair each device. If you are too slow, you will draw suspicion.

CORE GAMEPLAY

The devices you receive will have multiple layers and require different methods to fix. Identify the correct approach for each one and complete the repair.

During this process, you will encounter minigames with various puzzle mechanics. These minigames include an error margin—making too many mistakes will affect the status of your mission.

INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM

Each day, you must plant a listening device in one of the units. Every evening, we will inform you which device to target.

You will plant the bug and, later at home, tune your radio to its frequency and record what you hear.

Transmit any valuable information to us using Morse code.

DECISIONS AND CONSEQUENCES

Work with precision during repairs and avoid drawing suspicion.

There will be moments when you must make critical decisions—make the right ones and minimize errors. Analyze the situation and act in our favor.

RISK AND OUTCOME

The information you provide is vital to our position in the war.

Remember, you are alone. You are responsible for your actions and your mistakes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Capybara Bingo is a fast-paced, cozy party bingo game where up to 8 players manage 1–6 bingo cards simultaneously, racing to stamp called numbers and claim bingo before anyone else.

But call it wrong? You pay the price.

Classic Bingo. Cozy Chaos.

Numbers fly, cards pile up, and the good panic of scanning 6 cards at once is exactly the kind of chaos that makes everyone at the table laugh. Stamp any square at any time — bingo is only yours if you can prove it.

Key Features

  • Single-player vs 7 unique NPC capybaras, or online multiplayer for 2–8 players
  • Manage 1–6 bingo cards simultaneously
  • 9 round types: Regular, Double, Four Corners, Full Card, X-Shape, T-Shape, Postage Stamp, Outside Frame, and Blackout Speed
  • Chaos ability system — disrupt other players with power-ups earned by stamping
  • Earn Capy Tokens and unlock capybara characters, dotters, table skins, and more

How to Play

Numbers are called automatically. Stamp squares as they're called across all your cards. When you've got a winning pattern, hit your bingo key.

One More Round

Short sessions, low stakes, high laughs. Capybara Bingo is the bingo game that's actually fun to play with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Master the Void, Defy the Gravity]

Alpha Star blends classic arcade shoot-'em-up thrills with a dynamic physics-based environment. It's not just about dodging bullets—it's about surviving the space-time distortions of massive black holes that pull everything into their grasp.

🚀 Key Features

  • Dynamic Space Battlefield: Experience a battlefield that reacts to physics. Encounter Black Holes that warp the trajectory of every projectile. Use their gravitational pull to your advantage or fight to stay outside the event horizon.

  • Evolving Threat Levels: Progress through 10 distinct mission phases. Face the "Red Storm" of high-velocity Super Bullets and dodge relentless volleys of seeker missiles as the sector's difficulty spikes.

  • Strategic Ship Upgrades: After every wave, choose from 3 randomized upgrade cards. Will you boost your Photon Engine for speed, deploy a Chrono Field to slow enemies, or prioritize the Rapid Recharge of your shields?

  • Dual-Layer Defense: Master the synergy between your ship’s hull and its Auto-Regenerating Shields. Knowing when to engage and when to retreat for a shield recharge is the key to survival.

  • Atmospheric Sci-Fi Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the void with a haunting 80s-inspired dark synth-wave soundtrack that evolves with the intensity of the combat.

✨ Special Thanks & Credits

[ SOUND & MUSIC ]

  • Universfield - Dark 80s Sci-Fi Atmosphere

  • AtlasAudio - Ambient Cinematic

  • NastelBom - Cinematic Ambient

  • SLD Audio - Sci-Fi and Cyberpunk Music Pack

[ VISUAL ASSETS ]

  • NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center / Jeremy Schnittman (Special thanks for the scientific visualization of black hole environments)

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Start with a small, worn-down roadside motel and turn it into a profitable business. Manage rooms, serve guests, repair damage, clean up messes, and invest your earnings into upgrades that increase value and attract better customers.

Built as a solo passion project from scratch, this motel management simulator combines hands-on tasks, progression systems, and business management in one experience.

Manage Your Motel

Take control of the full guest experience from check-in to checkout.

Assign customers to available rooms, set prices based on room quality, upgrades, and cleanliness, then collect payments after their stay. Keep rooms in top condition to earn better rewards and tips.

Poorly maintained rooms lose value over time and are more likely to become damaged or dirty.

Clean, Repair, Repeat

Every room needs attention. After guests leave, inspect the damage and restore everything before the next booking.

Handle tasks such as:

  • Cleaning trash and messes

  • Replacing light bulbs

  • Repairing switches

  • Fixing damaged devices

  • Cleaning toilets

  • Restoring room condition

The better you maintain your motel, the more money you can earn.

Upgrade Every Room

Improve your rooms with furniture, appliances, and useful add-ons to permanently increase rental value.

Each room supports multiple upgrade slots, allowing you to customize layouts and create higher-tier accommodations.

Possible upgrades include:

  • Television

  • Microwave

  • Game console

  • Intercom

  • Coffee maker

  • Water dispenser

  • Towels

  • Air conditioner

  • Stove

Shop & Expand

Buy supplies and upgrades in physical stores early in the game, then unlock remote ordering through your phone or laptop for faster management later. Plan purchases carefully and keep your motel stocked with everything needed to stay operational.

Upgrade Your Character

Use the special reception TV to unlock player bonuses and improve your efficiency.

Possible upgrades include:

  • Higher room rental income

  • More inventory space

  • Faster movement speed

  • Extra rewards for repairs

Build Storage & Organize Supplies

Use the warehouse behind reception to build shelves and organize your growing business.

Create better storage systems to hold cleaning products, spare parts, furniture, and more.

Optional Side Income

Take a break from motel work and grow potted plants in the warehouse for extra profit.

A small optional system for players who enjoy additional progression and cozy side activities.

Solo Passion Project!

This is my first game, fully created solo from scratch. Every system is being built with care, with the goal of delivering a polished and rewarding management experience.

I hope all of you will have at least a little fun playing it. And if there are things you don’t like, or something you feel could be better, I hope you’ll give me the chance to improve it and make the game better with your feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
SIT OR DIE is a 3D multiplayer party game with a dark and suspenseful twist. As prisoners trapped by a mad warden, you are forced to play a deadly game of musical chairs.

Core Game Mechanics:

Music stops, time to grab a chair.Sitting does not necessarily mean you are safe.There's a chance to turn things around even while standing.

Every round is different
Over 30 game modes are randomly combined in each match. You never know what comes next—react fast, trust your luck, or outplay others.
(Demo includes 10 modes.)

NEW Skill: Push and Kick.

We listened to the players' feedback and decided to add more interactivity to the musical chairs phase. You can push away your fellow inmate competing for a chair, or kick them down.

Note that both actions have a limited number of uses, so use them carefully to maximize your chances of survival.

Not enough players? Add AI
Supports 1–12 players. If fewer than 6 players join, you can add AI prisoners up to 12. They compete, eliminate, solve tasks… and can be even more cunning than real players.

More Modes.

From the basic "musical chairs" game, there are over 30 different modes, so you can never guess what you'll face in the next round.

Don't let your guard down; the situation could turn around at any time.

FAKE chair or TRUE chair ？

Faced with a mix of real and fake chairs, do you try them one by one, or wait for your fellow inmates to finish?

More modes will be revealed soon!

Try your best to survive.

Become a ghost after elimination (Feature under development).
Once eliminated, you turn into a ghost. Take revenge on those who defeated you—or prank your friends and drag them down with you.

Can you survive to the end and claim the throne of thorns?

"I am trapped in this miniature world. Please, help me."

When you awaken, a goddess speaks these words to you.
There may be no way out—but there is no other choice.

You take control of a rabbit and set out to collect five medals scattered across this world.

  • Explore a roughly 1 km-wide open field

  • Find medals hidden throughout the world and return them to the goal

  • No enemies, but unstable platforms, environmental hazards, and deadly falls stand in your way

  • Practice features let you retry difficult sections as many times as you like

Place respawn points almost anywhere.
Learn, retry, and overcome each challenge at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the minimalist world of Lightfold, the key to unraveling puzzles lies at the border of light and dark. Playing as a little cat in this purely geometric space, you will move light sources and obstacles to shape shadows, engaging in a satisfying mental workout of visual and spatial logic.

Core Gameplay: Sokoban Meets Silhouette Puzzles

In Lightfold, your ultimate goal is the "shape." You must simultaneously manipulate two distinct elements: illuminating light sources and light-blocking blocks. By precisely controlling the distance and angle between them, you will use the principles of projection to piece together and overlap specific target shadow patterns on the ground or walls.

Game Features

  • Dual Puzzle-Solving Mechanics: You must carefully plan the cat's path to avoid dead ends, while simultaneously visualizing how shadows will stretch, shrink, or merge as the relative positions of the lights and blocks change.

  • Intuitive Shadow Puzzles: There are no complex text tutorials. Observe the target silhouette and reverse-engineer the correct positions for the light sources and blocks. Every step you take provides immediate and realistic visual feedback from the dynamically shifting light and shadow.

  • Pure Minimalist Aesthetics: Clean geometric shapes, high-contrast lighting, and tranquil ambient sounds. Free from cluttered UI elements, the game allows you to fully immerse yourself in a state of pure puzzle-solving flow alongside the little cat.

store_data.about_the_game:
A fast paced bullet heaven FPS played with just the mouse where your speed is your fire rate.

As a member of the Hypervibers you will complete missions for the Hypervibers fighting against inhuman hordes in the Dronelord's Domain to ultimately take down the Dronelord.

Accelerate, glide and surf across procedurally generated zones. Ramp off of the terrain to fly through the air raining down bullets from above, leveling up to fill the screen with bullets.

Features

  • Mouse only control scheme so you can sit back and enjoy a snack while you play.

  • Automatic weapons triggered by movement conditions such as landing from the air.

  • A new fast paced take on the movement and positioning gameplay of the bullet heaven genre.

  • A choice of characters to play, each starting with one weapon and a unique movement ability triggered by the scroll wheel.

  • Fight waves of drones across a variety of procedurally generated levels.

  • Automatic targeting so you can focus on movement.

  • In game guide with detailed explanations of mechanics and controls.

  • Complete runs across 3 zones lasting roughly 8 minutes each.

  • Level up to choose between weapons, stat upgrades from cyberchips and upgrades to your existing loadout.

  • Find the cargo crate in each level to unlock bonus stat upgrades or add additional weapons and cyberchips to your loadout.

Story

In a distant future in a distant place there lived a man who ran a simple delivery business. One day he decided to amass a fleet of drones to make the job easier for himself and lower his operating costs. As he amassed drones he became more isolated, never traveling far from his warehouse, anything he needed he could deliver to himself. Over time he grew to see his automatons as companions, then friends and finally equals. He'd begun manufacturing them himself, learning about robotics and even cybernetics until one day he took the plunge turning himself into a cyborg, losing sight of his initial motivations in the process and yearning only to cover the surface of the planet with as many of his friends as possible. Humans no longer mattered to him and so his drones were fitted with mechanisms to erase them from existence.

Cyborgs weren't uncommon in this time and place and as the Dronelord's horde grew a small resistance force of augmented humans grew. They were more selective than the Dronelord choosing to optimise their bodies instead of replacing the vital parts that made them human. They installed cyberchips in a special interface port they had designed and created a wireless connection to the hoverboards that were the common mode of transport. When the Dronelord began to attack humans these cyborgs known as Hypervibers entered the lands around his warehouse. Most regions had been bled dry, left barren, covered in metal plating or exposed wastes of lava where mining processes had weakened the planet's crust. Few areas had grass and even those were devoid of living beings.

Join the Hypervibers to embark on reconnaissance missions, scouting new zones in the dronelords domain. As you progress you will slowly make progress destroying key Dronelord infrastructure and creating a path to finally take down the Dronelord in the fortress that was once his warehouse.

Controls

This game can be played entirely with Mouse movement and left and right click.

There is also controller support using the left and right trigger and left analogue stick to match the mouse controls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Upper Echelons.

Nova Impact is an adrenaline-fueled 2D Space Shooter RPG (SSRPG) where survival is your only path to glory. You are a Zenith, an elite licensed pilot taking part in humanity’s ultimate combat simulation. But in this arena, you are the ultimate prize.

Relentless waves of unlicensed challengers, known as the Trackers, will hunt you down like a pack to steal your license. Your mission? Outmaneuver the swarm, rack up kills, and prove you are the #1 champion.

UNINTERRUPTED ACTION: PRE-PLAN YOUR BUILD

Say goodbye to menus that break your flow. In Nova Impact, the action never stops! Plan your ship's upgrade path before you enter the arena. As you destroy Trackers and gain XP, your ship automatically levels up and deploys your pre-selected enhancements. Focus entirely on dodging, shooting, and surviving the swarm.

EARN CREDITS & V.O.I.D. POINTS

Every single kill in the arena is tracked. At the end of each run, your combat performance is converted into two crucial resources: Credits and V.O.I.D. points. Spend your hard-earned Credits to purchase powerful modules that permanently reinforce your ship's capabilities. Meanwhile, accumulate V.O.I.D. points (Virtual Orbit & Interstellar Duels) to climb the division leaderboards and prove your worth to the League.

CLIMB THE LEAGUE & DUEL THE ELITE

You start at the bottom of the Zenith ladder, but your ambition doesn't stop there. As you survive longer and push your limits, you will unlock new routes in the League. Once you reach the top of the ranks, prepare for the ultimate challenge: intense, 1-on-1 boss fights against rival Zeniths to claim their spot.

A LIVING, EVOLVING COSMOS

Fight over a sleek, tactical Hex-Grid while the universe comes to life beneath you. Thanks to a stunning multi-layered parallax system, watch breathtaking nebulas form and massive planets materialize in the deep space background as the simulation intensifies.

  • Fast-Paced SSRPG Gameplay: A perfect blend of classic arcade space shooting and deep RPG progression.

  • Zero-Pause Leveling: Pre-plan your build and enjoy uninterrupted combat as your ship upgrades automatically.

  • The Tracker Swarm: Survive against massive, diverse waves of desperate challengers hunting you down.

  • Deep Customization & Ranking: Convert your arena kills into Credits to buy permanent ship modules, and accumulate V.O.I.D. points to climb the competitive ladder.

  • Epic 1v1 Boss Duels: Climb the division ranks and defeat rival Zeniths to become the #1 pilot.

  • Dynamic Environments: Experience a gorgeous, multi-layered background that evolves as you fight.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a detailed map featuring numerous locations and a dynamic day-night cycle. Every corner is filled with interactive elements that pull you deeper into the unique provincial atmosphere.

Along the way, you will meet three girls, each with her own distinct personality, struggles, and hobbies. To succeed, you must find a unique approach to each of them and navigate their individual questlines.

Beyond romantic interests, you can build meaningful connections with friends, relatives, and a diverse cast of characters, each featuring their own unique personality and dedicated questline. The game is packed with interactive depth: from shopping for various items and engaging in micromanagement gameplay to branching dialogues where your choices truly shape the unfolding narrative.

This isn’t an attempt to reconstruct reality, but rather to capture a specific mood. It’s an echo of an era when cities were less polished, yet somehow felt more alive. Today, the streets are cleaner, the facades brighter, and the spaces more convenient. And yet, the memory holds onto the warmth of those courtyards, stairwells, and vacant lots where an entire generation grew up.

Always Summer Out Here is a journey into that very feeling. It’s a place that never truly existed, but one that everyone will recognize.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jianghu Cangfeng is a martial arts turn-based party-building roguelike RPG set in a dangerous jianghu world.

Lead your heroes into mysterious realms filled with battles, random events, treasure, rest points, and difficult choices. Every step consumes supplies, and every encounter tests your planning, martial arts setup, equipment choices, and resource management.

The game features techniques from multiple martial arts sects, as well as wandering jianghu styles. Skills differ in damage types, cooldowns, energy costs, buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling effects. Build each character around their role, combine techniques with equipment, and adapt your strategy to different enemies.

During each expedition, you may gain temporary raid perks, equipment rewards, and event outcomes that change your run. Choosing when to take risks, when to conserve supplies, and how to prepare for key battles is central to survival.

This is not a game about simply overpowering enemies with numbers. It is about making choices under pressure, shaping your martial arts build, and slowly forging a party that can survive the hidden dangers of the jianghu.

Key Features:

- Martial arts turn-based combat

- Party building with multiple playable characters

- Techniques from different sects and wandering jianghu styles

- Character growth shaped by skills, equipment, and temporary raid perks

- Expedition-based exploration with supply management

- Random events, treasure, rest points, and combat encounters

- Combat mechanics including buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling

- Strategic choices that shape each run

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your new job at Bowl City High School! You could have sworn the place has been abandoned your whole life, but you need the paycheck. The teachers there do get a bit quirky at night, so you must be on guard. Don't worry though, Mr. Phone is there to give you instructions to survive the night, and with more than 8 teachers to keep track of, you must listen carefully: use the cameras to check the teacher's positions and plan ahead, complete your homework to stop Mr. Math, block off vents to keep the teachers at bay, and use hiding spots to sneakily avoid the teachers. The school runs on limited power, so limiting consumption is key, and Micheal Science doesn't appreciate your power usage, so make sure to keep your usage down to a minimum. Most importantly, however... you must stop Mr. Gut... 

Once you've made it through the first 6 nights, overtime is an option, but it is unadvised due to extreme safety hazards. Other nights are available as well, like the custom night for extra challenges and rewards.


Can you survive five nights at Bowl City High School?

This game was created using Godot game engine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bloomtide

Every morning, a 9×9 board reshuffles from your filling pool. Apples, lightning, hawks, cherry blossoms — what ends up next to what decides how much you earn today. You have one job: pay the rent.

But the real game is turning "enough" into an explosion.

Core Loop

  • The board reshuffles every day — same pool, new layout. Adjacent relationships create new synergies each run.

  • Event queue resolution — growth, devour, movement, decay, burst. One event triggers the next, chaining into exponential payoffs.

  • Daily 3-pick (CoreItem) — add a new symbol type, or weight an existing one. Slowly bend the random board toward your archetype.

  • Rent at the end of each cycle — survive the rent check, then pick a BuffItem or EffectItem to amplify whatever build is forming. Cycles get longer as you progress; rent keeps climbing.

Three Strategy Layers

  • Board (CoreItem) — define what can show up on your board.

  • Environment (EffectItem) — Snowy Mountain accelerates growth. Deep Sea strengthens devouring. Match your archetype.

  • Equipment (BuffItem) — multiplier wands, xmult rings. Take a working build and break the numbers.

"I went growth-fruits → I need the snowy mountain → I need the multiplier wand." When the build clicks, you feel the machine working for you.

Two Modes

  • Campaign — 12 rent payments to win. A guided ramp through every mechanic.

  • Endless — rent stops scaling at run 14. All items unlocked. No survival pressure — just "how far can my build push the numbers?"

Why You Won't Stop

  • Numbers go up — hard. A modifier pipeline (chips_add → chips_mul → mult_add → mult_mul → xmult) takes a good hand from dozens to millions in a single resolve.

  • Hidden combos to discover. A hawk eating a snake poisons the field. A cherry blossom hitting zero blows up everyone. Hundreds of cross-item interactions waiting.

  • Every run is different. Archetypes × environments × equipment = a vast space of viable builds.

  • Simple rules, emergent depth. Each item is readable at a glance. The combinations are not.

  • Stylized symbol art. Every piece is readable at a glance — high information density, zero recognition cost.

store_data.about_the_game:
A decade and almost 1 million mobile downloads later, Skillful Pixel Dungeon comes to Steam.

Dive into a challenging roguelike RPG where every run tells a different story. Choose from four distinct classes, each offering unique active and passive abilities that open up multiple playstyles. Whether you favor brute force, precision, or strategy, no two journeys feel the same.

Descend through 25 procedural generated levels filled with danger, secrets, and loot, culminating in five formidable bosses that will test your mastery. With ever-changing dungeons and meaningful build variety, Skillful Pixel Dungeon delivers a fresh, high-stakes experience every time you play.

Pick one of 4 classes

Warrior

The warrior relies on brute strength and toughness in combat. His skills are close combat oriented leveraging melee weapons and high durability. The gladiators excel in single melee combat while berserkes are all around strong and can attack multiple enemies in one attack.

Mage

The mage relies on magic and minions to battle the forces of evil. The battle mage subclass boosts wand damage and allows using mana to absorb damage while the warlock turns his minions into even more feared beasts.

Rogue

The rogue relies on stealth and speed. Some rogues are so fast they can create copies of themselves while others excel in stealth allowing them to instantly take out sleeping enemies.

Huntress

The huntress is the weakest of all physically but her ranged skills make sure no enemy comes to close. The huntress's knowledge with the bow gives her access to skills like fletching and kneeshot. The warden is capable of shooting two arrows in one go as well as hunting animals passively for food. Snipers are capable of putting enemies to sleep and even attaching explosives to arrows.

Mercenaries

The hero is not alone on his quest. He can hire one of five mercenaries to aid him on his quest. The mercs come with basic equipment that may need replacement as the levels get tougher.

Brute

The toughest of mercenaries. A brute is slow but capable of soaking a lot of damage. He is also of capable of carrying any item in the carry slot.

Wizard

The wizard is physically weak but can summon rats in combat.

Thief

The thief is very fast and relies on stealth. His attack may poison enemies.

Archer

The archer does not have a lot of health so she attacks from distance. She has a habit of attacking kneecaps.

Archer Maiden

The elite version of archer mercs. Archer maidens are more expensive but worth the investment.

Rogue

The rogue relies on stealth and speed. Some rogues are so fast they can create copies of themselves while others excel in stealth allowing them to instantly take out sleeping enemies.

Huntress

The huntress is the weakest of all physically but her ranged skills make sure no enemy comes to close. The huntress's knowledge with the bow gives her access to skills like fletching and kneeshot. The warden is capable of shooting two arrows in one go as well as hunting animals passively for food. Snipers are capable of putting enemies to sleep and even attaching explosives to arrows.

Mercenaries

The hero is not alone on his quest. He can hire one of five mercenaries to aid him on his quest. The mercs come with basic equipment that may need replacement as the levels get tougher.

Brute

The toughest of mercenaries. A brute is slow but capable of soaking a lot of damage. He is also of capable of carrying any item in the carry slot.

Wizard

The wizard is physically weak but can summon rats in combat.

Thief

The thief is very fast and relies on stealth. His attack may poison enemies.

Archer

The archer does not have a lot of health so she attacks from distance. She has a habit of attacking kneecaps.

Archer Maiden

The elite version of archer mercs. Archer maidens are more expensive but worth the investment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Idle Defense throws you into a hypnotic, minimalist arena where neon cubes of every color surge toward you. You can crush them yourself or build an automatic defense grid that grinds them down while you strategize.

This isn't just another idle game. It's a deep, neon-soaked loop of progression, prestige, and pure destruction.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dual-Mode Destruction – Play actively by smashing cubes with your mouse, or go idle by purchasing automated turrets that fire non-stop. Both paths are viable. Both are rewarding.

  • 7 Cube Colors = 7 Currencies – Each color has its own resource, its own upgrade tree, and its own behavior. All seven can swarm your screen at once. Manage the chaos.

  • 25 Base Upgrades – Split across three core pillars:
    Cube upgrades, Idle turret upgrades, Mouse upgrades.

  • Prestige System – Reset your progress to permanently boost your base upgrade power with multipliers and raise upgrade base levels. Each prestige makes the next run noticeably stronger.

  • Tiers Difficulty – Complete specific objectives to ascend to higher Tiers. Each new Tier ramps up the danger—and the rewards.

  • Perk System – Unlock passive skills and unique bonuses based on your total enemies defeated. The more you kill, the more specialized your build becomes.

  • Boss Waves – Summon massive, high-risk waves at will. Defeat the boss to claim exclusive rewards that normal cubes never drop.

  • Minimalist. Neon. Satisfying. – No clutter. No distraction. Just a grid, vivid cubes, sharp particle effects, and clean UI. It looks simple. It plays deep.

Add Idle Defense to your wishlist and dive into the neon grind very soon!

store_data.about_the_game:
About Hearts in Open Water


Hearts in Open Water is an adult romance visual novel set aboard M/Y Halcyon, a 55-meter superyacht working a high-pressure Mediterranean charter season while quietly preparing for a looming sale. You play as Reeve, a disciplined ex-Royal Navy captain whose authority is absolute on the water—and whose job depends on a single line in a closing memo.

Over twelve weeks of procedures, port calls, and midnight requests that never make it into the official log, three women step across thresholds only the captain controls. Choose one route, live one romance—and learn what a season-ending decision really costs.

Meet the Cast




Cosima — The Owner's Suite
Cosima Lasry is the perfectly photographed wife of a hedge-fund titan—and the most strategic person on the yacht. As her marriage approaches a contractual deadline, she begins using the vessel's routines to carve out an escape that no one is allowed to notice. To Reeve, she is both principal and pressure point: a woman who understands his discretion, and knows exactly how to ask for it.



Anouk — The Survey
A senior yacht sales broker with a six-figure commission on the line, Anouk boards Halcyon as the buyer's observer—clipboard in hand, reputation sharpened to a blade. Her closing memo contains a retention line that can keep Reeve in command or quietly end his tenure. Their relationship is a controlled collision of ambition and attraction: two people trained to keep everything on record, tempted by what happens when the record is closed.



Tully — The Interior
Promoted to Chief Stewardess on Reeve's signature, Tully runs the yacht's luxury like a mission—fast, flawless, and almost invisible until she chooses not to be. Behind the polished service is a private urgency: her sister's chemo back in Brisbane, paid for by the very season she cannot afford to leave. With Reeve, her romance is built on mutual competence and late-night honesty—two professionals choosing each other in the only gaps the job allows.

Key Features


  • Single-choice romance routes with high-stakes intimacy: commit to one love interest and follow a focused, escalating relationship shaped by your decision.
  • A superyacht romance grounded in power, protocol, and consequence: maritime law, chain of command, and professional distance are the central tension.
  • The Logbook as a living threat: what gets recorded, what gets omitted, and what can never be erased drives the story's suspense.
  • Three distinct romantic arcs, three distinct worlds: The Interior, The Survey, and The Owner's Suite.
  • A seasonal clock you cannot stop: the sale closes, the charter ends, and the vessel moves on—no matter what you choose.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Galaxiwilds is a narrative-driven space exploration experience focused on discovery, first contact, and uncovering the unknown.

Reality is breaking.

Across multiple universes, rifts tear through space, black holes behave unpredictably, and entire systems collapse without warning. These phenomena are not random—they are connected.

Your mission is not to conquer.
It is to understand.

Travel between universes, chart strange systems, and make contact with 75 unique alien civilizations, each with their own culture, history, technology, and perspective on the unfolding crisis.

Some will share knowledge.
Some will grant you new abilities.
Some will offer allies you can call upon—individuals with their own personalities, insights, and stories to tell.

As your network grows, so does your understanding of what lies beyond the rifts… and what may be causing them.

But this is not a guided journey.

Clues are not handed to you. Coordinates are not saved. Information must be observed, remembered, and recorded.

The truth is out there—but only if you’re paying attention.

store_data.about_the_game:
Medieval vs Machines is an incremental tower defense auto-battler about building a medieval army to defend your castle against a massive invasion of machines from another dimension.

Your kingdom was peaceful… until the sky split open and strange mechanical armies came pouring through. Robots, cyber soldiers, tanks, and war machines now march toward your land. Your only choice is to raise an army, strengthen your defenses, and fight back.

Build your forces from humble medieval troops into a powerful fantasy army. Recruit warriors, lancers, archers, knights, and even mighty monsters to protect your castle. Every unit has a role in battle, and every upgrade brings you closer to surviving the next wave.

Build Your Medieval Army

Start small, then grow into a full battlefield force. Add more troops, improve their stats, and unlock new ways to fight the machine horde.

Train and upgrade:

  • Sword-wielding warriors

  • Long-range archers

  • Charging lancers

  • Heavy armored knights

  • Powerful fantasy monsters

  • Defensive towers and castle upgrades

As your army grows, battles become larger, louder, and more chaotic.

Defend Against the Machine Horde

The machines do not stop. Each wave brings more enemies, stronger units, and deadlier attacks. Fight against robotic soldiers, futuristic weapons, armored vehicles, and cybernetic monsters from another dimension.

Your medieval army may look simple, but with the right upgrades, even swords and bows can stand against steel and lasers.

Incremental Progression

Medieval vs Machines is built around satisfying incremental growth. Earn resources from battle, spend them on upgrades, and come back stronger every wave.

Upgrade your troops, improve your castle, unlock new units, and push deeper into the machine invasion. Every run makes your army stronger and your defenses harder to break.

Unlock Skill Trees

Customize your strategy through skill trees. Improve your troops, boost your towers, unlock special upgrades, and shape your army around your favorite playstyle.

Focus on overwhelming numbers, powerful elite units, stronger defenses, faster attacks, or monster-based chaos.

Massive Auto-Battler Battles

Once the battle begins, your army fights automatically. Watch huge pixel-art battles unfold as medieval soldiers clash against futuristic machines.

Battles can grow into massive 100 vs 100+ fights filled with arrows, blades, bullets, explosions, monsters, and robots.

Your job is to prepare the army.
Their job is to hold the line.

Charming Pixel Art Style

Enjoy a fun contrast between cute medieval fantasy units and colorful cyberpunk machines. The battlefield is full of personality, from tiny knights and archers to giant monsters and mechanical invaders.

  • Auto-battler style combat

  • Build and upgrade a medieval army

  • Defend your castle against machine hordes

  • Recruit warriors, lancers, archers, knights, and monsters

  • Unlock skill trees and customize your troops

  • Large-scale 100 vs 100+ pixel-art battles

  • Medieval fantasy vs cyberpunk machine theme

  • Charming pixel art and chaotic battlefield action

Defend the Castle

The machines want your land.
Your army stands in their way.

Build your kingdom. Upgrade your troops. Hold the castle.

This is your land. Defend it.
